ranking_policy: Source priority plus recency; curated view balances topics and caps each source. Not popularity or proof verification.

items.title: Why and how to transparently disclose AI use in mathematics research
items.excerpt: With the goal of standardising AI disclosures, I argue for the inclusion of maximally transparent AI disclosures in mathematics research. I provide concrete and actionable guiding principles, a taxonomy and a LaTeX package for implementation.
items.title_zh: 为什么以及如何透明地披露人工智能在数学研究中的使用
items.excerpt_zh: 为了标准化人工智能披露的目标，我主张在数学研究中纳入最大程度透明的人工智能披露。我提供了具体且可操作的指导原则、分类法和用于实施的 LaTeX 包。

items.title: Math2038: A Day in the Life of Future Mathematicians
items.excerpt: A short story (8 min read) about one Friday in 2038: AI has become extremely capable at mathematics, yet a professor, a postdoc and a first-year student still find meaning and joy in their craft.
items.title_zh: Math2038：未来数学家生活中的一天
items.excerpt_zh: 一个关于 2038 年某个星期五的短篇故事（阅读 8 分钟）：人工智能在数学方面已经变得非常有能力，但教授、博士后和一年级学生仍然在自己的技艺中找到意义和乐趣。

items.title: Responsibility of Mathematicians in the Age of AI
items.excerpt: “The day mathematics felt different to me was sometime in July. Until the beginning of this year, I had mostly avoided AI, hoping the hype would blow over. Anyway, the models hallucinated too much to be very useful. Then something changed. They got better, very very quickly.” […]
items.title_zh: 人工智能时代数学家的责任
items.excerpt_zh: “七月份的某个时候，我对数学感到不一样。直到今年年初，我基本上都回避人工智能，希望炒作能够平息。无论如何，这些模型产生了太多幻觉，不太有用。然后事情发生了变化。它们变得更好，非常非常快。” […]

items.title: Forcing square with small conditions
items.excerpt: We show that if $\kappa^{<\kappa} = \kappa$, then there is a $\kappa$-strategically closed, $\kappa^+$-c.c. partial order that forces $\square_\kappa$. We discuss consequences for generic large cardinals.
items.title_zh: 小条件下强制平方
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，如果 $\kappa^{<\kappa} = \kappa$，则存在 $\kappa$-策略关闭，$\kappa^+$-c.c。强制 $\square_\kappa$ 的偏序。我们讨论一般大基数的后果。

items.title: Counting Markov triples and simple geodesics
items.excerpt: We give an asymptotic formula for the number of Markov triples with largest entry below $x$. We show that the error term is $o(\log x)$, which improves upon the previous best known results due to McShane and Rivin. We give an explicit error based on classical zero-free regions of the Riemann zeta function, and a sharper estimate under the quasi-Riemann hypothesis. The proof uses the correspondence between Markov triples and simple closed geodesics on the modular punctured torus and a careful analysis of the McShane-Rivin unit ball.
items.title_zh: 计算马尔可夫三元组和简单测地线
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了最大条目低于 $x$ 的马尔可夫三元组数量的渐近公式。我们证明误差项是 $o(\log x)$，它改进了 McShane 和 Rivin 先前最知名的结果。我们给出了基于黎曼 zeta 函数的经典无零区域的显式误差，以及拟黎曼假设下的更清晰的估计。该证明使用了马尔可夫三元组与模穿孔环面上的简单闭合测地线之间的对应关系以及对 McShane-Rivin 单位球的仔细分析。

items.title: Uniform local models of quasi-unipotent $p$-adic differential equations
items.excerpt: We construct uniform analytic models of quasi-unipotent differential modules over Robba rings. For modules of rank at most $r$ and highest ramification break at most $b$, the inner radius of the model annulus depends only on $r,b$ and the residue characteristic $p$. At each radius, the model admits a basis, possibly depending on the radius, in which the connection matrix is bounded by a constant depending only on $r,b,p$. Both bounds are independent of the coefficient field, and these analytic models require no coefficient extension. A prescribed absolute Frobenius structure extends to such a bounded model with the same radius and connection bound. After a finite coefficient extension, we also realize quasi-constant modules, which carry the finite local monodromy, as differential direct summands of sums of pushforwards of rank-one modules, with uniformly bounded cover degrees and highest breaks of the inducing modules.
items.title_zh: 拟单能$p$-adic微分方程的均匀局部模型
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构建了 Robba 环上准单能微分模的一致解析模型。对于等级最多为 $r$ 且最高分枝断点最多为 $b$ 的模块，模型环的内半径仅取决于 $r,b$ 和残差特征 $p$。在每个半径处，模型承认一个基，可能取决于半径，其中连接矩阵由仅取决于 $r,b,p$ 的常数界定。两个界限都独立于系数场，并且这些解析模型不需要系数扩展。规定的绝对弗罗贝尼乌斯结构扩展到具有相同半径和连接边界的有界模型。经过有限系数扩展后，我们还实现了准常数模块，它具有有限局部单性，作为一级模块的前推和的微分直加数，具有均匀有界的覆盖度和归纳模块的最高中断。

items.title: Hankel determinants for the $(n+2)$-shifted $q$-metallic numbers
items.excerpt: Let $\Phi_n(q)$ denote the $q$-deformation (in the sense of Morier-Genoud & Ovsienko) of the metallic number $\phi_n=\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$. This is a power series with integer coefficients. We prove that the Hankel continued fraction of the $(n+2)$-shifted series $\Phi_n^{(n+2)}$ is eventually periodic, and that the corresponding Hankel determinant sequence $\Delta^{(n+2)}$ is $2n(n+1)$-periodic if $n$ is even, $2n(n+1)$-antiperiodic if $n$ is odd, and that it takes only the values $-2,-1,0,1,2$. This confirms part of a former conjecture of ours and complements similar results we obtained for all $\ell$-shifts of $\Phi_n$ with $0\le\ell\le n+1$. In addition, we formulate a new conjecture of quasi-polynomiality for higher shifts $\ell\ge n+3$. The determinant values arise as telescoping products of the partial numerators of the Hankel continued fraction. Most of the technically involved and lengthy verifications are carried out by a symbolic computation program, whose code is publicly available on GitHub for independent verification.
items.title_zh: $(n+2)$ 移动的 $q$ 金属数的 Hankel 行列式
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\Phi_n(q)$ 表示金属数 $\phi_n=\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$ 的 $q$ 变形（在 Morier-Genoud 和 Ovsienko 的意义上）。这是具有整数系数的幂级数。我们证明$(n+2)$平移级数$\Phi_n^{(n+2)}$的汉克尔连分式最终是周期的，并且相应的汉克尔行列式序列$\Delta^{(n+2)}$是$2n(n+1)$-周期如果$n$是偶数，$2n(n+1)$-反周期如果$n$是奇数，并且它只需要值$-2,-1,0,1,2$。这证实了我们之前猜想的一部分，并补充了我们对 $\Phi_n$ 与 $0\le\ell\le n+1$ 的所有 $\ell$-shifts 获得的类似结果。此外，我们针对更高的位移 $\ell\ge n+3$ 提出了一个新的拟多项式猜想。行列式值作为汉克尔连分数的部分分子的伸缩乘积而出现。大多数涉及技术且冗长的验证都是通过符号计算程序进行的，其代码在 GitHub 上公开可供独立验证。

items.title: Computations in weight 3 of higher Bloch groups
items.excerpt: We computationally investigate a weight 3 analogue of the relationship between higher Bloch groups, algebraic K-theory, higher regulators, and special values of Dedekind zeta functions. In particular, for F a number field F, we define the pruned Bloch group B _3(F) and compare the covolume of its regulator lattice with zeta_F(3). We define a quantity kappa_3(F), which is conjecturally an integer, that is expected to be closely related to the order of K_4(O_F).
items.authors: Herbert Gangl, Paul E. Gunnells, Dan Yasaki
items.title_zh: 更高 Bloch 群的权重 3 的计算
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过计算研究了高级布洛赫群、代数 K 理论、高级调节器和 Dedekind zeta 函数的特殊值之间关系的权重 3 类似物。特别是，对于 F 数域 F，我们定义剪枝的布洛赫群 B _3(F) 并将其调节晶格的余体积与 zeta_F(3) 进行比较。我们定义一个量 kappa_3(F)，推测它是一个整数，预计与 K_4(O_F) 的阶数密切相关。

items.title: Infinite families and sporadic solutions of the equation $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$
items.excerpt: Ranjan and Singh proved that for every composite $n$ which is not twice an odd prime, $\varphi(n)$ is at least one plus the sum of $\varphi$ over the prime divisors of $n$, with equality exactly for $n=4,12,30$. \new{We study the weighted equation $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$. We determine the parameters $(c,\alpha)$ admitting infinite families of solutions, prove that all remaining solutions are finite in number and arise from an explicit linear mechanism, and compute them exactly in a range of parameters; the finiteness of $\{4,12,30\}$ becomes a special case. We also settle the analogous equations for the divisor functions $\tau$ and $\sigma$ and for the Jordan totients, and, from known results on the sum of the prime divisors, derive the full asymptotic expansion of the average deficiency.} \K{In the range $|c|\le10$, $1\le\alpha\le6$ the composite solution set is determined completely\V{, and the number and the size of the sporadic solutions are shown to be bounded by polynomials in $|c|+\alpha$}.} \B{Finally, replacing the prime values $\varphi(p)$ by their iterates $\varphi^{(k)}(p)$, we determine all solutions
items.authors: Hac\`ene Belbachir, Ravi Ranjan, Shubh N. Singh
items.title_zh: 方程的无限族和零星解 $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$
items.excerpt_zh: Ranjan 和 Singh 证明，对于每个不是奇素数两倍的复合 $n$，$\varphi(n)$ 至少是 $\varphi$ 与 $n$ 素数因数之和的一加上，对于 $n=4,12,30$ 完全相等。 \new{我们研究加权方程$\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$。我们确定允许无限族解的参数$(c,\alpha)$，证明所有剩余的解在数量上是有限的并且由显式线性机制产生，并在参数范围内精确地计算它们； $\{4,12,30\}$ 的有限性成为一种特殊情况。我们还解决了除数函数 $\tau$ 和 $\sigma$ 以及 Jordan totients 的类似方程，并根据素因数之和的已知结果，推导出平均缺陷的完全渐近展开式。} \K{在 $|c|\le10$、$1\le\alpha\le6$ 范围内，复合解集完全确定\V{，并且零星解的数量和大小显示为有界通过 $|c|+\alpha$} 中的多项式。} \B{最后，将素数 $\varphi(p)$ 替换为其迭代 $\varphi^{(k)}(p)$，我们确定所有解

items.title: Retriangular numbers and affine maps between polygonal numbers
items.excerpt: A positive integer $a$ is called \emph{retriangular} if there is a positive integer $b$ such that $aT+b$ is a triangular number whenever $T$ is. We show that the retriangular numbers are exactly the odd squares greater than $1$, and that for each of them $b$ is unique. The proof rests on a rigidity principle: a non-constant affine map carrying the values of one quadratic sequence into the values of another is induced by an affine map of the plane sending the vertex of one parabola to the vertex of the other. We use it to classify all affine maps between sets of polygonal numbers; the $s$-gonal numbers map affinely into the $t$-gonal numbers if and only if $M_t\mid M_s$, where $M_s=2(s-2)/\gcd(s,4)$ defines a bijection from $\{3,4,5,\dots\}$ onto the positive integers. We also treat sparse data, polynomial maps, figurate numbers of higher degree and sums of two triangular numbers, and we study the monoid of affine self-maps of an arbitrary set of integers. For the $s$-gonal numbers this monoid is an arithmetical congruence monoid, and the factorization of self-maps into irreducible ones is unique only for triangular and square numbers.
items.title_zh: 直角三角形数和多边形数之间的仿射映射
items.excerpt_zh: 如果存在正整数 $b$，使得只要 $T$ 为三角数，$aT+b$ 就是三角数，则正整数 $a$ 称为 \emph{retriangular}。我们证明，再三角数正是大于 $1$ 的奇数平方，并且每个 $b$ 都是唯一的。该证明基于刚性原理：将一个二次序列的值传递到另一个二次序列的值中的非恒定仿射图是由将一个抛物线的顶点发送到另一个抛物线的顶点的平面仿射图导出的。我们用它来对多边形数集之间的所有仿射映射进行分类；当且仅当 $M_t\mid M_s$ 时，$s$-gonal 数会亲和地映射到 $t$-gonal 数，其中 $M_s=2(s-2)/\gcd(s,4)$ 定义从 $\{3,4,5,\dots\}$ 到正整数的双射。我们还处理稀疏数据、多项式映射、更高阶的图形数以及两个三角形数的和，并且我们研究任意整数集的仿射自映射的幺半群。对于 $s$-gonal 数，这个幺半群是算术同余幺半群，并且将自映射分解为不可约的幺半群仅对于三角形和平方数是唯一的。

items.title: Pointwise to global good reduction problems
items.excerpt: Given a smooth proper family of varieties over some $p$-adic field, if (sufficiently many of) the closed fibers have good reduction, does the family as a whole have good reduction? This question is asked and positively answered in recent work of Cadoret-Tamagawa for curves in general, and abelian varieties if the base field has absolute ramification at most $p-1$. In this paper we define a general framework for studying this question, yielding new positive answers for families of K3 surfaces and cubic fourfoulds, again with ramification at most $p-1$. Our strategy is to study several extension properties of moduli spaces and how they transfer under various morphisms. Of particular importance are integral canonical models of Shimura varieties, and whether or not their extension properties are preserved under ramified scalar extension. Additionally, building on earlier counterexamples by Raynaud-Ogus-Gabber and Vasiu-Zink, we show that the ramification assumption is optimal for the result of Cadoret-Tamagawa on families of abelian varieties. This reflects the fact that the extension property of Siegel Shimura varieties no longer holds o
items.title_zh: 针对全球商品减少问题
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个在某些 $p$-adic 域上的光滑真值族，如果（足够多的）闭合纤维具有良好的还原性，那么该族作为一个整体是否具有良好的还原性？如果基场的绝对分枝至多为 $p-1$，则在 Cadoret-Tamakawa 最近针对一般曲线和阿贝尔变体的工作中提出了这个问题并得到了积极的回答。在本文中，我们定义了一个研究这个问题的总体框架，为 K3 曲面族和立方四元组提供新的肯定答案，同样具有最多 $p-1$ 的分支。我们的策略是研究模空间的几个可拓性质以及它们在各种态射下如何转移。特别重要的是 Shimura 簇的积分规范模型，以及它们的可拓特性是否在分支标量可拓下得以保留。此外，基于 Raynaud-Ogus-Gabber 和 Vasiu-Zink 的早期反例，我们表明分枝假设对于 Cadoret-Tamakawa 对阿贝尔变种家族的结果是最优的。这反映了这样一个事实：Siegel Shimura 品种的可拓性质不再成立。

items.title: Gross--Prasad conjecture in geometric Langlands
items.excerpt: We prove part of the global Gross--Prasad conjecture for $G = \mathrm{SO}_{n} \times \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ and $H = \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ in the unramified de Rham geometric Langlands setting proposed by Ben-Zvi--Sakellaridis--Venkatesh.
items.title_zh: 格罗斯--几何朗兰兹中的普拉萨德猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在 Ben-Zvi--Sakellaridis--Venkatesh 提出的未分支 de Rham 几何 Langlands 设置中证明了 $G = \mathrm{SO}_{n} \times \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ 和 $H = \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ 的全局 Gross--Prasad 猜想的一部分。

items.title: Average eccentricity in k-connected tournaments
items.excerpt: The average eccentricity $\avec(D)$ of a strong digraph $D$ is the mean eccentricity of all vertices in $D$. A tournament $T$ is an orientation of a complete graph. In this paper, we prove that the average eccentricity satisfies $2 \le \avec(T) < \frac{n}{2k} + \frac{11}{2} + \frac{k}{8n}$ for a $k$-connected tournament $T$ of order $n$. We further examine the case for strong tournaments where $k = 1$, and show that $\avec(T) \le \frac{n+11}{2} + \frac{1}{8n}$ for any strong tournament $T$. Moreover, we show that the lower bound $2$ is sharp and that the upper bounds are best possible apart from an additive constant.
items.title_zh: k 连接锦标赛中的平均偏心率
items.excerpt_zh: 强有向图 $D$ 的平均偏心率 $\avec(D)$ 是 $D$ 中所有顶点的平均偏心率。锦标赛 $T$ 是完整图的一个方向。在本文中，我们证明对于 $n$ 阶的 $k$ 连接锦标赛 $T$，平均偏心率满足 $2 \le \avec(T) < \frac{n}{2k} + \frac{11}{2} + \frac{k}{8n}$。我们进一步研究 $k = 1$ 的强锦标赛的情况，并表明对于任何强锦标赛 $T$ 都有 $\avec(T) \le \frac{n+11}{2} + \frac{1}{8n}$。此外，我们表明下限 $2$ 是尖锐的，并且除了加性常数之外，上限是最好的。

items.title: On Hamilton cycles in quasiprimitive graphs of order $2pq$
items.excerpt: Let $p>q>5$ be primes. We determine the socles and corresponding actions of quasiprimitive imprimitive groups of degree $2pq$, all of which are almost simple. Using this classification, we prove that a connected graph of order $2pq$ admitting a quasiprimitive automorphism group contains a Hamilton cycle, except possibly for three specified families of actions with socle $\PSL(2,p)$ or $\PSL(2,q^2)$.
items.title_zh: 论 $2pq$ 阶准原图中的哈密顿循环
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $p>q>5$ 为素数。我们确定$2pq$阶的准原初群的底点和相应的动作，所有这些都几乎是简单的。使用此分类，我们证明承认准原语自同构群的 $2pq$ 阶连通图包含汉密尔顿循环，除了可能具有底 $\PSL(2,p)$ 或 $\PSL(2,q^2)$ 的三个指定的动作族。

items.title: A generalization of pseudocomplementation in semilattices, lattices and posets with 0
items.excerpt: Pseudocomplemented lattices satisfy a lot of nice properties and were studied by a number of algebraists. However, even when a poset P with 0 is not pseudocomplemented, we can assign to every element a of P the set $a^p$ of all maximal elements being orthogonal to a. This assignment $^p$ is a non-trivial operator provided P satisfies the so-called Ascending Chain Condition (ACC). In particular, we investigate this operator when the poset P in question is a semilattice or a lattice. We characterize this operator and describe its properties that turn out to be similar to the corresponding properties of pseudocomplementation. Moreover, we introduce an equivalence relation $\Theta_p$ on P induced by $^p$ similarly as it was done by V. I. Glivenko for distributive pseudocomplemented lattices. Finally, we investigate for which lattices L with 0 satisfying the ACC this equivalence relation turns out to be a congruence and when the quotient lattice $L/\Theta_p$ is complemented respectively modular.
items.title_zh: 半格、格和 0 偏序集中伪补的推广
items.excerpt_zh: 伪补格满足许多良好的性质，并被许多代数学家研究。然而，即使当具有 0 的偏序集 P 不是伪补集时，我们也可以将与 a 正交的所有最大元素的集合 $a^p$ 分配给 P 的每个元素 a。如果 P 满足所谓的升序链条件 (ACC)，则此赋值 $^p$ 是一个不平凡的运算符。特别是，当所讨论的偏序集 P 是半格或格时，我们研究该算子。我们描述了该运算符的特征并描述了其与伪互补的相应属性相似的属性。此外，我们在 P 上引入了由 $^p$ 引发的等价关系 $\Theta_p$，类似于 V. I. Glivenko 对于分配伪补格的做法。最后，我们研究对于哪些具有 0 的格 L 满足 ACC，该等价关系被证明是同余的，以及商格 $L/\Theta_p$ 何时分别模补。

items.title: Existence of uniformly most reliable two-terminal graphs with distance constraints
items.excerpt: A two-terminal graph is a simple graph equipped with two distinguished vertices, called terminals. Let $T_{n,m}$ be the class consisting of all non-isomorphic two-terminal graphs on $n$ vertices and $m$ edges. Let $G$ be any two-terminal graph in $T_{n,m}$, and let $d$ be any positive integer. For every $\rho\in [0,1]$, the \emph{$d$-constrained two-terminal reliability of $G$ at $\rho$}, denoted $R_G^d(\rho)$, is the probability that $G$ has some path of length at most $d$ joining its terminals after each of its edges is independently deleted with probability $\rho$. We say $G$ is a \emph{$d$-uniformly most reliable two-terminal graph} ($d$-UMRTTG) if for each $H$ in $T_{n,m}$ and every $\rho \in [0,1]$ it holds that $R_{G}^d(\rho)\geq R_{H}^{d}(\rho)$. Previous works studied the existence of $d$-UMRTTG in $T_{n,m}$ when $d$ is greater than or equal to $n-1$, or equivalently, when the distance constraint is dropped. In this work, a characterization of all $1$-UMRTTGs and $2$-UMRTTGs is given. Several structural properties of 3-UMRTTGs are established. items.title_zh: 存在距离约束的一致最可靠的两端图
items.excerpt_zh: 二端图是一个简单的图，配有两个不同的顶点，称为终端。令 $T_{n,m}$ 为由 $n$ 个顶点和 $m$ 个边上的所有非同构二端图组成的类。令$G$ 为$T_{n,m}$ 中的任意二端图，并令$d$ 为任意正整数。对于 [0,1]$ 中的每个 $\rho\，$G$ 在 $\rho$} 处的 \emph{$d$ 约束两端可靠性，表示为 $R_G^d(\rho)$，是在以概率 $\rho$ 独立删除其每条边后，$G$ 具有某个长度至多 $d$ 的路径连接其终端的概率。如果对于 $T_{n,m}$ 中的每个 $H$ 和 [0,1]$ 中的每个 $\rho \in 都认为 $R_{G}^d(\rho)\geq R_{H}^{d}(\rho)$，我们说 $G$ 是一个 \emph{$d$-一致最可靠的二端图} ($d$-UMRTTG)。以前的工作研究了当$d$大于或等于$n-1$时，或者等效地，当距离约束被删除时，$T_{n,m}$中$d$-UMRTTG的存在性。在这项工作中，给出了所有 $1$-UMRTTG 和 $2$-UMRTTG 的特征。 3-UMRTTG 的几个结构特性已确定。对于每个 $d\geq 3$，我们证明 $T_{n,\binom{ 中存在唯一的 $d$-UMRTTG

items.title: Trace-minimal graphs maximizing the number of spanning trees
items.excerpt:
A classical problem in spectral graph theory is to determine, among all simple graphs with a fixed number of vertices and edges, those that maximize the number of spanning trees. Such graphs are called $t$-optimal. Petingi and Rodr'iguez [Discr. u$-min graphs. They conjectured that the class of $d$-regular $

items.title: A new infinite family of covers of complete graphs that admit a half-transitive action of a Suzuki simple group
items.excerpt: We construct a new infinite family of antipodal $2(q-1)$-covers of complete graphs $K_{q^2+1}$ of diameter $3$, where $q=2^{2e+1}\ge 8$, admitting a half-transitive action of the Suzuki simple group $Sz(q)$. We further show that each constructed cover admits an involutory automorphism interchanging the two $Sz(q)$-orbits on arcs, which yields that its full automorphism group is arc-transitive.
items.title_zh: 一个新的无限族完全图覆盖，承认铃木简单群的半传递作用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构建了一个新的无限族对映体 $2(q-1)$ - 覆盖了直径为 $3$ 的完整图 $K_{q^2+1}$，其中 $q=2^{2e+1}\ge 8$，承认铃木单群 $Sz(q)$ 的半传递作用。我们进一步表明，每个构造的覆盖都承认一个内卷自同构，交换弧上的两个 $Sz(q)$ 轨道，这使得它的完整自同构群是弧传递的。

items.title: Mutation-acyclicity in rank four is decidable but not semialgebraic
items.excerpt: We prove that mutation-acyclicity of quivers on four vertices is decidable. If a four-vertex quiver $Q$ is mutation-acyclic, then some sequence of mutations takes it to an acyclic quiver without any arrow multiplicity exceeding $\operatorname{max}\{\operatorname{ht}(Q),m(Q)\}$, where $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ is the largest arrow multiplicity of $Q$ and $m(Q)$ is the Markov invariant of Fomin and Neville evaluated on the totally proper wiggle class of $Q$. A search within a computable form of this bound decides mutation-acyclicity of four-vertex quivers with $O(h^{24})$ states for input height $h\ge1$. Together with a theorem of Caldero and Keller, it also decides mutation equivalence of two four-vertex quivers up to relabeling whenever one of them is mutation-acyclic. We conjecture that $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ alone suffices as the bound, which would reduce the search to $O(h^{6})$ states, and we verify this for all four-vertex quivers of height at most three. In the other direction, for every $n\ge4$ we construct an affine family of connected $n$-vertex quivers whose nonnegative even members are mutation-acyclic and whose positive odd m
items.authors: Kymani T. K. Armstrong-Williams, Edward Hirst, Blake Jackson, Kyu-Hwan Lee
items.title_zh: 第四级的突变无循环性是可判定的，但不是半代数的
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了四个顶点上的箭袋的突变无环性是可判定的。如果四顶点箭袋 $Q$ 是突变无环的，则某些突变序列将其带到无环箭袋，而没有任何箭头重数超过 $\operatorname{max}\{\operatorname{ht}(Q),m(Q)\}$，其中 $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ 是 $Q$ 的最大箭头重数，$m(Q)$ 是在$Q$ 的完全正确的摆动类别。该边界的可计算形式内的搜索决定输入高度 $h\ge1$ 具有 $O(h^{24})$ 状态的四顶点箭袋的突变无环性。与卡尔德罗和凯勒定理一起，它还决定了两个四顶点箭袋的突变等价性，只要其中一个是突变无环的，就可以重新标记。我们推测 $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ 本身就足以作为边界，这会将搜索减少到 $O(h^{6})$ 状态，并且我们针对高度最多为 3 的所有四顶点箭袋验证这一点。在另一个方向上，对于每个 $n\ge4$，我们构造一个由连接的 $n$ 顶点颤动组成的仿射族，其非负偶数成员是突变无环的，其正奇数 m

items.title: On the diameter and distribution of Sidon sets
items.excerpt: A Sidon set is a set $\mathcal{A}$ of integers with the property that if $0\neq a-b=c-d$ and $a,b,c,d\in\mathcal{A}$, then $(a,b)=(c,d)$. Our main result is an improved and explicit bound on the diameter of a Sidon set: if $\mathcal{A}$ is a Sidon set with $k\ge 1$ elements, then \[\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2 \left(\frac{1}{1 + 0.945/\sqrt{k}}-\frac{0.945}{\sqrt k}\right) -1;\] in particular, $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A})\ge k^2-1.89 k^{3/2}$. This implies that if $\mathcal{A}\subseteq[1,N]$ is a Sidon set, then $|\mathcal{A}| \le N^{1/2}+0.945 \, N^{1/4}+0.447$. Our technique also gives an improved bound for the case of large $k$, namely $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2-1.88607 k^{3/2}$ for $k\ge 483$. A $\gamma$-Golomb ruler is a set $\mathcal{A}$ of integers with the property that there are not $\gamma+1$ distinct pairs $(a_i,b_i)\in\mathcal{A}^2$ with $0\neq a_1-b_1=\cdots=a_{\gamma+1}-b_{\gamma+1}$. Our diameter bounds extend in a natural way to the case of Golomb rulers. Our techniques can also be adapted to address a number of questions on the distribution of Golomb rulers: we provide upper bounds on t
items.authors: Daniel Carter, Kevin O'Bryant, Terence Tao
items.title_zh: 关于西顿集的直径和分布
items.excerpt_zh: Sidon 集是整数的集合 $\mathcal{A}$，其属性为：如果 $0\neq a-b=c-d$ 且 $a,b,c,d\in\mathcal{A}$，则 $(a,b)=(c,d)$。我们的主要结果是对 Sidon 集直径的改进和显式限制：如果 $\mathcal{A}$ 是具有 $k\ge 1$ 个元素的 Sidon 集，则 \[\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2 \left(\frac{1}{1 + 0.945/\sqrt{k}}-\frac{0.945}{\sqrt k}\right) -1;\]特别是$\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A})\ge k^2-1.89 k^{3/2}$。这意味着如果 $\mathcal{A}\subseteq[1,N]$ 是 Sidon 集，则 $|\mathcal{A}| \le N^{1/2}+0.945 \, N^{1/4}+0.447$。我们的技术还为大$k$的情况提供了改进的界限，即$\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A})\ge k^2-1.88607 k^{3/2}$ for $k\ge 483$。 $\gamma$-Golomb 标尺是一组 $\mathcal{A}$ 整数，其属性是不存在 $\gamma+1$ 不同对 $(a_i,b_i)\in\mathcal{A}^2$ 和 $0\neq a_1-b_1=\cdots=a_{\gamma+1}-b_{\gamma+1}$。我们的直径范围以自然的方式延伸到哥伦布尺的情况。我们的技术还可以适用于解决有关哥伦布标尺分布的许多问题：我们提供了 t 的上限

items.title: Elementary Moves on Ideal Webs, Local Monodromies on Hitchin Fibrations, and Tropical Mutations on $\mathrm{K_0}$ Groups
items.excerpt: This paper builds on the work of Goncharov by studying the correspondence between topological spectral covers constructed from generic $A_{m-1}$-webs with rank $m\ge2$, Hitchin spectral curves over good Hitchin loci, and the Grothendieck groups $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma})$ associated with the quivers with potential $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$ assigned to corresponding bipartite $A_{m-1}$-graphs. We show that the automorphisms on the non-frozen quiver lattices $\Lambda_{\Gamma}^{\circ}$ induced by compositions of elementary moves on ideal webs/bipartite graphs are the same as the Gauss--Manin monodromy actions on the $SL_m$ Hitchin fiber lattices $H_1(\operatorname{Prym}(\Sigma);\mathbb{Z})$ locally around discriminant loci. And the Gauss--Manin monodromy actions agree with the automorphisms on the Grothendieck groups $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma}^{\circ})$ induced by compositions of mutations on the quivers with potential $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$.
items.title_zh: 理想网的基本移动、希钦纤维的局域单频以及 $\mathrm{K_0}$ 群的热带突变
items.excerpt_zh: 本文以 Goncharov 的工作为基础，研究了由等级为 $m\ge2$ 的通用 $A_{m-1}$-网构建的拓扑谱覆盖、良好希钦位点上的希钦谱曲线以及与分配给对应的潜在 $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$ 的颤动相关的格罗滕迪克群 $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma})$ 之间的对应关系二部$A_{m-1}$图。我们证明，由理想网/二部图上的基本移动组合引起的非冻结颤动格子 $\Lambda_{\Gamma}^{\circ}$ 上的自同构与局部围绕判别式的 $SL_m$ 希钦纤维格子 $H_1(\operatorname{Prym}(\Sigma);\mathbb{Z})$ 上的高斯-马宁单向作用相同基因座。高斯-马宁单向行为与格罗腾迪克群 $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma}^{\circ})$ 上的自同构一致，该自同构是由具有潜在 $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$ 的颤动突变组合引起的。

items.title: K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group in positive characteristic
items.excerpt: We classify K3 surfaces with finite automorphism group in positive characteristic. The classification is the same as over the complex numbers, except when the base field is $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p$.
items.title_zh: 具有正特征的有限自同构群的 K3 曲面
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将具有有限自同构群的 K3 曲面分类为正特征。分类与复数的分类相同，但基字段为 $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p$ 时除外。

items.title: Motivic $C_p$-power operations in $\mathrm{MGL}$
items.excerpt: In this paper, we give a new proof of the Hopkins-Morel-Hoyois theorem for fields $k$ of characteristic unequal to $p$ containing all primitive $p$-power roots of unity for a fixed prime $p$. This new proof follows Quillen's proof for the structure of the homotopy groups of $\mathrm{MU}$ which utilizes topological power operations. To this end we define a motivic analog of the Steenrod power operations, using the theory of normed motivic spectra as developed by Bachmann--Hoyois and their application for the definition of motivic colimits as developed by Bachmann-Elmanto-Heller.
items.title_zh: Motivic $C_p$-$\mathrm{MGL}$ 中的幂运算
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们给出了霍普金斯-莫雷尔-霍约伊斯定理的新证明，该定理的特征不等于$p$的域$k$包含固定素数$p$的所有原始$p$幂单位根。这个新证明遵循 Quillen 对 $\mathrm{MU}$ 同伦群结构的证明，该结构利用了拓扑幂运算。为此，我们使用 Bachmann-Hoyois 开发的赋范动机谱理论及其在 Bachmann-Elmanto-Heller 开发的动机余极限定义中的应用，定义了 Steenrod 幂运算的动机模拟。

items.title: A vanishing-cycle obstruction to smoothing Calabi-Yau threefolds
items.excerpt: We prove a homological obstruction to smoothing projective Calabi-Yau threefolds with nodes and anticanonical cones over smooth del Pezzo surfaces of degrees six and seven. On a crepant resolution that is small over the nodes and blows up the cone vertices, any smoothing forces a relation among link classes bounding in the local Milnor fibers. The relation is nonzero at every node and degree-seven point, and at each degree-six point smoothed through the one-dimensional component. The proof uses vanishing periods and applies to smoothing arcs of arbitrary contact order, extending the necessity direction of Friedman's criterion. We apply the obstruction to a Batyrev hypersurface whose thirty singularities are individually smoothable but which admits no smoothing, even formally. On its mirror partner, two nodes cannot be smoothed by any analytic deformation, independently of a locally nonsmoothable cone point.
items.title_zh: 消失循环障碍使卡拉比-丘平滑三倍
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了在六度和七度光滑的 del Pezzo 表面上用节点和反正则锥平滑投影 Calabi-Yau 三重的同调障碍。在节点上较小且炸毁圆锥顶点的绉纹分辨率上，任何平滑都会强制局部 Milnor 纤维中边界的链接类之间的关系。该关系在每个节点和七阶点处都是非零的，并且在每个六阶点处通过一维分量进行平滑。该证明使用消失周期并应用于任意接触阶的平滑弧，扩展了弗里德曼准则的必要性方向。我们将障碍物应用于 Batyrev 超曲面，该超曲面的 30 个奇点可以单独平滑，但不允许平滑，即使是形式上也是如此。在其镜像伙伴上，两个节点无法通过任何解析变形进行平滑，独立于局部不可平滑的锥点。

items.title: Nonvanishing implies abundance
items.excerpt: We prove that the nonvanishing conjecture implies the abundance conjecture.
items.title_zh: 不消失意味着丰富
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了非零猜想蕴含着丰度猜想。

items.title: There are no unexpected toric positroid varieties
items.excerpt: Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a positroid. We prove that the positroid variety $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ is toric with respect to some algebraic torus if and only if $\mathcal{M}$ is regular. In that case, $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ is toric with respect to the standard diagonal torus. Thus, there are no unexpected toric positroid varieties.
items.title_zh: 没有意外的环面正类品种
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\mathcal{M}$ 为正类。我们证明正类变体 $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ 相对于某些代数环面是环面当且仅当 $\mathcal{M}$ 是正则的。在这种情况下，$\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ 相对于标准对角环面是复曲面。因此，不存在意外的环面正类变体。

items.title: Smoothing Calabi-Yau threefolds with nodes and del Pezzo cone points
items.excerpt: We give a necessary and sufficient homological criterion for smoothing projective Calabi-Yau threefolds with nodes and anticanonical cones over smooth del Pezzo surfaces of degrees five, six and seven, or over a smooth quadric surface. For some choice of local smoothing components, the criterion requires a relation on a crepant resolution among link classes whose associated local parameters avoid every discriminant. The complexified relation space describes first-order deformations modulo locally trivial ones. Necessity follows from local period and vanishing-cycle arguments; sufficiency applies Friedman's unobstructedness theorem to a crepant partial resolution. Whenever the criterion holds, the deformation space on the chosen components is smooth. A nonsmoothable example, whose deformation space is reduced with four smooth components, shows why nonvanishing at every singular point is insufficient. We also construct a smoothable Batyrev hypersurface admitting no smoothing induced by proper ambient families obtained from Minkowski decompositions at a single lattice degree.
items.title_zh: 使用节点和 del Pezzo 锥点对 Calabi-Yau 进行三倍平滑
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了在五度、六度和七度光滑 del Pezzo 曲面上或在光滑二次曲面上用节点和反正则锥平滑投影 Calabi-Yau 三重的必要且充分的同调准则。对于局部平滑分量的某些选择，该标准需要链接类别之间的绉纹分辨率的关系，其相关的局部参数避免每个判别式。复数关系空间描述了模局部平凡变形的一阶变形。必然性源自局部周期和消失周期论证；充分性将弗里德曼无阻碍定理应用于 crepant 部分解析。只要该准则成立，所选组件上的变形空间就是平滑的。一个不可平滑的例子，其变形空间通过四个平滑分量减少，说明了为什么每个奇点处的非消失是不够的。我们还构造了一个可平滑的 Batyrev 超曲面，不允许由单晶格度的 Minkowski 分解获得的适当环境族引起的平滑。

items.title: Finite Symplectic Automorphisms of Hyperk\"ahler Manifolds of $K3^{[n]}$-Type Act Trivially on Discriminant Groups
items.excerpt: We give an alternative proof of Mongardi's result that every finite group of symplectic automorphisms of a hyperk\"ahler manifold of $K3^{[n]}$-type acts trivially on the discriminant groups of its second cohomology lattice and its coinvariant lattice. The proof combines sphere-packing bounds, Vinberg's reflection chambers and structure results on even $2$-elementary lattices.
items.authors: Jie Fu, Shihao Wang, Zhiwei Zheng
items.title_zh: $K3^{[n]}$型Hyperk\"ahler流形的有限辛自同构对判别群的作用微不足道
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了 Mongardi 结果的另一种证明，即 $K3^{[n]}$ 类型的 hyperk\"ahler 流形的每个有限群辛自同构对它的第二上同调格和它的协变格的判别群起着微不足道的作用。该证明结合了球堆积界、Vinberg 反射室和甚至 $2$ 基本格上的结构结果。

items.title: Accelerating Langevin Dynamics with Weighted Laplacian Flow: Global Well-Posedness and Exponential Convergence
items.excerpt: We study an accelerated Langevin equation in which the classical overdamped Langevin drift is supplemented by a nonlocal gradient velocity determined through a target-weighted Poisson equation. The target $p$ is only assumed to be strictly positive and need not be normalized. Writing the dynamics in terms of $\omega=\log(p/q)$ yields a coupled parabolic-elliptic system whose parabolic component contains the usual Langevin diffusion, whereas the elliptic component generates a global transport. The system is invariant under multiplication of $p$ by a positive constant. On a bounded smooth domain with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions, we establish global existence and uniqueness of classical solutions for strictly positive $C^{2+\alpha}$ target weights and compatible $C^{2+\alpha}$ initial data. For long-time behavior, the oscillation of $\omega$ decays at the explicit rate $e^{-t}$ and the solution density exponentially converges to target density. Moreover, an exact entropy-dissipation identity holds relative to the target density, in which the relative Fisher information and the Jeffreys divergence give the two dissipation mech
items.authors: Ziyue Cai, Weiye Gan, Borui Miao, Zuoqiang Shi
items.title_zh: 使用加权拉普拉斯流加速 Langevin 动力学：全局适定性和指数收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了加速朗之万方程，其中经典过阻尼朗之万漂移由通过目标加权泊松方程确定的非局部梯度速度进行补充。目标 $p$ 仅被假设为严格正数，无需标准化。用 $\omega=\log(p/q)$ 编写动力学会产生一个耦合的抛物线-椭圆系统，其抛物线分量包含通常的朗之万扩散，而椭圆分量则生成全局传输。该系统在 $p$ 乘以正常数的情况下保持不变。在具有齐次诺依曼边界条件的有界光滑域上，我们为严格正的 $C^{2+\alpha}$ 目标权重和兼容的 $C^{2+\alpha}$ 初始数据建立了经典解的全局存在性和唯一性。对于长时间行为， $\omega$ 的振荡以显式速率 $e^{-t}$ 衰减，并且解密度以指数方式收敛到目标密度。此外，精确的熵耗散恒等式相对于目标密度成立，其中相对费舍尔信息和杰弗里斯散度给出了两个耗散机制

items.title: Using the Blackwell-Cover Guessing Strategy to Separate Unobserved Bernoulli Trials - II
items.excerpt: In a prior paper, we investigated what could be said about the number in the pair that was not observed when we employed the BlackwellCover Guessing Strategy. In this paper, we generalize prior results to arbitrary distributions. We use a variant of the BlackwellCover strategy ro take pairs of coins chosen from a mixture of two different distributions G and H such that one of the coins is flipped, and as a result of that flip the unobserved (unflipped) coin is placed in one of two sets A and B. We show that, regardless of which distributions are used for G and H, there are situations in which this can be done so that the mean of the heads probabilities of the unobserved coins in A is less than the mean of the heads probabilities of the unobserved coins in B. What makes this result surprising, in addition to its generality, is a comparison with a corresponding result for marbles. If one knows that one will always be weighing one of two marbles with different specific weights, such as 10g and 20g, knowing the weight of the marble being weighed automatically determines the weight of the other. items.title_zh: 使用 Blackwell-Cover 猜测策略来分离未观察到的伯努利试验 - II
items.excerpt_zh: 在之前的一篇论文中，我们研究了当我们采用 BlackwellCover 猜测策略时未观察到的对中的数字可以说的内容。在本文中，我们将先验结果推广到任意分布。我们使用 BlackwellCover 策略的变体，即从两种不同分布 G 和 H 的混合中选择一对硬币，其中一枚硬币被翻转，并且作为翻转的结果，未观察到的（未翻转的）硬币被放置在两组 A 和 B 中的一组中。我们表明，无论 G 和 H 使用哪种分布，在某些情况下都可以这样做，以便 A 中未观察到的硬币的正面概率的平均值小于B 中未观察到的硬币的正面概率的平均值。除了其普遍性之外，这个结果令人惊讶的原因还在于与弹珠的相应结果的比较。如果知道人们总是会称量两颗不同重量（例如 10 克和 20 克）的弹珠中的一颗，那么知道被称重的弹珠的重量就会自动确定另一颗弹珠的重量。然而，即使知道自己会

items.title: Non-local to local limit for stochastic conservation laws
items.excerpt: This work proves the convergence of stochastic nonlocal conservation laws, with spatially inhomogeneous noise, to stochastic conservation laws when the range of particle interaction vanishes. This provides rigorous justification for a class of stochastic conservation laws that has received considerable attention in the last decade. To handle technical challenges such as gradient-dependent noise, modified versions of the equations with specific cutoff boundaries are utilized and new uniform estimates to ensure stability during the limiting process are established. In addition, the work demonstrates that this convergence depends on the presence of a viscous term, as a counterexample shows that without it, the limiting solution may fail to be an entropy solution.
items.title_zh: 随机守恒定律的非局部到局部极限
items.excerpt_zh: 这项工作证明了当粒子相互作用范围消失时，具有空间不均匀噪声的随机非局域守恒定律收敛于随机守恒定律。这为一类在过去十年中受到广泛关注的随机守恒定律提供了严格的理由。为了应对梯度相关噪声等技术挑战，使用了具有特定截止边界的方程的修改版本，并建立了新的统一估计以确保限制过程中的稳定性。此外，该工作表明，这种收敛取决于粘性项的存在，反例表明，如果没有粘性项，极限解可能无法成为熵解。

items.title: A note on the Besov spaces ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$
items.excerpt: Regarding the Besov space ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$, defined by S. Geiss and Ylinen (Memoirs AMS 1335, 2021) by a coupling method, we prove for $\xi\in{\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2} \cap L_2$ a distributional estimate in terms of the Lorentz-Zygmund space $L_{1,\infty}(\ln L)^{-1}$ for the Malliavin derivative ${\rm D}(T_u\xi)$ uniformly in $u>0$, where $(T_u)_{u\ge }$ is the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semi-group. Here $\xi$ is not necessarily Malliavin differentiable in the ${\rm D}_{1,1}$-sense. This provides for Theorem 4.22 of the aforementioned reference an extension to the borderline case $p=1$.
items.title_zh: 关于 Besov 空间的注释 ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$
items.excerpt_zh: 关于由 S. Geiss 和 Ylinen (Memoirs AMS 1335, 2021) 通过耦合方法定义的 Besov 空间 ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$，我们证明 $\xi\in{\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2} \cap L_2$ 是 Lorentz-Zygmund 空间的分布估计$L_{1,\infty}(\ln L)^{-1}$ 为 Malliavin 导数 ${\rm D}(T_u\xi)$ 均匀地在 $u>0$ 中，其中 $(T_u)_{u\ge }$ 是 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 半群。这里 $\xi$ 不一定是 Malliavin 在 ${\rm D}_{1,1}$ 意义上可微的。这为上述参考文献的定理 4.22 提供了对边界情况 $p=1$ 的扩展。

items.title: Growing-time trace fluctuations and self-averaging form factors of Grover walks on random lifts
items.excerpt: We prove a functional central limit theorem for trace statistics of Grover walks on random $N$-lifts of a fixed finite connected simple $d$-regular graph, $d\geq3$. All observations are computed from the same random lift. The squared centred traces, divided by their observation times, have averages converging in probability to a degree-dependent constant. Their partial sums, centred at this constant and divided by the square root of the window length, converge to Brownian motion. For a window of length $M$ beginning at $t\geq1$, it suffices that $M\to\infty$ and $R^4(d-1)^R/N\to0$, where $R=t+M$. The initial time may remain fixed, with no further restriction on $M/t$. Convergence holds jointly with fixed low-degree polynomial trace statistics; their limiting vector is independent of the Brownian motion. For non-bipartite bases, we also identify Gaussian trace limits at fixed time offsets. Under common initial-time normalisation, subtracting a deterministic growth profile gives an explicit Brownian time change when $M/t$ has a finite limit. Bipartite bases retain the same averaged constant and have twice the Brownian variance rate. The
items.title_zh: 格罗弗在随机升降机上行走的生长时间轨迹波动和自平均形状因子
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了一个功能中心极限定理，用于在固定有限连通简单 $d$-正则图 $d\geq3$ 的随机 $N$-lift 上 Grover 游走的迹统计。所有观测值都是根据相同的随机提升计算的。以平方为中心的迹线除以它们的观察时间，其平均值在概率上收敛到依赖于程度的常数。它们的部分和以该常数为中心并除以窗口长度的平方根，收敛于布朗运动。对于从 $t\geq1$ 开始的长度为 $M$ 的窗口，$M\to\infty$ 和 $R^4(d-1)^R/N\to0$ 就足够了，其中 $R=t+M$。初始时间可能保持固定，对 $M/t$ 没有进一步限制。收敛性与固定低次多项式迹统计量共同成立；它们的极限向量与布朗运动无关。对于非二分基，我们还确定固定时间偏移处的高斯迹线限制。在常见的初始时间归一化下，当 $M/t$ 具有有限极限时，减去确定性增长曲线会给出显式的布朗时间变化。二分基保留相同的平均常数，并且具有两倍的布朗方差率。这

items.title: Dirichlet-Constrained Random Operators and Quenched Reflection Quantum Walks: Tree Spectra and Poisson Criticality at High Degree
items.excerpt: We study spectral limits of random operators whose incident edge weights are coupled by local normalization, and the reflection quantum walks associated with them. At each vertex of a $d$-regular graph, an independent Dirichlet probability vector distributes unit mass among outgoing directions. At fixed degree, the empirical spectral measures of the associated self-adjoint operators converge almost surely on locally tree-like graph sequences. We give a closed-walk formula for every moment of the limiting tree law. Our main result identifies two distinct high-degree scales. After rescaling the deterministic expected root spectral law by $\sqrt d$, a weak limit exists if and only if $d\alpha_d^2$ converges in $[0,\infty]$, where $\alpha_d$ is the Dirichlet parameter. The limits range from a point mass at zero through non-semicircular critical laws to the semicircle law. The critical laws admit a Poisson-tree representation with an explicit Bessel intensity. The extended family, including both endpoint laws, provides a first-Wasserstein approximation uniform over positive Dirichlet parameters. In the regime $d\alpha_d^2\to0$, the rescale
items.title_zh: 狄利克雷约束随机算子和淬火反射量子行走：树谱和高度泊松临界
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究随机算子的光谱限制，其入射边权重通过局部归一化耦合，以及与之相关的反射量子游走。在 $d$ 正则图的每个顶点，独立的狄利克雷概率向量在传出方向之间分配单位质量。在固定程度下，相关自伴算子的经验谱测度几乎肯定会收敛于局部树状图序列。我们给出了极限树定律每一时刻的闭游公式。我们的主要结果确定了两个不同的高度量表。通过 $\sqrt d$ 重新调整确定性预期根谱定律后，当且仅当 $d\alpha_d^2$ 收敛于 $[0,\infty]$ 时，存在弱极限，其中 $\alpha_d$ 是狄利克雷参数。限制范围从零点质量到非半圆临界定律再到半圆定律。临界定律承认具有明确贝塞尔强度的泊松树表示。该扩展族（包括两个端点定律）提供了正狄利克雷参数上的一阶 Wasserstein 近似均匀性。在 $d\alpha_d^2\to0$ 体系中，重新缩放

items.title: Risk measures for infinite-server queues driven by a Cox-BESQ process
items.excerpt: This paper introduces a model for infinite-server queues driven by a Cox process with stochastic intensity given by a squared Bessel (BESQ) process. Exploiting the affine structure of the underlying dynamics, we derive a closed-form expression for the joint moment-generating function (MGF) of the arrival intensity, the number of customers in the system, and the integral of the number of customers in the system over a time interval. This MGF can also be obtained at two (or more) dates, thereby allowing an analysis of the time evolution of infinite-server queues driven by a Cox--BESQ process. The availability of these explicit MGFs enables the development of risk measures for these variables, such as the joint moments of the arrival intensity, the number of customers in the system, and the integral of the number of customers in the system over a time interval, conditional on one of these variables exceeding a critical threshold. These risk measures can be determined at one or two dates. They rely essentially on the explicit form of the MGF of the state variables and on Fourier representations of the risk measures. Numerical experiments
items.authors: Jos\'{e} Da Fonseca, Yajun Shi, Wenjun Zhang
items.title_zh: 由 Cox-BESQ 流程驱动的无限服务器队列的风险度量
items.excerpt_zh: 本文介绍了一种由 Cox 过程驱动的无限服务器队列模型，其随机强度由平方贝塞尔 (BESQ) 过程给出。利用基础动力学的仿射结构，我们推导出到达强度、系统中的客户数量以及系统中的客户数量在一段时间内的积分的联合矩生成函数（MGF）的封闭式表达式。该 MGF 还可以在两个（或更多）日期获得，从而允许分析由 Cox-BESQ 进程驱动的无限服务器队列的时间演变。这些显式 MGF 的可用性使得能够为这些变量开发风险度量，例如到达强度的联合矩、系统中的客户数量以及系统中的客户数量在一段时间内的积分，条件是这些变量之一超过临界阈值。这些风险措施可以在一两个日期确定。它们本质上依赖于状态变量 MGF 的显式形式和风险度量的傅立叶表示。数值实验

items.title: CLT for quadratic additive functionals of three-dimensional and four-dimensional voter models
items.excerpt: In this paper, we prove central limit theorems for the quadratic additive functionals of the three-dimensional and four-dimensional voter models. Our main results show that, under proper time-space scalings, the centered quadratic additive functional of the four-dimensional voter model converges weakly to a Brownian motion and that in the three-dimensional case converges weakly to a Gaussian process without independent increment. The proof of the main result in the four-dimensional case extends the martingale decomposition method. In the three-dimensional case, we introduce a quadratic fluctuation limit theorem which shows that the quadratic fluctuation density field of the voter model converges weakly to a generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. Then our main result in the three-dimensional case follows from an argument where the quadratic additive functional is approximated by an integral of a test function with respect to the quadratic fluctuation density field. The duality relationship between the voter model and the coalescing random walk is repeatedly utilized in proofs of the main results. The proof strategies introduced in thi
items.title_zh: 用于三维和四维选民模型的二次可加泛函的 CLT
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明了三维和四维选民模型的二次加性泛函的中心极限定理。我们的主要结果表明，在适当的时空缩放下，四维选民模型的中心二次加性函数弱收敛于布朗运动，并且在三维情况下弱收敛于无独立增量的高斯过程。四维情况下主要结果的证明扩展了鞅分解方法。在三维情况下，我们引入了二次波动极限定理，该定理表明选民模型的二次波动密度场弱收敛于广义的 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程。然后，我们在三维情况下的主要结果来自一个论证，其中二次加性泛函由测试函数相对于二次涨落密度场的积分来近似。选民模型和合并随机游走之间的对偶关系在主要结果的证明中被反复利用。本文介绍的证明策略

items.title: Dynamical Tensor Train Approximation for Wigner--Fokker--Planck Equation with Applications to Open Quantum Systems
items.excerpt: We develop a dynamical tensor-train method for the Wigner--Fokker--Planck equation arising in continuous-variable open quantum systems. The Wigner function is evolved directly in tensor-train form using a projector-splitting integrator, while the nonlocal Wigner pseudo-differential operator is treated through low-rank representations of the potential difference and matrix-free exponential actions. The resulting method avoids full tensor-product computations in high-dimensional phase space. Numerical experiments in one, two, and three spatial dimensions demonstrate the accuracy and scalability of the method, including simulations in a six-dimensional phase space.
items.title_zh: 维格纳-福克-普朗克方程的动态张量列逼近及其在开放量子系统中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为连续变量开放量子系统中出现的维格纳-福克-普朗克方程开发了一种动态张量序列方法。维格纳函数使用投影分割积分器直接以张量序列形式演化，而非局部维格纳伪微分算子则通过势差的低秩表示和无矩阵指数作用进行处理。由此产生的方法避免了高维相空间中的完整张量积计算。一维、二维和三维的数值实验证明了该方法的准确性和可扩展性，包括六维相空间中的模拟。

items.title: Monte Carlo Power Iteration Algorithms: Convergence, Analysis and Application to Reactor Criticality Calculations
items.excerpt: We study Monte Carlo power iteration algorithms in the context of reactor criticality simulations. Under mild conditions on the underlying physical system and the algorithmic structure, we derive explicit error bounds, which are to the best of our knowledge the first rigorous results for such methods which are ubiquitous in nuclear engineering. This is done by exploiting connections to Sequential Monte Carlo algorithms, and extending recent developments about stochastic neutron transport. We demonstrate the applicability of our results by considering a concrete version of the Monte Carlo power iteration algorithm as well as variance reduction schemes.
items.authors: Alexander M. G. Cox, Tom Davis, Julian Hofstadler, Andreas E. Kyprianou
items.title_zh: 蒙特卡罗功率迭代算法：收敛、分析及其在反应堆临界计算中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在反应堆临界模拟的背景下研究蒙特卡罗功率迭代算法。在底层物理系统和算法结构的温和条件下，我们得出了明确的误差范围，据我们所知，这是核工程中普遍存在的此类方法的第一个严格结果。这是通过利用与顺序蒙特卡罗算法的联系并扩展随机中子输运的最新进展来完成的。我们通过考虑蒙特卡罗幂迭代算法的具体版本以及方差减少方案来证明我们的结果的适用性。

items.title: A Fast Algorithm for Quaternion Tensor Singular Value Decomposition under the QT-Product with Applications to Color Video Processing
items.excerpt: Based on the complex representation of quaternion matrices, this paper revisits the quaternion tensor singular value decomposition (QT-SVD) under the QT-product and establishes the corresponding $z$-block circulant matrix decomposition. We develop an efficient implementation of the QT-SVD. Numerical experiments show that this implementation is substantially faster than QT-SVD based on the quaternion matrix SVD approach \cite[Theorem~2.3]{AMLzhang2022} while maintaining high numerical accuracy. We further apply the QT-SVD to color video encryption and reconstruction. Experiments on five DAVIS video sequences show that the QT-SVD achieves higher reconstruction quality and shorter decomposition times than the quaternion T-SVD \cite{tsvdarxiv} under the same processing procedure. Both methods exhibit comparable ciphertext statistics and differential sensitivity, while the QT-SVD introduces less additional distortion under the tested input perturbations.
items.authors: Daochang Zhang, Yue Zhao, Jingqian Li
items.title_zh: QT乘积下四元数张量奇异值分解的快速算法及其在彩色视频处理中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 基于四元数矩阵的复表示，本文重新审视了QT-product下的四元数张量奇异值分解（QT-SVD），并建立了相应的$z$块循环矩阵分解。我们开发了 QT-SVD 的高效实施。数值实验表明，这种实现比基于四元数矩阵 SVD 方法的 QT-SVD 快得多，同时保持较高的数值精度。我们进一步将QT-SVD应用于彩色视频加密和重建。对五个 DAVIS 视频序列的实验表明，在相同的处理过程下，QT-SVD 比四元数 T-SVD 具有更高的重建质量和更短的分解时间。两种方法都表现出可比较的密文统计数据和差分灵敏度，而 QT-SVD 在测试的输入扰动下引入的额外失真较少。

items.title: ODAT-SE: A modular and parallel framework for simulation-based inverse problems
items.excerpt: Open Data Analysis Tool for Science and Engineering (ODAT-SE) is an open-source Python framework for inverse problems that are solved by repeated forward simulations. It succeeds 2DMAT, which was developed for surface-structure analysis with quantum-beam diffraction and has since been applied to other fields. In version 3, the search algorithms were separated from the application-specific solvers, which became independent packages, and the software was renamed; this paper describes the current version 4.0. The framework connects optimization and sampling algorithms to solvers through a common interface for parameter mapping, constraints, and objective evaluation, so that an existing simulation code can be used with any of the algorithms. Relative to the previously published 2DMAT, it provides two-level MPI parallelism, which distributes candidate evaluations over processes and each evaluation over a parallel solver, checkpoint and continuation facilities, random search, global optimizers from SciPy, tensor-train optimization, and a Bayesian workflow that estimates partition-function ratios, model evidence, effective noise levels, and
items.authors: Tatsumi Aoyama, Kazuyoshi Yoshimi, Yuichi Motoyama, Akito Nakano, Hengyu Li, Yusuke Konishi, Takeo Hoshi
items.title_zh: ODAT-SE：用于基于仿真的反问题的模块化并行框架
items.excerpt_zh: 科学与工程开放数据分析工具 (ODAT-SE) 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于通过重复正向模拟解决逆问题。它继承了 2DMAT，后者是为利用量子束衍射进行表面结构分析而开发的，现已应用于其他领域。在版本3中，搜索算法与特定于应用程序的求解器分离，成为独立的软件包，并且软件被重新命名；本文介绍了当前的4.0版本。该框架通过用于参数映射、约束和客观评估的通用接口将优化和采样算法连接到求解器，以便现有的模拟代码可以与任何算法一起使用。相对于之前发布的 2DMAT，它提供了两级 MPI 并行性，将候选评估分布在进程上，并将每个评估分布在并行求解器、检查点和延续设施、随机搜索、SciPy 的全局优化器、张量训练优化以及估计配分函数比率、模型证据、有效噪声水平和

items.title: A minimizing-movement framework for parametric finite element approximation of anisotropic curve shortening flows
items.excerpt: We propose a minimizing-movement framework for constructing parametric finite element methods (PFEMs) for anisotropic curve shortening flows. The cornerstone is an admissible modified energy: a smooth, convex, and iteration-dependent surrogate that majorizes the original anisotropic energy and agrees with it at the current iterate. For any fixed finite element degree $n\geq1$ and any positive surface energy density $\gamma\in C^2(\mathbb{S}^1)$, the unconstrained one-step problem has a unique solution for any time-step size whenever the parametric derivative of the current discrete curve does not vanish on any mesh element. It also satisfies a one-step discrete energy dissipation inequality. It therefore preserves the variational structure of the underlying $L^2$-gradient flow. The framework recovers a variational interpretation of Dziuk's isotropic scheme and applies directly to the weak anisotropies. For strong anisotropies, a convex splitting removes the weak-anisotropy restriction on the original density. A scalar constraint further extends the framework to area-preserving flows. items.authors: Wei Jiang, Chunmei Su, Ganghui Zhang
items.title_zh: 各向异性曲线缩短流的参数有限元近似的最小化运动框架
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个最小化运动框架，用于构建各向异性曲线缩短流动的参数有限元方法（PFEM）。基石是一个可接受的修改能量：一个平滑、凸且依赖于迭代的替代项，它使原始各向异性能量最大化并在当前迭代中与其一致。对于任何固定的有限元次数 $n\geq1$ 和任何正表面能量密度 $\gamma\in C^2(\mathbb{S}^1)$，只要当前离散曲线的参数导数在任何网格元素上不消失，无约束单步问题对于任何时间步长都有唯一的解。它还满足一步离散能量耗散不等式。因此，它保留了底层 $L^2$ 梯度流的变分结构。该框架恢复了 Dziuk 各向同性方案的变分解释，并直接应用于弱各向异性。对于强各向异性，凸分裂消除了对原始密度的弱各向异性限制。标量约束进一步将框架扩展到面积保留流。数值实验显示近似的exp

items.title: Dynamic Properties of Numerical Solution for Stochastic Epidemic Models with a Fully Implicit Form
items.excerpt: This paper establishes a fully implicit model to investigate the spread of epidemics and studies its dynamic properties, extending the semi-implicit model in Yang et al.(Commun. Nonlinear Sci. Numer. Simul., 152 (2026) 109140 ). We first employ the split-step backward Euler method to address the non-adaptability arising from backward Euler discretization and ensure the global convergence of the numerical solution. By linearizing the model, the computational cost is reduced at the expense of a slight increase in error, effectively avoiding complex iterative solution processes. Then, we derive the existence, uniqueness, positivity, and boundedness of the numerical solution, and obtain its global convergence order. On this basis, the extinction and persistence of the disease are investigated under three different scenarios. The results indicate that environmental noise is a key factor leading to disease extinction. Finally, numerical simulations visually verify the obtained theoretical conclusions.
items.authors: Zeyao Jin, Zhiming Li, Shenglong Chen
items.title_zh: 全隐式随机流行病模型数值解的动态性质
items.excerpt_zh: 本文建立了一个全隐式模型来研究流行病的传播并研究其动态特性，扩展了Yang等人的半隐式模型（Commun. Nonlinear Sci. Numer. Simul., 152 (2026) 109140）。我们首先采用分步后向欧拉方法来解决后向欧拉离散化带来的不适应性，并确保数值解的全局收敛。通过对模型进行线性化，以误差略有增加为代价降低了计算成本，有效避免了复杂的迭代求解过程。然后推导出数值解的存在性、唯一性、正性、有界性，并得到其全局收敛阶。在此基础上，在三种不同的情况下研究了该疾病的灭绝和持续存在。研究结果表明，环境噪声是导致疾病灭绝的关键因素。最后，数值模拟直观地验证了所得的理论结论。

items.title: Demodalising G\"odel's God? Ultrafilters, Rigidity and Modal Collapse Revisited
items.excerpt: G\"odel's ontological argument is modal by design. Possibility and necessity are among its central concerns, and connected interpretation decisions -- extensions or intensions for the positive properties, constant or varying quantifier domains, the choice of modal logic, etc. -- subtly shape the argument and, in particular, whether the modal collapse is implied or not. It is tempting to abstract the modality away and to read the positive properties as merely forming an ultrafilter -- which, however, may replace G\"odel's argument with a perhaps more manageable alternative that may have little to do with G\"odel's original intention. In this spirit, Odifreddi and Gomes argue that modal collapse is an intrinsic structural feature of any theory that characterises positive properties as an ultrafilter and identifies God as its principal generator. This comment shows that the structural claim is false. items.title_zh: 解模态 G\"odel 的上帝？重新审视超滤器、刚性和模态崩溃

items.title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
items.excerpt: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. items.title: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
items.excerpt: Benchmarks for verifiable code generation usually test a proof against one fixed implementation. We ask whether the same proof remains valid after a program refactoring that preserves behavior. We introduce RefactorProof, which derives 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in our pinned environment while holding the specification and evaluated proof fixed byte-for-byte. VERINA supplies reference proofs for 46 tasks, all from its basic split; the primary model-versus-reference comparisons further match on 21-25 short, non-recursive tasks. Structural refactorings expose substantial brittleness across proof sources: task-normalized structural PSR is 4.3% for the supplied references and 13.3-26.8% for the specialized provers. On the matched tasks, specialized prover proofs nevertheless have higher overall unchanged-proof survival than the supplied reference artifacts: +15.6 points for DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, +18.8 for Goedel-Prover-V2-32B, and +20.3 for Goedel-Prover-V2-8B; all three 95% CIs exclude zero. items.title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
items.excerpt: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. items.title: Learning to Formalize: Bridging Open-Ended Workloads and Fast Decision Models
items.excerpt: Decision models offer fast choices over sup- plied alternatives, while general-purpose large language models interpret open-ended tasks through flexible generation and reasoning at the cost of sequential decoding. Many work- loads expect a generative backend to determine what can be done and therefore provide no well-defined candidate list. We bridge this in- terface gap with a small candidate formalizer trained on offline teacher-generated lists. The formalizer constructs explicit, validated alter- natives from task context, and a frozen deci- sion model selects an entry. A motivating com- parison with official TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0 on 200 CALVIN-D test episodes reports 11% suc- cess with generic motions versus 46.5% with DeepSeek V4 Flash pose candidates. Sepa- rately, a six-arm privileged-state evaluation on 1,011 CALVIN-D validation annotations finds that a locally deployed decision model can achieve at most 52.6% task success rate with the fine-tuned formalizer, compared with 11.8% without it, and the end-to-end latency is kept to 2.09 s, whereas Qwen3.5-27B is 3.67 s with the exact experiment setting.
items.authors: Chengxuan Pei, Ziyao Wang, Teng Mei, Zhe Li
items.title_zh: 学习形式化：连接开放式工作负载和快速决策模型
items.excerpt_zh: 决策模型提供了对所提供替代方案的快速选择，而通用大型语言模型通过灵活的生成和推理来解释开放式任务，但代价是顺序解码。许多工作负载期望生成后端来确定可以做什么，因此没有提供明确定义的候选列表。我们通过在离线教师生成的列表上进行训练的小型候选形式化器来弥补这一接口差距。形式化器根据任务上下文构造明确的、经过验证的替代方案，并且冻结的决策模型选择一个条目。在 200 个 CALVIN-D 测试集上与官方 TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0 进行的令人兴奋的比较显示，通用动作的成功率为 11%，而 DeepSeek V4 Flash 候选姿势的成功率为 46.5%。另外，对 1,011 个 CALVIN-D 验证注释进行的六臂特权状态评估发现，使用微调形式化器，本地部署的决策模型最多可以实现 52.6% 的任务成功率，而没有微调形式化器的任务成功率为 11.8%，并且端到端延迟保持在 2.09 秒，而在精确的实验设置下，Qwen3.5-27B 为 3.67 秒。

items.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
items.excerpt: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with $2\times2$) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with $8\times1$). A simple runtime model explains the measured speedups under a finite worker pool, and batched settings also spend their metric-call and dollar budgets more efficiently. We frame the axes along which a reflective optimization step can scale in parallel, a first look at allocating a fixed optimization budget across them.
items.authors: Jialin Zhang, Lakshya A Agrawal, Shangyin Tan, Donghyun Lee, Lutfi Eren Erdogan, Dan Klein, Koushik Sen, Alex Dimakis, Matei Zaharia
items.title_zh: 批处理反射优化循环：并行提案使 GEPA 更快更好
items.excerpt_zh: 反射文本优化使代理系统变得更好，但优化循环本身是一个资源匮乏的工作负载，其顺序结构使并行评估能力闲置。我们扩展了开源 GEPA 优化器，以在每个优化步骤中提出并评估一批候选者，而不是一次一个候选者。在我们对两项任务的扫描中，大多数批处理运行在挂钟时间的一半或更短的时间内完成，最快的运行时间约为四分之一到三分之一。批量设置还获得了更高的保留测试分数，LiveBench-Math 上的分数从 68.9% 提高到 72.1%（$2\times2$），HoVer 上的分数从 49.0% 提高到 60.0%（$8\times1$）。一个简单的运行时模型解释了在有限工作池下测得的加速情况，并且批处理设置还可以更有效地花费其度量调用和美元预算。我们构建了反射优化步骤可以并行扩展的轴，首先考虑在它们之间分配固定的优化预算。

items.title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.
items.authors: Bo Yang, Zishuai Zhang, Weihua Li, Qinnan Zhang, Sijia Wen, Hainan Zhang
items.title_zh: Guided-RLVR：具有可验证奖励的强化学习的引导探索
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提高大型语言模型（LLM）在数学和编程等任务上的推理能力方面显示出强大的经验收益。然而，最近的研究表明，RLVR 的推出经常会陷入一组狭窄的推理轨迹，从而限制了探索的推理空间。受关键步骤中的思维标记作为 LLM 推理路径中的关键结构元素这一发现的启发，我们提出了 Guided-RLVR，这是一种通过轻量级控制器增强 RLVR 的新颖方法。控制器策略性地将语义上有意义的引导标记注入到采样分布中，鼓励模型从多个推理角度处理问题，从而扩大探索空间。数学推理和代码生成基准的实验表明，Guided-RLVR 始终优于现有的 RLVR 方法，同时产生更多样化的推理轨迹。

items.title: Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention
items.excerpt: Changing a deployment policy can invalidate a world model's uncertainty while leaving the physical transition mechanism and predictor unchanged. For one-step prediction, if source and target laws share the conditional mechanism $P(Y|X)=Q(Y|X)$, then the intervention is identified by the pre-outcome change of measure $w(X)=dQ_X/dP_X$. For policy-controlled dynamics this ratio factors into state-occupancy and action-propensity terms. Weighted conformal calibration transports marginal coverage to the target law; with an estimated ratio $\hat w$, $P_Q\{Y \in C_{\hat w}(X)\} \ge 1-\alpha-TV(Q,\hat Q) \ge 1-\alpha-E_P|w-\hat w|$. Population log-loss regret for a source-versus-target domain classifier bounds the same ratio error. If $h$ is its clipped target posterior, $\rho$ is the target-domain prior, and $\Delta(h)$ is population log-loss regret, then $E_P|w-\hat w_h| \le (1/(\rho\gamma))\sqrt{\Delta(h)/2}$. An exact cancellation improves the dependence from a generic odds-map bound of order $\gamma^{-2}$ to $(\rho\gamma)^{-1}$. items.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
items.excerpt: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. This raises a bitter-lesson question: can a simple agentic loop that scales test-time compute match these workflows? The answer matters as formal verification must scale to keep up with frontier models producing research mathematics, yet new workflows rarely settle it, as their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute. We study this question with h1, a simple harness that gives a model an efficient interface to Lean 4 and keeps it working through verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing a decomposition or search structure. h1 reaches state-of-the-art results on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and, at matched models, matches or outperforms specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus, surprisingly show
items.authors: Skander Moalla, Ahmad Rammal, Niket Patel, Remi Munos, Julia Kempe
items.title_zh: h1：自动化定理证明的惨痛教训
items.excerpt_zh: 虽然非正式数学的进步主要来自扩展前沿语言模型的思想链和代理推理，但形式定理证明越来越依赖于围绕这些模型的人为设计的工作流程，例如规划、分解和编排专门的证明者。这就提出了一个惨痛的问题：一个可扩展测试时计算的简单代理循环能否与这些工作流程相匹配？答案很重要，因为形式验证必须扩展以跟上产生研究数学的前沿模型，但新的工作流程很少解决这个问题，因为它们的收益常常与更强大的模型或更多的计算相混淆。我们使用 h1 来研究这个问题，h1 是一个简单的工具，它为模型提供了与精益 4 的有效接口，并通过验证者反馈和自我反思使其保持正常工作，而无需强加分解或搜索结构。 h1 在 PutnamBench、FATE-X 和 FormalConjectures100-Solved 上达到了最先进的结果，解决了 FormalConjectures 中的八个开放问题，并且在匹配的模型上，匹配或优于 Goedel-Architect 和 AlphaProof Nexus 等专业工作流程，令人惊讶地显示

items.title: Scaling and Renormalization in Neural Networks: An Effective Renormalization-Group Description of Grokking
items.excerpt: Grokking is a delayed transition from memorization to generalization in deep neural networks (NNs). We examine whether scaling and renormalization group (RG) theories can describe this dynamics, establishing a quantitative physical framework for neural generalization transitions. For modular addition on a two-layer NN, an ensemble of trained models defines an order parameter (the squared weight norm) and fluctuation proxies for the heat capacity and the susceptibility, with training epoch and weight decay serving as thermal and field control coordinates. To bridge neural architectures to real-space RG, we construct an exact coupling matrix via a second-order expansion of the loss with respect to per-neuron norms and use its Fiedler vector to define an effective geometry. This spectral ordering yields a monotonic spatial decay of coupling strength that is absent under random permutations. We then execute real-space RG by block-spin aggregating adjacent neurons and parameterizing the coupling matrix into off-diagonal band strengths. items.title: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural-network training
items.excerpt: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural networks gives macroscopic observables and enables training to be predicted, and controlled in a state space far smaller than the parameter space. In this paper, we first define the learning operator following the training law of neural networks and establish a descent theorem for the learning operator, which serves to determine whether the operator is sufficient to characterize the learning dynamics. Then the exact closure theorem and the dynamic coarse-graining theorem are presented in sequence. The three theorems established in this paper provide a systematic framework for constructing and assessing dynamical coarse-grained models of neural-network training. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of the theorems with a finite-width nonlinear ReLU network. Its dynamic coarse-grained model for a fixed pattern is exactly derived and composed of five independent moments. The model exactly predict the training outputs and evolving learning operator. The framework may also guide the development of approximate coarse-grained models for more general neural networks when exact closure is unavailable.
items.authors: Lin-Juan Wang, Da Li, Huiling Duan, Jianxiang Wang
items.title_zh: 神经网络训练的动态粗粒度
items.excerpt_zh: 神经网络的动态粗粒度提供了宏观可观测值，并使训练能够在远小于参数空间的状态空间中进行预测和控制。在本文中，我们首先遵循神经网络的训练规律定义学习算子，并建立学习算子的下降定理，用于确定算子是否足以表征学习动态。然后依次给出了精确闭包定理和动态粗粒度定理。本文建立的三个定理为构建和评估神经网络训练的动态粗粒度模型提供了系统框架。最后，我们通过有限宽度非线性 ReLU 网络证明了定理的适用性。其固定模式的动态粗粒度模型是精确推导的，由五个独立矩组成。该模型准确地预测了训练输出和不断发展的学习算子。当精确闭包不可用时，该框架还可以指导更通用神经网络的近似粗粒度模型的开发。

items.title: Proposing Better Rollouts for On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model post-training by letting the student learn from its own sampled trajectories under teacher supervision, aligning the training process with inference-time behavior. However, the rollout policy in OPD is usually treated as fixed: each round samples directly from the current student. We show that this choice can create a compounding teacher--student mismatch, because it requires the teacher to provide effective supervision on whichever trajectories the student samples, including ones less reachable by the teacher itself. On such trajectories, teacher supervision can become noisy or even misleading, leading to undesirable student patterns such as repetition. Moreover, since the updated student in turn defines the rollout policy of subsequent rounds, these patterns persist and potentially amplify over training. This failure mode suggests that improving OPD requires treating the rollout policy itself as an optimization target, rather than only modifying the distillation objective. items.title_zh: 提议更好地推出符合政策的蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 在策略蒸馏 (OPD) 通过让学生在教师监督下从自己的采样轨迹中学习，使训练过程与推理时间行为保持一致，从而改进语言模型后训练。然而，OPD 中的推出策略通常被视为固定的：每轮直接从当前学生中采样。我们表明，这种选择可能会造成教师与学生之间的复合错配，因为它要求教师对学生样本的任何轨迹提供有效的监督，包括教师本身难以达到的轨迹。在这样的轨迹上，教师的监督可能会变得嘈杂甚至误导，导致不良的学生模式，例如重复。此外，由于更新后的学生反过来定义了后续轮次的推出策略，因此这些模式会持续存在并可能在训练中放大。这种失败模式表明，改进 OPD 需要将推出策略本身视为优化目标，而不仅仅是修改蒸馏目标。我们提出混合提案按政策蒸馏（MPOPD），它衍生出一个以学生为锚定、教师指导的模型

items.title: The Batch Size Can Be One: Test-Time Adaptation from Classifier Geometry
items.excerpt: Test-time adaptation updates a deployed model on an unlabeled test stream. In practice this stream often arrives one sample at a time, with the classes in no particular order. A single sample then provides limited information for estimating distribution-level statistics, and selecting samples by confidence can admit predictions that are wrong yet confident. A corruption, however, shifts the features while leaving the decision regions of the frozen classifier unchanged. We therefore propose Origin-recentered Test-Time Adaptation (OriTTA), which constructs fixed geometric targets from the source model and adapts selected features toward them. Seen from the origin of the feature space, the classes lean toward a common direction. We choose a new origin to bring class scores closer together while keeping it near the mean feature of one synthetic prototype per class. From this origin, prototype directions spread more evenly, and each class obtains an axis and an ideal point before any test data arrives. items.title: Deep Bayesian Approaches for Interpretable Nonlinear Structural System Identification
items.excerpt: System identification, namely the inference of mathematical representations of dynamical systems from measured data, is fundamental to engineering diagnostics, prognostics, and decision-making. Bayesian filtering offers a principled framework for probabilistic state estimation but traditionally relies on prescribed transition and observation models. Recent advances in deep Bayesian filtering address this limitation by embedding learnable representations within probabilistic state-space formulations, enabling data-driven identification of unknown dynamics while retaining physical structure and uncertainty-aware inference. This tutorial provides a systematic introduction to deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, focusing on the interplay between learned dynamics, physical inductive biases, and posterior inference. The Deep Markov Model serves as a data-driven reference, while the Physics-guided Deep Markov Model (PgDMM) and Neural Extended Kalman Filter (Neural EKF) illustrate complementary approaches based on amortized variational inference and differentiable Kalman filtering, respectively. items.title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
items.excerpt: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. items.title: CONCUR: Concordant Auxiliary Rewards for Multi-Task, Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: When a Large Language Model (LLM) is trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on multiple tasks, a task's primary reward can gate auxiliary rewards such as a length reward: on a failing response, an auxiliary cannot exceed the primary. However, group-relative advantage estimators treat a gated auxiliary like any other component, so it can reverse the primary's order, and at the primary's ceiling only auxiliaries order responses. Keeping gated auxiliaries hurts some tasks, while dropping them hurts others. We propose CONCUR, an advantage estimator that replaces the standardized scores of each gated auxiliary with the closest scores that satisfy two conditions: responses with higher primary rewards cannot receive lower scores, and responses at the primary's ceiling receive equal scores. CONCUR-T applies both conditions throughout training, and CONCUR-A lifts the second for an auxiliary that agrees with the primary's order more often than it reverses it among passing responses. items.title_zh: CONCUR：多任务、多奖励强化学习的一致辅助奖励

items.title: Is Token Confidence Just Chain Length? A Signal-Processing Audit of Reasoning Traces
items.excerpt: Reasoning language models answer math problems by writing long chains of thought, and sampling many chains per problem and taking a majority vote raises accuracy at a large cost in generated text. A popular way to cut that cost scores each chain by the model's confidence in each token it writes, where a token is a word or part of a word. The method averages this confidence over a sliding window of 2048 tokens and keeps or stops chains based on the lowest average. We treat the confidence, recorded token by token, as a signal in the sense of audio or radio, and examine the method with standard signal-processing tools such as spectral analysis and statistical tests for detecting a sudden change. We sampled 16 chains for each of 500 problems from two math benchmarks with a small open reasoning model. The windowed-minimum score turns out to measure mostly how long a chain is. Ranking chains by length alone does as well as or better than the confidence score, and once length is accounted for the score carries no information about correctness. items.excerpt_zh: 推理语言模型通过编写长的思想链来回答数学问题，并对每个问题的许多链进行采样并采取多数投票来提高生成文本的准确性，但代价高昂。降低成本的一种流行方法是根据模型对其写入的每个令牌的置信度对每个链进行评分，其中令牌是一个单词或单词的一部分。该方法在 2048 个代币的滑动窗口上对这种置信度进行平均，并根据最低平均值保持或停止链。我们将逐个标记记录的置信度视为音频或无线电意义上的信号，并使用标准信号处理工具（例如用于检测突然变化的频谱分析和统计测试）来检查该方法。我们使用小型开放推理模型从两个数学基准测试中针对 500 个问题中的每一个问题抽取了 16 个链。事实证明，窗口最小分数主要衡量的是一条链的长度。仅按长度对链进行排名与置信度分数一样好甚至更好，并且一旦考虑了长度，分数就不会包含有关正确性的信息。信号处理解释了原因：缓慢漂移信号的较长一段的最小值较低

items.title: CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
items.excerpt: Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning. On WikiBigEdit, CAMR consistently leads evaluated methods in Original Match from 3K to 100K facts, reaching 93.66% after just 3K facts and surpassing Full-history Replay (LoRA) after 100K facts. items.title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient
items.excerpt: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. items.title_zh: 参数高效的分层低阶重新参数化
items.excerpt_zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法通过引入少量可训练参数来适应大型模型。然而，我们发现这些参数仍然包含冗余，可以在保持强大的任务性能的同时进一步压缩。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的分层低秩重新参数化方法。其核心思想是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重新组织成近似方阵，然后通过低秩分解来表达，并且可以递归应用。这就形成了一个多级结构，因子逐级压缩，大大减少了可训练参数的数量。在我们的实验中，我们将这种重新参数化与 LoRA、DoRA、MoSA 和 RaSA 结合起来。我们在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 上评估常识推理，并在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上进行额外的 GSM8K 数学推理实验。在可比较的可训练参数预算下，我们的方法与 LoRA 或 DoRA 相结合实现了更好的性能。此外，当原始方法的参数数量压缩大约一个数量级时，我们的方法仍然可以保持竞争力

items.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
items.excerpt: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. items.excerpt: We give a direct proof of Infinity in the no-empty version of New Foundations, denoted NF-0, by establishing that every model of the specified theory contains an object that is not finite in a precise, internally defined sense. The version considered has extensionality, at least two distinct objects, no empty objects, and inhabited stratified comprehension: a stratified extension is supplied whenever it has a member. Finiteness combines a two-sided internally represented well-order with the exclusion of internally represented nonterminating strict transitive relations on inhabited subsets. Assuming all objects finite, partial bijections yield comparison and finite extrema of positive Frege cardinals. Positive exponentiation, singleton type-raising, and the least orbit of the genuine two-cardinal lead to the equation n = T(n) + 1.
