items.title: On various notions of universally Baire sets and reflection of non-Baire property in Cantor sets
items.excerpt: Universally Baire sets are a standard tool in modern set theory, where they are closely connected with forcing and absoluteness. In this paper we study universal Baireness instead as purely a regularity notion for subsets of Polish spaces. Our aim is not to develop the set-theoretic theory, but to place the notion on a systematic descriptive-set-theoretic footing and to clarify the several nonequivalent definitions that occur in the literature. A subset of a Polish space is called \emph{universally Baire} if all its continuous preimages possess the property of Baire. However, it is important to specify what the domain of these continuous functions can be. items.excerpt_zh: 贝尔集普遍是现代集合论中的标准工具，它们与强制和绝对性密切相关。在本文中，我们研究普适拜尔性，将其作为纯粹的波兰空间子集的正则性概念。我们的目的不是发展集合论，而是将该概念置于系统的描述性集合论基础上，并澄清文献中出现的几个不等价的定义。如果波兰空间的所有连续原像都具有 Baire 属性，则该子集称为 \emph{通称 Baire}。然而，指定这些连续函数的域非常重要。事实上，文献中的不同作者使用了大量的定义，可能域的类别有时是波兰空间、紧可度量空间、所有拓扑空间、紧拓扑空间等。我们通过证明上述四个选项在连续统假设下成对不等价来澄清这种情况，我们确定了在 $ZFC$ 中可证明的这四个概念之间的所有含义，并且还表明所有概念

items.title: Dependent choice and iterated beta_n-model reflection
items.excerpt: In this paper, we consider conservation results for iterated $\beta_n$-model reflection principles. Using these principles, we characterize the $\Pi^1_{m+2}$-, $\Sigma^1_{m+2}$- and $\mathsf{B}(\Pi^1_{m+2})$-consequences of $\Sigma^1_{n+1}$-$\mathsf{DC}_0$ and $\Sigma^1_{n+1}$-$\mathsf{TDC}_0$ for $m \leq n$. Here, $\mathsf{B}(\Pi^1_{m+2})$ denotes the set of Boolean combinations of $\Pi^1_{m+2}$-formulas, and $\mathsf{TDC}$ stands for transfinite $\mathsf{DC}$. We also show that, in each case, the stronger theory has a super-exponential speed-up over the corresponding conservative subtheory.
items.title_zh: 相关选择和迭代 beta_n 模型反射
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们考虑迭代$\beta_n$模型反射原理的守恒结果。利用这些原理，我们描述了 $\Sigma^1_{n+1}$-$\mathsf{DC}_0$ 和 $\Sigma^1_{n+1}$-$\mathsf{TDC}_0$ 的 $\Pi^1_{m+2}$-、$\Sigma^1_{m+2}$- 和 $\mathsf{B}(\Pi^1_{m+2})$- 后果： $m \leq n$。这里，$\mathsf{B}(\Pi^1_{m+2})$表示$\Pi^1_{m+2}$-公式的布尔组合集合，$\mathsf{TDC}$表示超限$\mathsf{DC}$。我们还表明，在每种情况下，更强的理论都比相应的保守子理论具有超指数加速。

items.title: Finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebras and fixed-point combinators
items.excerpt: We study algebras for the $\mathbf{BM}$-, $\mathbf{BI}$-, and $\mathbf{BMI}$-fragments of combinatory logic, where $\mathbf{B} xyz \to_{w} x\left(yz\right)$, $\mathbf{M} x \to_{w} xx$ and $\mathbf{I} x \to_{w} x$. We prove that every finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebra $\mathcal{A}$ contains an element $Y$ satisfying $Yx = x\left(Yx\right)$ for all $x\in A$. Moreover, a single closed $\mathbf{BM}$-term represents such an element in every finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebra. On the other hand, we show that there exists an infinite $\mathbf{BMI}$-algebra with no such element. Consequently, the variety of $\mathbf{BM}$-algebras is not generated by finite $\mathbf{BM}$-algebras. We also characterise finite $\mathbf{BI}$-algebras as finite semigroups with two distinguished left units $B$ and $I$, and finite $\mathbf{BMI}$-algebras as finite idempotent semigroups with three distinguished left units $B$, $M$ and $I$.
items.title_zh: 有限$\mathbf{BM}$-代数和定点组合器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究组合逻辑的 $\mathbf{BM}$-、$\mathbf{BI}$- 和 $\mathbf{BMI}$- 片段的代数，其中 $\mathbf{B} xyz \to_{w} x\left(yz\right)$、$\mathbf{M} x \to_{w} xx$ 和 $\mathbf{I} x \to_{w} x$。我们证明每个有限的$\mathbf{BM}$-代数$\mathcal{A}$包含一个元素$Y$，对于A$中的所有$x\满足$Yx = x\left(Yx\right)$。此外，单个封闭的 $\mathbf{BM}$ 项表示每个有限 $\mathbf{BM}$ 代数中的这样一个元素。另一方面，我们证明存在一个无限的$\mathbf{BMI}$-代数，没有这样的元素。因此，$\mathbf{BM}$-代数的多样性不是由有限的$\mathbf{BM}$-代数生成的。我们还将有限 $\mathbf{BI}$ 代数表征为具有两个区分左单元 $B$ 和 $I$ 的有限半群，并将有限 $\mathbf{BMI}$ 代数表征为具有三个区分左单元 $B$、$M$ 和 $I$ 的有限幂等半群。

items.title: Relative distality and incidence bounds in positive characteristic
items.excerpt: We prove Szemer\'edi-Trotter-type incidence bounds for algebraic relations in any field $F$ admitting a valuation with finite residue field. This includes $\mathbb F_q(t)$, $\mathbb F_q((t))$, and all finitely generated extensions of finite fields. Bays and Martin show that any algebraic $K_{d,s}$-free relation $E\subseteq F^k\times F^\ell$ admits a power-saving in the classical Zarankiewicz bound of K\H{o}v\'ari, S\'os, and Tur\'an. Answering a question of the authors, we show that this power-saving is uniform in $F$: There is some $\epsilon>0$ depending only on $d$ and the complexity of $E$ (and not on $F$) such that for $A\subseteq F^k$ and $B\subseteq F^\ell$, the number of edges $|E(A,B)|$ is at most $O(|A|^{1-\epsilon}|B|^{1-\frac{1-\epsilon}{d}}+|A|+|B|)$. For the case where $A$ is a set of points and $B$ is a set of lines in $F^2$ and $E$ is the incidence relation, we prove the explicit bound $O(|P|^{\frac{8}{9}}|L|^{\frac{5}{9}}+|P|+|L|)$. items.title_zh: 阳性特征中的相对远端和发生率范围
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了任何域 $F$ 中代数关系的 Szemer\'edi-Trotter 型关联界，承认有限留数域的估值。这包括 $\mathbb F_q(t)$、$\mathbb F_q((t))$ 以及有限域的所有有限生成的扩展。 Bays 和 Martin 表明，任何代数 $K_{d,s}$ 自由关系 $E\subseteq F^k\times F^\ell$ 都承认在 K\H{o}v\'ari、S\'os 和 Tur\'an 的经典 Zarankiewicz 界中节能。在回答作者的问题时，我们表明这种节能在$F$中是一致的：有一些$\epsilon>0$仅取决于$d$和$E$的复杂性（而不是$F$），这样对于$A\subseteq F^k$和$B\subseteq F^\ell$，边的数量$|E(A,B)|$最多为$O(|A|^{1-\epsilon}|B|^{1-\frac{1-\epsilon}{d}}+|A|+|B|)$。对于 $A$ 是 $F^2$ 中的一组点、$B$ 是一组线、$E$ 是关联关系的情况，我们证明显式边界 $O(|P|^{\frac{8}{9}}|L|^{\frac{5}{9}}+|P|+|L|)$。作为证明的核心要素，我们引入了相对于可定义集合的远端性的模型理论概念。我们开始发展这个概念并证明代数理论

items.title: A Fibrational Framework For Multi-Conclusion Logics
items.excerpt: The fibrational framework of Licata, Shulman, and Riley gives a uniform account of substructural and modal logics for single-conclusion judgments. This thesis extends it to a multiple-output setting in which cartesian resources may be used freely, while linear resources occur exactly once on either side of the turnstile. Judgments are indexed by descriptors: directed acyclic graphs generalizing the tree-shaped expressions of the original framework. Descriptor $2$-cells encode structural transformations, and explicit gates provide weakening, contraction, coweakening, and cocontraction at linear modes. We define a sequent calculus generated by two connectives, $F$ and $U$. We prove identity, invertibility, and cut admissibility. The mode and type theories present linear-non-linear $2$-polycategories, and the projection is a local discrete fibration and a fibration, with opcartesian lifts for one-output base morphisms. Two adequacy results validate the framework: its cartesian fragment recovers the Licata--Shulman--Riley calculus, and its purely linear fragment presents classical multiplicative linear logic. items.title_zh: 多结论逻辑的纤维化框架
items.excerpt_zh: Licata、Shulman 和 Riley 的纤维化框架给出了单一结论判断的子结构和模态逻辑的统一解释。本文将其扩展到多输出设置，其中笛卡尔资源可以自由使用，而线性资源在旋转栅门的两侧仅出现一次。判断由描述符索引：有向无环图概括了原始框架的树形表达式。描述符 $2$-cell 编码结构变换，显式门提供线性模式下的弱化、收缩、弱化和共收缩。我们定义由两个连接词 $F$ 和 $U$ 生成的序列演算。我们证明同一性、可逆性并削减可接受性。模态和类型理论呈现线性-非线性 $2$-多类别，并且投影是局部离散纤维化和纤维化，具有单输出基态射的奥笛卡尔升力。两个充分性结果验证了该框架：其笛卡尔片段恢复了 Licata-Shulman-Riley 演算，其纯线性片段呈现了经典的乘法线性逻辑。最后，我们关联索引

items.title: Acceleration of the Method of Alternating Projections on subspaces by GMRES
items.excerpt: In this paper we propose a GMRES-accelerated version of the Method of Alternating Projections (MAP) for subspaces. It is proved that the accelerated version not only converges to a feasible solution, but also solves a best approximation problem. Comparisons are made with other accelerations proposed in the literature, for solving saddle point problems.

items.title_zh: GMRES 子空间交替投影方法的加速
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了子空间交替投影方法 (MAP) 的 GMRES 加速版本。事实证明，加速版本不仅收敛于可行解，而且解决了最佳逼近问题。与文献中提出的其他加速方法进行比较，以解决鞍点问题。

items.title: Multilevel Monte Carlo methods for random nonlinear eigenvalue problems
items.excerpt: We develop a multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) estimator to compute statistical quantities of interest of solutions to parameter-dependent nonlinear eigenvalue problems. The main difficulty for this problem is that parametrized eigenpairs often lack a globally well-defined parameter-to-solution map due to crossings and bifurcations. These phenomena render eigenvalue-tracking infeasible in multi-dimensional parameter domains. To overcome this issue, we propose both an Eulerian and a Lagrangian perspective on parameter-to-solution maps for nonlinear eigenvalue problems, which remain well-defined even in the presence of local crossings and bifurcations. Their implementation is based on a straightforward modification of Beyn's contour integral approach. Building on these maps, we propose an MLMC estimator that does not rely on matching eigenvalues or eigenvectors across samples or discretization levels. Nested approximation spaces and inter-level prolongation are only required when statistical quantities of interest related to the eigenspaces are of interest, but not for quantities of interest related to the eigenvalues. items.title_zh: 随机非线性特征值问题的多级蒙特卡罗方法

items.title: Can LLMs Reliably Grade Olympiad Proofs? A Study of Mathematical Verification with LLMs
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress on solving competition-level mathematics, yet their ability to verify natural-language mathematical proofs remains relatively underexplored. This gap is especially pronounced for Olympiad-level proofs, which require meticulous assessment of each claim in a long reasoning chain. Current proof verification thus primarily relies on expert inspection, which is costly to scale. In this paper, we present a systematic study of LLM-based verification in this setting. Specifically, we introduce a human-curated dataset of USAMO 2025 candidate solutions with expert grading, and conduct a broad evaluation of existing LLM verifiers across frontier models. We also propose TROJAN, an iterative self-critique pipeline for generating high-fidelity adversarial proofs at scale. Our comprehensive evaluation covers 20 models spanning seven metrics, two prompt styles, three inference methods, and three prompt templates, showing that state-of-the-art models still leave considerable room for improvement. items.title: Dependency Graphs of Mathematical Arguments: Representation, Structural Measurement, and Proof Review
items.excerpt: We propose a source-grounded framework for representing and measuring mathematical arguments with assistance from large language models. It includes numbered and unnumbered statements, equations, assumptions, and constructions, distinguishing source occurrences from contextual states and inference records. Proposed dependencies retain source evidence and review status. A measurement contract fixes manuscript versions, boundaries, granularity, proof choices, and macro anchors. On a selected finite directed acyclic graph, depth is the longest prerequisite-path length, and bulk counts distinct ancestor edges. We give a union recurrence that accounts for shared subarguments and identify reachability conditions preserving depth and the macro skeleton; unrestricted refinement need not preserve depth or bulk. A standardized, versioned prompt protocol separates annotation discovery, deterministic recomputation, and review assistance. Cross-paper links support a research agenda on theorem co-use, rare combinations, and connections between dependency communities. These patterns motivate probabilistic premise suggestions and review of possible o
items.title_zh: 数学论证的依赖图：表示、结构测量和证明审查
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个基于源的框架，用于在大型语言模型的帮助下表示和测量数学论证。它包括编号和未编号的陈述、方程、假设和构造，将源事件与上下文状态和推理记录区分开来。建议的依赖项保留源证据和审查状态。测量合同确定了手稿版本、边界、粒度、证明选择和宏观锚点。在选定的有限有向无环图上，深度是最长的先决路径长度，并且批量计数不同的祖先边缘。我们给出了一个联合递归，它解释了共享子参数并确定了保持深度和宏观骨架的可达性条件；无限制的细化不需要保留深度或体积。标准化的版本化提示协议将注释发现、确定性重新计算和审查协助分开。跨论文链接支持关于定理共同使用、罕见组合以及依赖社区之间的联系的研究议程。这些模式激发了概率前提建议和对可能的情况的审查

items.title: On AI Disclosures
items.excerpt: In this essay, I posit that to maintain integrity in mathematical sciences, journals and conferences must urgently adopt a policy of mandating detailed disclosures of AI usage. Academics should also respond by treating AI disclosure as a serious and integral part of the research process rather than a mere extra chore.
items.title_zh: 关于人工智能披露
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我认为为了保持数学科学的完整性，期刊和会议必须紧急采取一项政策，强制详细披露人工智能的使用情况。学者们还应该将人工智能披露视为研究过程中严肃且不可或缺的一部分，而不仅仅是一件额外的苦差事。

items.title: The Convex Hull Hypothesis
items.excerpt: Ever since the dawn of the "LLMs do math" era, many have independently come up with what I'll call the "Convex Hull Hypothesis" (CHH). Roughly speaking, CHH states that every AI-generated proof, no matter how complicated it may seem at first glance, is a simple combination of known mathematical ideas.
items.title_zh: 凸包假设
items.excerpt_zh: 自从“法学硕士做数学”时代到来以来，许多人独立提出了我所说的“凸包假设”（CHH）。粗略地说，CHH 指出，每个人工智能生成的证明，无论乍一看多么复杂，都是已知数学思想的简单组合。

items.title: A Sharp Distributional Lower Bound for Planar Discrepancy
items.excerpt: We prove that the unnormalized discrepancy function of every $n$-point set in the unit square has absolute value at least $c\sqrt{1+\log n}$ on a set of measure at least $\eta$, with absolute constants $c,\eta>0$. Consequently, its $L_p$-quasinorm is bounded below by $c\,\eta^{1/p} \sqrt{1+\log n}$ for every $p>0$.
items.title_zh: 平面差异的尖锐分布下界
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明单位正方形中每个$n$点集的非归一化差异函数在一组至少$\eta$的测度上具有至少$c\sqrt{1+\log n}$的绝对值，且绝对常数$c,\eta>0$。因此，对于每个 $p>0$，其 $L_p$-quasinorm 的下界为 $c\,\eta^{1/p} \sqrt{1+\log n}$。

items.title: On the unit group of some triquadratic fields
items.excerpt: In this paper, we calculate the unit groups and the $2$-class numbers of the fields $ \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2}, \sqrt{q}, \sqrt{rs})$, where $q\equiv3\pmod4$, $r$ and $s$ are distinct prime numbers satisfying some congruent conditions. As an application of our main results, we derive the precise 2-class number for each field in our family. Furthermore, we show that Greenberg's conjecture is verified for several infinite families of real biquadratic fields.
items.authors: Mohamed Mahmoud Chems-Eddin, Hamza El Mamry
items.title_zh: 关于一些三二次域的单位群
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们计算域 $ \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2}, \sqrt{q}, \sqrt{rs})$ 的单元组和 $2$ 类数，其中 $q\equiv3\pmod4$、$r$ 和 $s$ 是满足某些全等条件的不同素数。作为我们主要结果的应用，我们为我们家族中的每个领域导出了精确的二类数。此外，我们证明了格林伯格猜想对于几个无限的实双二次场族得到了验证。

items.title: Two parametric $q$-supercongruences from Andrews' multi-series transformation
items.excerpt: Recently, Guo and Guo (Results Math $76:37, ~2021$) obtained curious $q$-analogues of the following two supercongruences conjectured by Guo and Schlosser \cite[Conjectures $12.6$ and $12.7$]{GuoSclssr ConstApprox 21}: \begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{(p-1)/3} (6n+1) \frac{\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)_n^{4}(2n)!} {(n!)^{4}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)_{2n}} \equiv p \pmod{p^{3}} \qquad \text{for primes } p\equiv 1 \pmod{3}, \end{align*} \begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{(p+1)/3} (6n-1) \frac{\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)_n^{4}(2n)!} {(n!)^{4}\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)_{2n}} \equiv p \pmod{p^{3}} \qquad \text{for primes } p\equiv 2 \pmod{3}, \end{align*} where $(z)_n=z(z+1)\cdots(z+n-1)$ denotes the shifted factorial. In this paper, we establish a one-parameter extension of them. The main ingredients of our proofs are the creative microscoping method developed by Guo and Zudilin \cite{guo2019q} and Andrews' multi-series transformation.
items.title_zh: 安德鲁斯多级数变换的两个参数 $q$-超同余
items.excerpt_zh: 最近，Guo和Guo（结果数学$76:37，~2021$）获得了Guo和Schlosser猜想的以下两个超同余的好奇$q$类似物\cite[猜想$12.6$和$12.7$]{GuoSclssr ConstApprox 21}：\begin{align*}\sum_{n=0}^{(p-1)/3} (6n+1) \frac{\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)_n^{4}(2n)!} {(n!)^{4}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)_{2n}} \equiv p \pmod{p^{3}} \qquad \text{对于素数 } p\equiv 1 \pmod{3}, \end{align*} \begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{(p+1)/3} (6n-1) \frac{\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)_n^{4}(2n)!} {(n!)^{4}\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)_{2n}} \equiv p \pmod{p^{3}} \qquad \text{对于素数 } p\equiv 2 \pmod{3}, \end{align*} 其中 $(z)_n=z(z+1)\cdots(z+n-1)$ 表示移位阶乘。在本文中，我们建立了它们的单参数扩展。我们证明的主要成分是由Guo和Zudilin开发的创造性微观方法\cite{guo2019q}和Andrews的多级数变换。

items.title: On the evenness of coefficients of modular forms
items.excerpt: We study the density of primes such that $a_p$ is divisible by a prime above $2$ for modular forms $f = \sum_{n \ge 1} a_n q^n$ of small levels. First, we reduce the problem to low weight and odd level, or a mod $2$ CM type form. Then, we provide calculations for the evenness of particular newforms. In particular, we provide a list of levels where this "evenness" can be computed exactly for all the forms with trivial nebentypus.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究素数的密度，使得对于小级别的模形式 $f = \sum_{n \ge 1} a_n q^n$，$a_p$ 可以被 $2$ 以上的素数整除。首先，我们将问题简化为低权重和奇数级别，或 mod $2$ CM 类型形式。然后，我们提供特定新形式的均匀度的计算。特别是，我们提供了一个级别列表，其中可以针对所有具有平凡 nebentypus 的形式精确计算这种“均匀度”。
items.title_zh: 论模形式系数的均匀性

items.title: A secondary term in the first moment of cubic $L$-functions over function fields
items.excerpt: Let $q$ be a fixed odd prime power with $q\equiv2\pmod3$. We study the first moment of primitive cubic Dirichlet $L$-functions over $\Fq(T)$, ordered by their genus. By averaging the rational sieve variable in the double Dirichlet series of Hong and Fang, we obtain meromorphic continuation beyond the secondary polar divisor. Combining this continuation with the cubic Gauss-sum residues computed by David, Florea and Lal\'in gives an explicit term of order $q^{5g/6}$, with a real coefficient depending on $g$ modulo $6$, and an error $O_{q,\eps}(q^{(23/28+\eps)g})$. The periodic coefficient is not identically zero. The proof uses an exact first difference supplied by the functional equation, an Euler product for the sieve average, and Bochner's tube theorem in the Dirichlet variables.
items.title_zh: 函数域上三次 $L$ 函数的一阶矩中的次项
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $q$ 为 $q\equiv2\pmod3$ 的固定奇素数幂。我们研究 $\Fq(T)$ 上的原始三次狄利克雷 $L$ 函数的一阶矩，按其属排序。通过对 Hong 和 Fang 的双狄利克雷级数中的有理筛变量进行平均，我们获得了超出二次极除数的亚纯延拓。将此延拓与 David、Florea 和 Lal\'in 计算的三次高斯和留数相结合，给出阶 $q^{5g/6}$ 的显式项，其实数系数取决于 $g$ 模 $6$，以及误差 $O_{q,\eps}(q^{(23/28+\eps)g})$。周期系数不完全相同为零。该证明使用函数方程提供的精确一阶差分、筛平均值的欧拉积以及狄利克雷变量中的博赫纳管定理。

items.title: Local obstructions and certified computations for perfect powers in power sums
items.excerpt: Let $S_k(x)=1^k+\cdots+x^k$. We study perfect-power values of $S_k(x)$ by combining local valuations with finite congruence certificates. For an irregular Bernoulli pair $(p,r)$ with $e=v_p(B_r)\ge1$, we prove a valuation formula uniform for $k\equiv r+1\pmod{p^e(p-1)}$, subject to an explicit condition on $v_p(x(x+1))$. This gives explicit families of nonexistence results in which both $x$ and $k$ are unbounded. We also determine all solutions of $S_k(x)=y^n$ for $3\le x\le10^6$ with $x\equiv0,3\pmod4$, leaving $k$ and $n\ge2$ unrestricted and including squares. This extends Hajdu's fixed-$x$ classification in the same residue classes. A uniform restriction on the normalized odd part of $S_k(x)$ and finite certificates exclude every $k\ge6$; the remaining exponents are checked by exact integer arithmetic. The certificates admit independent verification. We further prove a limitation of congruence tests of bounded prime-power depth and solve the equation for every $x\equiv28\pmod{5\,110\,664}$.
items.title_zh: 局部障碍物和经过认证的幂总和完美幂计算
items.excerpt_zh: 设$S_k(x)=1^k+\cdots+x^k$。我们通过将局部估值与有限同余证书相结合来研究 $S_k(x)$ 的完美幂值。对于不规则伯努利对 $(p,r)$ 且 $e=v_p(B_r)\ge1$，我们证明了 $k\equiv r+1\pmod{p^e(p-1)}$ 的统一估值公式，且服从 $v_p(x(x+1))$ 的显式条件。这给出了显式的不存在结果族，其中 $x$ 和 $k$ 都是无界的。我们还用 $x\equiv0,3\pmod4$ 确定 $3\le x\le10^6$ 的 $S_k(x)=y^n$ 的所有解，使 $k$ 和 $n\ge2$ 不受限制并包括平方。这扩展了 Hajdu 在相同残留类别中的固定 $x$ 分类。对 $S_k(x)$ 的归一化奇数部分的统一限制和有限证书排除每个 $k\ge6$；其余指数通过精确整数算术检查。这些证书接受独立验证。我们进一步证明了有界素数幂深度的同余检验的局限性，并对每个 $x\equiv28\pmod{5\,110\,664}$ 求解方程。

items.title: Height growth of rational self-maps
items.excerpt: Let $K$ be a number field or a function field of a curve. Let $f$ be a dominant rational self-map of a normal projective variety $X$ of dimension $d$ over $K$, and let $h_H\geq1$ be an ample Weil height. Let $\lambda_1(f)$ denote the first dynamical degree of $f$. We show that there is a constant $C_{f,h_H}>0$ such that, for any $n\geq1$ and any point $P\in X(\overline{K})$ with well-defined forward orbit, $h_H(f^n(P))\leq C_{f,h_H}h_H(P)n^{2(d-1)}\lambda_1(f)^n$ if $\lambda_1(f)>1$, and $h_H(f^n(P))\leq C_{f,h_H}h_H(P)n^{2d}$ if $\lambda_1(f)=1$. Over number fields, the proof combines a new uniform upper bound for arithmetic degrees with a uniform comparison of point heights. Over function fields, it relies on the corresponding uniform upper bound for geometric degrees on a projective model.
items.title_zh: 理性自我图的高度增长
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $K$ 为曲线的数域或函数域。令 $f$ 为 $K$ 上维度 $d$ 的正态投影簇 $X$ 的主导理性自映射，并令 $h_H\geq1$ 为充足的 Weil 高度。令 $\lambda_1(f)$ 表示 $f$ 的第一动态度。我们证明存在一个常数 $C_{f,h_H}>0$，这样，对于任何 $n\geq1$ 和具有明确定义的前向轨道的 X(\overline{K})$ 中的任何点 $P\，$h_H(f^n(P))\leq C_{f,h_H}h_H(P)n^{2(d-1)}\lambda_1(f)^n$ 如果$\lambda_1(f)>1$，如果 $\lambda_1(f)=1$，则 $h_H(f^n(P))\leq C_{f,h_H}h_H(P)n^{2d}$。在数字域上，证明将算术度数的新统一上限与点高度的统一比较结合起来。在函数域上，它依赖于投影模型上相应的几何度的统一上限。

items.title: Squarefree Values of Random Polynomials
items.excerpt: In this paper we consider the error term in the expected count of squarefree values of a polynomial when evaluated at integers \(n\le N\). We prove a power saving on average over polynomials of fixed degree and height at most \(H\). Our results improve previous estimates of Browning and Shparlinski in that the required range of \(H\) is independent of the degree, but depends on \(N\)
items.title_zh: 随机多项式的无平方值
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们考虑以整数 \(n\le N\) 计算时多项式无平方值的预期计数中的误差项。我们证明了固定次数和高度最多\(H\) 的多项式的平均功耗。我们的结果改进了之前对 Browning 和 Shparlinski 的估计，因为所需的 \(H\) 范围与度数无关，但取决于 \(N\)

items.title: Non-adjacent triples of cells in a triangular grid: proofs of three conjectured generating functions
items.excerpt: Let $\Tn$ be the triangular grid of side $n$, with its $n^2$ unit cells, and let two cells be side-adjacent if they share an edge and point-adjacent if they share a vertex. We count the orbits of $3$-element sets of pairwise non-adjacent cells under the rotation group $C_3$ and under the full symmetry group $D_3$ of $\Tn$. Three of the four resulting sequences are OEIS A397730, A397731 and A397732, for each of which the only formula on record is a generating function conjectured by Sean A.\ Irvine on 14 July 2026. We prove all three conjectures. The route is Burnside's lemma, together with exact lattice counts for each fixed-point term. The side-adjacency graph turns out to be bipartite, so its triangle count vanishes, and the triangles of the point-adjacency graph have a clean structural description, which gives that count too. Along the way we obtain the first explicit closed forms for the three sequences, each a quasi-polynomial of degree $6$ and period $3$, $6$, $3$ respectively. The same machinery settles the fourth member of the family, whose closed form has been recorded at A289230 without proof since 2017, and the labeled coun
items.title_zh: 三角形网格中不相邻的单元三元组：三个猜想生成函数的证明
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $\Tn$ 为边 $n$ 的三角形网格，其单位单元为 $n^2$，如果两个单元共享一条边，则它们为边相邻；如果它们共享一个顶点，则为点相邻。我们计算旋转群 $C_3$ 和 $\Tn$ 的完全对称群 $D_3$ 下成对非相邻单元的 $3$ 元素集的轨道。四个结果序列中的三个是 OEIS A397730、A397731 和 A397732，其中每个序列的唯一记录公式是 Sean A.\ Irvine 在 2026 年 7 月 14 日猜想的生成函数。我们证明了所有三个猜想。该路线是伯恩赛德引理，以及每个定点项的精确格数。边邻接图原来是二部的，因此它的三角形计数消失了，并且点邻接图的三角形有一个干净的结构描述，这也给出了该计数。在此过程中，我们获得了三个序列的第一个显式封闭形式，每个序列分别是次数 $6$ 和周期 $3$、$6$、$3$ 的拟多项式。同样的机制解决了家庭的第四名成员，自 2017 年以来，其封闭表格已在没有证据的情况下记录在 A289230 中，并且标记为

items.title: Equidistribution of mesh patterns of length 2 on involutions
items.excerpt: We classify all 1024 length-two mesh patterns on involutions into exactly 287 equidis- tribution classes, consisting of 262 trivial classes and 25 nontrivial classes. Since many bi- jections on arbitrary permutations do not preserve the involution condition, our proofs use several involution-preserving bijections, including conjugation and local adjacent-transposition operations, transposition of the RSK recording tableau, prefix-rank swap bijections and marked-occurrence bijections. In particular, we establish the equidistribution of INV-099, a nontrivial class closely related to the unrestricted Class 69, by adapting the marked- occurrence bijection of Zhang and Zhao through a symmetric closure of the marked set. We also obtain explicit distribution formulas and recurrences for several classes, including continued fractions obtained by specializing known labeled Motzkin-path formulas and rational expressions derived from paired skew decompositions of involutions.
items.title_zh: 长度为 2 的网格图案在对合上的均匀分布
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将所有 1024 个长度为 2 的对合网格模式分类为 287 个等分布类，其中包括 262 个平凡类和 25 个非平凡类。由于任意排列上的许多双射不保留对合条件，因此我们的证明使用了几种保合双射，包括共轭和局部邻接转置操作、RSK 记录表的转置、前缀秩交换双射和标记出现双射。特别是，我们通过标记集的对称闭包来调整Zhang和Zhao的标记出现双射，建立了INV-099的均分布，INV-099是一个与非限制类69密切相关的非平凡类。我们还获得了几个类别的显式分布公式和递推式，包括通过专门化已知的标记莫茨金路径公式获得的连分式和从对合的成对偏斜分解导出的有理表达式。

items.title: Sages and Their Anonymous Slips
items.excerpt: Before the game, the sages agree on a finite set of symbols and on a rule for choosing one of them. They are then seated in an unknown order, either in a row or around a circle with a common clockwise direction. Each sage sees only the adjacent sage or sages and secretly writes one symbol. The slips are then mixed, so nobody learns who wrote which symbol; everyone learns only how many times each symbol occurred. The aim is that every sage should be able to independently reconstruct the entire seating. We ask for the smallest number of distinct symbols that makes this possible. We also consider a version in which the seats have fixed public labels, and each sage is told the label of their own seat. For large numbers of sages, the minimum number of symbols is proportional to the square of the number of sages, up to a constant factor. Several small cases can be settled exactly. Four sages in a row need exactly two symbols, and so do five sages on a circle. Six sages on a circle need exactly three symbols, both with and without labeled seats; we give a short explicit rule. Five sages in a row with labeled seats also need exactly three sym
items.title_zh: 圣贤和他们的匿名遗失
items.excerpt_zh: 在游戏之前，圣贤们就一组有限的符号以及选择其中一个符号的规则达成一致。然后，他们以未知的顺序就座，要么排成一排，要么绕着一个共同的顺时针方向围成一圈。每个圣人只看到相邻的一个或多个圣人，并秘密地写下一个符号。然后这些纸条被混合在一起，所以没有人知道谁写了哪个符号；每个人只知道每个符号出现了多少次。目标是每个圣人都应该能够独立地重建整个座位。我们要求最少数量的不同符号来实现这一点。我们还考虑了一个版本，其中座位有固定的公共标签，每个圣人都被告知他们自己座位的标签。对于大量圣人，符号的最小数量与圣人数量的平方成正比，最多为一个常数因子。几个小案子都能准确解决。四位连续的圣人恰好需要两个符号，五位圣人围成一圈也需要两个符号。一个圆圈上的六位圣人正好需要三个符号，无论有没有标记座位；我们给出了一个简短的明确规则。排成一排并带有标记座位的五位圣人也需要恰好三个 sym

items.title: Characteristic Chow Polynomials of Layered-Permutation Intervals
items.excerpt: We study characteristic Chow polynomials of principal intervals in generalized subword order, equivalently of pattern-containment intervals below layered permutations. A terminal-chain recurrence and canonical rightmost embeddings yield a recursive rational generating function for every fixed number of layers, governed by a universal denominator. In the two-layer case we obtain an explicit kernel, prove canonical interlacing when one layer has size at most four, and prove eventual interlacing at every fixed width by a Laguerre limit. We also treat two families with unboundedly many layers. Singleton-prefix intervals have a closed Delannoy-Jacobi gamma polynomial and form real-rooted interlacing sequences. Singleton-sandwich intervals admit rational three-variable series and a marked-slot formula for all gamma coefficients. Their central-layer-two and central-layer-three slices are real-rooted, with interlacing under growth from two to three. For each fixed pair of singleton flanks, a Laguerre differential transform proves eventual interlacing as the central layer grows. These results exhibit composition intervals as a structured testi
items.title_zh: 分层排列区间的特征Chow多项式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究广义子字顺序中主区间的特征 Chow 多项式，相当于分层排列下面的模式包含区间。终端链递归和规范的最右嵌入为每个固定层数产生一个递归有理生成函数，由通用分母控制。在两层情况下，我们获得显式内核，证明当一层的大小最多为四时的规范交错，并通过拉盖尔极限证明每个固定宽度的最终交错。我们对待两个家庭也有无限多的层次。单例前缀间隔具有闭合的 Delannoy-Jacobi 伽玛多项式并形成实根交错序列。单例三明治区间允许有理三变量级数和所有伽马系数的标记槽公式。中二层、中三层片为实根，二至三片交错生长。对于每对固定的单侧翼，拉盖尔差分变换证明随着中心层的生长最终会交错。这些结果展示了作为结构化测试的组成区间

items.title: The minimum number of wheel-saturating edges
items.excerpt: Let $G$ be an $H$-free graph and $e$ be a non-edge of $G$. We say $e$ is an $H$-saturating edge of $G$, if $G+e$ contains a copy of $H$. We denote by $f_H(n,m)$ the minimum number of $H$-saturating edges of an $n$-vertex $H$-free graph with exactly $m$ edges. In this paper, we show that $f_{W_{2k+1}}(n,ex(n,F_{2k+1})+1)= \begin{cases} \ell -k, &(k-2)\ell \ \text{is even}, 2(\ell-k)-1, &(k-2)\ell \ \text{is odd}, \end{cases}$ and $f_{W_{2k}}(n,ex(n,F_{2k})+1)=\left(\frac{2}{33}+o(1)\right)n^2.$ At the same time, we characterize the corresponding extremal graphs.
items.title_zh: 轮饱和边的最少数量
items.excerpt_zh: 令$G$ 为无$H$ 图，$e$ 为$G$ 的非边。如果 $G+e$ 包含 $H$ 的副本，我们就说 $e$ 是 $G$ 的 $H$ 饱和边。我们用 $f_H(n,m)$ 表示恰好具有 $m$ 边的 $n$-顶点 $H$-free 图的 $H$-饱和边的最小数量。在本文中，我们证明 $f_{W_{2k+1}}(n,ex(n,F_{2k+1})+1)= \begin{cases} \ell -k, &(k-2)\ell \ \text{为偶数}, 2(\ell-k)-1, &(k-2)\ell \ \text{为奇数}, \end{cases}$ 和$f_{W_{2k}}(n,ex(n,F_{2k})+1)=\left(\frac{2}{33}+o(1)\right)n^2.$同时，我们表征相应的极值图。

items.title: Nonintersecting Unit Diagonals in Odd Square Arrays
items.excerpt: Let $D(n)$ be the maximum number of unit-square diagonals in an $n\times n$ square array such that no two selected diagonals share an endpoint and no unit square contains both diagonals. We prove that, for every odd positive integer $n$, $D(n)=n(n+1)/2+\lfloor(n+1)/6\rfloor$. The matching lower bound was established by Boyland, Roth, Pint\'er, Lauk\'o, Schoenfield, and Wasielewski. We obtain the upper bound by transforming any admissible selection $M$ in a $(2k-1)\times(2k-1)$ square array into an isometric path cover of the $k\times k$ vertex grid with at most $2k^2-|M|$ paths. An auxiliary matching decomposes the original vertices into alternating paths. On each such path, all segments between blocks are either of type $da$ or of type $bc$. Projecting these paths to the block grid gives coordinate-monotone sequences, which become geodesics when diagonal steps are expanded. The Fisher--Fitzpatrick theorem then yields the sharp upper bound. We also describe a Lean verification of the upper-bound reduction, with the grid-cover theorem supplied as an explicit hypothesis.
items.title_zh: 奇数方阵中不相交的单位对角线
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $D(n)$ 为 $n\times n$ 方阵中单位方对角线的最大数量，使得没有两个选定的对角线共享端点，并且没有单位方格包含两条对角线。我们证明，对于每个奇数正整数 $n$，$D(n)=n(n+1)/2+\lfloor(n+1)/6\rfloor$。匹配下界由 Boyland、Roth、Pint'er、Lauk'o、Schoenfield 和 Wasielewski 建立。我们通过将 $(2k-1)\times(2k-1)$ 方阵中的任何允许选择 $M$ 转换为 $k\times k$ 顶点网格的等距路径覆盖（最多具有 $2k^2-|M|$ 路径）来获得上限。辅助匹配将原始顶点分解为交替路径。在每个这样的路径上，块之间的所有段都是 $da$ 类型或 $bc$ 类型。将这些路径投影到块网格会给出坐标单调序列，当对角线步长展开时，这些序列将变成测地线。然后费舍尔-菲茨帕特里克定理得出尖锐的上限。我们还描述了上限减少的精益验证，并提供了网格覆盖定理作为明确的假设。

items.title: Second largest eigenvalue thresholds for the vertex-connectivity of regular graphs
items.excerpt: Let $\lambda_2(G)$ and $\kappa(G)$ denote the second largest adjacency eigenvalue and the vertex-connectivity of a graph $G$. For a non-complete $r$-regular graph $G$, Fiedler's inequality $\lambda_2(G)\ge r-\kappa(G)$ shows that $\lambda_2(G)<\frac{r+2}{2}$, it is replaced by one of two explicit algebraic numbers, and the sign of an explicit polynomial $W(r,t)$, which never vanishes, decides which one applies. Each of the two numbers is attained exactly when $(r,t)$ satisfies an explicit arithmetic condition, and every extremal graph then consists of two cliques and an independent cut of size $t$. In this range our bound also improves a bound of Zhang that holds for every such $t$.
items.title_zh: 正则图顶点连通性的第二大特征值阈值
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\lambda_2(G)$ 和 $\kappa(G)$ 表示图 $G$ 的第二大邻接特征值和顶点连通性。对于非完备$r$-正则图$G$，费德勒不等式$\lambda_2(G)\ge r-\kappa(G)$表明$\lambda_2(G)<\frac{r+2}{2}$，它被两个显式代数数之一替换，并且永不消失的显式多项式$W(r,t)$的符号决定了应用哪一个。当 $(r,t)$ 满足显式算术条件时，恰好获得这两个数字中的每一个，并且每个极值图由两个派和大小为 $t$ 的独立割组成。在这个范围内，我们的界限还改进了对于每个这样的$t$都成立的Zhang界限。

items.title: Explicit strong blocking sets and minimal codes from expander graphs using a new graph parameter
items.excerpt: A strong blocking set is a set of points in a finite projective space that intersects every hyperplane of the space in a spanning set of the hyperplane. These objects have been studied both in finite geometry and coding theory due to their equivalence with minimal codes. We give an explicit construction of strong blocking sets using expander graphs that improves the explicit construction of Alon et al. (Noga Alon, Anurag Bishnoi, Shagnik Das, Alessandro Neri, Strong blocking sets and minimal codes from expander graphs. Transactions of the American Mathematical Society ) by introducing a new geometrically motivated graph parameter that is better suited for this problem. Using this approach, we improve the constant $C$ in the explicit construction of a strong blocking set of size $C (q+1) k$ in the $(k - 1)$-dimensional projective space over $\mathbb{F}_q$ for every prime power $q \geq 7$.
items.title_zh: 使用新的图形参数从扩展图中显式强阻塞集和最少代码
items.excerpt_zh: 强阻塞集是有限射影空间中的一组点，这些点与超平面的生成集中的空间的每个超平面相交。由于这些对象与最小代码等效，因此在有限几何和编码理论中都对这些对象进行了研究。我们使用扩展图给出了强阻塞集的显式构造，改进了 Alon 等人的显式构造。 （Noga Alon、Anurag Bishnoi、Shagnik Das、Alessandro Neri，扩展图的强阻塞集和最小代码。美国数学会汇刊）通过引入更适合此问题的新的几何驱动图参数。使用这种方法，我们在 $(k - 1)$ 维射影空间中显式构造大小为 $C (q+1) k$ 的强分块集时，对于每个素数幂 $q \geq 7$ 改进了 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上的常数 $C$。

items.title: Automorphisms and Hodge isometries of surfaces with $K^2=p_g=1$
items.excerpt: Let $S$ be a minimal complex surface of general type with $K_S^2=p_g(S)=1$. By a theorem of Catanese, the canonical model of $S$ is a complete intersection of two sextics in $\mathbf{P}(1,2,2,3,3)$ whose equations admit a normal form, and the global Torelli theorem fails for these surfaces. We describe $\operatorname{Aut}(S)$ in terms of the coefficients of the normal form, prove that $|\operatorname{Aut}(S)|\leq 72$, and classify the surfaces attaining the bound: two surfaces with singular canonical model and a one-parameter family $X_r$ of smooth surfaces. For the surfaces $X_r$ we compute a basis of the primitive cohomology consisting of eigenvectors of a subgroup $\mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z} \times \mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z}$ of $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$, given by residues of explicit polynomials, together with the intersection form in this basis. We then show that the natural map from $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$ to the group of Hodge isometries of the primitive lattice modulo $\pm1$ is injective but has image of index at least $331\,776$, so that the Torelli principle for automorphisms fails for these surfaces.
items.authors: Jorge Duque Franco, Alvaro Liendo, Pedro Montero
items.title_zh: $K^2=p_g=1$ 的曲面自同构和 Hodge 等距
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $S$ 为一般类型的最小复曲面，其中 $K_S^2=p_g(S)=1$。根据 Catanese 定理，$S$ 的规范模型是 $\mathbf{P}(1,2,2,3,3)$ 中两个六次方程的完全交集，其方程采用范式，而全局托雷利定理对于这些曲面是失败的。我们用范式系数描述 $\operatorname{Aut}(S)$，证明 $|\operatorname{Aut}(S)|\leq 72$，并对达到边界的表面进行分类：具有奇异规范模型的两个表面和光滑表面的单参数族 $X_r$。对于曲面 $X_r$，我们计算由 $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$ 的子群 $\mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z} \times \mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z}$ 的特征向量组成的本原上同调基，由显式多项式的留数给出，以及该基上的交集形式。然后我们证明从 $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$ 到本原晶格模 $\pm1$ 的 Hodge 等距群的自然映射是单射的，但索引图像至少为 $331\,776$，因此自同构的 Torelli 原理对于这些曲面是失败的。

items.title: GKZ Systems and Gauss-Manin Connections of Families of Projective Hypersurfaces
items.excerpt: Periods of projective hypersurfaces satisfy GKZ hypergeometric systems, which may have solutions that do not arise as periods. For deformations of Fermat hypersurfaces, we describe the Gauss-Manin connection in terms of images of contiguity operators between GKZ systems. These images are also realized as Fourier transforms of minimal extensions of Kummer modules.
items.title_zh: GKZ 系统和射影超曲面族的高斯-马南连接
items.excerpt_zh: 射影超曲面的周期满足 GKZ 超几何系统，该系统可能具有不作为周期出现的解。对于费马超曲面的变形，我们用 GKZ 系统之间的邻接算子图像来描述高斯-马宁连接。这些图像也被实现为 Kummer 模块最小扩展的傅立叶变换。

items.title: Movable Curves and Ample Normal Bundles
items.excerpt: We prove that the movable cone of a smooth complex projective variety is the closed cone generated by possibly singular curves with ample coherent normal sheaves, answering a question of Boucksom--Demailly--P\u{a}un--Peternell. For smooth curves, we establish the analogous equality in several geometric settings and give explicit constructions on blowups.
items.title_zh: 可移动的曲线和充足的法线束
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了光滑复射影簇的可动锥体是由具有充足相干法向滑轮的可能奇异曲线生成的闭锥体，回答了 Boucksom--Demailly--P\u{a}un--Peternell 的问题。对于平滑曲线，我们在几个几何设置中建立了类似的等式，并给出了爆炸的明确构造。

items.title: Brauer--Manin obstruction for Weil restrictions
items.excerpt: For a quasi-projective variety $X$ defined over a number field $k$, let $X'$ be its Weil restriction with respect to a finite field extension $k/k'$. We prove that the Brauer--Manin set of $X$ agrees with the Brauer--Manin set of $X'$. We also prove the agreement for Brauer--Manin set of them given by $\mathrm{Br}_1$.
items.title_zh: 布劳尔——马宁对韦尔限制的阻碍
items.excerpt_zh: 对于在数域 $k$ 上定义的准射影簇 $X$，令 $X'$ 为其相对于有限域扩展 $k/k'$ 的 Weil 限制。我们证明 $X$ 的 Brauer--Manin 集与 $X'$ 的 Brauer--Manin 集一致。我们还证明了 $\mathrm{Br}_1$ 给出的布劳尔-马宁集的一致性。

items.title: Uniform asymptotics and the Weil--Petersson constant
items.excerpt: In their celebrated work on the large-genus asymptotic expansion of Weil--Petersson volumes, Mirzakhani and Zograf left open the question of whether the Weil--Petersson constant satisfies $C_{\mathrm{WP}}=\pi^{-1/2}$. We resolve the conjecture affirmatively. Our strategy is to consider a family of spectral curves interpolating between $y=z-4z^3$ and $y=\sin(2\pi z)/(2\pi)$. For each fixed number $n\geq2$ of marked points, we normalize the cusp coefficients using the action integral and the derivative at its first positive zero. We prove that the logarithmic derivatives of these normalized coefficients with respect to the family parameter are $O_n(g^{-1})$, uniformly along the family. The proof combines the descendant recursion, positivity, the dilaton equation, KdV, and coefficient asymptotics for the Painlev\'e I equation.
items.title_zh: 一致渐近和 Weil--Petersson 常数
items.excerpt_zh: 在他们关于 Weil-Petersson 卷的大属渐近展开的著名工作中，Mirzakhani 和 Zograf 留下了 Weil-Petersson 常数是否满足 $C_{\mathrm{WP}}=\pi^{-1/2}$ 的问题。我们肯定地解决了这个猜想。我们的策略是考虑在 $y=z-4z^3$ 和 $y=\sin(2\pi z)/(2\pi)$ 之间插值的一系列光谱曲线。对于每个固定数量 $n\geq2$ 的标记点，我们使用作用积分和第一个正零处的导数对尖点系数进行归一化。我们证明这些归一化系数相对于族参数的对数导数是 $O_n(g^{-1})$，均匀地沿着族。该证明结合了 Painlev\'e I 方程的后代递归、正性、膨胀方程、KdV 和系数渐近。

items.title: Explicit equations of three pairs of fake projective planes
items.excerpt: We find explicit polynomial equations in their bicanonical embeddings into $\mathbb C\mathbb P^9$ for the pairs of fake projective planes labeled by $(C18,p=3,\{2\},D_3), (C18,p=3,\{2\},(dD)_3)$ and $(C18,p=3,\{2\},(d^2D)_3)$ in the Cartwright-Steger classification. We do this by starting with the equations of the commensurable fake projective plane labeled by $(C18,p=3,\{2I\})$ that were found in arXiv:2512.03213.
items.title_zh: 三对假射影平面的显式方程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在$(C18,p=3,\{2\},D_3)、(C18,p=3,\{2\},(dD)_3)$和$(C18,p=3,\{2\},(d^2D)_3)$标记的伪射影平面对的双正则嵌入中找到了显式多项式方程$\mathbb C\mathbb P^9$卡特赖特-斯蒂格分类。我们从 arXiv:2512.03213 中找到的标记为 $(C18,p=3,\{2I\})$ 的可公度假射影平面方程开始来做到这一点。

items.title: Global invertibility of polynomial mappings and connectedness of preimages of large spheres
items.excerpt: We prove that a polynomial mapping $\mathbb{R}^2 \to \mathbb{R}^2$ with nowhere zero Jacobian determinant is a global diffeomorphism provided the preimage of large circles are connected. In higher dimensions this result fails and we present families of counterexamples. Yet, in dimension $3$ with codimension of Jelonek set greater than one, we prove that if the preimages of large spheres are connected, then the Jelonek set of the mapping is neither homeomorphic to a line nor can have a single end at infinity.
items.authors: Francisco Braun, Zbigniew Jelonek, Maria Michalska
items.title_zh: 多项式映射的全局可逆性和大球体原像的连通性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，如果大圆的原像相连，则雅可比行列式不为零的多项式映射 $\mathbb{R}^2 \ 到 \mathbb{R}^2$ 是全局微分同胚。在更高的维度中，这个结果失败了，我们提出了一系列反例。然而，在 Jelonek 集余维大于 1 的维度 $3$ 中，我们证明，如果大球体的原像是连通的，那么映射的 Jelonek 集既不同胚于直线，也不可能在无穷远处有单一端点。

items.title: The generalized Dixmier conjecture and the two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture
items.excerpt: We prove that the two-dimensional Jacobian conjecture $\mathrm{JC}_2$ implies the generalized Dixmier conjecture $\mathrm{DC}'_1$ for the first Weyl algebra $A_1$, which states, in one of several equivalent formulations, that every endomorphism of the two-by-two matrix ring $\operatorname{Mat}_2(A_1)$ is invertible. For the converse, an endomorphism of $\mathbb A^2_{\mathbb C}$ with Jacobian one gives rise to a family of holonomic $A_2$-modules over finite fields. One needs to lift this family to an $A_2$-module in characteristic zero with the prescribed arithmetic support. The existence of such a lift is a special case of Kontsevich's conjecture on holonomic $\mathcal D$-modules with prescribed arithmetic support. We prove that in this special situation such a lift is unique whenever it exists. If these lifts exists for every endomorphism with Jacobian one, then $\mathrm{DC}'_1$ implies $\mathrm{JC}_2$. For every $n\ge 3$, we construct a Lagrangian subvariety of $T^*\mathbb{A}^n$ that provides a counterexample to Kontsevich's conjecture. The counterexamples arise from the graph of a noninvertible symplectic endomorphism of $\mathbb A
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明二维雅可比猜想 $\mathrm{JC}_2$ 隐含了第一个 Weyl 代数 $A_1​​$ 的广义迪克斯米尔猜想 $\mathrm{DC}'_1$，它在几个等价公式之一中指出，二乘二矩阵环 $\operatorname{Mat}_2(A_1)$ 的每个自同态都是可逆的。相反，$\mathbb A^2_{\mathbb C}$ 与雅可比一的自同态产生了有限域上的完整 $A_2$ 模族。我们需要将这个系列提升到特征为零的 $A_2$ 模块，并具有规定的算术支持。这种升力的存在是 Kontsevich 对具有指定算术支持的完整 $\mathcal D$ 模的猜想的一个特例。我们证明，在这种特殊情况下，这样的电梯无论何时存在都是独一无二的。如果这些提升对于每个具有雅可比同态的自同态都存在，那么 $\mathrm{DC}'_1$ 意味着 $\mathrm{JC}_2$。对于每个 $n\ge 3$，我们构造 $T^*\mathbb{A}^n$ 的拉格朗日子品种，它为 Kontsevich 的猜想提供了反例。反例来自 $\mathbb A 的不可逆辛自同态图
items.title_zh: 广义迪克斯米尔猜想和二维雅可比猜想

items.title: Cutoff profile for the coupon collector with many collections
items.excerpt: We solve the problem posed by Erd\H{o}s and R\'enyi in $1961$ about the limiting distribution of the number of draws $T_{n,m}$ that a coupon collector needs to complete $m$ collections of $n$ distinct types of coupons, when $m$ increases with $n$. For fixed $m$, Erd\H{o}s and R\'enyi proved that $\mathbb P(T_{n,m}\leq n\log n+(m-1)n\log\log n-n\log (m-1)!+\theta n)$ converges to $ \mathcal G(\theta)$, for every $\theta \in \mathbb R$, as $n \to \infty$, where $\mathcal G$ is the standard Gumbel distribution function, and they asked what happens when $m=m(n)$ increases with $n$. We give a complete answer to this question. More precisely, for every increasing sequence $m=m(n)$, we determine explicit sequences $t_{n,m}$ and $w_{n,m}$ satisfying $w_{n,m}/t_{n,m}\to0$ such that $\mathbb P(T_{n,m}\leq t_{n,m}+\theta w_{n,m})\to\mathcal G(\theta)$ for every $\theta\in\mathbb R$. We also determine the corresponding asymptotic behavior of $\mathbb E[T_{n,m}]$. To prove these results, we present a methodology, inspired by Poissonization, that can be applied to determine the asymptotic behaviors of standardized hitting times of discrete-time sto
items.excerpt_zh: 我们解决了 Erd\H{o}s 和 R\'enyi 在 $1961$ 中提出的问题，即当 $m$ 随着 $n$ 增加时，优惠券收集者完成 $m$ 个 $n$ 不同类型优惠券的收集所需的抽奖次数 $T_{n,m}$ 的限制分布。对于固定的 $m$，Erd\H{o}s 和 R\'enyi 证明了 $\mathbb P(T_{n,m}\leq n\log n+(m-1)n\log\log n-n\log (m-1)!+\theta n)$ 收敛于 $ \mathcal G(\theta)$，对于每个 $\theta \in \mathbb R$，如 $n \to \infty$，其中$\mathcal G$ 是标准的 Gumbel 分布函数，他们问当 $m=m(n)$ 随着 $n$ 增加时会发生什么。对于这个问题我们给出完整的答案。更准确地说，对于每个递增序列$m=m(n)$，我们确定满足$w_{n,m}/t_{n,m}\to0$的显式序列$t_{n,m}$和$w_{n,m}$，使得$\mathbb P(T_{n,m}\leq t_{n,m}+\theta w_{n,m})\to\mathcal G(\theta)$对于每个$\theta\in\mathbb R$。我们还确定了 $\mathbb E[T_{n,m}]$ 相应的渐近行为。为了证明这些结果，我们提出了一种受泊松化启发的方法，该方法可用于确定离散时间股票的标准化命中时间的渐近行为
items.title_zh: 具有许多收藏品的优惠券收集者的截止配置文件

items.title: Absorption probabilities of random walks without symmetry or general position
items.excerpt: Let $S_1,S_2,\dots$ be a random walk in $\mathbb R^d$ with independent identically distributed increments. We show that, for every distribution of the increments and for every $n\ge1$, \[ \mathbb P\bigl[0\notin\mathrm{conv}(S_1,\dots,S_n)\bigr] = \sum_{m=1}^n\frac1{m!}\sum_{\substack{k_1,\dots,k_m\ge1\\ k_1+\dots+k_m=n}}\frac{1}{k_1\cdots k_m}\,\mathbb P\bigl[0\notin\mathrm{conv}(S^{(1)}_{k_1},\dots,S^{(m)}_{k_m})\bigr], \] where $S^{(1)},S^{(2)},\dots$ are independent copies of the walk. No symmetry, general position or moment assumptions are needed. The result rests on a deterministic identity: for arbitrary vectors $x_1,\dots,x_n$, the number of orderings for which the convex hull of the partial sums avoids the origin equals the number of permutations for which the convex hull of the cycle sums avoids it. We derive it from a permutation-averaging identity for valuations obtained in our earlier work. Consequences include the identities of Sparre Andersen and Spitzer, the distribution-free absorption probabilities of Kabluchko, Vysotsky and Zaporozhets, their generating function found by Petrov, Randon-Furling and Zaporozhets, and a
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $S_1,S_2,\dots$ 为 $\mathbb R^d$ 中具有独立同分布增量的随机游走。我们证明，对于每个增量分布和每个 $n\ge1$， \[ \mathbb P\bigl[0\notin\mathrm{conv}(S_1,\dots,S_n)\bigr] = \sum_{m=1}^n\frac1{m!}\sum_{\substack{k_1,\dots,k_m\ge1\\ k_1+\dots+k_m=n}}\frac{1}{k_1\cdots k_m}\,\mathbb P\bigl[0\notin\mathrm{conv}(S^{(1)}_{k_1},\dots,S^{(m)}_{k_m})\bigr], \] 其中 $S^{(1)},S^{(2)},\dots$ 是独立副本步行的。不需要对称性、一般位置或力矩假设。结果取决于确定性恒等式：对于任意向量 $x_1,\dots,x_n$，部分和的凸包避开原点的排序数等于循环和的凸包避开原点的排列数。我们从我们早期工作中获得的估值的排列平均恒等式中得出它。结果包括 Sparre Andersen 和 Spitzer 的恒等式，Kabluchko、Vysotsky 和 ​​Zaporozhets 的无分布吸收概率，Petrov、Randon-Furling 和 Zaporozhets 发现的生成函数，以及
items.title_zh: 无对称性或一般位置的随机游走的吸收概率

items.title: Berry-Esseen bounds for products of random matrices under a $2+\delta$ polynomial moment
items.excerpt: Let $(g_{k})_{k \geq 1}$ be a sequence of independent and identically distributed matrices with law $\mu$ on $\mathrm{GL}(d,\mathbb{R})$, where $d\geq2$ is an integer. Suppose that the closed semigroup generated by the support of $\mu$ is strongly irreducible and proximal and that the polynomial moment of order $2+\delta$ is finite, where $0<\delta\leq 1$. We establish a Berry-Esseen bound of order $n^{-\delta/2}$ for $\log \| g_{n} \cdots g_{1} v\|$, where $v$ is a nonzero vector in $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ and $\|\cdot\|$ is an arbitrary norm on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$. As an application, we also obtain a Berry-Esseen bound of order $n^{-\delta/2}$ for $\log \| g_{n} \cdots g_{1}\|$, where $\|\cdot\|$ is any matrix norm. The proof combines an $m$-dependent approximation with Stein's method. The argument uses identities for exchangeable pairs constructed by resampling individual matrices, together with a concentration inequality for sums of the approximating variables.
items.authors: Zhi-Jun Cai, Qi-Man Shao, Hui Xiao, Zhuo-Song Zhang
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $(g_{k})_{k \geq 1}$ 为独立同分布矩阵序列，在 $\mathrm{GL}(d,\mathbb{R})$ 上具有 $\mu$ 定律，其中 $d\geq2$ 是整数。假设由 $\mu$ 的支持生成的闭半群是强不可约且近端的，并且 $2+\delta$ 阶多项式矩是有限的，其中 $0<\delta\leq 1$。我们为 $\log \| 建立一个阶数为 $n^{-\delta/2}$ 的 Berry-Esseen 界。 g_{n} \cdots g_{1} v\|$，其中$v$是$\mathbb{R}^{d}$中的非零向量，$\|\cdot\|$是$\mathbb{R}^{d}$上的任意范数。作为一个应用程序，我们还获得了 $\log \| 的阶数 $n^{-\delta/2}$ 的 Berry-Esseen 界。 g_{n} \cdots g_{1}\|$，其中 $\|\cdot\|$ 是任意矩阵范数。该证明将 $m$ 相关近似与 Stein 方法相结合。该论证使用通过对各个矩阵重新采样构造的可交换对的恒等式，以及近似变量之和的集中不等式。
items.title_zh: $2+\delta$ 多项式矩下随机矩阵乘积的 Berry-Esseen 界限

items.title: An upper bound on the smallest singular value of dense signed random combinatorial matrices
items.excerpt: Let $M_n$ be an $n\times n$ random matrix with entries in $\{-1, 0, 1\}$, where each row is independently and uniformly sampled from the set of all vectors in $\{-1, 0, 1\}^n$ containing exactly $d$ nonzero entries, with $d=pn$ for some fixed constant $p\in(0,1/2]$. A recent result by one of the authors gives a lower bound of order $n^{-1/2}$ for the smallest singular value $s_n(M_n)$ of this model with high probability. In this paper, we establish a matching upper bound for $s_n(M_n)$. Specifically, there exists a constant $C_p>0$ depending only on $p$ such that \[ \forall \varepsilon >0 \qquad \mathbb{P} \left( s_n(M_n) \le \frac{\sqrt{d}}{\varepsilon^2 n} \right) \ge 1-C_p\left(\varepsilon + \frac{1}{\sqrt{d}}\right). \] Consequently, in the dense regime, the smallest singular value $s_n(M_n)$ of signed random combinatorial matrices is typically of order $n^{-1/2}$.
items.authors: Yuxiao Shi, Zeyan Song, Kexin Yu, Tingzhou Yu
items.title_zh: 稠密有符号随机组合矩阵的最小奇异值的上限
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $M_n$ 是一个 $n\times n$ 随机矩阵，其中的条目在 $\{-1, 0, 1\}$ 中，其中每行都是从 $\{-1, 0, 1\}^n$ 中的所有向量集中独立且均匀地采样，其中恰好包含 $d$ 个非零条目，其中 $d=pn$ 表示某个固定常数 $p\in(0,1/2]$。一位作者最近的结果给出了阶数下限$n^{-1/2}$ 为该模型的最小奇异值 $s_n(M_n)$，在本文中，我们为 $s_n(M_n)$ 建立了一个匹配上限。具体来说，存在一个仅取决于 $p$ 的常数 $C_p>0$，使得 \[ \forall \varepsilon >0 \qquad \mathbb{P} \left( s_n(M_n) \le \frac{\sqrt{d}}{\varepsilon^2 n} \right) \ge 1-C_p\left(\varepsilon + \frac{1}{\sqrt{d}}\right) 因此，在稠密状态下，有符号随机组合矩阵的最小奇异值 $s_n(M_n)$ 通常为 $n^{-1/2}$ 阶。

items.title: Path space large deviation on a lattice for interacting particle systems
items.excerpt: We investigate the path space large deviation principle (LDP) for a class of interacting particle systems on a fixed finite discrete torus. As an illustrative example, we use the partial exclusion process with maximal occupation of $s$ particles. We first verify the standard Kurtz-type law of large numbers for the original and tilted processes, thereby identifying the deterministic flows around which the large deviations are formulated. We then establish the path space LDP, with speed $s$, and identify the associated rate function in variational form as the Legendre transform of a nonlinear Hamiltonian. The proof relies on martingale techniques, exponential tightness, and a change-of-measure argument based on exponential tilting, which renders atypical trajectories typical under a modified dynamics. We also explain how the same strategy extends to further interacting particle systems. The inclusion process illustrates the conservative non-compact finite-jump case. The harmonic process is qualitatively different: a single transition may move a variable number of particles, and the limiting Hamiltonian is logarithmic with a non-trivial
items.title_zh: 相互作用粒子系统的晶格上的路径空间大偏差
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了固定有限离散环上一类相互作用粒子系统的路径空间大偏差原理（LDP）。作为说明性示例，我们使用最大占用 $s$ 粒子的部分排除过程。我们首先验证原始过程和倾斜过程的标准库尔兹型大数定律，从而识别出大偏差所围绕的确定性流。然后，我们建立路径空间 LDP，速度为 $s$，并将变分形式的相关速率函数识别为非线性哈密顿量的勒让德变换。该证明依赖于鞅技术、指数紧度和基于指数倾斜的测量参数变化，这使得非典型轨迹在修改后的动力学下变得典型。我们还解释了相同的策略如何扩展到进一步相互作用的粒子系统。包含过程说明了保守的非紧凑有限跳跃情况。调和过程在本质上是不同的：单个跃迁可能会移动可变数量的粒子，并且极限哈密顿量是具有非平凡的对数

items.title: Boundedness of the Density of Wiener Functionals with Low Regularity
items.excerpt: In this paper we prove that if a Wiener functional $F$ is $1+\delta$-differentiable in the Malliavin sense for some $\delta>0$ and satisfies the nondegeneracy condition, then the density of the law of $F$ exists, is bounded and is H\"{o}lder continuous of every exponent $\beta<\delta$. This gives a partial positive answer to a problem proposed by Watanabe [13]; to date, this seems to be the best result available for the boundedness of the density of Wiener functionals. The approach is based on the fractional order Sobolev spaces associated with a probability measure and on the Riesz transform.
items.title_zh: 低正则维纳泛函密度的有界性
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明，如果维纳函数 $F$ 对于某些 $\delta>0$ 在 Malliavin 意义上是 $1+\delta$ 可微的，并且满足非简并条件，则 $F$ 定律的密度存在，有界并且每个指数 $\beta<\delta$ 都是 H\"{o}lder 连续的。这对 Watanabe [13] 提出的问题给出了部分肯定的答案；迄今为止，这似乎是最好的可用于维纳泛函密度有界性的结果 该方法基于与概率测度相关的分数阶 Sobolev 空间和 Riesz 变换。

items.title: Asymptotic expansions for random walks conditioned to stay positive with arbitrary endpoints
items.excerpt: We consider a one-dimensional random walk $S_n$ with i.i.d. integer-valued increments having zero mean and finite variance. Under suitable moment assumptions, we derive asymptotic expansions for the local probabilities $\pr(x+S_n=y,\tau_x>n)$, where $\tau_x=\inf\{n\ge1:x+S_n\le0\}$. These extend previous expansions for walks started at zero to arbitrary starting points. We obtain different expansions according to the sizes of the starting point and endpoint relative to $\sqrt n$.
items.title_zh: 随机游走的渐近展开条件为在任意端点上保持正值
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑具有 i.i.d 的一维随机游走 $S_n$。具有零均值和有限方差的整数值增量。在合适的矩假设下，我们推导出局部概率 $\pr(x+S_n=y,\tau_x>n)$ 的渐近展开式，其中 $\tau_x=\inf\{n\ge1:x+S_n\le0\}$。这些扩展了之前从零开始到任意起点的步行扩展。我们根据起点和终点相对于$\sqrt n$的大小得到不同的展开。

items.title: Limiting moments of sample covariance matrices from large fold tensor vectors
items.excerpt: We study the moments of sample covariance matrices $M_{n,k,m}$ formed from independent $k$-fold tensor products of $n$-dimensional random vectors. The base vectors have independent and identically distributed centered complex entries with unit variance and finite moments of all orders. For every fixed $p \in \mathbb N_+$, under suitable moment conditions, we obtain an asymptotic formula for $p$th moment as $n, k, m$ tend to infinity with $m/n^k \to c \in (0,\infty)$. There is no restriction on the growth rate of $k$ relative to $n$. We also prove a variance bound and obtain the corresponding almost sure asymptotic formula. The results recover known limiting moments in several regimes. When $k/n$ tends to infinity and the modulus of base vector entry is not constant, we establish the asymptotic growth rate for the $p$th moment of normalized matrices. In this regime, we also provide a lower bound for the growth rate of the largest eigenvalue.
items.title_zh: 大倍张量向量样本协方差矩阵的极限矩
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由 $n$ 维随机向量的独立 $k$ 倍张量积形成的样本协方差矩阵 $M_{n,k,m}$ 的矩。基向量具有独立且同分布的中心复数项，具有单位方差和所有阶的有限矩。对于每一个固定的$p \in \mathbb N_+$，在合适的矩条件下，我们得到$p$时刻的渐近公式，因为$n, k, m$趋于无穷大，$m/n^k \to c \in (0,\infty)$。 $k$相对于$n$的增长率没有限制。我们还证明了方差界并得到了相应的几乎确定的渐近公式。结果恢复了几种状态下的已知极限力矩。当$k/n$趋于无穷大且基向量项的模不恒定时，我们建立归一化矩阵的第$p$矩的渐近增长率。在这种情况下，我们还为最大特征值的增长率提供了下限。

items.title: Derivative-Informed Dimension Reduction of Stochastic Differential Equations: A Path-Space Sensitivity Approach
items.excerpt: Uncertainty in the drift of a stochastic differential equation (SDE) induces uncertainty in statistical observables defined as expected functionals on path space. We propose a derivative-informed method for identifying low-dimensional structure in the drift-to-observable map, with the aim of improving the tractability of uncertainty quantification. This approach can be viewed as a generalization of the active subspace method to infinite-dimensional input spaces and to path-space observables of SDEs. Representing uncertainty in the drift by random perturbations in a Hilbert space, we construct a path-space sensitivity operator using first-order Fr\'echet derivatives of the observable with respect to the perturbation. We establish conditions under which the leading eigenfunctions of this operator correspond to directions of maximum mean squared sensitivity of the observable, thus enabling low-dimensional approximation with certified error bounds. We further introduce a martingale control variate of the Fr\'echet derivative that reduces error in sample-based estimators of the operator. Using a Galerkin scheme for numerical discretization
items.authors: Joanna Zou, Han Cheng Lie, Youssef Marzouk
items.title_zh: 随机微分方程的导数降维：路径空间敏感性方法
items.excerpt_zh: 随机微分方程 (SDE) 漂移的不确定性会导致定义为路径空间上的预期泛函的统计可观测量的不确定性。我们提出了一种基于导数的方法来识别漂移可观测图中的低维结构，目的是提高不确定性量化的易处理性。这种方法可以被视为活动子空间方法对无限维输入空间和 SDE 的路径空间可观测量的推广。通过希尔伯特空间中的随机扰动来表示漂移的不确定性，我们使用可观测量相对于扰动的一阶 Fr\'echet 导数构建了路径空间灵敏度算子。我们建立了该算子的主要特征函数对应于可观测值的最大均方灵敏度方向的条件，从而实现具有经过认证的误差范围的低维近似。我们进一步引入了 Fr'echet 导数的鞅控制变量，它减少了基于样本的算子估计量的误差。使用 Galerkin 方案进行数值离散

items.title: Hybridizable Discontinuous Galerkin methods for the Keller-Segel model
items.excerpt: We propose a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) finite element method to approximate the solution of the time-dependent Keller-Segel model, a drift-diffusion system describing chemotactic cell movement. We develop and analyze the corresponding HDG scheme, and establish theoretical convergence results for the proposed discretization. Finally, we present numerical experiments that confirm the theoretical findings.
items.authors: Silvia Bertoluzza, Gabriella Bretti, Micol Pennacchio, Christophe Prud'homme
items.title_zh: Keller-Segel 模型的可杂交不连续 Galerkin 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种可混合的不连续伽辽金 (HDG) 有限元方法来近似求解时间相关的 Keller-Segel 模型，这是一种描述趋化细胞运动的漂移扩散系统。我们开发并分析了相应的 HDG 方案，并为所提出的离散化建立了理论收敛结果。最后，我们提出了数值实验来证实理论结果。

items.title: Robust augmented Block Preconditioning for two-phase Incompressible Inductionless MHD
items.excerpt: In this paper, we develop a robust augmented block preconditioner for three-dimensional, two-phase, incompressible inductionless MHD equations. We employ a high-order monolithic and charge-conservative arbitrary Lagrangian--Eulerian (ALE) finite element method as base scheme, for which the solution variables are current density, velocity, electric potential and pressure. Grad-div stabilization is added in both the current density equation and discrete momentum equation. Backward Euler method is used for the time discretization. At each time step, fully coupled solution strategy is adopted. This leads to large-scale, ill-conditioned, nonsymmetric, and indefinite dual saddle-point system. To solve this system efficiently, we construct an augmented block preconditioner within the constraint preconditioning framework. The ultimate preconditioner combines the augmented Lagrangian technique with approximate block factorization for current density sub-system and fluid sub-system. The fully coupled four-field system is then solved using preconditioned FGMRES iteration. Numerical experiments confirm the high-order accuracy and discrete charge
items.authors: Bijie Song, Lingxiao Li, Jie Zhang
items.title_zh: 两相不可压缩无感 MHD 的鲁棒增强块预处理
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们为三维、两相、不可压缩无感应 MHD 方程开发了一种鲁棒的增强块预处理器。我们采用高阶整体且电荷守恒的任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）有限元法作为基本方案，其解变量为电流密度、速度、电势和压力。在电流密度方程和离散动量方程中都添加了梯度稳定。时间离散化采用后向欧拉法。在每个时间步，都采用完全耦合的解决策略。这导致了大规模、病态、非对称和不确定的双鞍点系统。为了有效地解决这个系统，我们在约束预处理框架内构造了一个增强块预处理器。最终的预处理器将增强拉格朗日技术与电流密度子系统和流体子系统的近似分块分解相结合。然后使用预处理的 FGMRES 迭代求解完全耦合的四场系统。数值实验证实了高阶精度和离散电荷

items.title: Optimization-based Cell Average Limiters as Metric Projections: Constrained Evolution and Convergence Analysis for Convection-diffusion Equations
items.excerpt: The optimization-based cell average limiter enforces global conservation and bounds, and has been successfully applied to discontinuous Galerkin (DG) discretizations of a wide range of nonlinear systems, from phase-field models to the compressible Navier-Stokes equations. In this paper, taking the heat and convection-diffusion equations as prototypes, we analyze the convergence of the scheme resulting from cell average limiting. Encoding conservation and admissibility in a differential inclusion identifies the limiter as a backward Euler proximal step in a Lie splitting of the constrained evolution. This proximal step is the metric projection onto the convex admissible set, and we prove that it is nonexpansive and stable in the $L^2$ norm, and that it does not increase the total variation of the cell averages. Combined with the standard error analysis, nonexpansiveness yields an $O(\tau+h^{k+1})$ estimate for implicit Euler time stepping with DG discretization of polynomial degree $k$ under a reverse CFL condition, together with an unconditional $O(\tau+h^{k})$ estimate. Numerical experiments confirm the predicted convergence rates an
items.authors: Seungmin Lee, Sanghyun Lee, Chen Liu
items.excerpt_zh: 基于优化的单元平均限制器强制执行全局守恒和界限，并已成功应用于各种非线性系统的不连续伽辽金 (DG) 离散化，从相场模型到可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程。本文以热方程和对流扩散方程为原型，分析了单元平均限制导致的格式的收敛性。微分包含中的守恒性和容许性编码将限制器识别为受约束演化的李分裂中的向后欧拉近端步骤。这个近端步骤是到凸容许集上的度量投影，我们证明它在 $L^2$ 范数中是非扩展且稳定的，并且它不会增加单元平均值的总变化。结合标准误差分析，非扩张性在反向 CFL 条件下产生隐式欧拉时间步进的 $O(\tau+h^{k+1})$ 估计，以及多项式次数 $k$ 的 DG 离散化，以及无条件 $O(\tau+h^{k})$ 估计。数值实验证实了预测的收敛速度
items.title_zh: 基于优化的单元平均限制器作为度量投影：对流扩散方程的约束演化和收敛分析

items.title: An improved fast iterative moment method for the simulation of near-continuum gas flows with Shakhov model
items.excerpt: The fast iterative moment (FIM) method developed in [G. Li, C. Wang, and Z. Hu, Comput. Fluids, 311 (2026), 107031] achieves fast convergence for near-continuum gas flows modeled by the Boltzmann-BGK equation through alternating iterations between the high-order moment system and the consistent hydrodynamic equations. In this paper, we extend the FIM solver to the Shakhov model and improve it in the following aspects. A finite volume method with linear reconstruction is employed for high-resolution spatial discretization of both systems. Following the original FIM method, an implicit-explicit scheme treating the Shakhov collision term implicitly is adopted for the high-order moment system. A local Fourier analysis of a linearized one-dimensional BGK model reveals the need for more hydrodynamic iterations at smaller Knudsen numbers and their slower convergence on refined grids. Motivated by these findings, a Newton-multigrid method with a new regularization strategy is introduced for the hydrodynamic equations, generally providing an effective hydrodynamic correction with one step per alternating iteration, thereby reducing the need fo
items.authors: Zhenning Cai, Zhicheng Hu, Guanghan Li, Chunwu Wang, Xiaowen Wang
items.title_zh: 沙霍夫模型模拟近连续气体流动的改进快速迭代矩法
items.excerpt_zh: 快速迭代矩（FIM）方法在[G. Li、C. Wang 和 Z. Hu，计算机。 Fluids, 311 (2026), 107031] 通过高阶矩系统和一致流体动力学方程之间的交替迭代，实现了由 Boltzmann-BGK 方程建模的近连续气体流动的快速收敛。本文将FIM求解器扩展到Shakhov模型，并在以下方面进行改进。采用线性重建的有限体积方法来实现两个系统的高分辨率空间离散化。遵循原始FIM方法，对高阶矩系统采用隐式处理Shakhov碰撞项的隐式-显式方案。线性化一维 BGK 模型的局部傅立叶分析表明，在较小的努森数下需要更多的流体动力学迭代，并且它们在细化网格上的收敛速度较慢。受这些发现的启发，为流体动力学方程引入了一种具有新正则化策略的牛顿多重网格方法，通常可以通过每次交替迭代一个步骤来提供有效的流体动力学修正，从而减少对

items.title: Inverse problems with fractional operators: an analytical study and its numerical linear algebra treatment via the GLT theory
items.excerpt: Fractional derivatives model memory effects and nonlocal interactions beyond classical integer-order models. Fractional differential equations (FDEs) thus describe anomalous diffusion, transport in heterogeneous media, and hereditary dynamics. Their nonlocality, however, makes inverse problems challenging: unknown sources, coefficients, or initial conditions must be recovered from indirect and noisy data. Inverse problems for FDEs are usually ill-posed in the Hadamard sense, so regularization, such as the quasi-boundary value method, is required for stable reconstruction. Discretization produces large linear systems whose matrices inherit the nonlocal structure of fractional operators. Understanding the asymptotic spectral properties of these matrix sequences is essential for efficient solvers and preconditioners. Generalized Locally Toeplitz (GLT) theory provides a unified framework for the spectral distribution of large structured matrices and for preconditioner design. This thesis uses GLT theory to analyze matrix sequences from inverse problems for FDEs, construct structure-preserving preconditioners, and study nonlinear operation
items.title_zh: 分数算子的反问题：基于 GLT 理论的分析研究及其数值线性代数处理
items.excerpt_zh: 分数阶导数模拟记忆效应和超越经典整数阶模型的非局部相互作用。因此，分数阶微分方程 (FDE) 描述了异常扩散、异质介质中的传输以及遗传动力学。然而，它们的非定域性使得逆问题具有挑战性：必须从间接和噪声数据中恢复未知的源、系数或初始条件。 FDE 的反问题通常在 Hadamard 意义上是病态的，因此需要正则化（例如准边值法）来稳定重建。离散化产生大型线性系统，其矩阵继承了分数算子的非局部结构。了解这些矩阵序列的渐近谱特性对于高效求解器和预处理器至关重要。广义局部托普利茨 (GLT) 理论为大型结构化矩阵的谱分布和预处理器设计提供了统一的框架。本论文利用GLT理论分析FDE反问题的矩阵序列，构造保结构预处理器，并研究非线性运算

items.title: On the stability of second-order methods for DDEs and PDDEs
items.excerpt: In this paper, a one-parameter family of second-order implicit--explicit (IMEX) multistep methods is studied for delay differential equations (DDEs). The analysis is based on the matrix problem $y'(t)=A y(t) + B y(t-\tau(t))$, where $A$ is Hermitian negative definite but $B$ is any matrix. For constant, grid-aligned delays, a field-of-values argument yields unconditional stability whenever a suitable generalized field of values $F_p(A,B)$ is contained in the open unit disk. For a constant non-grid-aligned delay, we show that quadratic interpolation does not reduce the corresponding stability disk. For genuinely variable delays, the method is formulated as a nonautonomous augmented system, and product-level sufficient conditions are obtained from a common quadratic Lyapunov inequality and from a quantitative slow-variation hypothesis. The approach developed herein is illustrated through several examples in which the discussed theory is applied not only to DDEs, but also to semidiscrete parabolic problems given by partial delay differential equations with a diffusion term.
items.title_zh: 关于 DDE 和 PDDE 二阶方法的稳定性
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，研究了延迟微分方程（DDE）的一参数族二阶隐式-显式（IMEX）多步方法。该分析基于矩阵问题 $y'(t)=A y(t) + B y(t-\tau(t))$，其中 $A$ 是埃尔米特负定矩阵，但 $B$ 是任意矩阵。对于恒定的网格对齐延迟，只要开单位圆盘中包含合适的广义值域 $F_p(A,B)$，值域参数就会产生无条件稳定性。对于恒定的非网格对齐延迟，我们表明二次插值不会减少相应的稳定性盘。对于真正可变的延迟，该方法被表述为非自治增强系统，并且从常见的二次李雅普诺夫不等式和定量慢变假设获得产品级充分条件。本文开发的方法通过几个示例进行说明，其中所讨论的理论不仅应用于 DDE，而且还应用于由带有扩散项的偏延迟微分方程给出的半离散抛物线问题。

items.title: The Exact Dihedral Angle Sum Range for Circumcentral-Cevian Jaw Tetrahedra
items.excerpt: Hajja, Hammoudeh, Hayajneh and Martini showed that a tetrahedron whose cevians to the circumcenters of the opposite faces are concurrent is either a kite or a special jaw. We determine the exact dihedral-angle-sum range on the jaw component. The lower endpoint is attained only by the regular tetrahedron, while the upper endpoint is approached only in the degenerate limit. The proof reduces the family to one scale-invariant parameter and an explicit monotonicity argument.
items.title_zh: 圆心-Cevian颌四面体的精确二面角和范围
items.excerpt_zh: Hajja、Hammoudeh、Hayajneh 和 Martini 表明，相对面的圆心与中心线一致的四面体要么是风筝，要么是特殊的颌。我们确定颌部件上精确的二面角和范围。只有正四面体才能达到下端点，而只有在简并极限中才能接近上端点。该证明将族简化为一个尺度不变参数和一个显式的单调性论证。

items.title: J\'onsson cardinals, Magidor cardinals, and the number of omitted colors
items.excerpt: Let $\lambda$ be a Magidor cardinal and let $\alpha\in[\alpha_M,\lambda)$. We show that $\lambda\rightarrow[\lambda]^{\aleph_0-bd}_{\alpha,<\alpha}$. We prove the consistency of a similar statement for J\'onsson cardinals.
items.title_zh: J\'onsson 红衣主教、Magidor 红衣主教以及省略的颜色数量
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $\lambda$ 为 Magidor 基数，并设 $\alpha\in[\alpha_M,\lambda)$。我们证明 $\lambda\rightarrow[\lambda]^{\aleph_0-bd}_{\alpha,<\alpha}$。我们证明了 J\'onsson 红雀的类似陈述的一致性。

items.title: Inductive Grounded Arithmetic: Goodstein, the Hydra, and $\Gamma_0$
items.excerpt: What does a recursive definition mean when the logic is grounded, so a sentence is true only if a terminating process makes it so? Kripke's answer for the special case of truth was the least fixed point. This paper takes that answer as a rule. Reflective Grounded Arithmetic (RGA) already writes any recursive definition as one self-referential term, paradoxes included. Inductive Grounded Arithmetic (IGA) adds the elimination rule for every positive one, so that accessibility, the winning positions of a game, and grounded truth itself each come with their own induction principle. The rule is sound for the omega model and the system is consistent, both machine-checked in Isabelle/HOL. With the rule, IGA proves Goodstein's theorem outright, in a logic without implication at an undecided hypothesis, and the Kirby-Paris hydra game for primitive recursive strategies, both with every step of the arithmetic a grounded derivation. It proves the Cantor normal forms well-founded, from which the well-foundedness of the standard $\varepsilon_0$ notation system in HOL follows, and it certifies the Veblen notation as an ordinal below every $\varphi(n
items.title_zh: 归纳接地算术：古德斯坦、九头蛇和 $\Gamma_0$
items.excerpt_zh: 当逻辑扎根时，递归定义意味着什么，即只有终止过程使句子成立时才为真？克里普克对真理的特殊情况的回答是最不固定点。本文通常采用这个答案。反思基础算术（RGA）已经将任何递归定义写为一个自我指涉术语，包括悖论。归纳扎根算术（IGA）为每一个正数添加了消除规则，因此可达性、游戏的获胜位置和扎根真理本身都有自己的归纳原理。对于欧米茄型号来说，规则是合理的，并且系统是一致的，两者都在 Isabelle/HOL 中进行了机器检查。有了这条规则，IGA 就以一种没有暗示未定假设的逻辑彻底证明了古德斯坦定理，并证明了原始递归策略的 Kirby-Paris Hydra 博弈，算术的每一步都是有根据的推导。它证明了康托范式是有根据的，由此得出 HOL 中标准 $\varepsilon_0$ 表示法系统的有根据，并且它证明了维勃伦表示法是每个 $\varphi(n 以下的序数)

items.title: Comparisons of benchmark equivalence relations

leq_B{\equiv_m}$, $c_0
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$ and $\equiv_m
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$. Together with the previous positive direction, these give $\ell_p\leq_B{\equiv_m}$ if and only if $p\leq2$. items.excerpt: We are developing some topological dynamics below a given ambit. We define and study Bohr compactifications below ambits and other related objects. We describe a natural epimorphism from the Ellis group of an ambit to the Bohr compactification below its Ellis semigroup ambit. The first main result says that, assuming tameness and hereditary amenability, this natural map is an isomorphism of topological groups. We give two proofs of our main result: a shorter dynamical proof and an analytic proof. In the course of the dynamical proof, we prove some results on the universal compactification flow and on the generalized Bohr compactification below a given ambit which admits a left continuous semigroup operation extending the action of $G$. items.title: A Lambda Calculus Based on Quantum Logic
items.excerpt: We propose a typed lambda calculus based on quantum logic. We first present a natural deduction system for quantum logic with the Sasaki hook as its implication operation and then formulate a typed lambda calculus connected to this system through the Curry-Howard correspondence. We prove soundness and completeness of the former with respect to orthomodular lattices and strong normalization of the latter. The resulting lambda calculus has the characteristic feature that only one assumption is available in the typing derivation that serves as the premise of $\lambda$-abstraction. Under this restriction, ordinary currying is not available in general, but it is still possible to perform $\lambda$-abstraction by combining multiple assumptions into a single argument of product type and to construct a term corresponding to a deduction using the Sasaki projection.
items.title_zh: 基于量子逻辑的Lambda演算
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种基于量子逻辑的类型化 lambda 演算。 We first present a natural deduction system for quantum logic with the Sasaki hook as its implication operation and then formulate a typed lambda calculus connected to this system through the Curry-Howard correspondence.我们证明了前者关于正交模格的健全性和完整性以及后者的强归一化。由此产生的 lambda 演算具有这样的特征：在类型推导中只有一个假设可用，作为 $\lambda$-抽象的前提。在这种限制下，普通柯里化一般不可用，但仍然可以通过将多个假设组合成单个乘积类型参数来执行 $\lambda$ 抽象，并使用 Sasaki 投影构造与推导相对应的项。

items.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
items.excerpt: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. items.title: Beyond On-Policy vs. Off-Policy: At What Level Should LLM Agent Distillation Follow the Student?
items.excerpt: Distilling interactive LLM agents requires choosing between teacher-generated demonstrations and student-generated experience, corresponding broadly to off-policy and on-policy distillation. While both have proven effective, we argue that this distinction is inherently hierarchical: the policy that induces an interaction history need not be the same as the policy that generates the token prefix of the current action. We introduce a hierarchical agent distillation framework that formalizes these two levels of on-policiness and enables explicit control over their pairing, mixture proportions, and training schedule. We study this problem through self-distillation, where a frozen teacher has access to task guidance unavailable to the student, and conduct a three-stage controlled study across three models and four interactive environments. We find that student-induced histories paired with teacher-generated action prefixes generally provide the strongest standalone training signal, whereas following the student at both levels generally performs worst. Nevertheless, fully on-policy data becomes beneficial when incorporated into a mixture wi

items.title_zh: 超越在政策与非政策：LLM代理蒸馏应该在什么水平上跟随学生？
items.excerpt_zh: 提炼交互式法学硕士代理需要在教师生成的演示和学生生成的经验之间进行选择，大致对应于离政策和在政策提炼。虽然两者都被证明是有效的，但我们认为这种区别本质上是分层的：引发交互历史的策略不需要与生成当前操作的令牌前缀的策略相同。我们引入了一个分层代理蒸馏框架，该框架将这两个级别的同策略形式化，并能够明确控制它们的配对、混合比例和训练计划。我们通过自我蒸馏来研究这个问题，其中冻结的教师可以获得学生无法获得的任务指导，并在三个模型和四个交互环境中进行三阶段对照研究。我们发现，学生诱发的历史与教师生成的动作前缀相结合通常提供最强的独立训练信号，而在两个级别上跟随学生通常表现最差。然而，当将完全符合政策的数据纳入混合数据时，它会变得有益。

items.title: $M^3$: A Multi-LLM System for Multi-Turn Jailbreaking as a Markov Decision Process
items.excerpt: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to carefully orchestrated multi-turn interactions that progressively bypass safety mechanisms. However, many existing red-teaming approaches rely on heuristics or impose strong assumptions that limit their applicability in fully black box settings. We address this gap by introducing $M^3$, an automated red-teaming framework that formalizes multi-turn jailbreaking as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP). In $M^3$, an attacker LLM interacts with a target LLM while operating over a compact internal state produced by a state LLM. Across two benchmarks and six target models, $M^3$ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-turn red-teaming methods in Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving improvements of up to 53% in ASR@5. Even with lightweight attacker, $M^3$ attains gains up to 26% in ASR@1 and 34% in ASR@5, compared to baselines that use higher capacity attackers. items.title: CEMIR vs. FISER: a comparative study of reasoning-based and enrichment-based approaches to pragmatic intent recognition
items.excerpt: Intent recognition in human-robot interaction requires agents to resolve ambiguous natural language instructions by inferring the speaker's underlying goals. Research has increasingly focused on two notable paradigms for addressing this task: structured symbolic reasoning and multimodal input enrichment. By evaluating both approaches across four Large Language Models (LLMs), ranging from Qwen2.5-Omni-3B to GPT-5, on the HandMeThat v2 benchmark, we analyze their capability to resolve pragmatic ambiguities. items.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
items.excerpt: Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by $82.8$-$84.6\%$ in FLOPs and $47.7$-$58.4\%$ in runtime. items.authors: Yepeng Liu, Shengmai Chen, Xuandong Zhao, Chengzhi Liu, Dawn Song, Xin Eric Wang, Yuheng Bu
items.excerpt_zh: 最近的 \emph{测试时间训练} (TTT) 框架使开放权重大型语言模型 (LLM) 的性能优于由科学发现任务的前沿模型支持的纯推理框架。然而，TTT 在发现过程中引入了在线权重更新的额外计算成本，使得计算效率成为扩展到更大模型时的重要考虑因素。这激励我们探索一种有效的\emph{测试时间适应}方法来进行科学发现。我们引入\emph{测试时内存演化}（TTME），一种即插即用的测试时适应方法，作为 TTT 的替代方法。 TTME 通过提取经验来不断更新外部存储器，以指导后续发现，而无需更新模型权重。为了进行清晰的比较，我们在相同的发现框架下评估 TTME 和 TTT，仅替换测试时间适应方法。我们的评估表明，TTME 在所有五项数学任务上都优于 TTT，同时将 FLOP 中的计算成本降低了 $82.8$-$84.6\%$，在运行时降低了 $47.7$-$58.4\%$ 计算成本。这些结果使 TTME 成为一种有效且计算高效的方法

items.title: DELA: Learning Controllable Edits for Diffusion Language Models
items.excerpt: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support bidirectional denoising and iterative refinement, but generation remains largely controlled by token-level masking schedules. This leaves draft-level refinement implicit and limits explicit control over when to insert missing content, delete redundant spans, revisit uncertain regions, or stop editing. We introduce Diffusion Editing Language Adapter (DELA), a plug-in framework that enables controllable draft refinement with a frozen DLM. DELA operates on clean, variable-length drafts using four explicit editing actions: Insert, Delete, Remask, and Stop. The controller determines when and where to edit the draft, while the frozen DLM fills masked regions through denoising, separating high-level edit control from token-level generation. A naive single-phase editor would be computationally expensive because arbitrary interior edits can disrupt prefix stability and limit reliable KV-cache reuse.
