items.title: Minimum Description Length Unsupervisedly Separates Law-Grade from Statistical-Grade Knowledge in a Self-Improving Science Agent - and Reveals 86% of Its Own Discoveries Are Statistical
items.excerpt: AI systems that discover scientific relations now generate candidate "laws" at scale, but the bottleneck has shifted from generation to vetting: which candidates deserve belief? We show that a deployed self-improving science agent - one that has admitted 252 relations through held-out prediction courts - already computes the quantity that answers this question: the Minimum Description Length compression ratio used for model selection doubles, when read under discrete accounting, as an unsupervised epistemic grader. The compression-ranked top band of the agent's ledger recovers exactly the canonical laws among its discoveries (vis-viva across seven planets, Balmer/Rydberg) plus cross-measurement identities - enrichment $p=3.6\times10^{-12}$ under a hypergeometric test - with zero counterexamples and physically coherent band structure. The same lens retroactively reveals that 86% of the ledger compresses nothing ($\mathrm{cr}\approx 1$): the agent had been recording statistical regularities, including a learned predictor with held-out $R^2=0.541$ admitted through the prediction gate, under a narrative of compression as the unified value
items.title_zh: 最小描述长度在自我改进的科学代理中无监督地将法律级知识与统计级知识分开 - 并揭示其自己的 86% 的发现都是统计性的
items.excerpt_zh: 发现科学关系的人工智能系统现在可以大规模生成候选“定律”，但瓶颈已经从生成转移到审查：哪些候选值得相信？我们展示了一个部署的自我改进的科学智能体——它通过坚持的预测法庭承认了 252 个关系——已经计算出了回答这个问题的数量：当在离散会计下读取时，作为无监督的认知分级器，用于模型选择的最小描述长度压缩比加倍。代理账本的压缩排名顶部带准确地恢复了其发现中的规范定律（跨七个行星的 Viva，Balmer/Rydberg）加上交叉测量恒等式 - 在超几何测试下富集 $p=3.6\times10^{-12}$ - 具有零反例和物理相干的带结构。同样的镜头追溯显示，86% 的账本没有压缩任何东西（$\mathrm{cr}\approx 1$）：智能体一直在记录统计规律，包括一个学习的预测器，其中保留的 $R^2=0.541$ 通过预测门进入，在压缩作为统一值的叙述下

items.title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
items.excerpt: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons.
items.title_zh: 通过双向记忆技能学习实现终身情境适应
items.excerpt_zh: 终身 LLM 代理必须从不断扩展的交互历史中学习，同时在有界上下文窗口内做出每个决策。记忆可以提供过去的经验，但智能体可能仍然需要从检索到的记录中推断如何解决每个新任务。技能提供了可重用的程序，但可能会忽略应用它们所需的特定于任务的事实。由于检索到的记忆和技能会影响代理的行为，因此它们也会影响可用于未来学习的经验。我们推出了 MemCryst，这是一个通过使用冻结语言模型双向学习记忆和技能来实现终身情境适应的框架。存储在记忆中的重复事件支持技能的创建和复习，而这些技能引导的交互为后续学习提供了新的记忆。从记忆中检索到的事实和学到的技能共同构成了代理的上下文，而任务结果则调整了实际提供的记录的未来检索影响，而无需重写其内容。在涵盖具体控制、长文档阅读、对话、数学和代码等十个设置中，MemCryst 在七项报告的比较中处于领先地位。

items.title: ConsMSA: Semantic Distribution Consistency Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
items.excerpt: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict human sentiments by integrating signals from different modalities such as text, video, and audio. However, raw multimodal sequences often suffer from semantic inconsistency--exhibiting redundancy or conflicts within and across modalities--which hinders robust understanding and increases computational cost. To this end, we introduce ConsMSA, which explicitly formalizes semantic distribution consistency across both $\textit{intra}$- and $\textit{inter}$-modality, providing a consistency-aware mechanism for robust and efficient multimodal sentiment prediction. Specifically, ConsMSA projects multimodal token features into a shared sentiment space to compute an Intra- and Inter-modality Consistency Score ($I^2CS$). By coupling this score with predictive relevance, we formulate consistency-aware importance signals that are utilized: (i) as a consistency regularizer to align latent distributions during training, (ii) to derive semantic-aware weights for adaptive multimodal token reweighting, and (iii) as a practical criterion to prune redundant or conflicting tokens. Extensive experiments o
items.authors: Pan Wang, Lipeng Ke, Huajun Ying, Pritish Mohapatra, Rohan Sarkar, Suresh Lakhani, Sankar Venkataraman, Jingtong Hu
items.title_zh: ConsMSA：多模态情感分析的语义分布一致性学习
items.excerpt_zh: 多模态情感分析（MSA）旨在通过集成来自不同模态（例如文本、视频和音频）的信号来预测人类情感。然而，原始的多模态序列经常遭受语义不一致的困扰——模态内部和模态之间存在冗余或冲突——这阻碍了稳健的理解并增加了计算成本。为此，我们引入了 ConsMSA，它显式地形式化了 $\textit{intra}$- 和 $\textit{inter}$- 模态之间的语义分布一致性，为稳健且高效的多模态情感预测提供了一致性感知机制。具体来说，ConsMSA 将多模态令牌特征投影到共享情感空间中，以计算模态内和模态间一致性得分 ($I^2CS$)。通过将该分数与预测相关性相结合，我们制定了一致性感知重要性信号，这些信号可用于：（i）作为一致性正则器在训练期间对齐潜在分布，（ii）导出用于自适应多模态令牌重新加权的语义感知权重，以及（iii）作为修剪冗余或冲突令牌的实用标准。大量的实验

items.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
items.excerpt: This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.
items.authors: Siliang Zeng, Luca Viano, Chenliang Li, Jiaxiang Li, Volkan Cevher, Markus Wulfmeier, Stefano Ermon, Alfredo Garcia, Mingyi Hong
items.title_zh: 将大型语言模型与人类反馈结合起来：数学基础和算法设计
items.excerpt_zh: 本文介绍了用于使大型语言模型 (LLM) 与人类意图、偏好和价值观保持一致的数学基础和算法框架。我们讨论标准对齐技术，例如微调（SFT）、人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。我们还探索了从人类偏好中学习的理论基础，建立了与逆强化学习（IRL）和离散选择模型的联系。我们以教程的形式展示最先进的算法，讨论它们的优点和局限性，并提供对实际实现的见解。我们的阐述旨在为研究人员和从业者提供综合资源，提供对比对方法的基本理解以及开发更强大和可扩展的比对技术的框架。

items.title: Sharp Bounds on the Winner's Bias under Independent and Nonnegatively Correlated Noise
items.excerpt: Reporting the best of $M$ noisy, unbiased scores overstates the winner's value by up to $c\sqrt{V}$, where $V$ is the total noise variance and the sharp constant $c$ depends on how the noise is dependent. It was known only at the two extremes, arbitrary dependence ($\sqrt{(M-1)/M}$) and i.i.d. noise. We determine it for two classes in between: for independent, not identically distributed noise it is $\sqrt{(M-1)/(2M)}$, and for pairwise nonnegatively correlated noise it is $(M-1)/M$; for uncorrelated noise this answers the maximum version of an open question about the expected range. Explicit finite constructions attain both. As a corollary, the bias of the cross-validation estimator is bounded sharply within each class. All theorems are formally verified in Lean 4. Across 448 language-model and classifier selection pipelines, designs with per-candidate items realize a median 0.75 of the independent-class ceiling. At a fixed item budget, scoring all candidates on shared items is markedly less optimistic than giving each candidate its own items.
items.authors: Ivan Viakhirev, Kirill Borodin, Grach Mkrtchian
items.title_zh: 独立和非负相关噪声下获胜者偏差的急剧界限
items.excerpt_zh: 报告 $M$ 噪声、无偏分数中的最佳分数会夸大获胜者的价值高达 $c\sqrt{V}$，其中 $V$ 是总噪声方差，尖锐常数 $c$ 取决于噪声的相关性。仅在两个极端，任意依赖 ($\sqrt{(M-1)/M}$) 和独立同分布 (i.i.d) 下才知道它。噪音。我们为中间的两类确定它：对于独立的、分布不均匀的噪声，它是 $\sqrt{(M-1)/(2M)}$，对于成对非负相关噪声，它是 $(M-1)/M$；对于不相关的噪声，这回答了有关预期范围的开放问题的最大版本。显式有限构造实现了这两者。作为推论，交叉验证估计器的偏差在每个类别内都有很大的界限。所有定理均在 Lean 4 中得到正式验证。在 448 个语言模型和分类器选择管道中，每个候选项目的设计实现了独立类上限的中位数 0.75。在固定项目预算下，对所有候选人共享项目进行评分显然不如为每个候选人提供自己的项目乐观。

items.title: A Mathematical Theory of the Jacobian Lens
items.excerpt: Recent work from Anthropic introduced a new interpretability tool, called the Jacobian lens (J-lens, Gurnee et al., 2026). This method identified linear directions in the hidden states of frontier language models that had properties reminiscent of working memory-like representations. However, it is unclear what mechanistic properties of such features make them detectable to the J-lens. To this end, we introduce a mathematical theory of the J-lens, and show that it preferentially identifies coherent features -- directions that act like leading, spatially coherent Lyapunov modes. Small perturbations along these directions amplify across layers, remain roughly constant across token positions, and are consistent across different contexts. While we are agnostic to whether these properties are necessarily associated with a ``Global Workspace'', the analytically derived preferences of the J-lens nevertheless explain prior empirical applied to both model classes. We validate our analysis on a Bayes filter and a toy transformer, each optimally predicting next tokens emitted from a Hidden Markov Model (HMM). We show how modulating task paramete
items.authors: Mitchell Ostrow, Daoyuan Qian, Toni Liu, Ila Fiete
items.title_zh: 雅可比透镜的数学理论
items.excerpt_zh: Anthropic 最近的工作引入了一种新的解释工具，称为雅可比透镜（J-lens，Gurnee 等人，2026）。该方法识别了前沿语言模型隐藏状态中的线性方向，这些模型具有类似于工作记忆表示的属性。然而，尚不清楚这些特征的机械特性是什么使得它们可以被 J 透镜检测到。为此，我们引入了 J 透镜的数学理论，并表明它优先识别相干特征——类似于主导的空间相干李亚普诺夫模式的方向。沿着这些方向的小扰动会跨层放大，在令牌位置上保持大致恒定，并且在不同的上下文中保持一致。虽然我们不知道这些属性是否必然与“全局工作空间”相关，但 J 透镜的分析得出的偏好仍然解释了应用于这两个模型类的先前经验。我们验证了对贝叶斯过滤器和玩具变压器的分析，每个过滤器都能最佳地预测从隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）发出的下一个标记。我们展示了如何调节任务参数

items.title: PRISM: Promoting Sampling Diversity of Large Language Models with Implicit Stochastic Modulation
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes semantic repetition rather than discovery, making rare but stronger solutions unlikely to surface and leaving self-evolution and continual learning difficult to sustain. Most remedies intervene only at inference time, shaping sam- ples without making diversity a model capability. We propose PRISM, a training-time framework that internalizes diversity within the model. PRISM combines (i) submodular curation that pairs each prompt with diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions, and (ii) stochastic embedding modulation, which turns special-token perturbations into implicit signals for sampling distinct outputs. A theoretical analysis establishes the stability of this mechanism. On WritingPrompts and BookMIA, PRISM moves the quality-diversity frontier outward, achieving the best generation quality in all model-benchmark settings while maintaining the strongest or near-strongest semantic diversity across two open-weight model families. items.authors: Qixin Xu, Zihan Zhu, Xiaojiang Liu, Bohan Lyu
items.title_zh: PRISM：通过隐式随机调制促进大型语言模型的采样多样性
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 表现出模式崩溃，其输出分布集中于熟悉的语义模式。当多样性消失时，重复采样变成了语义重复而不是发现，使得罕见但更强大的解决方案不太可能浮出水面，并使自我进化和持续学习难以维持。大多数补救措施仅在推理时进行干预，塑造样本，而不使多样性成为模型能力。我们提出了 PRISM，这是一个将模型多样性内在化的训练时间框架。 PRISM 结合了 (i) 子模块管理，将每个提示与多样化但正确的多教师解决方案配对，以及 (ii) 随机嵌入调制，它将特殊令牌扰动转换为隐式信号，用于对不同输出进行采样。理论分析确定了该机制的稳定性。在 WritePrompts 和 BookMIA 上，PRISM 将质量多样性前沿向外移动，在所有模型基准设置中实现最佳生成质量，同时在两个开放权重模型系列中保持最强或接近最强的语义多样性。它还提高了采样率

items.title: Beyond Data Schedule: Fast LLM Pretraining on Data Mixtures by Loss-Reweighting
items.excerpt: Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this work, we investigate whether such trade-offs can be improved by changing how strongly each domain contributes to learning while keeping its data exposure fixed. We find that, in controlled knowledge--mathematics experiments, loss reweighting produces a single checkpoint that surpasses the best knowledge and reasoning scores attained along either stage trajectory. This reveals an independent control that data-mixture ratios alone do not capture. Building on this finding, we propose LARE (Loss-Adaptive Reweighting under fixed Exposure), which automatically adjusts domain weights from running loss statistics. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mixture or requiring additional runs to search for weights. Across knowledge, mathematics, and code, \Method{} improves all five evaluated benchmarks for a 1.5B model trained on 240B tokens, averaging +7.84
items.authors: Jiazheng Li, Huaqing Zhang, Jing Xu, Tianle Cai, Jingzhao Zhang
items.title_zh: 超越数据计划：通过损失重新加权对数据混合物进行快速 LLM 预训练
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型通常通过连续的预训练阶段获得专门的能力，但这些收益可能是以忘记早期知识为代价的。在这项工作中，我们研究是否可以通过改变每个领域对学习的贡献程度，同时保持其数据暴露固定来改善这种权衡。我们发现，在受控知识数学实验中，损失重新加权产生的单个检查点超过了沿任一阶段轨迹获得的最佳知识和推理分数。这揭示了数据混合比率本身无法捕获的独立控制。基于这一发现，我们提出了 LARE（固定曝光下的损失自适应重新加权），它根据运行损失统计数据自动调整域权重。受梯度噪声理论分析的启发，其归一化反平方根规则平衡了相对损失尺度，而不改变采样的混合物或需要额外的运行来搜索权重。在知识、数学和代码方面，\Method{} 改进了在 240B 令牌上训练的 1.5B 模型的所有五个评估基准，平均 +7.84

items.title: MS-TTRL: Breaking the Frequency Conflict in Multiple-Solution Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Scientific, engineering, and mathematical reasoning tasks can admit multiple valid solutions, while exhaustive annotation of the full solution set is often prohibitively costly. Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) applies reinforcement learning to unlabeled test instances, offering a label-free approach to multiple-solution reasoning. In this setting, generation frequency serves two opposing objectives: correctness estimation favors frequent outcomes, whereas outcome-level diversity preservation favors less frequent outcomes. We term this tension the \textbf{Frequency Conflict}. To resolve this conflict, we propose MS-TTRL, which obtains frequency-independent correctness estimates through Outcome-Level Self-Verification while reserving generation frequency solely for diversity preservation. Three-State Outcome Cache and the Candidate State support verification reuse across repeated observations and confidence-aware handling of ambiguous outcomes, while Confidence-Gated Inverse Probability Scaling selectively strengthens the learning signals of rare, reliably verified outcomes. items.authors: Zhixia Zhang, Binqian Xu, Huaiyang Wang, Yikun Ban, Dianbo Liu
items.title_zh: MS-TTRL：打破多解决方案测试时强化学习中的频率冲突
items.excerpt_zh: 科学、工程和数学推理任务可以接受多个有效的解决方案，而对完整解决方案集进行详尽的注释通常成本高昂。测试时强化学习 (TTRL) 将强化学习应用于未标记的测试实例，为多解决方案推理提供无标签方法。在这种情况下，生成频率服务于两个相反的目标：正确性估计有利于频繁的结果，而结果级别的多样性保留有利于不太频繁的结果。我们将这种张力称为 \textbf{频率冲突}。为了解决这一冲突，我们提出了 MS-TTRL，它通过结果级自我验证获得与频率无关的正确性估计，同时保留生成频率仅用于多样性保护。三状态结果缓存和候选状态支持重复观察和对模糊结果的置信感知处理的验证重用，而置信门控逆概率缩放则有选择地加强罕见、可靠验证结果的学习信号。跨两个基准、四个多解决方案的实验

items.title: Correct but Unselectable: The Hidden Interface Tax in Multi-Candidate Reasoning
items.excerpt: Small language models deployed under cost, latency, or privacy constraints cannot simply switch to larger models when reasoning fails. Multi-candidate generate-then-rerank offers a natural test-time scaling route. However, more candidates do not always yield higher accuracy. We identify a previously overlooked bottleneck between generation and selection: a correct answer may appear in the candidate pool yet fail to be selected because it is incomplete, unparseable, or misaligned with the answer mode the fixed selector expects. We term this loss the hidden interface tax and formalize a coverage-conversion decomposition that distinguishes raw oracle coverage from selectable coverage, the subset of problems where a correct candidate can actually be consumed by the selector. We propose Compatibility-Aware Candidate Construction (CACC), an interface layer between the candidate source and the fixed selector that repairs fragments, aligns answer modes, and removes selector-confusing noise without retraining either component. On numeric reasoning (GSM8K, competition_math), CACC raises both oracle coverage and final accuracy. On GPQA Diamond,
items.authors: Qianli Ma, Zhiqing Tang, Fanshuai Meng, Zhi Yao, Hanshuai Cui, Weijia Jia
items.title_zh: 正确但不可选择：多候选推理中隐藏的接口税
items.excerpt_zh: 在成本、延迟或隐私限制下部署的小语言模型在推理失败时不能简单地切换到更大的模型。多候选生成然后重新排名提供了一种自然的测试时间扩展路线。然而，更多的候选者并不总是能产生更高的准确性。我们发现了生成和选择之间以前被忽视的瓶颈：正确的答案可能出现在候选池中，但却无法被选择，因为它不完整、不可解析或与固定选择器期望的答案模式不一致。我们将这种损失称为隐藏接口税，并形式化覆盖率转换分解，将原始预言机覆盖率与可选择覆盖率区分开来，可选择覆盖率是选择器实际上可以使用正确候选者的问题子集。我们提出了兼容性感知候选构建（CACC），这是候选源和固定选择器之间的接口层，可以修复片段、对齐答案模式并消除选择器混淆噪声，而无需重新训练任何一个组件。在数字推理（GSM8K、competition_math）方面，CACC 提高了预言机覆盖率和最终准确性。在 GPQA 钻石上，

items.title: Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation
items.excerpt: Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen "System One" models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, "confidence" conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). items.title_zh: 两个不确定性不是一个：廉价结构化内容审核中的分歧与决策风险
items.excerpt_zh: 内容审核将数十亿个项目的分级的、有争议的人类判断压缩为二元行为（留下/删除），在这样的规模下，在每个帖子上运行前沿法学硕士是不经济的。一类新的冻结“System One”模型返回键入的、校准的决策，而不是文本，每次调用约 0.000025 美元，约 100 毫秒。我们对 142,658 条人工标记评论对此类模型进行了首次独立审核，并在共享探针集上与 14 个前沿推理模型（GPT-5.x、Claude、Gemini 3 和 Grok 系列）进行基准测试。有两个发现很引人注目。首先，廉价模型具有准确性竞争性：其零样本分类 AUROC (0.83) 与 14 个前沿系统中的 13 个系统在统计上不可分离（配对引导，n=56；无法拒绝奇偶校验，而不是等价证明），同时成本低 1-3 个数量级，而且它的校准并不比其中几个系统差。其次，“信心”融合了两种相互独立的不确定性：人类分歧（注释者在讽刺和编码语言上存在分歧）和决策风险（自动行动的错误代价高昂）。在不对称调节损失下，这些 ca

items.title: Five Architectures, One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging
items.excerpt: Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical
items.authors: Oladimeji Anthonio, Dimeji Olawuyi, Oloruntoba Ajayi, Temilola Aderemi
items.title_zh: 五种架构，一种共享空间 跨模型表征对齐，无需权重合并
items.excerpt_zh: 组合语言模型通常是通过平均权重来完成的，只有当模型共享一个共同的起点时，这种方法才有效。我们询问五个具有不同内部设计的冻结的、独立训练的模型（来自四个组织的四个变压器和一个状态空间模型）是否可以仅通过它们的激活来关联，而无需权重合并。使用排列测试、独立的复制探针集、深度扫描、合并消融和混杂检查，我们发现五个模型如何组织相同文本之间在统计上稳健的对应关系。它在每个模型的最后一层最强，而状态空间模型则较弱，其最弱配对仍然是 35-43 倍的机会。我们用它来构建一个通用普罗克拉斯特分析的共享空间，其中没有模型是固定的参考。在最后一层，两个探针集上二十个有序模型对的平均保留检索精度为 0.91 到 0.93（机会 0.03），优于成对线性图（0.82 到 0.85），但空间比中间层的那些图差。它转换为不熟悉语法形式的普通英语，并且在数学上失败

items.title: Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies
items.excerpt: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. The embedding-based taxonomies exhibit substantial but incomplete correspondence with the existing taxonomies, revealing both preserved and alternative
items.authors: Kia Karbasi, Kaveh Karbasi, Gregory Pottie
items.title_zh: 基于嵌入的教育分类法
items.excerpt_zh: 教育分类法将教育内容（例如练习问题）组织成概念，也称为技能或知识成分。这些分类法定义了智能辅导系统等教育应用中的学习目标。它们通过人类专业知识和迭代完善而开发，还为课程、评估和学生学习模型提供了基本结构。语义文本嵌入的最新进展使得从内容本身计算构建替代教育分类法成为可能。在本文中，我们通过对数学问题的嵌入进行聚类来构建基于嵌入的教育分类法来研究这种可能性。我们将这些分类法与两个 ASSISTments 数据集中现有的基于共同核心国家标准 (CCSS) 的知识组件分类法进行比较，并评估它们在深度知识追踪（一项依赖于问题到知识组件的分类映射的下游任务）中的效用。基于嵌入的分类法与现有分类法表现出大量但不完全的对应关系，揭示了保留的和替代的分类法

items.title: When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic
items.excerpt: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE .
items.authors: Chong Zhao, Ruyi Yang, Changming Liu, Alice Zhao
items.title_zh: GEPA 合并何时有帮助？机制级诊断
items.excerpt_zh: GEPA 是针对语言模型程序最强的反射提示优化器之一，但其系统感知合并运算符在不同模型之间不稳定：合并平均改进了 gpt-4.1-mini，同时降低了 Qwen3-8B，这种不对称性在 GEPA 论文中被注意到但没有得到解释。我们研究了五个数据集和两个模型的这种不稳定性。我们对合并计时和合并运算符的九个配置扫描表明，如果配置适当，合并可以改进这两个模型。这表明配置敏感性比合并运算符的固有缺陷更好地解释了合并不稳定。然后，我们测试提示级特征是否可以预测 GEPA 的合并接受决策，结果发现它们不能预测，从而排除了静态特征门控。作为概念证明，根据这些诊断构建的基于行为的探针通过放弃高风险任务来避免多种子运行中的大型合并失败，尽管它的性能并不总是优于 NoMerge。代码可作为 GEPA-MergeProbe 获取，网址为 https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE 。

items.title: Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning
items.excerpt: Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration
items.authors: Tao Jing, Chen Kang, Feifei Zhai, Pengyuan Liu, Dong Yu
items.title_zh: 通过长短对比剪枝提高剪枝推理模型的思想链可压缩性
items.excerpt_zh: 大型推理模型的服务成本很高，因为它们很大并且会产生很长的思想链 (CoT)。权重剪枝和 CoT 压缩分别解决了这两种成本，但它们的干扰是剪枝增加了对模型仍然解决的问题的冗余推理和对不再解决的问题的不完整推理，并且在更困难的问题上通过后续的长度偏好优化使模型的可压缩性降低。我们将其追溯到双方的盲点：剪枝标准无法区分必要推理和冗余推理，并且基于偏好的 CoT 压缩不会收到关于剪枝模型总是或从未解决的问题的训练信号。我们提出了对比集差异（CSD），它通过对比同一问题的长正确解和短正确解上的激活来识别富含冗余推理的神经元，并优先修剪它们，并且我们将偏好对扩展到修剪模型总是或从未解决的问题。修剪 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 的 20\%，该组合在四个数学基准上使用的思维标记比使用推理感知校准的修剪少 8--22\%

items.title: Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers
items.excerpt: In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth o
items.authors: Pengzhen Lin, Ke Zhang, Maziar Raissi, Zhouxing Shi
items.title_zh: 具有多个候选答案的精益陈述的高效证明生成
items.excerpt_zh: 在 Lean 4 等正式系统中，有效地找到数学问题的答案并生成可验证的证明是自动数学推理中的一项重要任务。在上游求解器提供多个候选答案的传统方式中，常见的工作流程需要单独搜索每个候选答案的证明，从而产生冗余的计算成本。为此，我们提出了一个联合证明框架，将候选答案选择、答案补充和形式证明生成集成到统一的推理过程中。其核心是训练有素的证明者，它选择给定的答案或提出新的答案，并在一次调用中生成至少一个答案的证明。联合证明还可以重复使用生成的证明来检查忠实性错误。对于具有唯一答案的问题，如果两个不同的答案都在同一正式陈述下获得可验证的证明，则这证实该陈述没有忠实地保留原始问题语义。在 MATH-500、AMC 2023 和 AIME 2024/2025/2026 上，我们的框架实现了与每个候选证明生成相同的形式证明成功率，大约为六分之一

items.title: RefinedGAW: A Refined German Academic Web Dataset
items.excerpt: The largest open German text datasets are built from broad web crawls, which provide scale but limited coverage of specific domains. We introduce RefinedGAW, a processed and annotated resource derived from 26 semi-annual crawls of the German Academic Web, totaling 122 million documents and 314 billion tokens, with full crawl and capture history of every text. Documents labeled as academic research account for 84% of German RefinedGAW tokens across HTML and PDF. At 87.6 billion tokens, this exceeds the 64.9 billion tokens in the German subsets of FineWeb2 and FinePDFs, despite their almost five-times-larger combined size. RefinedGAW also contains substantial amounts of educational, math-heavy, and expert-oriented content with minimal commercial bias. Across HTML and PDF, 88% of German RefinedGAW documents have no near-duplicate candidate match in the three evaluated reference datasets, supporting complementary coverage. We release a queryable metadata index for fine-grained data selection and a rehydration tool for retrieving and processing source documents.
items.authors: Maximilian Idahl, Oleh Astappiev, Benedikt Droste, Robert Scholz, Bj\"orn Pl\"uster, Jan Philipp Harries, Robert J\"aschke, Wolfgang Nejdl
items.title_zh: RefinedGAW：精炼的德国学术网络数据集
items.excerpt_zh: 最大的开放德语文本数据集是通过广泛的网络爬行构建的，它提供了特定领域的规模但覆盖范围有限。我们介绍RefinedGAW，这是一种经过处理和注释的资源，源自对德国学术网的 26 次半年度爬行，总计 1.22 亿份文档和 3140 亿个令牌，包含每个文本的完整爬行和捕获历史记录。标记为学术研究的文档占 HTML 和 PDF 格式的德国 RefinedGAW 代币的 84%。其代币数量为 876 亿个，超过了 FineWeb2 和 FinePDFs 德国子集的 649 亿个代币，尽管它们的总规模几乎是其五倍。 RefinedGAW 还包含大量教育性、数学性和专家导向的内容，且商业偏见极小。在 HTML 和 PDF 中，88% 的德国 RefinedGAW 文档在三个评估的参考数据集中没有几乎重复的候选匹配，支持互补覆盖。我们发布了用于细粒度数据选择的可查询元数据索引，以及用于检索和处理源文档的补充工具。

items.title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
items.excerpt: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). Given more tokens, the base closes most of the finishing gap itself. (2) Where the base has enough tokens, the gain is reliability: the RL model is graded right more often, even on problems both finish. (3) By our definition, RL rarely solves what its base cannot. Reach adds at most 2.1 percenta
items.title_zh: RL 购买什么结果：精加工、可靠性、很少达到
items.excerpt_zh: 结果 RL 在大 k 时提高了 pass@1，但没有提高 pass@k (Yue et al., 2025)。但每一次 pass@1 都是在象征性预算下评分的。每个食谱也都在一个食谱下进行训练。在固定代币预算下的物理和数学问题上，我们将 20 个已发布的 RL 模型（1.5B 到 32B）的 pass@1 与它们最初的思维模型进行了比较。我们询问每一次 pass@1 的收获是行为改变还是新知识。我们将 pass@1 中的每个更改分为三个部分。在预算用完之前完成答复的措施。可靠性措施一旦完成就正确。达到衡量的是 RL 解决的其基地在所有八次尝试中回答错误的问题，减去基地解决的 RL 在所有八次尝试中回答错误的问题。我们发现四件事。 (1) 如果基础经常在回答之前达到代币预算，则大部分变化、收益或损失正在完成（4k 和 8k 时为 82%）。如果有更多的代币，基数本身就会弥补大部分的整理差距。 (2) 当基础有足够的代币时，增益就是可靠性：强化学习模型更频繁地获得正确的评分，即使问题都完成了。 (3) 根据我们的定义，强化学习很少能解决其基础无法解决的问题。覆盖面最多增加 2.1%

items.title: Scaling Qualitative Analysis with Large Language Models: Development and Validation of the Smart Coder Framework for Human-LLM Collaborative Coding
items.excerpt: Current uses of large language models (LLMs) for qualitative coding often rely on ad hoc prompting with limited guidance for reliability and human oversight. To address these limitations, we propose the Smart Coder Framework, a three-phase approach structuring human-LLM collaborative coding through Instruction, Prompt Strategy, and Reliability Check. We evaluated the framework using 72 middle-school mathematics teacher interview transcripts and a human-consensus benchmark. A factorial design compared instructed versus uninstructed prompts, few-shot versus few-shot plus chain-of-thought prompting, and single-pass versus self-consistency coding. Twelve transcripts were used for prompt development and calibration, and 60 for the formal evaluation. In the results, instruction consistently improved agreement. Chain-of-thought further improved agreement under adequate instruction, and self-consistency produced smaller, theme-dependent gains but helped identify unstable decisions for human review. Performance also varied by transcript characteristics. Overall, the framework systematically structures and monitors LLM-assisted qualitative codi
items.authors: Cheng Tang, Kun Wang, Yaxuan Yang, Shiyu Wang, Allan Cohen, Rachael Eriksen Brown, Chandra Hawley Orrill
items.title_zh: 使用大型语言模型扩展定性分析：人类与法学硕士协作编码的智能编码器框架的开发和验证
items.excerpt_zh: 目前用于定性编码的大型语言模型 (LLM) 通常依赖于临时提示，而可靠性和人工监督的指导有限。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了智能编码器框架，这是一种通过指令、提示策略和可靠性检查构建人类与法学硕士协作编码的三阶段方法。我们使用 72 名中学数学教师访谈记录和人类共识基准来评估该框架。析因设计比较了指导提示与非指导提示、少样本提示与少样本加思维链提示，以及单遍编码与自一致性编码。 12 个成绩单用于快速开发和校准，60 个成绩单用于正式评估。结果显示，教学的一致性不断提高。思想链在充分的指导下进一步提高了一致性，而自我一致性产生了较小的、与主题相关的收益，但有助于识别不稳定的决策以进行人工审查。性能也因转录本特征而异。总体而言，该框架系统地构建和监控法学硕士辅助的定性准则

items.title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
items.excerpt: Frontier AI models are increasingly deployed on topics where the stakes are high and expert judgment is required, including healthcare, defense, finance, governance, and politics. We present a general methodology for distilling expert human judgment into automated evaluation systems that operate at scale. Our approach assembles networks of domain experts and develops techniques for extracting not just their conclusions but their reasoning processes, encoding those processes into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. We ground our approach in a long tradition of research on the nature of expertise and the conditions under which expert judgment is reliable and more effective than other approaches, and argue that independent, expert-calibrated evaluation is necessary not only on epistemic grounds but as a matter of accountability and public trust. We validate the methodology on AI news reporting as a first application domain. items.authors: Robbie Goldfarb, Andrew B. Hall, Jillian Fisher, Kathryn Salam, Matt Wilde
items.title_zh: 大规模提炼专家判断
items.excerpt_zh: 前沿人工智能模型越来越多地部署在风险较高且需要专家判断的主题上，包括医疗保健、国防、金融、治理和政治。我们提出了一种将专家的人类判断提炼成大规模运行的自动化评估系统的通用方法。我们的方法汇集了领域专家的网络，并开发了不仅提取他们的结论，还提取他们的推理过程的技术，将这些过程编码成自动化法官可以持续应用的结构化编辑标准。我们的方法以悠久的研究传统为基础，研究专业知识的性质以及专家判断比其他方法可靠且更有效的条件，并认为独立的、经过专家校准的评估不仅在认知方面是必要的，而且作为问责制和公众信任的问题。我们将人工智能新闻报道的方法作为第一个应用领域进行验证。在源质量方面，两位独立领域专家在应用编辑标准时在保留的测试集上实现了 Krippendorff 的 $\alpha = 0.83/0.69$，并且我们的自动化 Ju

items.title: Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability
items.excerpt: LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains. We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains. We further show that selective graph grounding improves correctness and cross-model consistency, while indiscriminate grounding introduces regressions. A layered grounding strategy achieves the strongest monotonicity profile, preserving correct knowledge while reducing inconsistency. F

items.title_zh: 范围语义不变性作为法学硕士可靠性的基础
items.excerpt_zh: 即使基本事实已知，法学硕士常常不一致地回答语义等效的查询。我们将一致性形式化为查询等价类上的语义不变性，并表明任意意义保留变换下的不变性通常是不可判定的。这激发了范围语义不变性，其中模型行为是相对于有界语义域进行评估的。我们使用知识图（KG）来操作该框架，知识图充当定义局部语义约束和基础上下文的显式语义控制结构。在 MITRE D3FEND 本体论和 8 个 Wikidata 衍生领域中，我们发现不一致是结构化的而不是随机的，集中在围绕重复出现的 TREE、STAR 和 CYCLE 模式组织的局部热点子图中，这些模式在模型和领域中保持稳定。我们进一步表明，选择性图接地提高了正确性和跨模型一致性，而不加区别的接地则引入了回归。分层接地策略实现了最强的单调性，保留正确的知识，同时减少不一致性。 F

items.title: AI Teaches Humans to Handle Complexity in the Game of Go
items.excerpt: Strategic decision-making in complex environments requires balancing local stability against global coordination. Using the game of Go as a bounded empirical testbed, we investigate how biological and artificial agents navigate this trade-off by formalizing a network-derived metric of strategic tension defined via the spectral radius of spatial dependency matrices. Across human skill progression, tension systematically decays from novices to masters as uncoordinated tactical skirmishes give way to disciplined territorial stabilization. However, a longitudinal analysis of professional play spanning 1980--2026 reveals a striking historical paradox: following the superhuman breakthrough of AlphaGo in 2016, elite human matches display a marked surge in sustained tension. A two-dimensional projection based on move distance and captures places modern professionals close to neural engines, separating their tension from the local contact fighting of novices and from random noise. items.title: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
items.excerpt: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. items.title_zh: 更多：自我进化智能体的模式优化推理和自适应努力
items.excerpt_zh: 自我进化训练通过可验证的反馈提高了代理在困难任务上的表现，但它通常在任务之间统一进行成本高昂的审议。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了具有自适应工作量的模式优化推理（MORE），这是一种自我进化的训练框架，可以为每个任务自适应地选择推理形式和计算工作量。具体来说，MORE 遵循两阶段训练范式：(i) \emph{Stage 1} 在直接回答、短链和长链以及基于代码的推理之上建立了一个紧凑的先验，(ii) \emph{Stage 2} 在生成的、可验证的任务流上（无需策划数据）通过模式自适应和测试时工作量 PPO (MATE-PPO) 自我进化此先验。通过联合学习模式选择和代币支出，MORE 将简洁的推理分配给允许的任务，同时在有用的地方保留扩展的审议。在编码、数学和一般推理基准测试中，MORE 在 3B 到 14B 模型规模的 Base 和 Coder 主干上实现了一致的性能提升。在推理过程中，MORE 表现出更高的准确性和更好的效率，

items.title: PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration
items.excerpt: Many mathematical research agents focus on solving problems with fixed statements. However, conjecture research, especially in applied mathematics, may require revising candidate questions or conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development. We present PACE, a research-proof agent that supports this process through a structured research loop that selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms. The whole prover constructs proofs from these mechanisms, and an independent verifier checks them against the original target. Evidence-tracking memory stores assumptions and dependencies arising during research and marks evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. This memory supports task-specific context composition that keeps checked premises, exploratory material and unresolved obligations distinct. items.title_zh: PACE：自适应猜想探索​​的研究证明剂
items.excerpt_zh: 许多数学研究人员专注于解决具有固定陈述的问题。然而，猜想研究，特别是在应用数学中，可能需要随着调查的进行修改候选问题或结论，将问题表述与证明开发结合起来。我们推出了 PACE，这是一种经过研究证明的代理，它通过结构化的研究循环来支持这一过程，该循环选择数学目标并开发或挑战候选机制。整个证明者根据这些机制构建证明，并由独立验证者根据原始目标检查它们。证据跟踪内存存储研究过程中出现的假设和依赖关系，并在候选人或条件发生变化时标记证据以供重新验证。这种记忆支持特定于任务的上下文组合，使检查的前提、探索性材料和未解决的义务保持清晰。为了评估证明构造和猜想研究，我们引入了 ResearchProofBench，这是一个专注于优化的应用数学基准，包括 51 个已知证明任务，其中包含历史抽象访问下的 331 个隐藏检查点和 6 个操作

items.title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
items.excerpt: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. items.title_zh: Numina Fuse：精益 4 中的交互式自动形式化
items.excerpt_zh: Numina Fuse 是一个代理原生应用程序，用于形式化 Lean 4 中的数学。由于 Lean 可以编译，但不能表示其预期的非正式含义，并且代理现在编写 Lean 的速度比人们阅读它的速度快，因此我们围绕代理工作的人工监督构建了 Fuse。用户在精益项目上使用人工智能编排器，并通过蓝图、依赖图和精益代码的视图对其进行监督，而后端则保留项目的派生状态并在用户不在场的情况下运行代理数小时。我们描述了 Fuse 在 2026 年的发展，它从由人工审查控制的指定代理管道转变为自行派遣专家、证明者和并行子节点的编排器。我们针对这种转变进行了设计，将项目状态、工具和界面设计与编排分开，以便代理可以在模型改进时接管更多工作。我们报告了 Fuse 在三维 Kakeya 猜想的形式化和证明模型研究中的使用。我们以下一代自动形式化系统的经验教训作为结束语。 Fuse Desktop，开源本地版本，已发布

items.title: Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems
items.excerpt: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. The G-layer enforces geometric quality assurance (GQA) via a mapping f: Theta -> Q from the statistical parameter space to a physically interpretable quality domain, employing a cosine similarity gate to retain minority updates based on physical geometry rather than statistical proximity. The T-layer executes topological Pareto control, identifying a sensitivity-based knee point (lambda_k) to balance multi-objective aggregation without majority degradation. items.excerpt_zh: 传统的联邦学习器隐式地针对全局手段进行了优化，创建了一种“一刀切”的范式，不可避免地在跨站点异质性下压制了少数人。为了弥补这一关键差距，我们提出了 Fed-Universe，这是一种可推广的语义-几何-拓扑-人类 (S-G-T-H) 架构，它将被动平均转变为主动协商以实现去中心化对齐。 S 层部署具有边缘功能的 LLM 作为语义代理，将异构输入转换为标准化的患者资料提示。 G 层通过从统计参数空间到物理可解释质量域的映射 f: Theta -> Q 来强制几何质量保证 (GQA)，采用余弦相似性门来保留基于物理几何而不是统计邻近性的少数更新。 T 层执行拓扑 Pareto 控制，识别基于灵敏度的拐点 (lambda_k)，以平衡多目标聚合而不会导致多数退化。最后，H 层操作认知双胞胎动态来反映用户的实时心理状态，动态地适应人类计算机

items.title: RadonBench: A Benchmark of Classical and Learning-Guided Search Techniques for Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
items.excerpt: Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. It remains open whether Radon-free configurations with $11$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^3$ or $21$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^4$ are possible. If they exist, they would improve the corresponding lower bounds on the integer Radon numbers. We compare exhaustive extension, greedy local search, PatternBoost, AlphaZero, and AlphaEvolve. All outputs use one success predicate: a convex target-sized configuration succeeds exactly when its number of integral Radon points is zero. PatternBoost and AlphaZero construct verified Radon-free configurations of sizes $10$ and $20$, one point short of the respective targets; AlphaZero's best convex target terminals have two integral Radon points in both dimensions. items.title_zh: RadonBench：组合几何问题的经典和学习引导搜索技术的基准

items.title: The Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) Method for Time Series Arising from Dynamical Systems
items.excerpt: We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems. CLOCK embeds observed sequences into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via a time-averaged occupation kernel, enabling trajectory comparison through their RKHS norm. For systems governed by differential equations, this formulation rigorously approximates the kernel mean embedding of the invariant Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen (SRB) measure, meaning our dissimilarity metric approximates the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between attractors. To accommodate general time series, we introduce time lags via Takens' Embedding Theorem to reconstruct the phase space. Crucially, CLOCK natively handles trajectories of unequal lengths and irregularly-spaced observations. We validate the proposed metric using spectral clustering, demonstrating superior performance against benchmark methods on both synthetic datasets and a real-world intracranial large-scale electroencephalogram (EEG) dataset. items.title_zh: 动态系统时间序列的聚类占用核（CLOCK）方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们介绍了聚类占用内核（CLOCK）方法，这是一种新颖的基于表示的框架，用于对动态系统产生的时间序列进行聚类。 CLOCK 通过时间平均占用内核将观察到的序列嵌入到再现内核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS) 中，从而能够通过其 RKHS 范数进行轨迹比较。对于受微分方程控制的系统，该公式严格近似不变 Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen (SRB) 测度的核均值嵌入，这意味着我们的相异度量近似于吸引子之间的最大平均差异 (MMD)。为了适应一般时间序列，我们通过 Takens 嵌入定理引入时间滞后来重建相空间。至关重要的是，CLOCK 本身可以处理不等长度的轨迹和不规则间隔的观测。我们使用谱聚类验证了所提出的指标，在​​合成数据集和现实世界的颅内大规模脑电图（EEG）数据集上展示了与基准方法相比的卓越性能。最后，Lorenz-96系统的消融研究与理论收敛速度一致

items.title: From Intelligence to Autonomy: Foundations and Construction of Autonomous Agents for Future Intelligent Systems
items.excerpt: Artificial intelligence is moving from one-off perception and generation tasks toward long-term planning, tool use, and interaction with real environments. Greater task competence, however, does not automatically yield autonomy: an external actor may still have to set goals, sustain operating conditions, detect failures, and approve updates. We define an autonomous agent as a system that, within explicit identity and authority boundaries, maintains both task goals and viability conditions, acts continuously using models of the world and itself, and adjusts its control mechanisms and long-term capabilities through feedback. We trace the conceptual path from homeostasis and feedback control to autopoiesis and biological autonomy. We then distinguish six lines of operationalization: computational autopoiesis, behavior-based robotics, agent formalization, adaptive software, embodied adaptation, and robotic self-modeling. On this basis, we propose a one-boundary, four-loop framework in which Operational, Viability, Reflexive, and Learning loops organize task execution, self-maintenance, metacontrol, and governed learning. items.title_zh: 从智能到自治：未来智能系统自治代理的基础和构建
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能正在从一次性的感知和生成任务转向长期规划、工具使用以及与真实环境的交互。然而，更强的任务能力并不会自动产生自主权：外部参与者可能仍然需要设定目标、维持操作条件、检测故障并批准更新。我们将自主代理定义为一个系统，在明确的身份和权限边界内，维持任务目标和生存条件，使用世界和自身的模型持续行动，并通过反馈调整其控制机制和长期能力。我们追踪从稳态和反馈控制到自创生和生物自主的概念路径。然后，我们区分了操作化的六条线：计算自创生、基于行为的机器人、代理形式化、自适应软件、体现适应和机器人自我建模。在此基础上，我们提出了一种一边界、四循环框架，其中操作循环、生存循环、反射循环和学习循环组织任务执行、自我维护、元控制和受控学习。五对同时

items.title: Polynomial Residual Networks are Generically Identifiable
items.excerpt: We prove identifiability results for constant-width residual networks with polynomial activations and bias terms. For activations of degree at least five with generic coefficients, the fiber over a generic parameter is a singleton. For activations of degree at least three with no linear term after a suitable translation of the input, the generic fiber is given by translating biases and then scaling weights and translated biases by real roots of unity. These results specialize to networks without bias terms. With the same proof technique, we further derive necessary conditions for critical points of the ResNet parametrization, that are central in singular learning theory.

items.title_zh: 多项式残差网络是一般可辨识的
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了具有多项式激活和偏差项的等宽残差网络的可识别性结果。对于具有通用系数的至少五级激活，通用参数上的纤维是单例。对于在输入的适当平移之后没有线性项的至少三阶激活，通过平移偏差然后通过单位实根缩放权重和平移偏差来给出通用纤维。这些结果专门针对没有偏差项的网络。使用相同的证明技术，我们进一步推导了 ResNet 参数化关键点的必要条件，这是奇异学习理论的核心。

items.title: DIGEST: Discovery-Guided LLM Tuning for Symbolic Regression
items.excerpt: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. To address these limitations, we propose DIGEST. To render greater flexibility in generation, DIGEST repurposes a pretrained decoder block from a lightweight LLM into a symbolic policy for Genetic Programming (GP) population seeding, thereby leveraging the broader modeling capacity of the LLM. items.title_zh: 摘要：发现引导的 LLM 符号回归调整
items.excerpt_zh: 符号回归 (SR) 旨在直接从数据中发现数学表达式，而不需要特定于任务的科学描述。尽管传统的基于搜索的方法和最近基于法学硕士的方法都取得了巨大的进步，但仍然存在两个关键的局限性。首先（有限的生成灵活性），传统的基于搜索的方法依赖于固定的搜索规则或专门的学习生成器，严重限制了跨不同表达结构的自适应候选生成。其次（未充分利用的搜索发现），大多数基于 LLM 的方法无法可靠地恢复真实表达式，因为它们无法有效利用 LLM 本身来彻底消化过去的表达式或自适应地指导未来的搜索。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 DIGEST。为了在生成过程中提供更大的灵活性，DIGEST 将预训练的解码器块从轻量级 LLM 重新调整为遗传编程 (GP) 群体播种的符号策略，从而利用 LLM 更广泛的建模能力。为了更充分地利用搜索发现，GP发现的高质量表达

items.title: Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for $\sigma$-Weighted Post-Training
items.excerpt: Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample's balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample $\sigma$-weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on $29%$ of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show $10.6$ percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and $\sigma$-amplification; a student trained on a $0%$-TIR teacher anchor emits it at $45.8%$. Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA) gates $\sigma$ with paired-rollout target evidence. Frozen and online ICA reduce TIR to $13.8%$ and $11.2%$, halve residual drag, improve accuracy from $47.5%$ to $48.7%$

items.title_zh: 干预认证放大：$\sigma$ 加权训练后的有效性门
items.excerpt_zh: 混合后训练通常混合监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），使用训练端信号来设置每个样本的平衡。这些信号表征了锚定数据和策略，但不表征所强调的行为是否有助于目标任务和评估设置。这种不匹配可以重新激活并放大预训练的行为，即使其字面形式被从监督中删除后也是如此。我们用 DIAA（双隐式对抗放大）来证明这一点，DIAA 是一种按样本 $\sigma$ 加权的 SFT/RL 混合体。随着所有文字 Python 围栏从其锚点上移除，DIAA 在 $29%$ 的 MATH-500 提示上发出未执行的工具集成推理 (TIR)，是普通 GRPO 的三倍。配对干预显示，当 TIR 受到抑制时，准确度恢复了 10.6% 个百分点，并且 SFT 模仿和 $\sigma$ 放大的贡献相当；接受 $0%$-TIR 教师锚训练的学生发出的信号为 $45.8%$。干预认证放大（ICA）通过配对推出目标证据来控制 $\sigma$。冻结和在线 ICA 将 TIR 降低至 $13.8%$ 和 $11.2%$，将残余阻力减半，将精度从 $47.5%$ 提高到 $48.7%$

items.title: The Information Geometry of Representation Formation
items.excerpt: Most analyses of neural representations focus on trained endpoints, leaving the process by which internal structure forms comparatively unmeasured. We instead treat representation formation itself as an object of study, asking whether the path a representation takes through training reveals information that its endpoint does not. We formalize this idea by viewing representation learning as a geometric trajectory, using Bures geometry to measure movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. We find that learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and that changing only the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. More strikingly, representation trajectories become systematically less direct as the learned computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors. This effect persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Importantly, formation history contains predictive informati
items.title_zh: 表征形成的信息几何
items.excerpt_zh: 大多数神经表征分析都集中在经过训练的端点上，而内部结构形成的过程相对而言是无法测量的。相反，我们将表征形成本身视为研究对象，询问表征通过训练所采取的路径是否揭示了其终点所没有的信息。我们通过将表示学习视为几何轨迹，使用 Bures 几何来测量表示空间中的运动，并使用量子 Fisher 信息来表征对输入因素的局部敏感性，从而形式化了这个想法。我们发现学习将局部敏感性集中在与任务相关的因素上，并且仅改变预测目标就会围绕相应的视觉因素重新组织这种几何形状。更引人注目的是，由于学习计算需要输入因素之间的高阶交互，表示轨迹在系统上变得不那么直接。这种效应在匹配性能和训练持续时间控制下持续存在，并且从合成向量输入转移到渲染图像和自然图像上的残差 CNN。重要的是，形成历史包含预测信息

items.title: BriLLM-MetaPred: A Representation-Prediction Unity Language Model with Adaptive Self-Measurement
items.excerpt: We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, instantiated for language modeling. The theory argues that MetaPred is both necessary and sufficient as a machine-learning primitive for general cognition. Taking this theoretical conclusion as a design premise, we report an implementation of the primitive for language modeling. A single continuously evolving dynamical state serves as both the context representation and the state from which predictions are read out. Continuous measurement of its own state reduces finite-depth inconsistency, maintains internal consistency, and provides an endogenous dynamical self-supervision signal in fixed-point form. The single dynamical state of MetaPred intrinsically couples training and inference. MetaPred therefore exhibits symmetry across almost all key elements of machine learning, an intuitive and observable property of the mathematical optimum over the space of all machine-learning paradigms. BriLLM-MetaPred is neither another recurrent language model nor an extension of BriLLM. It provides

items.title: Salvaging that which is dearest
items.excerpt: In the midst of this turmoil, we attempt to make sense of it all by trying to salvage what is dearest to us. This post is about what I instinctively rushed to salvage, what appears to be dearest to me as a mathematician
items.title_zh: 抢救最亲爱的东西
items.excerpt_zh: 在这场混乱之中，我们试图通过挽救对我们来说最珍贵的东西来理解这一切。这篇文章是关于我本能地急于抢救的东西，这对我作为一名数学家来说似乎是最珍贵的

items.title: How Voting Is Like a Klein Bottle
items.excerpt: A new topological model connects a centuries-old voting paradox to a surface with no distinct inside or outside. The post How Voting Is Like a Klein Bottle first appeared on Quanta Magazine

items.title: Mathematics and mysticism: another defense of human mathematics
items.excerpt: My intention here is to contribute to the discussion by pointing at an aspect of mathematics which I believe is under threat and has been forgotten in the rubble of this ongoing earthquake: the mystical aspect of mathematics. I am aware that using the word “mystical” in the mathematics community comes with some risks; yet I will try to defend it, because I think that this is one of the crucial aspects of human engagement with mathematics.
items.title_zh: 数学与神秘主义：人类数学的另一种辩护
items.excerpt_zh: 我在这里的目的是通过指出数学的一个方面来为讨论做出贡献，我认为数学的神秘方面正受到威胁，并在这场持续的地震的废墟中被遗忘。我知道在数学界使用“神秘”这个词会带来一些风险；但我会尽力捍卫它，因为我认为这是人类参与数学的关键方面之一。

items.title: Use LLMs to check your work
items.excerpt: Most discussions about LLMs in mathematics seem to focus on their (rapidly advancing) proof discovery abilities and the effects these abilities may have on professional mathematics. I write here about a different use of these technologies, to make the following point: we have a professional duty to use LLMs to proofread our work.
items.title_zh: 使用法学硕士来检查你的工作
items.excerpt_zh: 大多数关于数学法学硕士的讨论似乎都集中在他们（快速发展的）证明发现能力以及这些能力可能对专业数学产生的影响。我在这里写下这些技术的不同用途，是为了表达以下观点：我们有专业责任使用法学硕士来校对我们的工作。

items.title: AI and Mathematics: Public Good, Credit, and Education
items.excerpt: We should preserve the human ability to understand and explore mathematics, not preserve unsolved problems merely to protect a familiar way of working. The goal should be to enlarge public mathematical knowledge and understanding, whether the discoveries are made by humans, AI, or a collaboration between them. I also discuss competition, credit for AI contributions, and why restrictions on AI in education raise different questions from restrictions on research.
items.title_zh: 人工智能和数学：公益、信用和教育
items.excerpt_zh: 我们应该保留人类理解和探索数学的能力，而不是仅仅为了保护熟悉的工作方式而保留未解决的问题。目标应该是扩大公众的数学知识和理解，无论这些发现是由人类、人工智能还是他们之间的合作做出的。我还讨论了竞争、人工智能贡献的功劳，以及为什么对教育领域人工智能的限制会引发与对研究的限制不同的问题。

items.title: Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy
items.excerpt: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. In this work, we formalize this ultimate objective by introducing a new paradigm for SAE evaluation: requiring that SAE features, and more generally dictionary-based decompositions of model representations, form an atomic interpretable unit basis, a coordinate system for semantically meaningful explanation. Under this paradigm, we organize existing and n
items.title_zh: 重新思考 SAE 评估：原子可解释单元框架揭示隐藏的多语义性和冗余

items.title: FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models
items.excerpt: Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. Extensive experiments show that training-free methods preserve reasoning performance but substantially degrade tool use at both model scales. In contrast, MOPD preserves tool use and achieves a more balanced capability profile, but requires additional data preparation, inference, and training. Jointly retaining reaso

items.title_zh: FusionEval：大型语言模型的基准模型融合
items.excerpt_zh: 模型融合旨在将多专家模型的功能集成到单个模型中。现有的评估对长链思维和工具使用的推理覆盖范围有限，而强大的平均表现可能掩盖个人专家能力的重大损失。我们推出 FusionEval，这是一个提供受控专家池的基准测试，集成了有或没有额外训练的融合方法，并提供了统一的评估套件。这些人才库包含经过 Qwen3 和 Llama 基础模型独立培训的领域专家，涉及数学、代码、科学、指令遵循和工具使用。该套件在可比较的数据访问规则下评估八个公共基准的能力保留和计算成本，报告标准化的平均和最差性能、运行时间和峰值 GPU 内存使用情况。大量实验表明，免训练方法可以保留推理性能，但会大大降低两种模型规模的工具使用率。相比之下，MOPD 保留了工具的使用并实现了更平衡的能力概况，但需要额外的数据准备、推理和培训。共同保留理由

items.title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
items.excerpt: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. items.title_zh: 规范中未提及的内容：测试分级 Coding-Agent 基准中规范 Oracle 的差距

items.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
items.excerpt: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch \Delta on the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing \Delta restores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/tok
items.title_zh: Delta N-gram：仅向前连续写入语言模型的本机 N-gram 内存
items.excerpt_zh: 我们之前的分析发现，模型的本机哈希 N 元语法表是连续更新对基础干扰最少的地方，但其写入需要反向传播并更改了预训练表。我们提出了 Delta N-gram，这是该表的只进写入路径。预训练表 T^0 永远不会被修改。证据被写入它所寻址的行上的稀疏补丁 \Delta 中：4.1M 参数编写器为每个（位置，散列头）事件发出一个目标和一个门，并且块平均增量规则使每行保持其旧值和门控目标的凸组合。作者根据预训练目标接受原始文本的离线训练；在使用时写入仅需要前向传递，并且清除 Delta 会恢复原始模型。经过训练来回答问题的 0.6B 原型在第二次写入后保留了 16/16 个事实；在线梯度写入保持2--4/16。我们研究了两个写入器：一个使用仅 T^0 模型对证据进行编码的普通写入器，以及一个在编码时读取其当前内存的增量写入器。在 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 上，普通作者的记忆是特定于文档的：在 64 个保留的新闻事件中，它将连续 NLL 降低了 0.068 nats/tok

items.title: Finitely Verifiable Segmentation: Decidability for Every Tokenizer with a Finite-State Verifier
items.excerpt: A segmentation policy assigns to each byte string at most one segmentation into tokens. Call it finitely verifiable when a finite automaton over marked strings, bytes paired with boundary bits, accepts exactly the policy's own segmentations. The automaton judges a proposed segmentation and need not compute one. The paper shows what that hypothesis buys. Four questions that practice settles by folklore become decidable, whether a window certifies a token boundary, whether the boundary gap is bounded, whether a mask keeps generation completable, and whether two policies are equivalent. The last three specialize limitedness, coaccessibility and the equivalence of single-valued transducers. The first refines the synchronizing cut of code theory, and two more ask whether a certified cut, or the cuts of an inventory, let each piece scan alone. The class sits strictly between the online-scannable policies and those with regular domains, and its inner frontier is Choffrut's and decidable in polynomial time. Markings are length-preserving, so the class is exactly the rational segmentation policies, a normal form rather than a restriction, an
items.title_zh: 有限可验证分割：具有有限状态验证器的每个标记器的可判定性
items.excerpt_zh: 分段策略为每个字节串分配至多一个分段标记。当标记字符串（与边界位配对的字节）上的有限自动机完全接受策略自己的分段时，将其称为有限可验证。自动机判断提议的分割并且不需要计算分割。这篇论文展示了这个假设的意义。实践通过民间传说解决的四个问题变得可判定：窗口是否证明令牌边界、边界间隙是否有界、掩模是否保持生成可完成以及两个策略是否等效。最后三个专门研究单值传感器的局限性、可访问性和等效性。第一个完善了代码理论的同步切割，另外两个询问是否经过认证的切割或库存的切割，让每个部分单独扫描。该类严格位于可在线扫描的策略和具有常规域的策略之间，其内部边界是 Choffrut 的并且可在多项式时间内判定。标记是保长的，所以类正是合理的分段策略，是一种范式而不是限制，

items.title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. MCPD evaluates the teacher under multiple views and averages the re
items.title_zh: 一位老师，多种观点：降低在策略自蒸馏中的参考敏感性
items.excerpt_zh: 按策略自蒸馏 (OPSD) 通过根据参考解决方案的特权副本进行密集的代币级监督，按照自己的轨迹训练模型，从而改进推理。现有方法通常使用以完整参考为条件的单个教师分布。我们发现了这种表述的局限性：引用只是推理过程的一种实现。尽管它提供了有关答案的证据，但它还编码了顺序、措辞和解决方案路径。因此，全参考调节可以产生正确的目标，而这些目标过度依赖于学生在推理时无法获得的信息。我们证明，在保持问题和学生状态固定的情况下，用另一个有效参考替换一个有效参考可以显着改变教师分布，我们将这种现象称为参考引起的目标不稳定。为了解决这种不稳定性，我们引入了蒙特卡洛特权蒸馏（MCPD），它将特权上下文建模为部分参考视图的分布，并提取边际教师分布。 MCPD 在多个视图下对教师进行评估并平均

items.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indica
items.authors: Zhizhuo Kou, Sizai Hou, Long Chen, Jian Yang, Junyu Luo, Jingshu Peng, Wenkai Zhang, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
items.title_zh: 继承，而非发明：在推理模型中追踪等待的起源
items.excerpt_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 被认为可以教导推理模型在重新考虑步骤之前写下 {wait}，但 RL 准确率的大幅提升并不需要这个词。这种观点可能会将强化学习的发现与模型从训练数据继承的内容混淆。我们通过开放模型的训练历史来追踪这个词，用频率、位置、形式和用法的无标签索引以及注入错误测试来读取它，所有这些都是根据采样输出计算出来的。我们发现零强化学习几乎从不创造标记：在缺少这个词的碱基上，强化学习大大提高了 MATH-500 的准确性，而 {wait} 几乎不存在。它附带训练数据：在 OLMo-3 中进行中期训练，并对推理轨迹进行微调，将其安装在大多数缺乏训练数据的模型中。在基地已经使用它的情况下，两个发布的 RL-Zero 配方（OLMo-3、MiMo）都会将其相乘，而来自同一基地的无 KL GRPO 则不会； OLMo-3 的配方会磨损它的形状，使其成为一个更敏感但更自由的警报器；经过监督微调后的 RL 几乎不会改变它，而我们的 GRPO 配方会擦除通过微调播种的标记。最后，我们表明标记频率本身并不能表明
