items.title: Optimal Multitask Representations Under a Rate Constraint: An Information Bottleneck Analysis
items.excerpt: Which pretraining objective yields the best representation for downstream tasks under an information budget? We formalize this problem as a multitask information bottleneck, using a mutual information constraint to model incomplete information retention. For Gaussian inputs and tasks, we characterize optimal representations and show that a weakly task-aligned specialist can outperform a reconstruction generalist at low rates but lose at high rates. We also construct task families for which every fixed Gaussian prediction objective incurs arbitrarily large relative regret, driven by reversals in optimal allocation priorities. Conversely, the average task information matrix defines an objective with a uniform relative-regret bound controlled by maximum task SNR. CelebA and dSprites experiments illustrate that compression can change which pretraining objective performs best, and even task-aware training can reverse which downstream task is better preserved as rate increases.
items.title_zh: 速率约束下的最优多任务表示：信息瓶颈分析
items.excerpt_zh: 哪个预训练目标可以在信息预算下产生下游任务的最佳表示？我们将这个问题形式化为多任务信息瓶颈，使用相互信息约束来模拟不完整的信息保留。对于高斯输入和任务，我们描述了最佳表示，并表明弱任务对齐专家可以在低速率下胜过重建通才，但在高速率下会失败。我们还构建了任务族，其中每个固定的高斯预测目标都会因最优分配优先级的逆转而产生任意大的相对遗憾。相反，平均任务信息矩阵定义了一个目标，该目标具有由最大任务 SNR 控制的统一相对遗憾界限。 CelebA 和 dSprites 实验表明，压缩可以改变哪个预训练目标表现最好，甚至任务感知训练也可以随着速率的增加而逆转哪个下游任务得到更好的保留。

items.title: Solvable models of learning to pursue a moving target
items.excerpt: Agents tasked with intercepting a moving target must learn how to reach it, ideally as efficiently as possible. As observers of animal pursuit behavior have noticed, different strategies are possible: on one extreme, the agent reactively moves toward the target's current location; on the other, the agent predicts the target's future location and moves directly there. Motivated by the desire to understand how such strategies might be learned, we introduce a continuous-time linear-quadratic model of open-loop target pursuit whose optimal control strategies interpolate between these possibilities. Usefully, a small number of interpretable parameters control which type of strategy is optimal, and it is possible to derive closed-form solutions for optimal strategies, policy learning dynamics, and value learning dynamics. Exploiting our model's linear structure, we find that the time scales of learning precisely correspond to the eigenvalues of certain matrices, and that relevant eigenvalue spectra generically have a gap. We show that this gap indicates that agents tend to learn how to reach their target before optimizing their movement. Ou
items.title_zh: 追求移动目标的可解决学习模型
items.excerpt_zh: 负责拦截移动目标的特工必须学会如何到达目标，最好尽可能高效。正如动物追逐行为的观察者所注意到的，可能有不同的策略：在一种极端情况下，智能体反应性地向目标的当前位置移动；在另一种极端情况下，智能体会向目标的当前位置移动。另一方面，代理预测目标的未来位置并直接移动到那里。出于了解如何学习此类策略的愿望，我们引入了开环目标追踪的连续时间线性二次模型，其最佳控制策略在这些可能性之间进行插值。有用的是，少量可解释的参数控制哪种类型的策略是最优的，并且可以导出最优策略、策略学习动态和价值学习动态的封闭式解决方案。利用模型的线性结构，我们发现学习的时间尺度精确对应于某些矩阵的特征值，并且相关的特征值谱通常存在间隙。我们表明，这种差距表明智能体倾向于在优化其运动之前学习如何达到目标。欧

items.title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
items.excerpt: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. This decomposition yields a principled scoring rule to rank token-level guidance. We combine this with a progressive \textbf{coverage annea
items.authors: Shijie Li, Yilin Gao, Tieyuan Chen, Yun Luo, Weiyao Lin, Hang Yu
items.title_zh: GIFT：用于蒸馏增强推理 RL 的梯度通知过滤
items.excerpt_zh: 为复杂的推理任务训练大型语言模型依赖于两个互补的信号：稀疏的、基于结果的强化学习（RL）以确保正确性，以及密集的、令牌级蒸馏以提供指导。然而，监督上的互补并不能保证优化上的兼容性；以模仿为中心的蒸馏可能与结果驱动的强化学习目标相冲突，而现有的混合方法缺乏原则性的解决方案。我们提出了 \textbf{GIFT} （\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL），这是一种直接解决要应用哪些教师更新的分配问题的新颖方法。 GIFT 执行令牌级几何分析，将蒸馏梯度分解为与 RL 梯度平行的分量，它测量一阶冲突并提供安全过滤器，以及与其正交的分量，它量化新的方向指导并提供测量值。这种分解产生了一个原则性的评分规则来对代币级别的指导进行排名。我们将其与渐进式 \textbf{coverage annea 结合起来

items.title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
items.excerpt: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. On top of our state-of-the-art retriever, optimized query rewriting further improves Math
items.authors: Jialin Lu, Xiaoyu Liu, Hengrui Luo, Rodrigo Stehling, Linxi Liu, Weiran Sun, Yuepeng Wang, Wuyang Chen
items.title_zh: Lean Finder V2：对 Mathlib 进行语义搜索，消除用户查询的歧义
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入了 Lean Finder V2，这是 Mathlib 的语义搜索框架，它通过补充模型级对抗训练和输入级查询重写来消除用户查询的歧义。人类数学家和编码人员很少通过提供详细上下文来搜索 Mathlib。在实践中，它们查询简短的属性、符号、别名或假设，从而隐含了许多预期的数学内容。相比之下，现有的 Mathlib 搜索引擎不切实际地假设上下文丰富的查询。现实世界中短查询的稀缺与真实的 Mathlib 语句相结合使得这种歧义变得更加棘手。我们认为这本质上是一个数据问题。通过对抗性训练，我们扩大了带标签的短查询和模糊查询的生成，并学习在模型级微调和输入级查询重写中消除用户查询的歧义。在人工策划的 MathlibQR 基准测试中，我们的 Lean Finder V2 树立了新的技术水平，与之前最好的 Mathlib 语义搜索引擎相比至少有 11% 的相对改进。在我们最先进的检索器之上，优化的查询重写进一步提高了数学

items.title: Training Mixed-Monotone Neural Networks for Verification Without Set Propagation
items.excerpt: Most formal verification approaches for neural networks conservatively enclose the output set of the neural network. However, computing a tight output enclosure is in general computationally hard. We sidestep this challenge with a novel neural network architecture that realizes mixed-monotone functions as the difference of monotone subnetworks. By utilizing the theory on mixed-monotone systems, this reduces the computation of a tight output enclosure from complicated set propagation to two simple forward passes of opposite corners of an input interval. Moreover, because the size of the resulting enclosure is a closed-form function of the weights of the neural network, we can directly minimize it during training. We prove a lower bound on the size of any such enclosure, given by the total variation of the represented function generalized to several inputs, which makes it possible to compare the tightness of the enclosure against the optimum. Our evaluation on regression and dynamical-system benchmarks demonstrates that our training reduces the enclosure size to within 0.5% of the lower bound without sacrificing prediction accuracy. Com
items.authors: Jonas Fingerhut, Lukas Koller, Matthias Althoff
items.title_zh: 训练混合单调神经网络进行验证，无需集合传播
items.excerpt_zh: 大多数神经网络的正式验证方法都会保守地封闭神经网络的输出集。然而，计算紧凑的输出外壳通常在计算上是困难的。我们通过一种新颖的神经网络架构来回避这一挑战，该架构将混合单调函数实现为单调子网络的差异。通过利用混合单调系统的理论，这减少了紧密输出范围的计算，从复杂的集合传播到输入区间对角的两个简单的前向传递。此外，由于所得外壳的大小是神经网络权重的封闭函数，因此我们可以在训练期间直接将其最小化。我们证明了任何此类外壳尺寸的下限，由推广到多个输入的表示函数的总变化给出，这使得可以将外壳的密封性与最佳值进行比较。我们对回归和动力系统基准的评估表明，我们的训练将外壳尺寸减小到下限的 0.5% 以内，而不会牺牲预测精度。康姆

items.title: Aspects of quadratic Chabauty via modular forms
items.excerpt: We develop algorithms to construct a basis of de Rham cohomology for modular curves and a matrix representing the Hodge filtration required in the quadratic Chabauty method. We do this without requiring an explicit plane model of the curve and instead compute these objects in terms of modular forms. Our approach works for any modular curve; to demonstrate its efficiency, we implement our method for nonsplit Cartan modular curves.
items.title_zh: 通过模块化形式的二次 Chabauty 方面
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了算法来构建模曲线的 de Rham 上同调基础以及表示二次 Chabauty 方法中所需的 Hodge 过滤的矩阵。我们这样做不需要曲线的显式平面模型，而是以模块化形式计算这些对象。我们的方法适用于任何模块化曲线；为了证明其效率，我们实现了非分裂嘉当模曲线的方法。

items.title: Complete Determination of the Gallai--van der Waerden Number \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)
items.excerpt: This paper completely determines the Gallai--van der Waerden number \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\) for all integers \(r\ge 3\): \[ \mathrm{GW}(3;3,3)=\mathrm{GW}(4;3,3)=9,\qquad \mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)=r\quad (r\ge 5). \]
items.title_zh: 加莱的完全确定--范德韦尔登数 \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)
items.excerpt_zh: 本文完全确定了所有整数\(r\ge 3\)的Gallai--van der Waerden数\(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)：\[ \mathrm{GW}(3;3,3)=\mathrm{GW}(4;3,3)=9,\qquad \mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)=r\quad (r\ge 5)。 \]

items.title: OpenAI partially disproves Littlewood's 1961 $L^α$-flat theorem
items.excerpt: We present a counterexample, produced by OpenAI, to Littlewood's 1961 theorem on $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials. The theorem asserts that no $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials exist within the class of trigonometric polynomials of the form$$\sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m \cos(m\theta+\alpha_m), \qquad n \in \mathbb{N}^*,$$satisfying$$k\, n^2 \sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m^2 \;\leq\; \sum_{m=1}^{n} m^2 a_m^2,$$where $k$ is an absolute constant (alternatively expressed on the right-hand side as $K = 1/k$). We show that OpenAI's counterexample is contained within the class of hyper-lacunary sequences. Consequently, it offers only a limited refutation, as such sequences fail to satisfy an implicit assumption of Littlewood's theorem. We also discuss broader questions surrounding this counterexample and provide a brief historical overview.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个由 OpenAI 制作的反例，针对 Littlewood 1961 年关于 $L^\alpha$-平坦多项式的定理。该定理断言 $$\sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m \cos(m\theta+\alpha_m), \qquad n \in \mathbb{N}^*,$$satisfying$$k\, n^2 \sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m^2 形式的三角多项式类中不存在 $L^\alpha$ 平坦多项式\;\leq\; \sum_{m=1}^{n} m^2 a_m^2,$$其中 $k$ 是绝对常数（或者在右侧表示为 $K = 1/k$）。我们证明 OpenAI 的反例包含在超空白序列类别中。因此，它仅提供有限的反驳，因为此类序列无法满足利特尔伍德定理的隐含假设。我们还讨论了围绕这个反例的更广泛的问题，并提供了简短的历史概述。
items.title_zh: OpenAI 部分反驳了 Littlewood 1961 年的 $L^α$-平坦定理

items.title: The exponent $1/4$ in three complexity bounds: integer bases, continued fractions, and the $(3/2)^n$ steering word
items.excerpt: Let $\xi$ be a real algebraic irrational number and $p(n,\xi,b)$ the number of distinct blocks of length $n$ in its base-$b$ expansion. Bugeaud and Evertse proved in 2008 that $p(n,\xi,b)/(n(\log n)^\eta)$ is unbounded for every $\eta<1/11$. We prove this for every $\eta<1/4$. We also prove the analogous bound for the continued fraction expansion of an algebraic number of degree at least three, with every exponent $\delta<1/4$. Bugeaud announced this statement in 2013 with an unspecified $\delta>0$. Finally, the subword complexity of the steering word of $(3/2)^n$ exceeds $C\,k(\log k)^\eta$ infinitely often for every $\eta<1/4$ and every $C$. The three proofs share one count: $\varepsilon^{-1}$ classes times $\varepsilon^{-3}$ subspaces from the quantitative Subspace Theorem of Evertse and Ferretti. The subspaces are then disposed of at the cost of a logarithm, with no further power of $\varepsilon^{-1}$. All three results, and the quantitative Subspace Theorem they rest on, are machine-verified in Lean~4.
items.title_zh: 指数 $1/4$ 在三个复杂度范围内：整数基数、连分数和 $(3/2)^n$ 控制字
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $\xi$ 为实代数无理数，$p(n,\xi,b)$ 为其基 $b$ 扩展中长度为 $n$ 的不同块的数量。 Bugeaud 和 Evertse 在 2008 年证明，对于每个 $\eta<1/11$，$p(n,\xi,b)/(n(\log n)^\eta)$ 是无界的。我们对每个 $\eta<1/4$ 证明了这一点。我们还证明了至少三阶代数数的连分式展开的类似界限，每个指数 $\delta<1/4$。 Bugeaud 在 2013 年宣布了这一声明，但未指定 $\delta>0$。最后，对于每个 $\eta<1/4$ 和每个 $C$，$(3/2)^n$ 的控制字的子字复杂度经常无限地超过 $C\,k(\log k)^\eta$。这三个证明共享一个计数：$\varepsilon^{-1}$ 类乘以 Evertse 和 Ferretti 定量子空间定理中的 $\varepsilon^{-3}$ 子空间。然后以对数为代价处理子空间，不再有 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的幂。所有三个结果以及它们所依据的定量子空间定理均在 Lean~4 中进行了机器验证。

items.title: Reflections on Trusting Lean
items.excerpt: It is known, by works of Werner and Carneiro, that the type theory of Lean (and indeed of CIC plus a version of choice) is equiconsistent with ZFC plus "there are infinitely many strongly inaccessible cardinals". We prove a finer connection between these two formal systems; namely, given any formula in the language of second order arithmetic, that formula is provable in the aforementioned extension of ZFC if and only if the same formula, when viewed as a type in Lean, is inhabited.
items.title_zh: 对信任精益的思考
items.excerpt_zh: 根据 Werner 和 Carneiro 的著作，我们知道精益的类型论（实际上是 CIC 加上选择的版本）与 ZFC 加上“有无限多个强不可接近的基数”是一致的。我们证明了这两个形式系统之间存在更精细的联系；也就是说，给定二阶算术语言中的任何公式，当且仅当将相同的公式视为 Lean 中的类型时，该公式在上述 ZFC 扩展中是可证明的。

items.title: A Study in Solution Models for SAT using the PBNF-transform
items.excerpt: In this article, we use the PBNF-transform, or Polynomial Boolean Normal Form, described earlier in two articles and now extended to higher arity, to solve Boolean satisfiability problems (SAT), which are part of the P versus NP problem. SAT consists of a statement of conjunctions of clauses, and in our SAT-solving models, we dualize the logical equations, inverting the problem by \emph{multiplying} letters (literals) in the transferred clauses, now phrases: $pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$, and using a binary iterated composition based on \emph{adding polynomials} for the conjunctions in our solution formula. We obtain Polynomial Boolean Equations, PBE=0, by also renaming the truth value $1\mapsto 0$(T). To find a solution, we look for repeating literals in the clauses to factor out. With reversed literal repetition, we can even reduce the CNF to the sum of the transformed clauses.
items.title_zh: 使用 PBNF 变换的 SAT 解决方案模型研究
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们使用 PBNF 变换或多项式布尔范式（多项式布尔范式）来解决布尔可满足性问题 (SAT)，该变换是 P 与 NP 问题的一部分，该变换在前面的两篇文章中进行了描述，现在已扩展到更高的数量。 SAT 由子句的连词陈述组成，在我们的 SAT 求解模型中，我们对逻辑方程进行对偶化，通过在转移的子句中乘以 \emph{} 字母（文字）（现在是短语：$pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$）来反转问题，并使用基于 \emph{添加多项式} 的二进制迭代组合作为我们解决方案公式中的连词。我们通过将真值 $1\maps 重命名为 0$(T) 来获得多项式布尔方程，PBE=0。为了找到解决方案，我们在子句中寻找重复的文字来分解。通过反向文字重复，我们甚至可以将 CNF 简化为转换子句的总和。

items.title: Computable presentations of separable Lebesgue spaces
items.excerpt: For every right-c.e.\ real $p\in(1,2)$, $L^p[0,1]$ has a computable presentation. The proof combines an effective stability modulus for almost isometric embeddings with a Fra\"{\i}ss\'e-style construction in which the exponent varies. In the same range, if $\ell^p$ has a computable presentation, then $p$ is computable. Combining these with the known results gives the computable presentability classification for all separable Lebesgue spaces. We also formulate an effective Fra\"{\i}ss\'e theorem for Banach spaces and apply it to obtain a computable presentation of the Gurarij Banach space.
items.title_zh: 可分离勒贝格空间的可计算表示
items.excerpt_zh: 对于每个右 c.e.\ real $p\in(1,2)$，$L^p[0,1]$ 都有一个可计算的表示。该证明将几乎等距嵌入的有效稳定性模量与指数变化的 Fra\"{\i}ss\'e 式构造相结合。在相同范围内，如果 $\ell^p$ 具有可计算表示，则 $p$ 是可计算的。将这些与已知结果相结合，给出所有可分离勒贝格空间的可计算表示性分类。我们还制定了有效的 Fra\"{\i}ss\'e Banach 空间定理，并应用它来获得 Gurarij Banach 空间的可计算表示。

items.title: Non-aware computable presentations of randomizations
items.excerpt: Let 2 be the two-element structure in the empty signature. We build a computable presentation Q of the Borel randomization $2^{[0,1)}$ in which neither constant random variable is a computable point. Consequently, Q is not aware. This gives a negative answer to a question of Cuervo Ovalle and Goldbring \cite{CG}. We also construct a countable structure $M$ with no computable presentation but $M^{[0,1)}$ has a computable presentation. This answers another question and establishes the necessity of the awareness condition stated in one of the main theorems in \cite{CG}.
items.title_zh: 随机化的无意识可计算呈现
items.excerpt_zh: 令 2 为空签名中的二元素结构。我们构建了 Borel 随机化 $2^{[0,1)}$ 的可计算表示 Q，其中常数随机变量都不是可计算点。因此，Q 并不知道。这对 Cuervo Ovalle 和 Goldbring \cite{CG} 的问题给出了否定的答案。我们还构造了一个可数结构 $M$ ，没有可计算的表示，但 $M^{[0,1)}$ 有可计算的表示。这回答了另一个问题，并建立了 \cite{CG} 中的一个主要定理中所述的意识条件的必要性。

items.title: Analytification and tropicalization via hyperfields and definable types
items.excerpt: We study the analytification and tropicalization of algebraic varieties over valued fields via Jun's spaces of hyperfield points. Our main new objects are a family of power-tropical hyperfields $H_n$ and their inverse limit $H$, recording at each level the class of a leading term modulo $n$-th powers of the residue field. They yield an enhanced tropicalization of the associated space $X(H)$, strictly finer than the Berkovich one exactly when the multiplicative group of the residue field is non-divisible: it specialises to the Berkovich analytification when the residue field is algebraically closed, to the real analytification of Jell-Scheiderer-Yu when it is real closed, and to a new $p$-adic analytification when it is $p$-adically closed. Over henselian valued fields of equicharacteristic $0$ we then construct a model-theoretic avatar of $X(H)$: the space $\widehat{X}_T$ of definable types orthogonal to the value group, which sharpens the geometry in the spirit of Hrushovski and Loeser and recovers their space over algebraically closed valued fields. We show that $\widehat{X}_T$ is strictly pro-definable, satisfies a model-theoretic
items.authors: Pablo Cubides Kovacsics , Mariana Vicaría , Jinhe Ye
items.title_zh: 通过超场和可定义类型进行分析和热带化
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过Jun的超场点空间研究了有价值域上的代数簇的分析和热带化。我们的主要新对象是一系列幂热带超场 $H_n$ 及其逆极限 $H$，在每个级别记录剩余场的首项模 $n$ 次方的类别。它们产生关联空间 $X(H)$ 的增强热带化，当留数域的乘法群不可整时，它比 Berkovich 空间更精细：当留数域代数闭时，它专门用于 Berkovich 分析；当 Jell-Scheiderer-Yu 实闭时，它专门用于 Jell-Scheiderer-Yu 的实分析；当它是 $p$-adic 时，它专门用于新的 $p$-adic 分析。关闭。然后，在等特征 $0$ 的汉森值域上，我们构建了 $X(H)$ 的模型理论化身：与值组正交的可定义类型的空间 $\widehat{X}_T$，这按照 Hrushovski 和 Loeser 的精神锐化了几何形状，并在代数闭值域上恢复了它们的空间。我们证明 $\widehat{X}_T$ 是严格可定义的，满足模型理论

items.title: Set-theoretic inevitability
items.excerpt: After defining the concept of inevitability for statements with the modal logic of forcing, we raise the question of which statements are inevitable under $\mathsf{ZFC}$ and under large cardinal hypotheses. We show that $\mathsf{SOA}$ (defined as $\mathsf{ZFC}^-$ + $\mathsf V=\mathsf{HC}$) plus the $\boldsymbol\Sigma^1_2$-perfect set property is $\mathsf{ZFC}$-inevitable, and that Projective Determinacy is inevitable in the theory of $\mathsf{ZFC}$ with a proper class of Woodin cardinals. We then discuss the possible conceptual significance of these results for the foundations of set theory.
items.title_zh: 集合论必然性
items.excerpt_zh: 在用强制的模态逻辑定义了陈述的必然性概念之后，我们提出了在 $\mathsf{ZFC}$ 和大基数假设下哪些陈述是不可避免的问题。我们证明$\mathsf{SOA}$（定义为$\mathsf{ZFC}^-$ + $\mathsf V=\mathsf{HC}$）加上$\boldsymbol\Sigma^1_2$-完美集合属性是$\mathsf{ZFC}$-不可避免的，并且在$\mathsf{ZFC}$理论中射影决定性是不可避免的，具有合适的伍丁类红衣主教。然后我们讨论这些结果对于集合论基础可能的概念意义。

items.title: There is no universal $F_σ$ equivalence relation
items.excerpt: Rosendal proved that any $K_\sigma$ equivalence relation is Borel reducible to $\ell_\infty$. We prove that for every $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation $F$ on a Polish space, there is an $F_\sigma$ real linear subspace $H$ of $\ell_2$ such that the coset relation $x\mathrel{E_H}y$ if and only if $x-y\in H$ has no Baire-measurable reduction to $F$. In particular, there is no $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation universal under Borel reducibility for all $F_\sigma$ equivalence relations. This answers a question of Rosendal.
items.excerpt_zh: Rosendal 证明任何 $K_\sigma$ 等价关系都是 Borel 可简化为 $\ell_\infty$。我们证明，对于波兰空间上的每个 $F_\sigma$ 等价关系 $F$，存在 $\ell_2$ 的 $F_\sigma$ 实线性子空间 $H$，使得陪集关系 $x\mathrel{E_H}y$ 当且仅当 $x-y\in H$ 没有 Baire 可测量的减少到 $F$。特别是，对于所有 $F_\sigma$ 等价关系，在 Borel 可约性下不存在通用的 $F_\sigma$ 等价关系。这回答了罗森达尔的问题。
items.title_zh: 不存在通用的$F_σ$等价关系

items.title: Groups satisfying the minimal condition on centralizers are complete co-analytic
items.excerpt: In this paper, we prove that the set of groups satisfying the minimal condition on centralizers is a complete co-analytic subset of the Polish space of countable groups. This answers a question of Wesolek and Williams.
items.title_zh: 满足扶正器最小条件的群是完全协分析的
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明满足集中器最小条件的群的集合是可数群的波兰空间的完全协分析子集。这回答了韦索莱克和威廉姆斯的问题。

items.excerpt: Mathematicians are humans, and humans have emotions. This essay scratches the surface of an intricate issue behind a very simple question: in what ways and to what extent are mathematicians’ reactions to AI driven by emotion?
