items.title: An Asymptotic for Non-Wieferich Numbers
items.excerpt: A cyclic number is a positive integer $n$ such that $\gcd(n, \varphi(n)) = 1$. Erd\H{o}s showed that the number of cyclic numbers up to $x$, $C(x)$, has $C(x) \sim e^{-\gamma}x/\log_3(x)$ asymptotically as $x$ tends to infinity. We define Wieferich numbers to be odd, positive integers $n$ such that $(n, (2^{\ell(n)}-1)/n) > 1$, where $\ell(n)$ is the smallest positive integer with $2^{\ell(n)} \equiv 1 \mod n$. Franco and Pomerance showed that non-Wieferich numbers have density zero among the odd integers. We show that the counting function of $n \leq x$ in the symmetric difference of non-Wieferich numbers and cyclic numbers is $O(x/(\log_3(x))^2)$, under a mild assumption on the counting function of Wieferich primes.
items.excerpt_zh: 循环数是一个正整数 $n$，使得 $\gcd(n, \varphi(n)) = 1$。 Erd\H{o}s 表明，直到 $x$ 的循环数 $C(x)$ 的数量，随着 $x$ 趋于无穷大，$C(x) \sim e^{-\gamma}x/\log_3(x)$ 渐近。我们将 Wieferich 数定义为奇数正整数 $n$，使得 $(n, (2^{\ell(n)}-1)/n) > 1$，其中 $\ell(n)$ 是 $2^{\ell(n)} \equiv 1 \mod n$ 的最小正整数。 Franco 和 Pomerance 证明，非 Wieferich 数在奇数整数中的密度为零。我们证明，在对 Wieferich 素数计数函数的温和假设下，非 Wieferich 数和循环数的对称差中 $n \leq x$ 的计数函数为 $O(x/(\log_3(x))^2)$。
items.title_zh: 非 Wieferich 数的渐近

items.title: A Counterexample to the Eventual Stability Conjecture
items.excerpt: We give a counterexample to the eventual stability conjecture over number fields and classify for power maps.
items.title_zh: 最终稳定性猜想的反例
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了数域上的最终稳定性猜想的反例，并对幂图进行了分类。

items.title: Sch\"affer's conjecture for even $k \le 42$
items.excerpt: In 1956, Sch\"affer made a conjecture on the whole number solutions to the Diophantine equation $S_k(x):=1^k+2^k+\cdots+x^k=y^n$. In this paper we show how for even $k$, we can descend to a long list of three coupled equations of the form $Ax^p-By^p=1$, where $A,B\in\mathbb{Q}$. To this system, we apply the modular method, linear forms in logarithms, and local methods. As a result, we prove Sch\"affer's conjecture for even $k \le 42$.
items.authors: Imin Chen, Stephen Choi, James Houle
items.title_zh: Sch\"对 $k \le 42$ 的猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 1956 年，Sch\"affer 对丢番图方程 $S_k(x):=1^k+2^k+\cdots+x^k=y^n$ 的整数解做出了猜想。在本文中，我们展示了如何对于偶数 $k$，我们可以下降到 $Ax^p-By^p=1$ 形式的三个耦合方程的长列表，其中 $A,B\in\mathbb{Q}$。在这个系统中，我们应用了模方法、对数线性形式和局部方法，结果，我们证明了 Sch\"affer 的猜想，甚至是 $k \le 42$。

items.title: A quaternary Diophantine inequality with prime numbers of a special form (II)
items.excerpt: Let $N$ be a sufficiently large real number. In this paper, it is proved that, for $1<\frac{5179}{3909}$ and for any arbitrary large number $E>0$, the Diophantine inequality \begin{equation*} \big|p_1^c+p_2^c+p_3^c+p_4^c-N\big|<(\log N)^{-E} \end{equation*} is solvable in prime variables $p_1,p_2,p_3,p_4$ such that each of the numbers $p_i+2\,(i=1,2,3,4)$ has, counted according to multiplicity, at most $[\frac{31250}{5179-3909c}]$ prime factors, which constitutes a large improvement upon the previous results of Dimitrov [13] and Li-Xue-Zhang [22], respectively.
items.authors: Yuhua Zhao, Jinjiang Li, Linji Long, Min Zhang
items.title_zh: 具有特殊形式素数的四元丢番图不等式（II）
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $N$ 为足够大的实数。本文证明，对于$1<\frac{5179}{3909}$和任意大数$E>0$，丢番图不等式 \begin{equation*} \big|p_1^c+p_2^c+p_3^c+p_4^c-N\big|<(\log N)^{-E} \end{equation*} 在素数变量中是可解的$p_1,p_2,p_3,p_4$使得每个数$p_i+2\,(i=1,2,3,4)$按照重数计算最多有$[\frac{31250}{5179-3909c}]$素因子，这分别比Dimitrov [13]和Li-Xue-Zhang [22]之前的结果有很大的改进。

items.title: A relative Schinzel-Zassenhaus bound for the polynomial $T^2 - 1$
items.excerpt: For $f(T) = T^2 - 1$, we establish a lower bound for the relative dynamical house of wandering algebraic integers. This bound depends on the degree over the maximal abelian extension of the rationals. Our proof follows Dimitrov's approach to the Schinzel-Zassenhaus Conjecture and its generalization by Habegger-Schmidt.
items.title_zh: 多项式 $T^2 - 1$ 的相对 Schinzel-Zassenhaus
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $f(T) = T^2 - 1$，我们为游荡代数整数的相对动态房屋建立了下界。该界限取决于有理数的最大阿贝尔扩张的程度。我们的证明遵循迪米特洛夫对辛泽尔-扎森豪斯猜想的方法及其由哈贝格-施密特的推广。

items.title: Short sums of the M\"obius function over function fields
items.excerpt: We develop a new method which allows us to estimate, with a power saving, sums of the M{\"o}bius function over function fields $\F_p(X)$. The sums run over monic polynomials with all other coefficients in short intervals, of length below the P\'olya--Vinogradov threshold $p^{1/2}$. A classical result of L.~Stickelberger (1898) reduces this question to bounding character sums with polynomial discriminants which are inhomogeneous multivariate polynomials. Variants of Burgess's method with non-linear shifts {\it {\`a} la carte} are introduced to go beyond the P\'olya--Vinogradov range, combined with a stratification result of J. Xu (2020) for complete character sums.
items.authors: Etienne Fouvry, Igor E. Shparlinski, Ping Xi
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种新方法，可以节省功耗地估计 M{\"o}bius 函数在函数域 $\F_p(X)$ 上的和。这些和在短间隔内与所有其他系数一起运行的单调多项式上运行，其长度低于 P\'olya--Vinogradov 阈值 $p^{1/2}$。L.~Stickelberger (1898) 的经典结果将这个问题简化为边界字符和：多项式判别式是 Burgess 方法的变体，具有非线性位移 {\it {\`a} la carte}，其被引入以超越 P\'olya-Vinogradov 范围，并与 J. Xu (2020) 的分层结果相结合以获得完整的字符和。
items.title_zh: M\"obius 函数在函数域上的简和

items.title: Subset sums of power values over Galois rings
items.excerpt: Let $R=GR(p^m,p^{mf})$, where $p$ is prime, $q=p^f$, $m,f\geq1$, $d\geq2$ and $p\nmid d$. We count $n$-element subsets of $P=\{x^d:x\in R\}\setminus\{0\}$, the set of distinct nonzero $d$th-power values, with a prescribed sum. For fixed $m,d,n$ with $n\geq3$, the count equals \[ q^{-m}\binom{|P|}{n}(1+O_{m,d,n}(q^{1-n/2})) \] as $q\to\infty$ through admissible prime powers, uniformly over all targets and with both $p$ and $f$ allowed to vary. For fixed $m,d$, we also classify uniform relative equidistribution at the remaining positive sizes: it fails at $n=1$, and at $n=2$ it holds along an admissible sequence if and only if, for all sufficiently large terms, $\gcd(d,q-1)=1$ and $(m\geq2\text{ or }p\ne2)$.
items.excerpt_zh: 设$R=GR(p^m,p^{mf})$，其中$p$是质数，$q=p^f$、$m,f\geq1$、$d\geq2$和$p\nmid d$。我们计算 R\}\setminus\{0\}$ 中 $P=\{x^d:x\in R\}\setminus\{0\}$ 的 $n$ 个元素子集，即不同的非零 $d$ 次方值的集合，并具有规定的总和。对于固定的 $m,d,n$ 和 $n\geq3$，计数等于 \[ q^{-m}\binom{|P|}{n}(1+O_{m,d,n}(q^{1-n/2})) \] 作为 $q\to\infty$ 通过允许的素数幂，在所有目标上统一，并且 $p$ 和 $f$ 都允许变化。对于固定的 $m,d$，我们还在剩余的正大小处对均匀相对均匀分布进行分类：它在 $n=1$ 时失败，而在 $n=2$ 时，它保持沿着可接受的序列当且仅当，对于所有足够大的项，$\gcd(d,q-1)=1$ 和 $(m\geq2\text{ 或 }p\ne2)$。
items.title_zh: 伽罗瓦环上幂值的子集和

items.title: On a conjecture of Velani
items.excerpt: We investigate the approximation of elements of the middle-third Cantor set by dyadic rationals, and natural extensions. We prove a conjecture of Velani, completing the metric theory for the Cantor measure. Our key method enables a quantitative study of the incommensurability of binary and ternary expansions of integers, initiated by Furstenberg. The method has other applications, e.g. $\sum_{k} |\hat{\mu}(2^k)|^\sigma < \infty$ for any $\sigma > 0$, where $\mu$ is the Cantor measure.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了二进有理数和自然扩张所设置的中三分之一康托元素的近似。我们证明了 Velani 的猜想，完成了康托测度的度量理论。我们的关键方法能够对整数的二元和三元展开的不可通约性进行定量研究，由 Furstenberg 发起。该方法还有其他应用，例如$\sum_{k} |\hat{\mu}(2^k)|^\sigma < \infty$ 对于任何 $\sigma > 0$，其中 $\mu$ 是康托测度。
items.title_zh: 关于 Velani 的猜想

items.title: Triangulation, Volume, and Symmetries of the Dihedral Group Analogue of the Permutohedron
items.excerpt: We study the analogue of the permutohedron for the dihedral group, which we call the dihedral permutohedron. We determine the facet structure of the dihedral permutohedron, use the facet structure to construct a triangulation, and determine a nice combinatorial formula for the volume of the dihedral permutohedron. Lastly, we find a family of interesting unimodular affine symmetries of the odd dihedral permutohedron.
items.title_zh: 全四面体二面体群类似物的三角测量、体积和对称性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究二面体群的置换三面体的类似物，我们称之为二面体置换三面体。我们确定了二面体置换面体的面结构，使用面结构构建了三角剖分，并确定了二面体置换面体体积的良好组合公式。最后，我们发现了奇二面体排列的一族有趣的单模仿射对称性。

items.title: Two q-Deformations of Narayana Polynomials: Rogers Moments, Hankel Positivity, and q-Narayana Kernels
items.excerpt: We study two $q$-deformations of the continuous interpolation between type $B$ and shifted type $A$ Narayana polynomials, both constructed from the continuous $q$-ultraspherical (Rogers) functional. The first consists of affine moments of ordinary powers. For fixed $0 <1$ and $-1<\beta<1$, we prove coefficientwise Hankel total positivity in the polynomial variable by a continuant comparison criterion. We also determine leading continuants, Hankel determinants, and extreme coefficients of arbitrary Hankel minors. The second deformation uses Askey--Wilson basis products and yields a basic-hypergeometric Narayana kernel. We give two independent moment evaluations and prove that its row polynomials have simple negative zeros and are $\gamma$-positive after palindromic normalization. An Askey--Wilson integral with base $q^2$ gives a continuous-parameter extension and a moment proof of the Krattenthaler--Wachs super $q$-Narayana expansion, including its integrality. An ordinary-power expansion also proves Pan's Touchard identity. For fixed $0 <1$ and $\theta>-1$, we prove total positivity of the kernel triangle by a Jackson $q$-Bessel--Edre
items.title_zh: Narayana 多项式的两个 q-变形：Rogers 矩、Hankel 正性和 q-Narayana 核
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究 $B$ 型和 $A$ 型 Narayana 多项式之间连续插值的两个 $q$-变形，两者都是由连续 $q$-超球面 (Rogers) 泛函构造而成。第一个由普通幂的仿射矩组成。对于固定的 $0 <1$ 和 $-1<\beta<1$，我们通过连续比较标准证明多项式变量中的系数 Hankel 总正性。我们还确定主导连续项、汉克尔行列式以及任意汉克尔次要项的极值系数。第二次变形使用 Askey--Wilson 基积并产生基本超几何 Narayana 核。我们给出了两个独立的矩评估，并证明其行多项式具有简单的负零点，并且在回文归一化后为 $\gamma$-正值。以 $q^2$ 为底的 Askey--Wilson 积分给出了连续参数扩展和 Krattenthaler--Wachs 超级 $q$-Narayana 扩展的矩证明，包括其完整性。普通功率的扩展也证明了潘的 Touchard 身份。对于固定的 $0 <1$ 和 $\theta>-1$，我们通过 Jackson $q$-Bessel--Edre 证明了核三角形的总正性

items.title: Low-degree filtrations in ordinary and Lagrangian Grassmannian cohomology
items.excerpt: We prove the Hilbert-series formulas conjectured by Reiner--Tudose and by the Polymath Jr. Grassmannian group for the subalgebras of ordinary and Lagrangian Grassmannian cohomology generated in bounded degree. We determine the finite coefficient images underlying the proofs, together with the kernels of the coefficient and cancellation maps. We also construct bases adapted to the auxiliary ideal filtrations and identify the cancellation layers, as modules, with shifts of finite complete-intersection algebras. First-order deformations give the derivative inclusions needed to recover the filtration increments. We disprove the two ordinary basis conjectures of the Polymath group. For every $r\ge 2$, the span of each prescribed family has codimension one in weight $3r+2$ of $H^{2*}(\operatorname{Gr}(2,3r+1);\mathbb Q)$; replacing one index gives a basis in each of these components. More generally, each prescribed two-row family has codimension at most one in every weight. Weights are half the cohomological degrees, and all coefficients are rational.
items.title_zh: 普通和拉格朗日格拉斯曼上同调中的低度过滤
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 Reiner-Tudose 和 Polymath Jr. Grassmannian 群针对有界生成的普通和拉格朗日格拉斯曼上同调的子代数所猜想的希尔伯特级数公式。我们确定证明背后的有限系数图像，以及系数和取消图的内核。我们还构建了适应辅助理想过滤的基础，并将消除层识别为模块，并具有有限完全相交代数的移位。一阶变形给出恢复过滤增量所需的衍生夹杂物。我们反驳了博学者群的两个普通基础猜想。对于每个$r\ge 2$，每个指定族的跨度的权重为$3r+2$，其余维为$H^{2*}(\operatorname{Gr}(2,3r+1);\mathbb Q)$;替换一个索引为每个组件提供了基础。更一般地，每个规定的两行族在每个重量中最多具有一个余尺寸。权重是上同调度的一半，并且所有系数都是有理数。

items.title: From Wheel to Jahangir graphs: spectra and energy under structured edge deletion
items.excerpt: The energy of a graph, introduced by Gutman, is defined as the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix. In this work we study how the energy of the Wheel graph $W_n$ changes when a specific set of spokes is removed. The resulting graphs are precisely the Jahangir graphs $J_{m,n}$, where m divides n, and which may also be viewed as the Cycle graph $C_n$ together with an additional vertex adjacent to certain vertices of $C_n$ in a cyclic pattern. We determine the spectra of $J_{2,n}$, $J_{4,n}$, and $J_{6,n}$ by exploiting a factorization of their characteristic polynomials arising from equitable partitions. This yields explicit closed formulas for their energies. Moreover, under certain conditions, we establish the following monotonicity chain: \[\mathcal{E}(C_n) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{6,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{4,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{2,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(W_n).\]
items.authors: Diego Bravo, Florencia Cubr\'ia, Annabella Zapattini
items.excerpt_zh: 古特曼提出的图的能量被定义为其邻接矩阵的特征值的绝对值之和。在这项工作中，我们研究了当一组特定的辐条被移除时，轮图 $W_n$ 的能量如何变化。生成的图正是 Jahangir 图 $J_{m,n}$，其中 m 除 n，并且也可以将其视为循环图 $C_n$ 以及循环模式中与 $C_n$ 的某些顶点相邻的附加顶点。我们通过利用公平划分产生的特征多项式的因式分解来确定 $J_{2,n}$、$J_{4,n}$ 和 $J_{6,n}$ 的谱。这产生了它们能量的显式封闭公式。此外，在一定条件下，我们建立以下单调性链： \[\mathcal{E}(C_n) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{6,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{4,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{2,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(W_n).\]
items.title_zh: 从 Wheel 到 Jahangir 图：结构化边缘删除下的光谱和能量

items.title: Tree-independence number VIII. 3PC-free graphs have logarithmic tree-independence number
items.excerpt: A three-path-configuration is a graph consisting of three pairwise internally vertex-disjoint paths, the union of every two of which is an induced cycle of length at least four. A graph is 3PC-free if no induced subgraph of it is a three-path-configuration. We show that 3PC-free graphs have logarithmic tree-independence number, which is asymptotically best possible.
items.authors: Maria Chudnovsky, Julien Codsi, Ajaykrishnan E S, Daniel Lokshtanov, Ilya Maier
items.title_zh: 树独立数VIII。 3PC-free 图具有对数树独立数
items.excerpt_zh: 三路径配置是由三个成对内部顶点不相交路径组成的图，其中每两个路径的并集是长度至少为四的诱导循环。如果一个图没有诱导子图是三路径配置，则该图是无 3PC 的。我们证明无 3PC 图具有对数树独立数，这是渐近最好的。

items.title: A sporadic simplicial arrangement of $51$ lines
items.excerpt: We construct a sporadic simplicial arrangement of $51$ lines in the real projective plane. It is obtained from the icosahedral arrangement $\mathcal{A}(21,2)$ by adjoining the $30$ images of the line $y+\sqrt{\varphi}\,z=0$ under the rotation group of the icosahedron, where $\varphi=(1+\sqrt5)/2$. Its intersection multiplicities are $t_2=120$, $t_3=190$, $t_5=36$, and $t_6=15$, with all other $t_r$ zero. These counts give equality in Melchior's inequality and hence prove simpliciality. The arrangement is irreducible, belongs to neither of the two known infinite families of irreducible simplicial arrangements, and is not supersolvable. It therefore disproves the $37$-line bound for sporadic arrangements conjectured by Cuntz and M\"ucksch. We give explicit coordinates, a finite incidence certificate, a geometric explanation of the parameter $\sqrt{\varphi}$, and a standalone exact-arithmetic verifier.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在真实射影平面上构建了 51 美元线的零星单纯排列。它是通过在二十面体旋转群下邻接线 $y+\sqrt{\varphi}\,z=0$ 的 $30$ 图像，从二十面体排列 $\mathcal{A}(21,2)$ 获得的，其中 $\varphi=(1+\sqrt5)/2$。其交集重数为 $t_2=120$、$t_3=190$、$t_5=36$ 和 $t_6=15$，所有其他 $t_r$ 为零。这些计数给出了梅尔基奥尔不等式中的等式，从而证明了简单性。该排列是不可约的，不属于两个已知的不可约单纯排列的无限族中的任何一个，并且不是超可解的。因此，它反驳了 Cuntz 和 M\"ucksch 猜想的零星排列的 $37$ 线界限。我们给出了明确的坐标、有限重合证明、参数 $\sqrt{\varphi}$ 的几何解释，以及一个独立的精确算术验证器。
items.title_zh: $51$ 行的零星简单排列

items.title: The domination number of the $k$-token graph of the complete bipartite graph $K_{m,n}$
items.excerpt: This paper is about token graphs and domination number. Let $G=(X,E)$ denote an undirected graph that is connected, with no loops or multiple edges, vertex set $X$, and edge set $E$. Pick a positive integer $k\leq \vert X\vert$. The $k$-token graph of $G$, denoted by $F_k(G)$, is defined as follows. The vertex set $\mathcal{X}$ consists of all $k$-subsets of $X$. Two vertices $x,y\in \mathcal{X}$ are adjacent whenever the symmetric difference of $x$ and $y$ consists of two vertices that form an edge in $E$. In this paper, we compute the exact value for the domination number of $F_2(K_{m,n})$ where $K_{m,n}$ is the complete bipartite graph with parameters $m,n$. We present some bounds for the domination number of $F_k(K_{m,n})$ when $k\geq 3$.
items.authors: Nathaniel Chinman, Antonio Cortijo, Beatrice Pedroni, Ian Seong, Lucy Stenger
items.excerpt_zh: 本文是关于令牌图和支配数的。设 $G=(X,E)$ 表示无向连通图，无环或多边，顶点集 $X$ 和边集 $E$。选择一个正整数 $k\leq \vert X\vert$。 $G$ 的 $k$ 代币图，用 $F_k(G)$ 表示，定义如下。顶点集 $\mathcal{X}$ 由 $X$ 的所有 $k$ 个子集组成。当 $x$ 和 $y$ 的对称差由在 $E$ 中形成边的两个顶点组成时，两个顶点 $x,y\in \mathcal{X}$ 是相邻的。在本文中，我们计算 $F_2(K_{m,n})$ 支配数的精确值，其中 $K_{m,n}$ 是带有参数 $m,n$ 的完整二部图。当 $k\geq 3$ 时，我们给出了 $F_k(K_{m,n})$ 的支配数的一些界限。
items.title_zh: 完全二分图$K_{m,n}$的$k$-token图的支配数

items.title: On the Number of Iterations in a Kruskal-Type Process
items.excerpt: Motivated by the Kruskal counting procedure, this paper investigates a combinatorial elimination process defined on a deck consisting of $m$ copies of each value $1,2,\ldots,n$. Starting from an arbitrary arrangement of the $mn$ cards, the process repeatedly removes a number of consecutive cards equal to the value of the first remaining card. This generates a sequence of elimination steps whose length determines $T$, representing the total number of iterations required to exhaust the deck. The main objective of this paper is to analyze an upper bound $\sigma(m,n)$ for $T$, valid for every initial configuration of the deck, and to show that this bound is attained by a specific configuration.
items.title_zh: 关于克鲁斯卡尔型过程中的迭代次数
items.excerpt_zh: 受 Kruskal 计数过程的启发，本文研究了在由每个值 $1,2,\ldots,n$ 的 $m$ 个副本组成的牌组上定义的组合消除过程。从$mn$张牌的任意排列开始，该过程重复地移除与第一张剩余牌的值相等的连续牌。这会生成一系列消除步骤，其长度决定$T$，表示耗尽牌组所需的迭代总数。本文的主要目标是分析 $T$ 的上限 $\sigma(m,n)$，该上限对于牌组的每个初始配置都有效，并表明该上限是通过特定配置实现的。

items.title: Closedness of bounded strength and partition rank loci
items.excerpt: We show the existence of a quartic form of strength $3$ in the closure of the strength at most $2$ locus, answering a question of Ballico--Bik--Oneto--Ventura in the negative. In the analogous setting of partition rank as introduced by Naslund, we further show that the locus of tensors of partition rank at most $2$ is closed, but the locus of tensors of partition rank at most $3$ is not. Together with a suspension lemma, this answers for all $r$ whether the locus of forms/tensors of strength/partition rank at most $r$ is Zariski-closed.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了在强度至多 $2$ 轨迹的闭合中存在强度 $3$ 的四次形式，否定地回答了 Ballico--Bik--Oneto--Ventura 的问题。在Naslund介绍的类似划分秩的设置中，我们进一步证明划分秩至多$2$的张量轨迹是封闭的，但划分秩至多$3$的张量轨迹不是封闭的。与悬置引理一起，这回答了所有 $r$ 的强度/分区等级的形式/张量的轨迹是否最多 $r$ 是 Zariski 封闭的。
items.title_zh: 有界强度和分区等级位点的封闭性

items.title: The Logarithmic A-Discriminant
items.excerpt: We extend the GKZ theory of discriminants to the setting of Euler integrals where both coefficients and exponents are variables. The integrand is the likelihood function of a toric model in algebraic statistics, whose number of critical points is the volume of the Newton polytope. Our logarithmic A-discriminant vanishes when two critical points come together. This discriminant is a hypersurface, parametrized by the logarithmic Horn uniformization. Hurwitz forms of toric varieties yield a degree formula, and a description of leading coefficients. We emphasize applications and computations.
items.authors: Madeleine Goertz, Bernd Sturmfels, Simon Telen
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将判别式的 GKZ 理论扩展到欧拉积分的设置，其中系数和指数都是变量。被积函数是代数统计中环面模型的似然函数，其临界点的数量是牛顿多胞体的体积。当两个临界点聚集在一起时，我们的对数 A 判别式就会消失。该判别式是一个超曲面，由对数 Horn 均匀化参数化。复曲面簇的 Hurwitz 形式产生度数公式以及首项系数的描述。我们强调应用和计算。
items.title_zh: 对数 A 判别式

items.title: Moduli spaces of logarithmic connections associated with difference Painlev\'e equations of type $E^{(1)}_n$
items.excerpt: In this paper, we provide an explicit correspondence between moduli spaces of parabolic logarithmic connections on the projective line with spectral type $(2^2,1^4,1^4)$ and $(3^2, 2^3, 1^6)$, and the spaces of initial conditions for difference Painlev\'e equations with symmetry of type $E^{(1)}_7$ and $E^{(1)}_8$, respectively. Furthermore, we realize the extended affine Weyl group symmetries of the space of initial conditions in terms of connections.
items.title_zh: 与 $E^{(1)}_n$ 类型的差分 Painlev\'e 方程相关的对数连接模空间
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们提供了谱类型为 $(2^2,1^4,1^4)$ 和 $(3^2, 2^3, 1^6)$ 的射影线上抛物对数连接的模空间与具有 $E^{(1)}_7$ 和 $E^{(1)}_8$ 对称性的差分 Painlev\'e 方程的初始条件空间之间的显式对应。此外，我们在连接方面实现了初始条件空间的扩展仿射Weyl群对称性。

items.title: Derived categories of threefolds near the Noether line
items.excerpt: We show that derived categories of canonical stacks associated to general threefolds in the principal component of the moduli space of canonical threefolds on the refined Noether line are semiorthogonally indecomposable. First we generalize a criterion of Kawatani-Okawa for the indecomposability of derived categories of surfaces of general type to higher-dimensional varieties and stacks. And then we generalize a construction of Kobayashi and Hu-Zhang and a classification result of Coughlan-Pignatelli to the second and third Noether lines to show that our criterion applies to these canonical stacks.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，与精化诺特线上的正则三重模空间主成分中的一般三重相关的正则堆栈的派生类别是半正交不可分解的。首先，我们将一般类型表面的派生类别不可分解性的 Kawatani-Okawa 准则推广到更高维的种类和堆栈。然后我们将 Kobayashi 和 Hu-Zhang 的构造以及 Coughlan-Pignatelli 的分类结果推广到第二条和第三条 Noether 线，以表明我们的准则适用于这些规范堆栈。
items.title_zh: 诺特线附近三重的派生范畴

items.title: Germwise singular Fourier--Mukai partnerships
items.excerpt: We study how local behavior on the base controls whether integral transforms induce fully faithful functors or equivalences between singularity categories of proper flat families. By working with \'{e}tale germs, we show (under mild hypotheses) that the loci where this happens are open and are compatible with \'{e}tale base change. Moreover, we give examples, exhibit an autoequivalence of the singularity category which detects regularity of the base, and compute these loci for arithmetic families.
items.title_zh: Germwise 奇异傅里叶--Mukai 合作伙伴关系
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究基础上的局部行为如何控制积分变换是否诱导完全忠实的函子或真平坦族的奇点类别之间的等价性。通过对“故事”细菌的研究，我们表明（在温和的假设下）发生这种情况的基因座是开放的，并且与“故事”碱基变化兼容。此外，我们给出了例子，展示了检测基数规律性的奇点类别的自等价性，并计算算术族的这些轨迹。

items.title: Lax descent and foliated Verdier duality
items.excerpt: Higher categorical methods allow us to view recollements as lax descent data and build a corresponding descent theory governed by an $\infty$-bicategorical theory of limits. We demonstrate some concrete innovations brought along by these new techniques in the classical context of constructible and perverse sheaves on stratified spaces. Our first application uses partially (op)lax descent to recover the famous result of Beilinson telling us how to glue perverse sheaves in terms of vanishing and nearby cycles. The remainder of the article is concerened with establishing a uniform view on a series of classification results for perverse sheaves culminating in recent work of Kapranov-Schechtman. Namely, we use lax descent to establish a ``foliated'' variant of Verdier duality which, informally speaking, identifies the derived constructible category of a suitably foliated space with sections of a categorical cosheaf on the leaf space whose stalks are the categories of sheaves along the leaves. Again, this is obtained as an application of lax descent, and seems to provide a reasonable framework to formalize the idea of ``mixed sheaf-cosheaf
items.authors: Tobias Dyckerhoff, Till Heine, Simon Schneider, Kostiantyn Tolmachov
items.title_zh: 宽松的血统和叶状韦尔迪尔二元性
items.excerpt_zh: 更高的分类方法允许我们将 recollements 视为宽松的下降数据，并建立一个由 $\infty$-双分类极限理论控制的相应下降理论。我们展示了这些新技术在分层空间上可构造和反常滑轮的经典背景下带来的一些具体创新。我们的第一个应用程序使用部分（op）松弛下降来恢复 Beilinson 的著名结果，告诉我们如何根据消失和附近周期粘合反常滑轮。本文的其余部分涉及对反常滑轮的一系列分类结果建立统一的观点，这些结果在 Kapranov-Schechtman 最近的工作中达到了顶峰。也就是说，我们使用松散下降来建立 Verdier 对偶性的“叶状”变体，非正式地讲，它标识了适当叶状空间的派生可构造类别，其中叶空间上有分类余束的部分，其茎是沿叶的滑轮的类别。同样，这是作为松散血统的应用而获得的，并且似乎提供了一个合理的框架来形式化“混合束-余束”的想法

items.title: On the gap of thresholds
items.excerpt: We propose an algorithm to compute the gap numbers of log canonical thresholds, anticanonical thresholds, and $\mathbb{R}$-complementary thresholds for surface pairs with a given rational hyperstandard coefficient set. As an example, we compute these gap numbers for a special hyperstandard set that appears in the effective boundedness of $n$-complements for surface pairs.
items.title_zh: 关于门槛的差距
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种算法来计算具有给定理性超标准系数集的表面对的对数规范阈值、反规范阈值和 $\mathbb{R}$-互补阈值的间隙数。作为一个例子，我们为一个特殊的超标准集计算这些间隙数，该超标准集出现在表面对的 $n$-补集的有效有界性中。

items.title: The recent counterexamples to the Eisenbud-Schreyer-Weyman Ulrich problem (2003) and to Hochster's small Cohen-Macaulay conjecture (1973): a survey, with a generalization to arbitrary dimension
items.excerpt: In September 2026 four preprints and an AI-generated manuscript moved one numerical obstruction from projective geometry to local algebra. For a smooth complex projective surface $Y$ with an ample, globally generated divisor $H$ such that $H^2<\sigma(Y)$, the signature, one obtains in turn: no Ulrich bundles when $H$ is very ample (Anghel, arXiv:2609.02718; extended to every dimension by Lopez, arXiv:2609.06678), answering negatively the Eisenbud-Schreyer-Weyman question of 2003 for sheaves supported on the whole variety; no arithmetically Cohen-Macaulay bundles, i.e. section rings without graded maximal Cohen-Macaulay modules in characteristic zero (Anghel, arXiv:2609.15589); and complete local domains without small Cohen-Macaulay modules, counterexamples to Hochster's 1973 conjecture, if $K_Y\equiv4H$ (Chen, arXiv:2609.24142, proposed) or $\sigma>2H^2$ (OpenAI, released 6 October). We recall the definitions and main statements, and add two things. First, through a finite projection to $\mathbb P^2$ and an identity already present in the OpenAI manuscript, the three obstructions become one variance identity; for surfaces this explain
items.excerpt_zh: 2026 年 9 月，四份预印本和一份人工智能生成的手稿将一个数值障碍从射影几何转移到了局部代数。对于具有充足的全局生成除数 $H$ 的平滑复射影曲面 $Y$，使得 $H^2<\sigma(Y)$ 签名，依次获得：当 $H$ 非常充足时，没有乌尔里希束（Anghel，arXiv：2609.02718；由 Lopez 扩展到每个维度，arXiv：2609.06678），否定回答2003 年 Eisenbud-Schreyer-Weyman 问题，针对全品种支撑的滑轮；没有算术上的 Cohen-Macaulay 丛，即特征零中没有分级最大 Cohen-Macaulay 模的截面环 (Anghel, arXiv:2609.15589)；并在没有小 Cohen-Macaulay 模块的情况下完成本地域，这是 Hochster 1973 猜想的反例，如果 $K_Y\equiv4H$ （Chen，arXiv:2609.24142，提议）或 $\sigma>2H^2$ （OpenAI，10 月 6 日发布）。我们回顾一下定义和主要陈述，并添加两件事。首先，通过对 $\mathbb P^2$ 的有限投影和 OpenAI 手稿中已经存在的恒等式，这三个障碍物成为一个方差恒等式；对于表面这解释
items.title_zh: 最近的 Eisenbud-Schreyer-Weyman Ulrich 问题 (2003) 和 Hochster 的小 Cohen-Macaulay 猜想 (1973) 的反例：一项调查，概括为任意维度

items.title: Percolation on Bidirected Graphs
items.excerpt: We study bidirected percolation on an undirected graph $G$: each edge is replaced by two oppositely directed edges, each of which is open independently with probability $p$. Two vertices are strongly connected if they are mutually reachable by open directed paths. Let $p_\mathrm{sc}$ denote the threshold for the existence of an infinite strongly connected cluster, and let $p_c$ denote the usual Bernoulli percolation threshold on $G$. On every transitive amenable graph, we prove that $p_\mathrm{sc}=p_c$. In contrast, sufficiently spread-out modifications of every transitive non-amenable graph satisfy $p_\mathrm{sc}>p_c$. We also show that, on $\mathbb Z^d$ with $d\ge11$, the expected size of the strongly connected cluster is finite at $p=p_\mathrm{sc}$.
items.authors: Yucheng Liu, Leonardo T. Rolla, Yuliang Shi
items.title_zh: 双向图上的渗滤
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究无向图 $G$ 上的双向渗流：每条边都被两条方向相反的边替换，每条边以 $p$ 的概率独立开放。如果两个顶点可以通过开放有向路径相互到达，则它们是强连接的。令$p_\mathrm{sc}$ 表示存在无限强连接簇的阈值，并令$p_c$ 表示$G$ 上通常的伯努利渗流阈值。在每个传递性好的图上，我们证明 $p_\mathrm{sc}=p_c$。相反，每个传递性不服从图的充分展开修改满足 $p_\mathrm{sc}>p_c$。我们还表明，在 $\mathbb Z^d$ 和 $d\ge11$ 上，强连接簇的预期大小在 $p=p_\mathrm{sc}$ 处是有限的。

items.title: Kinetic Mean-Field Planning via Schr\"odinger Bridges: Existence, Penalization, and Consistency Bounds
items.excerpt: We study a mean-field planning problem for a swarm of interacting, non-cooperative agents whose dynamics are stochastic and kinetic. The noise acts on the velocity only, and the interaction (of Cucker-Smale type for instance) enters through the drift. For a fixed flow, the problem reduces to a Schr\"odinger bridge problem, and we first prove the existence of an equilibrium by a Schauder fixed-point argument. Then we replace the hard terminal constraint by a penalty function and show that equilibria of the penalized problems converge, along subsequences, to an equilibrium of the original problem. Since equilibria are not unique in general, we instead quantify the consistency error, which measures how far an equilibrium of the penalized problem is from being an equilibrium of the original one. The rate is of order $n^{-1/2}$ for the relative-entropy penalty. The proof relies on the quantitative stability of entropic optimal transport and on a pointwise linear growth bound on the score of the degenerate reference dynamics, which is of independent interest.
items.authors: Erhan Bayraktar, Zhiyan Ding, Hiroaki Horikawa
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了一群相互作用的、非合作的智能体的平均场规划问题，这些智能体的动力学是随机的和动态的。噪声仅作用于速度，相互作用（例如 Cucker-Smale 类型）通过漂移进入。对于固定流，问题简化为 Schr\"odinger 桥问题，我们首先通过 Schauder 定点论证证明均衡的存在。然后，我们用惩罚函数替换硬终端约束，并表明惩罚问题的均衡沿着子序列收敛到原始问题的均衡。由于均衡通常不是唯一的，因此我们量化一致性误差，该误差衡量惩罚问题的均衡与原始问题的均衡的距离一. 相对熵惩罚的速率为 $n^{-1/2}$ ，该证明依赖于熵最优传输的定量稳定性以及简并参考动力学分数的逐点线性增长界限，这是独立的。
items.title_zh: 通过薛定谔桥的动态平均场规划：存在性、惩罚性和一致性界限

items.title: Functional limit theorems for self-interacting random walks
items.excerpt: We consider a wide class of nearest neighbor self-interacting random walks on $\mathbb{Z}$ and show that, under mild conditions, their scaling limits at the process level can be uniquely identified and constructed directly from the augmented joint Ray-Knight theorem for their local times, i.e., the joint convergence of rescaled local time ``curves'' of the walks stopped at certain stopping times together with the merge and absorption times of these ``curves'' to a concatenation of coalescing reflected-absorbed diffusions and their merge and absorption times. We apply our results to polynomially self-repelling walks introduced and studied in the mid-90s by B. T\'oth, and to ``true'' self-avoiding walks with bond repulsion. The first application solves a problem that has been open since T\'oth's work: it gives a construction and first properties of a new family of processes, polynomially self-repelling motions, as scaling limits of polynomially self-repelling walks. These processes were simultaneously and independently constructed from flows of correlated powers of Bessel processes by Y. Yu. The second application strengthens an earlier
items.authors: Elena Kosygina, Laure Mar\^ech\'e, Thomas Mountford, Jonathon Peterson
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑了 $\mathbb{Z}$ 上的一类最近邻自交互随机游走，并表明，在温和的条件下，它们在过程级别的缩放限制可以唯一地识别，并直接根据其本地时间的增强联合雷奈特定理构建，即，在某些停止时间停止的游走的重新缩放的本地时间“曲线”的联合收敛以及这些“曲线”的合并和吸收时间到串联合并反射吸收扩散及其合并和吸收时间。我们将我们的结果应用于 B. T'oth 在 90 年代中期引入和研究的多项式自排斥游走，以及具有键排斥的“真正”自回避游走。第一个应用解决了自 Toth 的工作以来一直悬而未决的问题：它给出了一系列新过程的构造和第一个属性，即多项式自排斥运动，作为多项式自排斥游走的缩放极限。这些过程是由 Y. Yu 根据贝塞尔过程的相关幂流同时且独立地构建的。第二个应用加强了早期的应用
items.title_zh: 自相互作用随机游走的函数极限定理

items.title: Free energy and fluctuations of generalized bipartite Sherrington-Kirkpatrick models and generalized Hopfield models
items.excerpt: We consider the free energy of generalized bipartite Sherrington-Kirkpatrick models in the high temperature regime, with one spin normalized and the other either normalized or i.i.d. We derive a unified formula for the limiting free energy in both settings. We also prove that the fluctuations of the free energy converge to a Gaussian distribution under mild assumptions. The proof is based on a bipartite multigraph expansion, which also gives free energy results for generalized Hopfield models and log likelihood ratio of spiked rectangular models.
items.title_zh: 广义二部 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型和广义 Hopfield 模型的自由能和涨落
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑高温状态下广义二部谢林顿-柯克帕特里克模型的自由能，其中一个自旋标准化，另一个自旋标准化或独立同分布。我们推导出两种情况下限制自由能的统一公式。我们还证明了在温和的假设下自由能的波动收敛于高斯分布。该证明基于二分多重图展开，它还给出了广义 Hopfield 模型的自由能结果和尖峰矩形模型的对数似然比。

items.title: Refined Cram\'er-type moderate deviations by Stein's method under dependence
items.excerpt: In this paper, we establish refined Cram\'er-type moderate deviations for dependent random variables at any fixed order $m\geq3$. Combining higher-order Stein identities with exponential tilting, we obtain cumulant-corrected tail approximations with explicit error bounds for boundedly supported kernels. Our main application gives a fourth-order expansion under bounded local dependence, reaching an $O(n^{3/10})$ deviation range under standard normalization with fixed dependence parameters. It improves on previous work in both deviation range and applicability, and also covers bounded $m$-dependent sequences without an independent-base representation. Further applications to the generalized combinatorial central limit theorem and the Curie-Weiss model also extend some earlier results under permutation and mean-field dependence.
items.authors: Hui-Lin Liu, Song-Hao Liu, Dawei Lu
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们为任意固定阶 $m\geq3$ 的因随机变量建立了精炼的 Cram\'er 型适度偏差。将高阶 Stein 恒等式与指数倾斜相结合，我们获得了累积量校正的尾部近似，并为有界支持的内核提供了显式误差界限。我们的主要应用程序给出了有界局部相关性下的四阶展开，在具有固定相关性参数的标准归一化下达到 $O(n^{3/10})$ 偏差范围。它在偏差范围和适用性方面改进了以前的工作，并且还涵盖了有界 $m$ 依赖序列，而没有独立碱基表示。对广义组合中心极限定理和居里-魏斯模型的进一步应用也扩展了排列和平均场依赖性下的一些早期结果。
items.title_zh: 相关性下斯坦因法精化的克拉姆型适度偏差

items.title: Conditional Reflected Backward Stochastic Differential Equations
items.excerpt: In this paper, we introduce a new type of reflected backward stochastic differential equations (reflected BSDEs), referred to as conditional reflected BSDEs, in which the conditional expectation of the Y-component of the solution with respect to a given sub-{\sigma}-algebra appears in both the generator and the obstacle. Under a Lipschitz condition on the loss function with sufficiently small Lipschitz constants, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the solution for both the case of Lipschitz generator and the case of quadratic generator, bounded terminal value and bounded loss function. When the generator has quadratic growth and the terminal value and loss function are unbounded, we establish the uniqueness with the help of {\theta}-method. Finally, a penalization approximation scheme holds under an additional monotonicity structure imposed on the generator and the loss function, without any restriction on the Lipschitz constants of the loss function.
items.title_zh: 条件反射后向随机微分方程
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们引入了一种新型反射后向随机微分方程（反射BSDE），称为条件反射BSDE，其中解的Y分量相对于给定子代数的条件期望同时出现在生成器和障碍物中。在具有足够小的 Lipschitz 常数的损失函数的 Lipschitz 条件下，我们建立了 Lipschitz 生成器的情况和二次生成器的情况、有界终值和有界损失函数解的存在性和唯一性。当生成器具有二次增长且终值和损失函数无界时，我们借助{\theta}方法来建立唯一性。最后，惩罚近似方案在施加于生成器和损失函数的附加单调性结构下成立，而对损失函数的 Lipschitz 常数没有任何限制。

items.title: Normal approximation, moderate and large deviations for the elephant random walk with stops and random step sizes
items.excerpt: We study the elephant random walk with stops and independent positive random step sizes. Building on fixed-movement estimates, we obtain quantitative normal approximations for an empirically normalized statistic by controlling its random denominator and the independent movement clock. A permutation comparison preserves the diffusive Kolmogorov rate, while variance matching permits third-order Zolotarev estimates. We also derive self-normalized Cram\'er-type moderate deviations. For regularly varying step-size tails, we obtain uniform precise large deviations and establish the necessity of the diffusive and critical threshold orders. Further applications of the clock representation yield large deviation principles for Weibull-type and light-tailed step sizes, and a precise light-tailed expansion in the balanced case.
items.title_zh: 带停止点和随机步长的大象随机游走的正态近似、中度和大偏差
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究带有停止点和独立正随机步长的大象随机游走。基于固定运动估计，我们通过控制其随机分母和独立运动时钟来获得经验归一化统计量的定量正态近似。排列比较保留了扩散柯尔莫哥洛夫率，而方差匹配允许三阶佐洛塔列夫估计。我们还推导了自我归一化的克拉姆型适度偏差。对于规则变化的步长尾部，我们获得均匀的精确大偏差，并建立扩散和临界阈值阶数的必要性。时钟表示的进一步应用产生了威布尔型和轻尾步长的大偏差原理，以及平衡情况下的精确轻尾展开。

items.title: Normal approximation and self-normalized moderate deviations for the minimal random walk with random step sizes
items.excerpt: We study the minimal random walk with independent positive random step sizes. By separating the movement count from the centered step-size noise, we obtain normal approximations and self-normalized Cram\'er-type moderate deviations under finite-moment assumptions. For the noise, conditioning on the movement count yields Kolmogorov, Wasserstein and Zolotarev bounds. A polynomial moderate-deviation range holds when a recalled stop can lead to movement. At the boundary where this probability is zero, we obtain a logarithmic range and construct a bounded nonsymmetric example excluding a general polynomial range. For the full position, a weighted martingale representation gives limit laws in the different regimes, nonuniform normal approximations and moment-distance bounds without logarithmic losses. Variance concentration also yields self-normalized moderate deviations in the diffusive and critical regimes.
items.title_zh: 具有随机步长的最小随机游走的正态近似和自归一化适度偏差
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究具有独立正随机步长的最小随机游走。通过将运动计数与中心步长噪声分开，我们在有限矩假设下获得了正态近似和自归一化的 Cram'er 型适度偏差。对于噪声，对运动计数进行调节会产生 Kolmogorov、Wasserstein 和 Zolotarev 界限。当召回的停止可以导致运动时，多项式中等偏差范围成立。在该概率为零的边界处，我们获得对数范围并构造一个排除一般多项式范围的有界非对称示例。对于完整头寸，加权鞅表示给出了不同状态下的极限定律、非均匀正态近似和矩距离界限，而没有对数损失。方差集中还会在扩散和临界状态中产生自归一化的适度偏差。

items.title: A Structure-Preserving Scheme for Computing the Gradient of the Eikonal Equation
items.excerpt: We propose a first-order, structure-preserving method for directly computing the normalized traveltime gradient of the eikonal equation in smooth first-arrival regions. The method combines analytical derivatives of spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) in a Godunov-type upwind discretization with spherical forward Euler (SFE) pseudo-time integration. This construction gives a tangent residual and keeps every iterate on $\mathbb{S}^2$ without projection or normalization. The SLERP discretization exactly preserves a family of curved orientation equilibria. Removing the background discretization bias improves absolute orientation accuracy near these equilibria, allowing a prescribed error tolerance to be reached on a coarser grid. We prove the equilibrium-preservation property and, separately, a smaller angular error for SFE than normalized Euler in a one-cell relaxation under the stated step-size condition. Two- and three-dimensional experiments examine convergence, geometric preservation, and computational cost. Comparisons with gradient recovery from scalar traveltimes show more accurate directions on the same grid in the curved medi
items.title_zh: 计算Eikonal方程梯度的保结构方案
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种一阶结构保持方法，用于直接计算平滑初至区域中程函方程的归一化走时梯度。该方法将 Godunov 型逆风离散化中的球面线性插值 (SLERP) 的解析导数与球面前向欧拉 (SFE) 伪时间积分相结合。这种结构给出了切线残差，并保持 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 上的每次迭代，无需投影或归一化。 SLERP 离散化准确地保留了一系列弯曲方向平衡。消除背景离散化偏差可提高这些平衡附近的绝对方向精度，从而允许在较粗糙的网格上达到规定的误差容限。我们证明了平衡保持特性，并且在规定的步长条件下，在单细胞松弛中，SFE 的角度误差比归一化欧拉更小。二维和三维实验检查收敛性、几何保留和计算成本。与标量走时梯度恢复的比较显示了弯曲介质中同一网格上更准确的方向

items.title: Deflation-Based Spectral Preconditioning for the Conjugate Gradient Method on Perturbed Systems
items.excerpt: We consider sequences of large symmetric positive-definite linear systems in which spectral information from a reference matrix $A$ is reused to accelerate the solution of a nearby system with perturbed matrix $A(t)=A+tE$, where $E$ is symmetric, $\|E\|_F=1$, and $t\geq0$ is the perturbation size. We compare deflated conjugate gradient (deflated CG) with preconditioned CG (PCG) equipped with a scaled spectral preconditioner constructed from the same spectral information of $A$. First, we derive an energy-norm error characterization of deflated CG. We then use perturbation analysis to show that, after one additional PCG iteration, the squared PCG error is bounded, up to terms of order $t^2$, by an explicit multiple of the squared deflated CG error. This result clarifies the role of the scaling parameter in the preconditioner. Experiments show that the scaled spectral preconditioner recovers much of the convergence improvement provided by deflation while requiring fewer products with $A(t)$.
items.authors: Youssef Diouane, Selime G\"urol, Oussama Mouhtal, Dominique Orban
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑大型对称正定线性系统的序列，其中参考矩阵 $A$ 中的谱信息被重用来加速具有扰动矩阵 $A(t)=A+tE$ 的附近系统的求解，其中 $E$ 是对称的，$\|E\|_F=1$，$t\geq0$ 是扰动大小。我们将紧缩共轭梯度（deflated CG）与配备了由 $A$ 的相同光谱信息构建的缩放光谱预处理器的预处理 CG (PCG) 进行比较。首先，我们推导出紧缩 CG 的能量范数误差特征。然后，我们使用扰动分析来表明，在进行一次额外的 PCG 迭代后，平方 PCG 误差的界限（最多为 $t^2$ 阶项）是平方紧缩 CG 误差的显式倍数。该结果阐明了缩放参数在预处理器中的作用。实验表明，缩放后的谱预处理器恢复了通货紧缩提供的大部分收敛性改进，同时需要更少的 $A(t)$ 产品。
items.title_zh: 摄动系统共轭梯度法的基于紧缩的谱预处理

items.title: Mixed finite element methods for a heat-assisted model of sedimentation
items.excerpt: A model for the consolidation-sedimentation process incorporating thermal effects is analysed. The model is motivated by novel applications to heat-assisted sedimentation of mineral suspensions. A system of convection-diffusion equations for the concentration and temperature are coupled to flow equations for the volume-average velocity and pressure. The model is supplemented with Dirichlet and mixed boundary conditions. A quasi-stationary approach of the system is analysed by means of a mixed variational formulation, where additional variables such as the pseudostress tensor and variables for the gradient of the temperature and concentration are introduced. The existence and uniqueness of the system is shown making use of the Babu{\v s}ka-Brezzi theory and Banach's fixed-point theorem, under hypotheses of smallness of the data and additional regularity on the solutions. A discrete formulation based on finite element spaces is proposed and analysed, and the existence of solutions is achieved thanks to Brouwer's fixed-point theorem. Additionally, C\'ea and a priori estimates are derived for the mixed formulation. Finally, numerical exam
items.excerpt_zh: 分析了包含热效应的固结沉积过程模型。该模型的灵感来自于矿物悬浮液热辅助沉降的新颖应用。浓度和温度的对流扩散方程组与体积平均速度和压力的流动方程耦合。该模型补充了狄利克雷和混合边界条件。通过混合变分公式来分析系统的准稳态方法，其中引入了伪应力张量以及温度和浓度梯度变量等附加变量。在数据较小和解具有附加规律性的假设下，利用 Babu{\v s}ka-Brezzi 理论和 Banach 不动点定理证明了系统的存在性和唯一性。提出并分析了基于有限元空间的离散公式，并根据布劳威尔不动点定理得到了解的存在性。此外，C'ea 和先验估计是针对混合公式得出的。最后是数值考试
items.title_zh: 热辅助沉积模型的混合有限元方法

items.title: A hybridization-derived interior penalty Nitsche method for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion
items.excerpt: We develop an interior penalty Nitsche finite element formulation for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion problems, which is derived from an interior-penalty stabilized Lagrange multiplier method. A distinctive feature of the derived method is that it simultaneously combines two popular stabilization strategies: (i) a boundary penalty mechanism similar to Nitsche's methods and (ii) an interior penalty mechanism as for Continuous Interior Penalty (CIP) methods. Furthermore, the normal component of the numerical flux is single-valued across the mesh skeleton and available in closed form. We establish the equivalence between the hybridized Lagrange multiplier formulation and its condensed Interior Penalty Nitsche (IPN) form, and we deliver the stability and convergence analysis of the latter. For sufficiently regular solutions, we establish energy-norm error estimates for the three symmetry variants. Under a piecewise elliptic regularity assumption on the adjoint problem, the $L^2$ estimate is optimal for the symmetric variant and exhibits a half-order loss for the incomplete and nonsymmetric variants; its constant may depend on the
items.title_zh: 异质和各向异性扩散的杂交衍生内罚 Nitsche 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们针对异质和各向异性扩散问题开发了内罚尼切有限元公式，该公式源自内罚稳定拉格朗日乘子法。派生方法的一个显着特征是它同时结合了两种流行的稳定策略：（i）类似于 Nitsche 方法的边界惩罚机制和（ii）与连续内部惩罚（CIP）方法类似的内部惩罚机制。此外，数值通量的法向分量在网格骨架上是单值的，并且以封闭形式提供。我们建立了混合拉格朗日乘子公式与其压缩的内罚尼采（IPN）形式之间的等价性，并给出了后者的稳定性和收敛性分析。对于足够规则的解决方案，我们为三个对称变体建立了能量范数误差估计。在伴随问题的分段椭圆正则性假设下，$L^2$ 估计对于对称变体是最优的，并且对于不完全和非对称变体表现出半阶损失；它的常数可能取决于

items.title: Order-Specified Quaternion CP Decomposition: Models, Algorithms, and Applications
items.excerpt: Tensor CP decomposition serves as a fundamental tool for representing multiway data. While quaternion tensors are well suited to modeling color visual data, extending CP decomposition to the quaternion domain is nontrivial due to the noncommutativity of quaternion multiplication. This paper develops an order-specified quaternion CP decomposition (OS-QCP) for third-order tensors, allowing all three factor matrices to be quaternion-valued and explicitly incorporating their multiplication order into the model. We show that different multiplication orders can yield different OS-QCP ranks for the same quaternion tensor, characterize the permutation and quaternion scaling indeterminacies, and establish a sufficient condition for essential uniqueness for any prescribed multiplication order. An explicit example further shows that OS-QCP rank can depend on the multiplication order even when the complex representation of the quaternion tensor admits an essentially unique CP decomposition. An alternating least-squares (ALS) algorithm is derived by expressing quaternion left and right multiplication as real linear operators, reducing each factor
items.authors: Jifei Miao, Niansheng Tang, Michael K. Ng, Juan Han, Kit Ian Kou
items.title_zh: 指定顺序的四元数 CP 分解：模型、算法和应用
items.excerpt_zh: 张量 CP 分解是表示多路数据的基本工具。虽然四元数张量非常适合对颜色视觉数据进行建模，但由于四元数乘法的非交换性，将 CP 分解扩展到四元数域并非易事。本文为三阶张量开发了一种指定阶数的四元数 CP 分解（OS-QCP），允许所有三个因子矩阵都为四元数值，并明确地将它们的乘法阶数合并到模型中。我们证明，不同的乘法阶可以对相同的四元数张量产生不同的 OS-QCP 等级，表征排列和四元数缩放不确定性，并为任何规定的乘法阶的基本唯一性建立充分条件。一个明确的例子进一步表明，即使四元数张量的复数表示允许本质上唯一的 CP 分解，OS-QCP 等级也可以取决于乘法顺序。通过将四元数左乘和右乘表示为实数线性算子，导出交替最小二乘 (ALS) 算法，减少每个因子

items.title: A high-order multi-scale method and its error analysis for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems in composite materials
items.excerpt: Significant spatial heterogeneity and nonlocal history-dependent attenuation jointly govern wave propagation in composite materials, making full-scale direct numerical simulation (DNS) computationally prohibitive. This study proposed a high-order multi-scale (HOMS) method for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems with highly oscillatory and discontinuous material coefficients. Using a multi-scale asymptotic expansion approach, the macroscopic homogenized equation, and first- and second-order correction terms are derived to construct the high-accuracy HOMS solution. Moreover, a local pointwise error analysis identifies the leading residual eliminated by this HOMS solution and validates its local physical balance preservation. Then, a global energy-norm error estimate establishes the $O(\varepsilon)$-order convergence rate for the HOMS solution. Subsequently, an efficient spatiotemporal multi-scale algorithm integrating the finite element and finite difference methods is designed, which employs a novel fully discrete $L2\text{-}1_{\sigma}$-Newmark scheme, and corresponding unconditional shifted-energy stability and explicit
items.authors: Gehao Wang, Hao Dong, Yufeng Nie, Junzhi Cui
items.title_zh: 复合材料非局部分数阻尼波问题的高阶多尺度方法及其误差分析
items.excerpt_zh: 显着的空间异质性和非局域历史相关的衰减共同控制着复合材料中的波传播，使得全面的直接数值模拟（DNS）在计算上难以实现。本研究提出了一种高阶多尺度（HOMS）方法，用于解决具有高振荡和不连续材料系数的非局部时间分数阻尼波问题。采用多尺度渐近展开方法，导出宏观均质方程以及一阶和二阶修正项，构建高精度 HOMS 解。此外，局部逐点误差分析识别了该 HOMS 解决方案消除的主要残差，并验证其局部物理平衡保持。然后，全局能量范数误差估计确定 HOMS 解的 $O(\varepsilon)$ 阶收敛率。随后，设计了一种集成有限元和有限差分方法的高效时空多尺度算法，该算法采用新颖的全离散$L2\text{-}1_{\sigma}$-Newmark格式，以及相应的无条件移位能量稳定性和显式

items.title: Approximate Matrix Multiplication through Joint Leverage Score Sampling
items.excerpt: In this paper, we investigate approximate matrix multiplication through random sampling. Specifically, we propose using a non-uniform sampling distribution constructed from the leverage scores of the two matrices, and characterize the associated approximation error in terms of the matrix spectral norm; which is well-known to better characterize the downstream error when the matrix product operator is applied to an input vector. We provide the probability error bounds for the proposed algorithm are also given, and discuss connections to data-oblivious approximate matrix multiplication, and graph sparsification algorithms.
items.authors: Neophytos Charalambides, Mert Pilanci, Alfred O. Hero III
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们通过随机采样研究近似矩阵乘法。具体来说，我们建议使用由两个矩阵的杠杆分数构建的非均匀采样分布，并根据矩阵谱范数来表征相关的近似误差；众所周知，当矩阵乘积运算符应用于输入向量时，可以更好地表征下游误差。我们还给出了所提出算法的概率误差界限，并讨论了与数据无关的近似矩阵乘法和图稀疏算法的联系。
items.title_zh: 通过联合杠杆分数采样近似矩阵乘法

items.title: General function bases moment models for suspended sediment with vertical profile of concentration
items.excerpt: We introduce a general hydrostatic shallow moment framework for suspended sediment transport with vertically varying horizontal velocity and concentration profiles. The formulation is constructed over arbitrary vertical functional bases that are numerically orthogonalised via the Gram-Schmidt algorithm. This approach allows the approximation spaces for the vertical profile to be adapted to the specific structure of each physical variable, where also the velocity and sediment concentration can be projected onto different functional spaces. To overcome the limitations due to the inherent oscillatory nature of global Legendre polynomials, we explore a specific continuous piecewise linear $\mathbb{P}_1$ finite-element basis. Furthermore, non-uniform vertical partitions are considered, enabling an enhanced representation of the vertical profiles in specific regions. Numerical experiments involving boundary layers and suspended sediment transport demonstrate that the proposed framework is accurate to reproduce the expected vertical profiles. The improvement is particularly significant for sediment concentration profiles with sharp vertical
items.authors: Celia Caballero-C\'ardenas, Jos\'e Garres-D\'iaz, Irene G\'omez-Bueno, Tom\'as Morales de Luna
items.title_zh: 具有垂直浓度分布的悬浮泥沙通用函数基矩模型
items.excerpt_zh: 我们介绍了一种通用的静水浅力矩框架，用于具有垂直变化的水平速度和浓度分布的悬浮沉积物输送。该公式是在任意垂直函数基上构建的，这些函数基通过 Gram-Schmidt 算法进行数值正交。这种方法允许垂直剖面的近似空间适应每个物理变量的特定结构，其中速度和沉积物浓度也可以投影到不同的功能空间上。为了克服全局勒让德多项式固有振荡性质带来的限制，我们探索了一种特定的连续分段线性 $\mathbb{P}_1$ 有限元基础。此外，还考虑了不均匀的垂直分区，从而增强了特定区域中垂直剖面的表示。涉及边界层和悬浮沉积物迁移的数值实验表明，所提出的框架能够准确地再现预期的垂直剖面。对于具有尖锐垂直线的泥沙浓度剖面，这种改善尤其显着。

items.title: Choice principles in countable partition models
items.excerpt: We study the countable partition model over a set of atoms of arbitrary uncountable cardinality $\kappa$. Its supports are partitions of the atoms into countably many blocks, and a permutation fixes a support when it preserves each block setwise. This model was proposed by Bruce and studied by Banerjee. We prove that dependent choice holds for every $\kappa$, although the filter of subgroups is not closed under countable intersections. Choice for well-orderable families holds exactly when $\kappa<\aleph_{\omega_1}$; when $\kappa\ge\aleph_{\omega_1}$, an $\omega_1$-indexed family witnesses its failure. The Hartogs and Lindenbaum numbers of the set of atoms are both $\omega_1$. The proofs use permutations matching blocks of equal cardinality and establish shift completeness of the filter. Together with Banerjee's failure of $\mathsf{DC}_{\omega_1}$, these results determine which dependent choice principles hold in the model.
items.title_zh: 可数划分模型的选择原则
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究一组任意不可数基数 $\kappa$ 原子上的可数划分模型。它的支持是将原子划分为可数个块，并且当按集合保留每个块时，排列会固定支持。该模型由Bruce提出，并由Banerjee研究。我们证明依赖选择对于每个 $\kappa$ 都成立，尽管子群的过滤器在可数交集下不是封闭的。当 $\kappa<\aleph_{\omega_1}$; 时，有序族的选择恰好成立；当$\kappa\ge\aleph_{\omega_1}$时，$\omega_1$索引的家族见证了它的失败。原子集的 Hartogs 数和 Lindenbaum 数均为 $\omega_1$。该证明使用排列匹配相同基数的块并建立过滤器的移位完整性。与 Banerjee 的 $\mathsf{DC}_{\omega_1}$ 失败一起，这些结果决定了模型中适用哪些依赖选择原则。

items.title: General Criterion for a Poset to Admit a Partition Into $\omega$-Chains
items.excerpt: Given a poset $P$ with no maximal element the question naturally arises of when $P$ can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. In this paper we give general criterion for when this can be done. We show that in the case when a poset with no maximal element is countable or a well-founded forest, then it can always be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. We then introduce the lifting property for posets with no maximal element and show that a poset can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains if and only if it has the lifting property.
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个没有最大元素的偏序集 $P$，自然会出现 $P$ 何时可以划分为 $\omega$ 链的问题。在本文中，我们给出了何时可以做到这一点的一般标准。我们证明，当没有最大元素的偏序集是可数的或有良好基础的森林时，它总是可以划分为$\omega$-链。然后我们引入没有最大元素的偏序集的提升性质，并证明当且仅当它具有提升性质时，偏序集可以划分为 $\omega$-链。
items.title_zh: 允许一个分区进入$\omega$-链的一般标准

items.title: On the gradient conjecture at infinity: Finite spherical length for gradient trajectories of definable potentials
items.excerpt: We prove that for every open $ U \subseteq \mathbb R^n $ the spherical projection of every gradient trajectory $\theta(t)$, $t \geq 0$, of a definable $C^1$-potential $F \colon U \to \mathbb R$ has finite length and, in particular, converges (directional convergence). In other words, every gradient trajectory of a definable $C^1$-potential has finite total angular motion. Here, definable means definable in an arbitrary o-minimal structure expanding the real field. Notably, the gradient trajectory in this result is an arbitrary solution of the gradient flow differential equation (whose solutions may not be unique) with no further assumptions: The gradient trajectory may be unbounded and diverge to infinity or it may be convergent. The established theorem therefore provides affirmative answers to both the gradient conjecture at infinity for definable potentials and the definable Thom gradient conjecture. We apply our theorem to the training of deep neural networks (DNNs) to conclude that, in the case of definable and continuously differentiable activation and loss functions, the spherical projection of the DNN training flow must alway
items.authors: Thang Do, Arnulf Jentzen, Benno Kuckuck
items.title_zh: 关于无穷远梯度猜想：可定义势梯度轨迹的有限球面长度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于每个开 $ U \subseteq \mathbb R^n $，可定义的 $C^1$-势 $F \colon U \to \mathbb R$ 的每个梯度轨迹 $\theta(t)$、$t \geq 0$ 的球面投影具有有限长度，特别是收敛（方向收敛）。换句话说，可定义的 $C^1$ 势的每个梯度轨迹都具有有限的总角运动。这里，可定义意味着可在扩展实域的任意o-最小结构中定义。值得注意的是，该结果中的梯度轨迹是梯度流微分方程的任意解（其解可能不是唯一的），没有进一步的假设：梯度轨迹可以是无界的并且发散至无穷大，也可以是收敛的。因此，所建立的定理为可定义势的无穷远梯度猜想和可定义 Thom 梯度猜想提供了肯定的答案。我们将定理应用于深度神经网络 (DNN) 的训练，得出结论：在可定义且连续可微的激活函数和损失函数的情况下，DNN 训练流的球形投影必须始终

items.title: Logic vs doctrines, a mirror symmetry
items.excerpt: This paper studies doctrines in categorical logic and their relations to fragments of geometric logic. After a brief account of the historical context for the notion of doctrine in categorical logic, we propose our working definition. We then show that there is a Galois connection between the poset of doctrines and the poset of fragments of geometric logic as defined in the framework of Kan injectivity in the 2-category of topoi, recently developed by the first and third authors. Concretely, the connection is realised by a general construction of syntactic categories and classifying topoi which encompasses all well-known examples in categorical logic. This yields a mirror symmetry, between the algebraic world of doctrines and the geometric world of topoi: to provide evidence of this phenomenon, we prove a few symmetric results relating doctrines and logics by means of syntactic categories and classifying topoi. We conclude with a discussion on the theme of conceptual completeness.
items.authors: Ivan Di Liberti, Umberto Tarantino, Lingyuan Ye
items.title_zh: 逻辑与学说，镜像对称
items.excerpt_zh: 本文研究范畴逻辑学说及其与几何逻辑片段的关系。在简要说明了范畴逻辑学说概念的历史背景之后，我们提出了我们的工作定义。然后我们证明，学说偏序集和几何逻辑片段偏序集之间存在伽罗瓦联系，如第一作者和第三作者最近开发的topoi 2-范畴中Kan单射性框架中所定义的。具体来说，这种联系是通过句法类别的一般构造和分类主题来实现的，其中包含了分类逻辑中所有众所周知的例子。这在学说的代数世界和拓扑学的几何世界之间产生了镜像对称：为了提供这种现象的证据，我们通过句法范畴和拓扑学分类证明了一些与学说和逻辑相关的对称结果。我们最后讨论了概念完整性的主题。

items.title: Classification of bipartite observables III: simplicity, mixtures and quantum error correction
items.excerpt: This is the third of a series of three papers that bring model theory to quantum information. The dividing lines of Shelah's classification theory, which separate the tame first-order theories from the wild ones, become properties of bipartite observables: properties of the expectation values obtained when two independently prepared quantum systems are idealized one after the other. In this paper we focus on simple unstable theories. The Pauli group of quantum error correction, with anticommutation as its relation, has a simple unstable theory, like the random graph. Forking and the Kim--Pillay independence theorem acquire a meaning in stabilizer codes: forking recognizes logical errors, and the independence theorem glues syndromes.
items.excerpt_zh: 这是将模型理论引入量子信息的三篇论文系列中的第三篇。谢拉分类理论的分界线将驯服的一阶理论与野生理论区分开来，成为二分可观测量的性质：当两个独立准备的量子系统相继理想化时获得的期望值的性质。在本文中，我们关注简单的不稳定理论。量子纠错泡利群，以反交换为关系，有一个简单的不稳定理论，就像随机图一样。分叉和 Kim-Pillay 独立定理在稳定器代码中获得了意义：分叉识别逻辑错误，独立定理粘合综合症。
items.title_zh: 二部可观测量分类 III：简单性、混合性和量子纠错

items.title: On stable semilinear sets in ordered vector spaces
items.excerpt: We establish a general decomposition for regular closed semilinear sets, derived from a detailed study of their topological boundary. As an application, we characterize stable semilinear sets in ordered vector spaces over an ordered field, extending previous results of Hoffmann, Tran, and Ye.
items.title_zh: 有序向量空间中的稳定半线性集
items.excerpt_zh: 我们对正则闭半线性集建立了一般分解，这是从对其拓扑边界的详细研究中得出的。作为一个应用，我们描述了有序域上有序向量空间中的稳定半线性集，扩展了 Hoffmann、Tran 和 Ye 之前的结果。

items.title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
items.excerpt: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endo
items.authors: Tanqiu Jiang, Min Bai, Sadat Shahriar, Wanyu Du, Sandesh Swamy
items.title_zh: PerMIT：通过机器检查的完整性定理和可扩展的社区信任来保护 LLM 代理的持久内存
items.excerpt_zh: 持久内存在很大程度上是一个不设防的注入和中毒表面，同样的风险也限制了代理之间的内存共享。我们提出了 PerMIT，这是一种在明确的信任假设下具有可证明完整性保证的内存架构：只有用户输入的输入和在门上确认的值才是可信的。 PerMIT 通过有限的内存接口协调不受信任的环境派生值的释放和使用，同时保留代理驱动的多轮规划和工具选择。在这个有限的接口上，我们证明了两个完整性定理，它们也在 Lean 4 中进行了机器检查，它们共同确保只有在门处得到确认时，环境衍生的记忆才能达到敏感动作，并且仅通过门所显示的内容来影响代理的行为。因此，我们的威胁模型中的每次攻击都简化为单个可审计的决策，人类、LLM 验证者或两者都可以在实践中做出这一决策。在 Trojan Hippo 上，PerMIT 通过自我验证和轻量级验证器记录了零观察到的攻击成功。由于每次确认都是对确切内容的记录判决，因此用户之间的认可会累积，并充分结束

items.title: NormTune: Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Reasoning-Intensive Tasks
items.excerpt: Full fine-tuning has achieved remarkable success on reasoning-intensive tasks, but it often requires substantial GPU resource consumption. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) provides a promising alternative for reducing this cost, yet we observe a substantial performance gap on reasoning-intensive tasks. In this paper, we present three key observations showing that this gap is closely associated with norm-related under-adaptation, where PEFT produces markedly smaller weight-update norms than full fine-tuning. Based on these observations, we propose Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (NormTune), a simple yet effective strategy that adaptively strengthens insufficiently updated layers according to their weight-update norms. Extensive experiments show that NormTune consistently enhances multiple PEFT methods across challenging reasoning benchmarks. Specifically, when trained on S1K-1.1, integrating NormTune into rank-8 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA yields substantial average accuracy improvements of 24.24\%, 11.33\%, and 16.21\% , respectively, across AIME 2024, MATH 500, GPQA, and AIME 2025. Moreover, NormTune-enhanced rank-256 LoRA
items.authors: Zhangming Li, Qinghao Hu, Weifan Guan, Yifan Zhang, Peisong Wang, Jian Cheng
items.title_zh: NormTune：针对推理密集型任务的规范引导参数高效微调
items.excerpt_zh: 完全微调在推理密集型任务上取得了显着的成功，但通常需要大量的 GPU 资源消耗。参数高效微调（PEFT）为降低这种成本提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但我们观察到推理密集型任务的性能差距很大。在本文中，我们提出了三个关键观察结果，表明这种差距与规范相关的适应不足密切相关，其中 PEFT 产生的权重更新规范明显小于完全微调。基于这些观察，我们提出了规范引导的参数高效微调（NormTune），这是一种简单而有效的策略，可以根据权重更新规范自适应地加强更新不足的层。大量实验表明，NormTune 在具有挑战性的推理基准测试中始终如一地增强了多种 PEFT 方法。具体来说，在 S1K-1.1 上进行训练时，将 NormTune 集成到 8 级 LoRA、Bone 和 MoRA 中，在 AIME 2024、MATH 500、GPQA 和 AIME 2025 中，平均准确度分别大幅提高 24.24%、11.33% 和 16.21%。此外，NormTune 增强的 256 级 LoRA

items.title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. While maintaining comparable Teacher accuracy, it encourages the Teacher to explore and re-solve problems, thereby reducing its reliance on the reference solution. At each rol
items.authors: Linfei Ji (Huazhong University of Science and Technology), Jiayun Li (Tsinghua University), Haozhao Wang (Huazhong University of Science and Technology), Siyu Jiang (Huazhong University of Science and Technology), Zehao Wang (Harbin Institute of Technology), Longtao Xiao (Huazhong University of Science and Technology), Yu-Jie Yuan (Huawei Technologies Ltd), Ruixuan Li (Huazhong University of Science and Technology)
items.excerpt_zh: 按策略自蒸馏 (OPSD) 使语言模型能够向从同一模型实例化的教师学习，但可以访问特权信息，例如参考解决方案。我们发现，获得足够的特权信息可以让老师生成高度准确的轨迹；然而，仅准确性并不能保证这些轨迹适合学生学习。直接访问完整的解决方案可能会鼓励缩短、参考条件的推导，从而省略在没有特权信息的情况下解决问题所需的探索、验证和自我纠正。我们引入了 TeachBack，这是一个用于策略自我蒸馏的双向偏好学习框架，它不仅向教师学习，还向教师应该如何教学学习。 TeachBack 通过控制注入提示中的参考推理后缀的长度以及改变提示样式来塑造教师的生成行为。在保持可比较的教师准确性的同时，它鼓励教师探索和重新解决问题，从而减少对参考解决方案的依赖。在每个卷
items.title_zh: TeachBack：通过双向偏好优化学习教学以实现策略自我蒸馏

items.title: Solving Go under Positional Superko: Sound Proof Transfer and New Board Values
items.excerpt: Positional superko (PSK) forbids recreating any earlier whole-board position. It is part of the Chinese rules as written and of the rules used in computer Go. Yet almost all solved Go boards were computed under a simpler basic-ko rule set. PSK makes solving hard: legality depends on the whole game history, and this breaks the three tools that make solving tractable, namely transposition tables (the graph-history interaction problem), static life-and-death recognition, and safe move pruning. We present Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver that restores all three soundly. Its core is a cheap proof-transfer theorem: a stored proof stays valid on a new path unless a board that the proof's winner must create has already occurred. Sanko proves 5x5 Go in 16 minutes with six threads, where the previous state of the art needed 5.25 hours with six processes, and in about a minute and a half on one 192-thread machine. It also establishes the first PSK values of twenty-three further boards, eleven of which were unsolved under any rules. Superko changes game-theoretic values: 4x7, a full-board win under basic ko, is worth only 12 poin
items.title_zh: 解决位置 Superko 下的围棋问题：隔音传输和新棋盘值
items.excerpt_zh: 位置超级 (PSK) 禁止重新创建任何早期的全盘位置。它是中国成文规则和计算机围棋规则的一部分。然而，几乎所有已解决的围棋棋盘都是在更简单的基本棋规则集下计算的。 PSK 使得求解变得困难：合法性取决于整个游戏历史，这打破了使求解变得容易处理的三个工具，即换位表（图历史交互问题）、静态生死识别和安全移动修剪。我们推出了 Sanko，一种并行深度优先证明数解算器，可以完美地恢复这三者。它的核心是一个廉价的证明转移定理：存储的证明在新路径上保持有效，除非证明的获胜者必须创建的棋盘已经出现。 Sanko 在 16 分钟内用 6 个线程证明了 5x5 Go，而之前的最先进技术需要 5.25 小时用 6 个进程，而在一台 192 线程机器上大约需要 1 分半钟。它还确定了另外 23 个棋盘的第一个 PSK 值，其中 11 个棋盘在任何规则下都未解决。 Superko改变了游戏理论值：4x7，基本ko下的全盘胜利，只值12分

items.title: An Exact 93-Move Solution to a Nonlocal Crystal-Exchange Puzzle
items.excerpt: We determine the minimum number of directional commands needed to solve alevel of Order of the Sinking Star, modeled as a crystal-exchangepuzzle on an 11*11 board. A command swapsthe player with the nearest crystal in the selected row or column, regardlessof distance; only an empty ray permits an ordinary unit walk. Two gates admitthe player to the exit exactly while all sixteen crystals occupy their targetcells. We give an explicit 93-command solution and exclude every shortersolution by an exact, cost-bounded breadth-first search. The search representsa position by its seventeen occupied cells and one active cell. Its admissibleheuristic partitions command costs between a compressed core abstraction andresidual motion, strengthened by a necessary activation detour and a cornervisit condition. The completed computation retained 605,349,215 occupied setsand 1,863,925,136 states. We prove the reductions and pruning conditions,describe the exact storage scheme, and provide source code, execution logs,and a reproduction driver. items.title_zh: 非局部水晶交换谜题的精确 93 步解法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们确定了解决《沉星令》关卡所需的最少方向命令数量，该游戏被建模为 11*11 棋盘上的水晶交换谜题。命令将玩家与所选行或列中最近的水晶交换，无论距离如何；只有空射线允许普通的单位行走。当所有十六个水晶占据其目标单元时，两扇门准确地允许玩家到达出口。我们给出一个显式的 93 个命令的解决方案，并通过精确的、有成本限制的广度优先搜索排除每个较短的解决方案。该搜索通过十七个占用单元和一个活动单元来表示位置。其可接受的启发式划分压缩核心抽象和残余运动之间的命令成本，并通过必要的激活绕行和角落访问条件得到加强。完成的计算保留了 605,349,215 个占用集和 1,863,925,136 个状态。我们证明了缩减和修剪条件，描述了确切的存储方案，并提供了源代码、执行日志和复制驱动程序。结果是指定实例的计算机辅助证明，具有明确的实现信任边界

items.title: The CIDOC CRM Periodic Table: Documentation You Can Test to Support the Adoption of Scientific Research Ontologies for the Humanities
items.excerpt: The CIDOC CRM family is not only a schema for museum collections. Its extensions formalise the apparatus through which research knowledge is produced and justified: CRMsci models scientific observation and measurement, CRMdig the provenance of digital processes, CRMinf inference and belief. Together they constitute a schema for research data, and the obstacle to their adoption is documentary rather than theoretical: four normative documents, four code conventions, and eighty-nine typed links crossing document boundaries. This paper presents the CIDOC CRM Periodic Table, a single-page browser rendering 131 classes and 480 property entries from CIDOC CRM 7.1.3, CRMsci 3.2, CRMdig 5.0 and CRMinf 1.2.1 as one navigable surface, with two inference facilities: a one-step triple builder admitting only the class-property combinations licensed by declared domains, ranges and the subclass closure, and a multi-step path finder enumerating property chains between two classes. Because all loaded models are merged into one code-keyed dictionary before the hierarchy closures are computed, both resolve chains that cross model boundaries; we documen
items.title_zh: CIDOC CRM 元素周期表：您可以测试以支持采用人文科学研究本体的文档
items.excerpt_zh: CIDOC CRM 系列不仅仅是博物馆藏品的模式。它的扩展形式化了研究知识产生和论证的工具：CRMsci 模拟科学观察和测量，CRMdig 数字过程的起源，CRMinf 推理和信念。它们共同构成了研究数据的模式，采用它们的障碍是文献而非理论：四个规范性文档、四个代码约定和八十九个跨越文档边界的类型化链接。本文介绍了 CIDOC CRM 周期表，这是一种单页浏览器，将 CIDOC CRM 7.1.3、CRMsci 3.2、CRMdig 5.0 和 CRMinf 1.2.1 中的 131 个类和 480 个属性条目呈现为一个可导航表面，并具有两个推理工具：一个单步三重构建器，仅允许由声明的域、范围和子类闭包许可的类属性组合，以及一个多步路径查找器枚举两个类之间的属性链。由于在计算层次结构闭包之前，所有加载的模型都会合并到一个代码键控字典中，因此两者都会解析跨越模型边界的链；我们记录

items.title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
items.excerpt: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. The framework integrates advances from two areas: (1) it leverages the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover interpretable skills from questions, and (2) it applies cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) from psychometrics to estimate per-skill abilities of LLMs. We conduct experiments on 3,811 LLMs evaluated on 9,523 items across five benchmarks spanning diverse domains (MATH, BBH, GPQA, MuSR, IFEval). Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise model profiles that more accurately predict model behavior on unseen items. We also demonstrate the utility of SkillEval in two downstream tasks: (1) LLM routing, which dynamically assigns each query t
items.authors: Berke Arda, Peng Cui, Qiaoyuan Zheng, Rudolf Debelak, Mubashara Akhtar, Mrinmaya Sachan
items.title_zh: SkillEval：通过认知诊断模型学习法学硕士的可解释能力概况
items.excerpt_zh: 当前对法学硕士的基准评估通常会将各个示例的表现汇总为单个标量分数。这种方法过于粗糙，并且忽略了基准数据集涵盖的不同技能范围。为了解决这一限制并更好地利用基准数据，我们提出了 SkillEval，这是一种执行跨模型、技能水平分析的新评估框架。该框架整合了两个领域的进步：（1）它利用法学硕士的元认知能力从问题中自动发现可解释的技能，（2）它应用心理测量学的认知诊断模型（CDM）来估计法学硕士的每项技能能力。我们对 3,811 名法学硕士进行了实验，评估了跨越不同领域（MATH、BBH、GPQA、MuSR、IFEval）的 5 个基准的 9,523 个项目。与传统的基于平均值的评估范式相比，SkillEval 生成可靠、更校准、信息更丰富且简洁的模型配置文件，可以更准确地预测模型在看不见的项目上的行为。我们还演示了 SkillEval 在两个下游任务中的实用性：(1) LLM 路由，动态分配每个查询 t

items.title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
items.excerpt: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4
items.authors: Nghi Dao, Calder Morton-Ferguson, Noah Golowich, Adam Block
items.title_zh: ReAPO：重试感知策略优化，用于 LLM 推理中的高效探索
items.excerpt_zh: RLVR 改进了语言模型推理，但通常依赖于独立的随机推出进行探索，这可以重复采样类似的失败策略。先前的工作已经取得了成功，通过在后续尝试的上下文中包含不正确的解决方案，将依赖性引入采样过程来指导探索。尽管如此，这些方法还是引入了额外的问题，即如何为每次尝试分配信用。我们建议通过随机最短路径的视角来看待信用分配，这是经典强化学习中的一个框架，旨在最小化达到最终状态的预期累积成本（在我们的例子中，是经过验证的成功响应）。我们表明，在适当的简化假设下，这种观点自然会导致对 GRPO 的简单修改，我们称之为重试感知策略优化（ReAPO）。 ReAPO 为失败的轨迹分配额外的生成，允许在不奖励先前失败的情况下强化成功的重试，并以理论上有原则的方式为每次尝试分配信用。跨越 Qwen3 和 OLMo-2 型号，从 0.6B 到 4

items.title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
items.excerpt: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. items.title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. items.title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
items.excerpt: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural
items.authors: Zijie Liu, Zhen Tan, Charles Fleming, Tianlong Chen
items.title_zh: 通过知识重铸对抗持续领域适应中的灾难性遗忘
items.excerpt_zh: 在训练后使语言模型适应新领域可能会降低之前获得的能力，这种现象通常被称为灾难性遗忘。现有的缓解方法主要将遗忘视为模型过度漂移的结果。因此，它们通过保留旧输出、重放旧数据或规范参数和表示的更改来限制更新，以便更新后的模型保持接近其先前的状态。我们采取不同的观点：我们不是将更新后的模型拉回到旧状态，而是将新领域转换到模型预先存在的知识空间中，使不熟悉的知识可以通过熟悉的过程进行学习。因此，我们提出了技能模式传输（SST），这是一种训练后框架，可将新知识传输到模型现有的技能空间中。 SST 将每个示例类型抽象为技能模式，保留其基本操作、依赖关系和验证步骤，同时删除特定于领域的表面形式。通过将新示例重新塑造为可重用程序的实例，SST 将知识更新从轨迹记忆转变为程序化

items.title: Auditing Conformal Prediction for Language Models Under Inference-Time Model Shift
items.excerpt: Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. items.title: The Price of Choice in Selective Prediction
items.excerpt: A selective classifier may be claimed to satisfy a risk-coverage contract if some rule from a predeclared menu (a threshold or a union of $K$ score intervals) attains coverage at least $\kappa$ and error at most $\alpha$. Refuting this existential claim requires ruling out every permitted rule. The intersection-union test (IUT) achieves validity without a multiplicity correction, but its sample cost can increase with menu richness. We characterize this cost and compare it with the optimal audit. For a fixed interior risk target $\alpha$ and gap $\gamma$, the minimax sample size for K-interval menus at coverage floor $\kappa$ is $K(1-\kappa)/(\kappa\gamma^2)$, up to logarithmic factors, in the stated small-gap, large-menu regime; exact IUT attains this rate. The lower bound holds even with a known score distribution, while the upper bound extends to menus of VC dimension $d$. Procedures that refuse to reject whenever any rule appears feasible on the audit sample can pay a linear $K$ cost even when a square-root rate is possible. items.title: MHeatmap: Two-Walk Laplacian Reordering and Mosaic Layout for Rectangular Matrix Visualization
items.excerpt: Weighted rectangular matrices record relations between two types of objects, such as occupations and industries, documents and terms, origins and destinations, or annotated classes and computed clusters. Their heatmaps become difficult to read when arbitrary row and column orders scatter related objects, while equal size cells hide large differences in row and column totals. We present MHeatmap (Mosaic Heatmap), which addresses these problems in two stages. Two-Walk spectral seriation first represents the matrix as a weighted bipartite graph. Ordinary bipartite ordering uses only observed row to column links. Two-Walk also uses length-two walks, so rows that share columns and columns that share rows receive explicit similarity links. Sorting a Fiedler vector of the resulting graph Laplacian gives coordinated row and column orders. The Mosaic layout then partitions a unit square so that row height is proportional to the row total and column width is proportional to the column total, while color represents the observed entry. items.title_zh: MHeatmap：用于矩形矩阵可视化的两次拉普拉斯重新排序和马赛克布局
items.excerpt_zh: 加权矩形矩阵记录两类对象之间的关系，例如职业和行业、文档和术语、起点和目的地、或带注释的类和计算的集群。当任意行和列顺序分散相关对象时，它们的热图变得难以阅读，而相同大小的单元格隐藏了行和列总数的巨大差异。我们提出了 MHeatmap（马赛克热图），它分两个阶段解决这些问题。双步谱序列化首先将矩阵表示为加权二分图。普通的二分排序仅使用观察到的行到列的链接。两次行走还使用长度两次行走，因此共享列的行和共享行的列会收到显式的相似性链接。对所得图拉普拉斯的 Fiedler 向量进行排序可给出协调的行和列顺序。然后，马赛克布局划分一个单位正方形，以便行高与行总数成正比，列宽与列总数成正比，而颜色代表观察到的条目。我们证明了两步能量如何将直接对齐与共享邻居平滑性结合起来，导出精确的矩阵
