items.title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
items.excerpt: There is a widespread sense that AI-generated text has recently become harder to understand. In this study, we investigate a set of psycholinguistic features that are known to correlate with human processing difficulty (e.g., object relative clauses, long syntactic dependencies, low-frequency n-grams). Using a novel corpus of AI-generated text across diverse domains, we find that AI models use these difficult features more often than paraphrases generated by round-trip translation. Compared with human writing, all nine frontier and near-frontier models use more inanimate subjects with animate verbs and more low-frequency n-grams, and most also use longer dependencies, more stacked nouns, and more reduced object relatives in conversation; we also demonstrate substantial variation across model families. We propose and test a hypothesis as to why: while human language is optimized for successful communication, AI-generated text is increasingly optimized for other goals like math, code, and reasoning, in which there is a pressure for \textit{information density} rather than successful communication. We provide a proof-of-concept for this
items.authors: Thomas Hikaru Clark, Matias B. Martin, Kyle Mahowald
items.title_zh: 为什么人工智能生成的语言如此难以理解？
items.excerpt_zh: 人们普遍认为人工智能生成的文本最近变得越来越难以理解。在这项研究中，我们研究了一组已知与人类处理难度相关的心理语言学特征（例如，宾语相关从句、长句法依赖性、低频 n 元语法）。使用跨不同领域的人工智能生成文本的新颖语料库，我们发现人工智能模型比往返翻译生成的释义更频繁地使用这些困难的特征。与人类写作相比，所有九个前沿和近前沿模型都使用了更多无生命主语和有生命动词以及更多低频 n-gram，并且大多数还在对话中使用了更长的依存关系、更多的堆叠名词和更多的简化宾语亲属；我们还展示了不同模型系列之间的巨大差异。我们提出并测试了一个假设来解释原因：虽然人类语言针对成功的沟通进行了优化，但人工智能生成的文本越来越多地针对数学、代码和推理等其他目标进行了优化，其中存在 \textit{信息密度} 的压力，而不是成功的沟通。我们为此提供了概念验证

items.title: A Reverse-Gold Theorem: Positive-Data Identification by Substrate-Bounded Contrastive Learners
items.excerpt: Gold's theorem shows that no learner can identify an arbitrary language in a superfinite class from positive presentations alone. We prove a positive result of a different shape. Fix an innate \emph{recursive contrast operator} $R$ mapping any string to a finite set of structurally bounded perturbations of it, and a discriminative scorer of bounded capacity trained by InfoNCE-style contrastive estimation \citep{vandenoord2018,macollins2018} on self-generated perturbations. Under a faithfulness condition relating operator, scorer, and target, the trained scorer achieves \emph{PAC conditional identification} from positive data alone: with high probability it ranks all but an $\varepsilon$-fraction of positives above every out-of-language perturbation in their own orbit, with sample complexity polynomial in the capacity, the orbit size, the score bound, and $1/\varepsilon$. The negatives are constructed by the learner, not supplied by an oracle, and no global normalizing constant over strings is ever computed. The misranking bound follows from the geometry of the contrastive loss---per-example loss floors plus a definite loss increment
items.title_zh: 逆黄金定理：受基质限制的对比学习者的正数据识别
items.excerpt_zh: 戈尔德定理表明，没有学习者能够仅从正面表述中识别超有限类中的任意语言。我们证明了不同形状的积极结果。修复一个固有的 \emph{递归对比运算符} $R$ 将任何字符串映射到其结构上有界扰动的有限集合，以及由 InfoNCE 风格的对比估计 \citep{vandenoord2018,macollins2018} 对自生成扰动训练的有界容量判别评分器。在与算子、记分器和目标相关的忠实条件下，训练有素的记分器仅从正数据中实现 \emph{PAC 条件识别}：它以很高的概率将除 $\varepsilon$ 之外的所有正数分数排在其自己轨道上的每个语言外扰动之上，样本复杂度多项式包含在容量、轨道大小、分数范围和 $1/\varepsilon$ 中。负数是由学习器构造的，而不是由预言机提供的，并且不会计算字符串的全局标准化常量。排名错误的界限来自对比损失的几何形状——每个示例的损失下限加上明确的损失增量

items.title: ExpEvolve: Structuring and Reusing Experience for Open-Ended Discovery
items.excerpt: Evolutionary coding agents such as AlphaEvolve are one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite their success, mutations over programs are mostly low-level upon surface heuristics, without a persistent unit of control. In contrast, science compounds through ideas. In this work, we propose ExpEvolve, which injects idea-level extraction and control into evolution: it discovers and leverages the high-level factors from programs that explain scoring differences among different programs. We characterize theoretical conditions on when discovery with idea factors improves sample efficiency. We also build a practical framework to show that the extracted high-level idea factors are helpful for guiding exploitation from experience and exploration when discovery comes to a plateau. items.title: Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture
items.excerpt: For decades, a fundamental question about the difficulty of computing in high-dimensional spaces has resisted proof. New research resolves this question, removing a major theoretical obstacle to understanding the efficiency of randomized algorithms used across science and computing. The Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture was proposed in 1995. It asks whether, for a broad class of high-dimensional […] The post Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: Mathematics of the Future
items.excerpt: “Rapid advances in AI are transforming research, and for the growth of mathematical knowledge, this is thrilling. For our profession, however, this raises critical questions: Will there be a role for human mathematicians to play? How should mathematicians be trained and evaluated? […]”
items.title_zh: 未来的数学
items.excerpt_zh: “人工智能的快速进步正在改变研究，对于数学知识的增长来说，这是令人兴奋的。然而，对于我们的职业来说，这提出了关键问题：人类数学家会发挥作用吗？数学家应该如何接受培训和评估？[...]”

items.title: The Power of Beauty and Elegance
items.excerpt: What machines have: colossal knowledge and massive compute power. What humans have: intuition for beauty and elegance. The ultimate question is whether colossal knowledge and massive compute power wins over human intuition. If no, we only face some big changes. If yes, then human mathematics will degrade into exotic art.
items.title_zh: 美丽与优雅的力量
items.excerpt_zh: 机器拥有什么：海量的知识和强大的计算能力。人类拥有什么：对美丽和优雅的直觉。最终的问题是海量的知识和强大的计算能力是否会战胜人类的直觉。如果不是，我们只会面临一些重大变化。如果是的话，那么人类数学就会退化为奇异的艺术。

items.title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
items.excerpt: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just c
items.authors: Bowei He, Yankai Chen, Xiaokun Zhang, Changjiang Han, Ye Yuan, Chong Li, Xue Liu
items.title_zh: 代理强化学习中的数据如何扩展：法则和综合策略
items.excerpt_zh: 预训练缩放法则将训练数据视为一维数量：令牌计数。代理强化学习（RL）继承了这种标量抽象，但现代综合管道现在以非常不同的成本独立生成 \textit{tasks}、\textit{environments} 和 \textit{trajectories}，将数据转换为结构化设计空间。这就提出了一个预训练从来不需要回答的问题：给定综合预算，\textit{哪个轴}应该缩放？我们通过三个紧密耦合的贡献来端到端地解决这个问题。首先，我们将代理数据分解为三个基数轴（任务、环境、轨迹），加上奖励密度控制变量，并在跨数学+代码、SWE、Web 和 UI/工具应用程序域的不同大型语言模型 (LLM) 上拟合每轴缩放关系。在我们测量的所有模型大小、模型系列、领域和 RL 算法（PPO 和 GRPO）中，缩放指数顺序为环境 $>$ 任务 $>$ 轨迹。当环境多样性分解为世界多样性和环境结构多样性时，其优势主要由前者驱动，而后者只是由环境多样性驱动。

items.title: Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies
items.excerpt: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central st
items.authors: Guangya Hao, Yiting Duan, Longyan Tan, Yunbo Long, Hao Wu, Ge Zheng, Alexandra Brintrup, Zhuokai Zhao
items.title_zh: 通过进化策略进行持续的测试时学习
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地在开放环境中运行，在这种环境中，它们需要不断适应不断变化的任务和分布，而通常不需要外部监督。现有的持续学习方法依赖于外部监督，例如标记数据、演示或奖励信号，这在实践中可能成本高昂或不可用。测试时适应通过从自我生成的监督中学习来消除这种依赖性，但现有的方法从正在更新的单个策略中获得监督，因此一旦策略发生变化，其自身的学习信号也会随之变化，从而导致策略崩溃、推理退化和灾难性遗忘。在本文中，我们提出了 \textbf{进化策略强化学习（ESRL）}，这是一种持续的测试时间学习框架，它从一组策略而不是单个正在训练的策略中获取自我生成的监督。 ESRL 扰乱参数空间中的锚定策略，以形成附近策略的群体，从每个策略中采样一个轨迹，并将其答案聚合成中央策略的无标签组相关学习信号。

items.title: Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence
items.excerpt: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $\beta$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(\mu-1)\beta(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $\beta$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. items.title: Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform
items.excerpt: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. items.authors: Sho Sonoda, Luca Galimberti, Yuanchao Xu, Isao Ishikawa, Masahiro Ikeda
items.excerpt_zh: 输入为函数的神经网络（如算子学习）通常通过存在性论证（通过简化为有限维网络或通过 Stone-Weierstrass 型密度）证明是普遍的；这些证明了近似值的存在，但很少说明参数如何依赖于目标。我们采取建设性路线。我们将脊波变换（一种与傅立叶变换、氡变换和小波变换相关的积分变换）扩展到可分离的无限维希尔伯特空间上的连续映射，用方向空间上的均匀混合的高斯权重替换在无限维中不可用的勒贝格测度。生成的变换具有 Plancherel 恒等式和重建公式，其中包含帧算子、权重引起的校正，并且它为每个目标分配一个显式系数测量，每个可允许的分析滤波器都有一个。从这些表示中，我们获得了多项式增长的所有连续非多项式激活的紧集的一致近似，包括 ReLU，并且通过系数的蒙特卡罗采样，有限宽度网络
items.title_zh: 通过高斯加权脊波变换的无限维神经网络的构造通用逼近

items.title: Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale
items.excerpt: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $\gamma$. The challenge is to achieve error $\gamma+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $\gamma$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. Along the way, we use several tools that may be of independent interest. The first concerns $\varepsilon$-nets with
items.authors: Noga Alon, Steve Hanneke, Shay Moran, Tom Waknine
items.excerpt_zh: 均匀收敛询问有多少随机样本足以使经验平均值同时逼近整个函数类的期望。它是概率的核心概念，也是统计学习的基础。对于二值类，Vapnik--Chervonenkis 定理通过 VC 维度的有限性来表征一致收敛。对于维度 $d$，加性误差 $\varepsilon$ 的最坏情况样本复杂度为 $d/\varepsilon^2$。对于实值函数，类似的组合参数是脂肪粉碎维度，它取决于近似尺度 $\gamma$。挑战是用 $d/\varepsilon^2$ 样本实现错误 $\gamma+\varepsilon$，匹配二进制类的样本范围，其中 $d$ 现在是规模 $\gamma$ 上的脂肪粉碎维度。以前的结果要么实现了最佳规模，要么实现了最佳样本复杂性，但不能同时实现两者。我们的主要结果弥补了这一差距，在最佳规模下建立了尖锐的样本复杂性。在此过程中，我们使用了几种可能具有独立兴趣的工具。第一个涉及 $\varepsilon$-nets

items.title: Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration
items.excerpt: Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. By jointly learning an empowerment-maximizing policy together with its discounted state-occupancy measure, our estimator can be trained on unlabeled trajectories generated from any unkno
items.authors: Ishir Garg, Vivek Myers, Qiyang Li, Catherine Ji, Benjamin Eysenbach, Sergey Levine
items.title_zh: 衡量离线数据对内在驱动探索的授权
items.excerpt_zh: 先前经验的大型未标记数据集越来越多地可用于机器人和编码等领域的代理任务。这些任务的常见方法是使用先前的数据训练策略，然后通过在线部署进一步改进它。但是，虽然很多工作都在研究如何使用离线和在线数据进行策略提取，但在理解在线学习阶段如何使用先验数据有效地\textit{explore}方面所做的工作却少之又少。之前的工作试图通过定义 \textit{empowerment} 来形式化这个想法，这是一个衡量智能体可以实现多少种未来状态的指标；权力较高的国家需要更多的探索，因为有更多的未来可供探索。然而，现有的评估赋权的方法需要在环境中在线推出政策。我们提出了第一种方法，用于根据未标记的先验数据来估计赋权，而无需任何环境交互。通过共同学习赋权最大化策略及其折扣状态占用度量，我们的估计器可以接受由任何未知数生成的未标记轨迹的训练。

items.title: No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints
items.excerpt: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.
items.authors: Davide Maran, Marcello Restelli, Francesco Emanuele Stradi
items.title_zh: 库存限制下连续做市的无悔收入最大化
items.excerpt_zh: 做市商通过为买家和卖家设定出价和要价来保持交易效率。在顺序做市中，交易根据价格阈值独立发生，要求做市商在 T 轮中保持平衡、低风险的库存。本文研究了如何使用后悔最小化在未知的买家和卖家估值的情况下最大化收入。当做市商只看到交易成功或失败时，算法会实现遗憾，库存范围与 T 的 2/3 次方成正比。当失败交易的完整订单簿数据可用时，遗憾和库存限制将显着改善至 T 的平方根。我们还通过下限建立基本权衡，证明更严格的逐轮库存限制严格迫使更高的最小遗憾。

items.title: Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory
items.excerpt: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.
items.authors: Man-Ling Sung, William Hartmann, Jiangying Zhou
items.title_zh: 使用上下文管理和外部存储器进行推理
items.excerpt_zh: 推理模型通过上下文记忆维护有关其推理过程状态的信息。复杂的问题需要更大的上下文窗口和内存需求。在这种情况下，没有缓存的上下文管理可能会丢弃用于推理的有用信息。我们提出了 RCMEM，这是一种使用外部存储器扩展上下文管理的方法，以维护附加信息，而不会给推理模型带来附加上下文的负担。 RCMEM 显着减少了需要重复计算中间步骤的问题的计算时间，同时在复杂问题上实现了更好的性能。我们使用 0.4 到 2500 万参数的模型大小和 GPT-2 演示了我们解决一些数学问题的方法。

items.title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
items.excerpt: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model
items.authors: Wen-Zhi Li, Sainyam Galhotra, Claire Cardie
items.excerpt_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提高了大型语言模型的推理能力，但往往降低了其推理行为的多样性。我们从有限样本学习动态的角度研究这种现象，并表明有限的策略推出可以逐渐抑制语义上不同但同样奖励的推理模式。一旦某个模式变得足够欠采样，标准同策略 RLVR 很少能恢复它。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了 TAR，一种有针对性的自适应重放框架，它保留了基本策略中已经存在的各种正确推理行为。 TAR 构建了一个包含不同基本模型解决方案的紧凑存储库，并通过自适应机制选择性地重放它们，该机制仅在 RLVR 期间抑制存储的行为时激活。在六个数学推理基准和两个 Qwen2.5 模型尺度上，TAR 始终比现有的多样性保留后训练方法在推理性能和多样性保留之间取得了更好的平衡，同时大大减少了正确基础模型的遗忘
items.title_zh: 通过自适应重放保持强化学习中的推理多样性并提供可验证的奖励

items.title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
items.excerpt: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. We further use these features to analyze model representations during jailbreak attacks, mathematical and agentic reasoning. Our targeted feature construction thus offers a scalable
items.authors: Dmitry Scherbakov, Oleg Chernikov, Victoria Khamash, Kirill Afendulev, Alexey Dontsov, Ivan Oseledets, Elena Tutubalina, Anton Korznikov
items.title_zh: 从故事到特征：缩放概念向量以实现人工智能对齐和可解释性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究特征向量：语言模型激活空间中与人类可解释的概念相对应的方向，例如诚实或欺骗。现有的无监督方法（例如稀疏自动编码器）试图恢复整个特征空间，通常以特征质量和可解释性为代价。我们采取了更务实的路线：专注于与人工智能安全和对齐相关的概念，我们生成合成的概念-对抗故事对，并使用它们的平均模型激活的差异作为特征向量。我们使用公开发布的跨多种语言和流派的 2M 合成故事，将此方法扩展到 1,036 个与对齐相关的概念。在三个模型系列的六个模型中，我们的特征向量可靠地概括为检测聊天对话和网络文本中相应的概念。它们形成跨模型共享的可解释几何形状，并且在注入激活时可以因果地引导模型行为。我们进一步使用这些功能来分析越狱攻击、数学和代理推理期间的模型表示。因此，我们的目标特征构建提供了可扩展的

items.title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
items.excerpt: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. Probes using synonyms, nonce words and controls for shared surface context show that these gains come from linking source terms to their in-co
items.authors: Deevyanshu Malu, Deeptanshu Malu, Sunita Sarawagi
items.title_zh: 使用密码进行培训以增强稀有语言翻译的上下文术语学习
items.excerpt_zh: 使用上下文示例（IC-Train）微调法学硕士可以让翻译模型在部署时适应新的并行数据，但尚不清楚它们是否真的从这些示例中学习了罕见术语的翻译。我们将这种能力正式化为上下文术语学习（ICTL）。我们表明标准 IC-Train 只能弱地开发这种能力，并提出 RareCipherFT，它在没有任何词汇资源的情况下增强了这种能力。 RareCipherFT 将每个训练目标与与其共享稀有术语的上下文示例配对。然后，它在上下文和引用中都用字符打乱的密码替换该术语，因此只能通过从上下文复制来恢复该术语。训练数据的加密部分被退火以保持翻译质量。在英语和泰米尔语、阿萨姆语、米佐语、尼泊尔语和豪萨语之间的七个翻译方向以及从 1B 到 7B 参数的四个模型中，RareCipherFT 比标准 IC-Train 提高了术语召回率 5-15 个绝对点，而没有降低 COMET。使用同义词、随机数词和共享表面上下文控制的探测表明，这些收益来自于将源术语与其内部术语联系起来。

items.title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. Sparse replacement also retains much of the base model's diversity while staying close to the RL model at pass@1. At
items.authors: Siyu Zhang, Yuquan Lu, Yoshua Y. Li, Yifan Ding, Kun Zeng, Yu Huo, Yifu Guo, Rongxiang Weng, Xunliang Cai, Xiaoying Tang
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）极大地改善了数学推理，但它对基本模型的添加内容仍不清楚。我们通过对 Qwen3-4B-Base 进行一系列生成时间干预来研究这一问题，测量每次干预在 120 个 AIME 问题上恢复了多少经过 RL 训练的对应增益。具有相同 8,192 个令牌输出限制的功率采样不会带来除贪婪解码之外的任何增益。然而，仅在两个模型的贪婪选择不同的情况下借用 RL 模型的代币（生成头寸的大约 4%），即可恢复 pass@1 收益的 90.5%，在 MATH-500 上的三个模型对上也有类似的恢复。我们发现，即使是单个开头标记也会产生重大影响：强制基本模型以“好吧”开始可以恢复 35% 的 RL 增益。然而，仅开口是不够的。在相同的空缺之后的后续替换又为 pass@1 添加了 5.2 个百分点，而我们测试的插入反射词（例如“等待”）的固定规则并没有重现这一好处。稀疏替换还保留了基本模型的大部分多样性，同时在 pass@1 上保持接近 RL 模型。在
items.title_zh: 强化学习给推理带来了什么：一些基本模型不会做出的决定

items.title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
items.excerpt: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. Each newly authored template is linked to a documented source and a verbatim quote from it. Each evaluated template also has a counter-stereotypical

items.title: How Well Can LLMs Verbalize Mathematical Formulas? A Multi-Domain Evaluation
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across natural language tasks. But their ability to generate accurate written verbalizations of mathematical formulas has not been systematically evaluated. Such verbalization is important for text-to-speech systems supporting audio-based learning and visually impaired users. We evaluated five state-of-the-art LLMs across six scientific domains and constructed Read-Aloud Math, a balanced multi-domain corpus with LaTeX formulas, manually validated simple and extended transcriptions, multiple variants, textual context, domain labels, and formula complexity levels. Using multi-reference BLEU, GPT-5.2 achieved the highest score for simple transcriptions (75.9% without context, 64.9% with context), although without context it did not significantly outperform Grok 4.1 Fast or Claude Sonnet 4.5. Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieved the highest score for extended transcriptions without context (36.5%), and Grok 4.1 Fast with context (48.8%). items.title_zh: 法学硕士能够用语言表达数学公式吗？多领域评估

items.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
items.excerpt: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. items.title: Galois Groups of Shifted Exponential Polynomials
items.excerpt: Consider the shifted truncations of the exponential series and their Galois groups: $$F_{n,a}(x) := \sum_{j=0}^{n}\frac{x^j}{(a+j)!}\qquad G_{n,a}:= \text{Gal}(F_{n,a}/\mathbb{Q}).$$ In this paper we prove that for every fixed integer $a>0$, the set of $n$ for which $G_{n,a}=S_n$ has natural density one, thus answering a question of Katz and Rivin.
items.title_zh: 移位指数多项式的伽罗瓦群
items.excerpt_zh: 考虑指数级数及其伽罗瓦群的移位截断： $$F_{n,a}(x) := \sum_{j=0}^{n}\frac{x^j}{(a+j)!}\qquad G_{n,a}:= \text{Gal}(F_{n,a}/\mathbb{Q})。$$在本文中，我们证明对于每个固定整数 $a>0$，集合$n$ 的 $G_{n,a}=S_n$ 的自然密度为 1，从而回答了 Katz 和 Rivin 的问题。

items.title: Class polynomial obstructions to canonical congruences for the smallest parts function
items.excerpt: We resolve an open conjecture by proving that the only "canonical'' Ramanujan congruence primes for the Andrews' smallest parts function, $\operatorname{spt}(n)$, are $\ell= 5, 7, 13$. Building on work of Ahlgren and Kim, we show that any such congruence forces square-index coefficients of certain weakly holomorphic forms of weight $1/2$ to vanish modulo the congruence prime. A normalized Borcherds product converts this into the vanishing of the derivative of a quotient of two oriented CM polynomials on $X_0(6)$. A quaternionic volume estimate in an Eichler order of level $6$ prevents that vanishing when a suitable inert discriminant is small. Trevi\~no's character estimate supplies such a discriminant for every prime at least $10^{11}$. The remaining range is covered by the previous calculations of Ahlgren and Kim. These results have been verified in Lean by AxiomProver.
items.title_zh: 最小部分函数的规范同余的类多项式障碍
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过证明安德鲁斯最小部分函数 $\operatorname{spt}(n)$ 的唯一“规范”拉马努金同余素数为 $\ell= 5, 7, 13$ 来解决一个开放猜想。在 Ahlgren 和 Kim 的工作的基础上，我们证明任何这样的同余都会迫使权重 $1/2$ 的某些弱全纯形式的平方指数系数以模数消失同余素数将其转换为 $X_0(6)$ 上两个定向 CM 多项式的导数的消失。当合适的惰性判别式很小时，$6$ 级的四元数体积估计可以防止消失。Trevi\~no 的特征估计为每个素数提供至少 $10^{11}$ 的判别式。 Ahlgren 和 Kim 之前的计算涵盖了这些结果，并已由 AxiomProver 在 Lean 中进行了验证。

items.title: Small sums of roots of unity: polylogarithmic exceptional sets and conditional separation
items.excerpt: We prove a polylogarithmic exceptional-set estimate for symmetric five-term sums of roots of unity of arbitrary order. More precisely, at most $O((\log(2N))^{11})$ points of the $N$-grid satisfy $|1+2\cos(2\pi x)+2\cos(2\pi y)|<\exp(-C(\log(2N))^{13})$. This implies the corresponding bound for small conjugates at the reduced conductor: outside polylogarithmically many real embeddings, every such sum is at least quasipolynomially large. The proof is unconditional and combines a polynomial-vector-field multiplicity estimate, arithmetic jet determinants, analytic propagation, and interpolation determinants for nearby grid points. As a companion result, assuming a uniform number-field $abc$ conjecture, we prove that every sum of a fixed number of distinct prime-order roots of unity has modulus at least $\exp(-\varepsilon p)$ for every $\varepsilon>0$ and all sufficiently large primes $p$, uniformly in the exponents. That proof uses simultaneous compression of the exponents, discriminant estimates, and cyclic resultants.
items.title_zh: 统一根的小和：多对数异常集和条件分离
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了任意阶单位根的对称五项和的多对数例外集估计。更准确地说，$N$ 网格的最多 $O((\log(2N))^{11})$ 个点满足 $|1+2\cos(2\pi x)+2\cos(2\pi y)|<\exp(-C(\log(2N))^{13})$。这意味着在减少的导体处小共轭的相应界限：在多对数的实数嵌入之外，每个这样的总和至少是拟多项式大的。该证明是无条件的，并结合了多项式矢量场多重性估计、算术射流行列式、解析传播和附近网格点的插值行列式。作为伴随结果，假设统一数域 $abc$ 猜想，我们证明固定数量的不同素数阶单位根的每个总和对于每个 $\varepsilon>0$ 和所有足够大的素数 $p$ 具有至少 $\exp(-\varepsilon p)$ 的模，在指数中一致。该证明使用了指数、判别估计和循环结果的同时压缩。

items.title: Upper Bounds on the de Bruijn-Newman constant for Dirichlet $L$-functions with primitive real-valued characters
items.excerpt: Let $\chi_m$ be a primitive real-valued Dirichlet character of conductor $m\ge3$, let $L(s)=L(s,\chi_m)$ be the associated Dirichlet $L$-function, and let $\xi_L(s)$ denote its completed form. For each $t \in \mathbb R,$ we define the entire function \[ H^L_t(z) := \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{tu^2}\, \Phi_L(u)\, e^{izu}\, du, \] where $\Phi_L$ is the superexponentially decaying density \[ \Phi_L(u) := \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \xi_L\!\left(\frac{1+is}{2}\right) e^{-isu}\, ds. \] The family $\{H_t^L\}_{t \in \mathbb R}$ describes the heat-flow evolution of $\xi_L$ and solves a backward heat equation. By the work of Newman, there exists a finite constant $\Lambda_L$, called the generalized de Bruijn--Newman constant, such that all the zeros of $H_t^L$ are real if and only if $t \ge \Lambda_L$. The Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH) for $L$ is equivalent to the assertion that $\Lambda_L \le 0$. Dobner established the matching lower bound $\Lambda_L \ge 0$, while de Bruijn proved the upper bound $\Lambda_L \le \tfrac12$. We prove the unconditional uniform bound $\Lambda_L\le953/3200=0.2978125$ for every primitive real-valued
items.authors: Ricardo Freire, Cristian Gonz\'alez-Riquelme, Claudio Mu\~noz, Felipe Poblete, Vicente Salinas

items.title: The Projective Reed-Muller Code from Quartic Curves in the Projective Plane
items.excerpt: We study the Hamming weight enumerator of the projective Reed-Muller code $\mathcal C_{2,4}$ over $\mathbf F_q$, with $\operatorname{char}(\mathbf F_q)>3$. We determine the geometrically reducible and singular contributions by combining incidence counts with counts of plane linear series on a fixed normalization. The line and conic configurations and the genus zero cases give explicit polynomials. The line-cubic and genus one cases give formulas involving class numbers. The genus two contribution is a finite sum over hyperelliptic models, using their point counts over $\mathbf F_q$ and $\mathbf F_{q^2}$ and their rational Weierstrass points. The remaining smooth contribution is the weighted point count distribution of nonhyperelliptic genus three curves.
items.title_zh: 射影平面上四次曲线的射影Reed-Muller码
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究投影 Reed-Muller 码 $\mathcal C_{2,4}$ 在 $\mathbf F_q$ 上的汉明权重枚举器，其中 $\operatorname{char}(\mathbf F_q)>3$。我们通过将发生计数与固定归一化上的平面线性系列计数相结合来确定几何可约和奇异贡献。直线和圆锥曲线配置以及亏格零情况给出显式多项式。线三次和属一例给出了涉及类数的公式。属二贡献是超椭圆模型上的有限和，使用它们在 $\mathbf F_q$ 和 $\mathbf F_{q^2}$ 上的点数及其有理 Weierstrass 点。剩下的平滑贡献是非超椭圆亏格三曲线的加权点数分布。

items.title: Quantum Variance for Hecke--Maass Cusp Forms on the Vertical Geodesic
items.excerpt: Let $X=\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb Z)\backslash\mathbb H$, and let $\{u_j\}$ be an orthonormal basis of even Hecke--Maass cusp forms on $X$ with Laplace eigenvalues $1/4+t_j^2$. For a real-valued $\psi\in C_c^\infty(0,\infty)$, define \[ \mu_j(\psi)=\int_0^\infty\psi(y)|u_j(iy)|^2\,\frac{dy}{y}, \qquad M(\psi)=\frac6\pi\int_0^\infty\psi(y)\,\frac{dy}{y}. \] For $T\ge2$, $1\le U\le T$, and every $\varepsilon>0$, we prove \[ \sum_{\substack{u_j\ {\rm even}\\T<\theta\le1$, $0<\eta<\theta/2$, and every $\varepsilon>0$, if $T^\theta\le U\le T$, then all but \[ O_{\psi,\theta,\eta,\varepsilon} \!\left(T^{1+2\eta+\varepsilon}\right) \] of the even forms with $T<t_j\le T+U$ satisfy $\mu_j(\psi)=M(\psi)+O(T^{-\eta})$. In particular, the exceptional proportion tends to zero in this short spectral interval.
items.title_zh: 赫克的量子方差--垂直测地线上马斯尖点的形成
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $X=\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb Z)\backslash\mathbb H$，并设 $\{u_j\}$ 为 $X$ 上什至 Hecke--Maass 尖点形式的正交基，拉普拉斯特征值为 $1/4+t_j^2$。对于实值 $\psi\in C_c^\infty(0,\infty)$，定义 \[ \mu_j(\psi)=\int_0^\infty\psi(y)|u_j(iy)|^2\,\frac{dy}{y}, \qquad M(\psi)=\frac6\pi\int_0^\infty\psi(y)\,\frac{dy}{y}。 \] 对于 $T\ge2$、$1\le U\le T$ 和每个 $\varepsilon>0$，我们证明 \[ \sum_{\substack{u_j\ {\rm Even}\\T<\theta\le1$、$0<\eta<\theta/2$ 和每个 $\varepsilon>0$，如果 $T^\theta\le U\le T$，那么除了 \[ $T<t_j\le T+U$ 的偶数形式 O_{\psi,\theta,\eta,\varepsilon} \!\left(T^{1+2\eta+\varepsilon}\right) \] 满足 $\mu_j(\psi)=M(\psi)+O(T^{-\eta})$。特别是，在这个短光谱区间内，异常比例趋于零。

items.title: Bowen--Franks groups and minus class groups of imaginary abelian fields
items.excerpt: $\mathrm{Lei}$, $\mathrm{M\ddot{u}ller}$, and $\mathrm{Valli\grave{e}res}$ constructed a directed graph for which the torsion part of the corresponding Bowen--Franks group is related to the minus part of the class group of a cyclotomic number field with prime conductor. We extend this result to a general imaginary abelian field.
items.title_zh: Bowen--假想阿贝尔域的弗兰克群和负类群
items.excerpt_zh: $\mathrm{Lei}$、$\mathrm{M\ddot{u}ller}$和$\mathrm{Valli\grave{e}res}$构造了一个有向图，其中相应的Bowen--Franks群的扭转部分与素数导体分圆数域的类群的负部分相关。我们将这个结果扩展到一般的虚阿贝尔场。

items.title: Non-vanishing of central values of angular Hecke $L$-functions
items.excerpt: In this paper, we evaluate asymptotically the first and second moment of central values of the family of Hecke $L$-functions associated to angular characters over imaginary quadratic number fields of class number one. We use our results to deduce a non-vanishing result concerning these $L$-functions.
items.title_zh: 角度 Hecke $L$ 函数的中心值不为零
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们渐进地评估与第一类虚数二次数域上的角字符相关的 Hecke $L$ 函数族中心值的一阶矩和二阶矩。我们使用我们的结果来推断关于这些 $L$ 函数的非零结果。

items.title: Metric dimension and maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of graph Laplacians
items.excerpt: We study equality between metric dimension and the maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices. These quantities are not ordered in general. Using the standard decomposition associated with twin classes, we separate forced multiplicities from quotient-spectrum contributions. We give complete equality classifications for complete multipartite graphs and core--satellite graphs, and enumerate the multipartite equality graphs by order. For graphs formed by attaching at least two leaves to every vertex of a connected core, the metric dimension and the multiplicity of the eigenvalue $ 1 $ are known; we show that this multiplicity is maximal for both matrices, and uniquely maximal except for $ P_3 $. We enumerate this core--leaf family up to isomorphism and obtain a uniform asymptotic formula by order and metric dimension, together with the quadratic exponential growth rate $ 1/18 $. An exact census of connected graphs of orders two through seven identifies the first separating examples and examples without twins. Finally, for every odd $ r \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 3} $, we study $ \Theta_{2, 2, r} $ and dete
items.authors: Monther Rashed Alfuraidan, Suliman Khan, Lorenzo Sauras Altuzarra
items.title_zh: 图拉普拉斯算子的度量维数和最大特征值重数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究拉普拉斯矩阵和无符号拉普拉斯矩阵的度量维数和最大特征值重数之间的相等性。这些数量一般不订购。使用与孪生类相关的标准分解，我们将强制重数与商谱贡献分开。我们对完整的多元图和核心卫星图给出了完整的等式分类，并按顺序枚举了多元等式图。对于通过将至少两个叶子附加到连接核的每个顶点而形成的图，特征值$1$的度量维度和重数是已知的；我们证明了这两个矩阵的重数都是最大的，并且除了 $ P_3 $ 之外都是唯一最大的。我们将这个核心叶族枚举到同构，并通过阶数和度量维数得到统一的渐近公式，以及二次指数增长率$1/18$。对二阶到七阶连通图的精确普查确定了第一个分离示例和没有双胞胎的示例。最后，对于每个奇数 $ r \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 3} $，我们研究 $ \Theta_{2, 2, r} $ 并检测

items.title: A positivity conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton
items.excerpt: We prove the conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton (2003) that $\frac{1-q}{(q^n;q)_m}\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n}{m}_{q}$ has nonnegative power-series coefficients for $0 <n$, except when $n$ is even and $m\in\{2,n-2\}$. We obtain a polynomial version by bounding a M\"obius correction by first differences of Gaussian coefficients. The proof uses partitions and quadratic and cubic semi-invariants of binary forms. An extension of this bound proves the Reiner--Stanton--White conjecture on positivity of orbit polynomials for flags of subspaces.
items.title_zh: 普雷尔伯格和斯坦顿的实证猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 Prellberg 和 Stanton (2003) 的猜想，即 $\frac{1-q}{(q^n;q)_m}\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n}{m}_{q}$ 对于 $0 <n$ 具有非负幂级数系数，除非 $n$ 为偶数且 $m\in\{2,n-2\}$ 时除外。我们通过高斯系数的一阶差分来限制 M\"obius 校正，得到了一个多项式版本。证明使用了二元形式的划分以及二次和三次半不变量。这个界限的扩展证明了关于子空间标志的轨道多项式的正性的 Reiner--Stanton--White 猜想。

items.title: Vertex Removal and Vertex-Edge Domination
items.excerpt: A vertex $v$ of a graph $G$ $ve$-dominates every edge incident with a vertex in its closed neighborhood $N_{G}[v]$. A set of vertices is a vertex-edge dominating set ($ve$-dominating set) if every edge of $G$ is $ve$-dominated by some vertex in the set. The minimum cardinality of such a set is the vertex-edge domination number $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, also known as the isolation number. In this paper, we study the effect of vertex removal on $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, establish sharp bounds on $\gamma_{ve}(G-v)$ and characterize the vertices whose removal decreases, preserves, or increases $\gamma_{ve}(G)$. Let $V^0(G)$ and $V^+(G)$ denote the sets of vertices whose removal preserves and increases $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, respectively, and let $V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)$ consist of the vertices in $V^0(G)$ belonging to every minimum $ve$-dominating set. We prove that \[ |V^0(G)|\geq3|V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)|+\sum_{v\in V^+(G)} \bigl(\gamma_{ve}(G-v)-\gamma_{ve}(G)+1\bigr). \] In particular, $|V^0(G)|\geq 2|V^+(G)|$. We also prove that every vertex in $V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)$ lies on a cycle and that $V^0(T)\neq\emptyset$ for every tree $T$ of order at least three.
items.authors: Minhui Li, Shumin Zhang, Fengming Dong
items.title_zh: 顶点移除和点边支配
items.excerpt_zh: 图 $G$ $ve$ 的顶点 $v$ - 支配与其闭邻域 $N_{G}[v]$ 中的顶点相交的每条边。如果 $G$ 的每条边都被集合中的某个顶点 $ve$ 支配，则顶点集是顶点边支配集（$ve$-支配集）。这样一个集合的最小基数是点边支配数 $\gamma_{ve}(G)$，也称为隔离数。在本文中，我们研究了顶点移除对 $\gamma_{ve}(G)$ 的影响，在 $\gamma_{ve}(G-v)$ 上建立锐界，并表征移除后会减少、保留或增加 $\gamma_{ve}(G)$ 的顶点。令$V^0(G)$和$V^+(G)$分别表示移除后保留和增加$\gamma_{ve}(G)$的顶点集，并令$V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)$由$V^0(G)$中属于每个最小$ve$支配集的顶点组成。我们证明 \[ |V^0(G)|\geq3|V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)|+\sum_{v\in V^+(G)} \bigl(\gamma_{ve}(G-v)-\gamma_{ve}(G)+1\bigr)。 \] 特别是，$|V^0(G)|\geq 2|V^+(G)|$。我们还证明 $V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)$ 中的每个顶点都位于一个环上，并且 $V^0(T)\neq\emptyset$ 对于每棵树 $T$ 至少为三阶。

items.title: Gaussian Lower Bounds for Distinct Subset Sums in Higher Dimensions
items.excerpt: For sequences of $n$ nonnegative integer vectors in $\mathbb Z^k$ with distinct subset sums, we prove, for fixed $k$, the uniform lower bound $M\ge (C_k-o(1))2^{n/k}/\sqrt n$ for the largest coordinate, where \[ C_k=\sqrt{\frac{2k}{\pi}}\, \frac{(k+1)^{(k-1)/(2k)}}{\sqrt{\lfloor (k+1)^2/4\rfloor}}. \] The proof compares a Gaussian-kernel expectation with a sum over a translated lattice, uniformly over the vector sequence. We optimise the resulting quadratic-form constant using a vertex second-moment certificate. We show that $C_k$ also exceeds the variance constant obtained by optimising an ellipsoidal geometry.
items.title_zh: 高维中不同子集和的高斯下界
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $\mathbb Z^k$ 中具有不同子集和的 $n$ 个非负整数向量序列，我们证明，对于固定 $k$，最大坐标的统一下界 $M\ge (C_k-o(1))2^{n/k}/\sqrt n$，其中 \[ C_k=\sqrt{\frac{2k}{\pi}}\, \frac{(k+1)^{(k-1)/(2k)}}{\sqrt{\lfloor (k+1)^2/4\rfloor}}。 \] 证明将高斯核期望与平移晶格上的总和进行比较，均匀地在向量序列上。我们使用顶点二阶矩证书优化生成的二次形式常数。我们表明 $C_k$ 也超过了通过优化椭圆体几何形状获得的方差常数。

items.title: Partitionability is NP-complete
items.excerpt: We show that the problem of deciding whether a simplicial complex is partitionable is NP-complete in dimensions two and higher, answering a 1995 question of Kleinschmidt and Onn.
items.title_zh: 可分性是 NP 完全的
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了决定单纯复形是否可分的问题在二维及更高维度上是 NP 完全的，回答了 Kleinschmidt 和 Onn 1995 年的问题。

items.title: Tree Lattices and the Neumann-Zagier conjecture
items.excerpt: A tree with integer weights on its vertices presents an integral lattice called a tree lattice. We prove that if a tree lattice is positive definite, then one of the vertex elements is irreducible, i.e. determines a facet of its Voronoi polyhedron. As a corollary, we settle a 1985 conjecture of Neumann and Zagier: if a tree lattice is isometric to the lattice of integer points in Euclidean space, then the tree contains a vertex of weight one.
items.authors: Joshua Evan Greene, Ahmad Issa, Duncan McCoy
items.title_zh: 树格和诺伊曼-扎吉尔猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 顶点上具有整数权重的树呈现出称为树格的积分格。我们证明，如果树格是正定的，则​​其中一个顶点元素是不可约的，即确定其 Voronoi 多面体的一个面。作为推论，我们解决了 Neumann 和 Zagier 1985 年的猜想：如果树格与欧几里德空间中的整数点格等距，那么树包含一个权重为 1 的顶点。

items.title: Subgraph probabilities in random intersection graphs
items.excerpt: Since their introduction by Karo\'nski, Scheinerman, and Singer-Cohen in 90's, random intersection graphs have attracted much attention, mostly due to their various applications. In this article, we establish a general result for the probability that a given small subgraph is present in a random intersection graph. Our theorem applies to a broad range of parameters, including regimes that have not previously been considered in the literature. Moreover, it extends known results and situates them within a broader framework, making this approach a convenient tool for comparing the probabilities of graphs in the random intersection graph model. To prove our main result, we develop new proof techniques that, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been employed in the study of small subgraphs in random intersection graphs. Many special cases and examples are presented as well.
items.title_zh: 随机相交图中的子图概率
items.excerpt_zh: 自从 Karo'nski、Scheinerman 和 Singer-Cohen 在 90 年代提出以来，随机交集图引起了广泛的关注，这主要是由于它们的各种应用。在本文中，我们建立了给定小子图出现在随机交集图中的概率的一般结果。我们的定理适用于广泛的参数，包括以前在文献中未考虑过的制度。此外，它扩展了已知结果并将其置于更广泛的框架内，使该方法成为比较随机相交图模型中图的概率的便捷工具。为了证明我们的主要结果，我们开发了新的证明技术，据我们所知，这些技术以前尚未用于随机交叉图中的小子图的研究。还介绍了许多特殊情况和示例。

items.title: Normal approximation for subgraph counts in random intersection graphs: the case of cliques
items.excerpt: Let $X^{(r)}_n$ denote the number of copies of a complete graph $K_r$ in the random intersection graph model on $n$ vertices. We derive upper bounds on the distance between the standardized version of $X^{(r)}_n$ and the standard normal distribution, measured in both the Kolmogorov and Wasserstein metrics. We complement these results with necessary and sufficient conditions for asymptotic normality. As a byproduct, we provide precise estimates for the variance of $X^{(r)}_n$. In the process, we develop new general techniques for analysing so--called clique covers, which play a crucial role in the study of subgraph probabilities in random intersection graphs.
items.title_zh: 随机相交图中子图计数的正态近似：派系的情况
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $X^{(r)}_n$ 表示随机交集图模型中完整图 $K_r$ 在 $n$ 个顶点上的副本数。我们推导出 $X^{(r)}_n$ 的标准化版本与标准正态分布之间距离的上限，以 Kolmogorov 和 Wasserstein 度量进行测量。我们用渐近正态性的充分必要条件来补充这些结果。作为副产品，我们提供了 $X^{(r)}_n$ 方差的精确估计。在此过程中，我们开发了新的通用技术来分析所谓的派覆盖，这在随机相交图中子图概率的研究中发挥着至关重要的作用。

items.title: The integral $K_0$-ring of the stack of smooth hyperelliptic curves
items.excerpt: We compute the integral $K_0$-ring of the moduli stack $\mathscr H_g$ of smooth hyperelliptic curves of genus $g\ge2$ over a field of characteristic zero. We show that it is a free abelian group of rank $8g+2$ for even $g$ and $8g+4$ for odd $g$. We use the isotypic decomposition of the $K_0$ of a related $\mu_{g+1}$-gerbe to obtain presentations for both even and odd $g$'s from the standard quotient presentation of $\mathscr H_g$. Thus, our technique differs from the $CH^\bullet(\mathscr H_g)$ computations of Edidin--Fulghesu, Fulghesu--Viviani, Di Lorenzo, and the $K_0(\mathscr M_2)$ computation of Edidin--Hu. Using Pagani's description of the inertia stack of $\mathscr H_g$, we apply Riemann--Roch to interpret the rank of $K_0(\mathscr H_g)$ as the number of inertia components. Finally, we compare the $K_0$ and Chow rings of $\mathscr H_g$ through the gamma-filtration and give presentations to the associated graded rings $\operatorname{gr}_{\gamma}K_0(\mathscr H_g)\otimes\mathbb F_p$ for every prime $p$.
items.title_zh: 平滑超椭圆曲线堆栈的积分$K_0$-环
items.excerpt_zh: 我们计算在特征零域上亏格 $g\ge2$ 的平滑超椭圆曲线的模堆栈 $\mathscr H_g$ 的积分 $K_0$ 环。我们证明它是一个自由阿贝尔群，对于偶数$g$来说它是一个等级为$8g+2$的自由交换群，对于奇数$g$来说它是一个等级为$8g+4$的自由阿贝尔群。我们使用相关 $\mu_{g+1}$-gerbe 的 $K_0$ 的同型分解，从 $\mathscr H_g$ 的标准商表示中获得偶数和奇数 $g$ 的表示。因此，我们的技术不同于 Edidin--Fulghesu、Fulghesu--Viviani、Di Lorenzo 的 $CH^\bullet(\mathscr H_g)$ 计算，以及 Edidin--Hu 的 $K_0(\mathscr M_2)$ 计算。利用 Pagani 对 $\mathscr H_g$ 惯性堆栈的描述，我们应用 Riemann--Roch 将 $K_0(\mathscr H_g)$ 的秩解释为惯性分量的数量。最后，我们通过伽马过滤比较 $\mathscr H_g$ 的 $K_0$ 和 Chow 环，并对每个素数 $p$ 给出相关的分级环 $\operatorname{gr}_{\gamma}K_0(\mathscr H_g)\otimes\mathbb F_p$ 的演示。

items.title: Hodge Theory of Novikov Type Landau--Ginzburg Models
items.excerpt: We establish a strong Hodge decomposition theorem for Novikov type Landau--Ginzburg models, that is, triples $(M,g,\theta)$ consisting of a non-compact complete K\"ahler manifold $(M,g)$ and a non-trivial closed holomorphic one-form $\theta$ on $M$.Under the well-tameness condition and under the assumption that $M$ is Stein, we prove that the space of $L^{2}$-forms on $M$ admits an orthogonal decomposition into the space of harmonic forms of the twisted Laplacian $\Delta_{\theta}$ and the images of the twisted Dolbeault operators $\bar\partial+\theta\wedge$ and $\bar\partial^{\dagger}+\iota_{\bar\theta^{\sharp}}$; moreover, the harmonic space is concentrated in degree $n=\dim_{\C}M$ and is isomorphic to the Milnor rings of $\theta$. As applications, we endow the complement of a hyperplane arrangement with a complete cylindrical K\"ahler metric, and we show that the differential of a master function with nonresonant weights is well-tamed with respect to this metric. After passing to a log resolution in the non-normal-crossing case; we then apply the results to the Yang--Yang functional of the Gaudin model, whose critical points are the
items.title_zh: 诺维科夫型Landau--Ginzburg模型的Hodge理论
items.excerpt_zh: 我们建立了Novikov型Landau-Ginzburg模型的强Hodge分解定理，即由一个非紧完备K\"ahler流形$(M,g)$和$M$上的非平凡闭全纯一型$\theta$组成的三元组$(M,g,\theta)$。在良好驯服条件下，假设$M$是Stein，我们证明了空间$M$ 上的 $L^{2}$-forms 允许正交分解到扭曲拉普拉斯 $\Delta_{\theta}$ 的调和形式空间以及扭曲 Dolbeault 算子 $\bar\partial+\theta\wedge$ 和 $\bar\partial^{\dagger}+\iota_{\bar\theta^{\sharp}}$ 的图像，此外，调和空间集中在度上； $n=\dim_{\C}M$ 并且与 $\theta$ 的 Milnor 环同构。作为应用，我们赋予超平面排列的补集一个完整的圆柱 K\"ahler 度量，并且我们表明具有非共振权重的主函数的微分对于该度量来说是很好的驯服。非正态交叉情况下传递到日志解析后；然后我们将结果应用到 Gaudin 模型的 Yang--Yang 泛函中，其临界点是

items.title: Secondary Chow Invariants beyond Lawson--Massey Products
items.excerpt: We construct secondary Chow invariants that cannot be recovered from Lawson--Massey realization. For every smooth complex projective curve $C$ of positive genus and every $n\ge2$, explicit cubical defining systems yield $n$ distinct Massey values in $\rm{CH}^{3}(C\times P^{2},1)$, with zero full indeterminacy, forming a cyclic group of order $n$. All corresponding triples have identical morphic classes and zero morphic, Lawson, and singular Massey brackets, despite nonzero target groups. The values are detected by the Weil pairing. We further construct secondary quotient classes of every finite order on smooth projective varieties with ample canonical bundle in every dimension at least two, and prove that generically finite pullbacks of coprime degree preserve their exact orders. These constructions obstruct integral and prime-local motivic formality, although the corresponding brackets become $\{0\}$ after reduction modulo every integer $m\ge2$. All specified values are torsion and vanish after rationalization.
items.title_zh: Lawson 之外的二级 Chow 不变量--Massey Products
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构建了无法从 Lawson-Massey 实现中恢复的二级 Chow 不变量。对于正亏格的每个平滑复射影曲线 $C$ 和每个 $n\ge2$，显式立方定义系统在 $\rm{CH}^{3}(C\times P^{2},1)$ 中产生 $n$ 个不同的梅西值，完全不确定性为零，形成 $n$ 阶的循环群。尽管目标组非零，但所有相应的三元组都具有相同的形态类别和零形态、劳森和奇异梅西括号。这些值是通过 Weil 配对检测的。我们进一步在平滑射影簇上构造每个有限阶的次商类，在每个维度上至少有两个充足的规范束，并证明互素度的一般有限回撤保留了它们的精确阶。这些结构阻碍了积分和素局部动机形式，尽管相应的括号在对每个整数 $m\ge2$ 取模后变成 $\{0\}$ 。所有规定值均为扭转值，合理化后消失。

items.title: Terracini loci of tangential varieties of Veroneseans
items.excerpt: The Terracini locus of a projective variety tells us the sets of points at which Terracini's lemma will fail to recover the dimension of the corresponding secant variety. We study the Terracini loci of tangential varieties of Veronese varieties, classifying several cases, including a complete classification of the Terracini loci of tangential varieties to rational normal curves. We also show that many Terracini loci involve only sets with "intratangent pairs" that lie on the same tangent space to the underlying Veronese variety. Finally, we give some applications to algebraic statistics, showing that osculating varieties of Veronese varieties are moment varieties for local mixtures of location families and connecting Terracini loci to local identifiability.
items.title_zh: 维罗内斯切线变种的泰拉西尼位点
items.excerpt_zh: 射影簇的泰拉西尼轨迹告诉我们泰拉西尼引理将无法恢复相应割线簇维数的点集。我们研究了Veronese变种的切向变种的Terracini轨迹，对几种情况进行了分类，包括将切向变种的Terracini轨迹完整分类为有理正态曲线。我们还表明，许多泰拉西尼基因座仅涉及具有“内切线对”的集合，这些“内切线对”位于与底层维罗纳簇相同的切线空间上。最后，我们给出了代数统计的一些应用，表明维罗纳簇的密切簇是位置族局部混合的矩簇，并将泰拉西尼基因座与局部可识别性联系起来。

items.title: Nef complexity of klt Fano varieties: the full spectrum and classification below two
items.excerpt: Let $X$ be a complex klt Fano variety. We study the rational total index $\tau_X$ and the nef complexity $c_X=\dim X+\rho(X)-\tau_X$. Previous joint work of the author with Enwright, Filipazzi, Gongyo, Moraga, Svaldi, and Wang established the corresponding nonnegativity and zero-case characterization in the broader framework of a special class of generalized log Calabi--Yau pairs. Here we give a direct proof in the Fano setting, prove that there is no value strictly between zero and one, and classify all klt Fano varieties with $c_X<2$, without assuming $\mathbb Q$-factoriality. At complexity one, after splitting off projective-space factors, the remaining factor is a normal quadric of Picard number one, a linear blow-up of projective space, or an integral $(1,1)$ hypersurface in a product of projective spaces. If $1<2$, only two weighted-projective families occur; in particular, no smooth Fano variety has nef complexity strictly between one and two. We also determine the spectrum when the dimension is allowed to vary: \[ \{0\}\cup\left\{2-\frac2q \ \middle| \ q\in\mathbb Z_{\geq2}\right\} \cup(\mathbb Q\cap[2,\infty)). \] Most proofs
items.title_zh: klt Fano 品种的 Nef 复杂性：全谱和以下两个分类
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $X$ 为复杂的 klt Fano 簇。我们研究有理总指数 $\tau_X$ 和 nef 复杂度 $c_X=\dim X+\rho(X)-\tau_X$。作者之前与 Enwright、Filipazzi、Gongyo、Moraga、Svaldi 和 Wang 的联合工作在一类特殊的广义对数卡拉比 - 丘对的更广泛的框架中建立了相应的非负性和零情况表征。这里我们在 Fano 设置中给出直接证明，证明不存在严格介于 0 和 1 之间的值，并对所有 $c_X<2$ 的 klt Fano 变种进行分类，而不假设 $\mathbb Q$-阶乘。在复杂度为 1 的情况下，在分解射影空间因子后，剩下的因子是皮卡德一号的法向二次曲面、射影空间的线性放大或射影空间乘积中的积分 $(1,1)$ 超曲面。如果$1<2$，则仅出现两个加权投影族；特别是，没有平滑的 Fano 变体的复杂度严格介于 1 和 2 之间。我们还确定了允许尺寸变化时的光谱：\[ \{0\}\cup\left\{2-\frac2q \ \middle| \ q\in\mathbb Z_{\geq2}\right\} \cup(\mathbb Q\cap[2,\infty))。 \] 大多数样张

items.title: Lattice Moduli and Residual Atoms
items.excerpt: We study prescribed holomorphic lattices for regular-singular connections and residual factors of quantum $F$-bundles. For an arbitrary ordered monodromy spectrum, we classify the fully framed local groupoid: each residue fibre is a discrete affine space of dimension $r(r-1)$, with a unique normal form and trivial stabilisers. We then analyse elementary changes of lattice. A strictly positive integral residue difference obstructs the oriented wall; otherwise, in arbitrary rank, the extending normal-form arcs form an affine torsor of relative dimension $r(r-1)$, and specialisation to the shifted residue slice is polynomial and triangular by root height. Adjacent walls exhibit the composite-root correction dictated by the type-$A$ root-subgroup relations, while an example over the dual numbers detects a nilpotent saturation defect. For one-branch $F$-bundles, the scalar branch is recovered from the residual trace, and scalar residualisation yields a symmetric monoidal equivalence with zero-branch $F$-bundles. This construction yields residual atoms, functorial Jordan strata, and a residual chemical formula compatible with blow-ups and p
items.title_zh: 晶格模量和剩余原子
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了规则奇异连接的规定全纯晶格和量子$F$-丛的剩余因子。对于任意有序的单峰谱，我们对完全框架的局部群群进行分类：每个残差纤维是维度 $r(r-1)$ 的离散仿射空间，具有独特的范式和平凡的稳定器。然后我们分析晶格的基本变化。严格正的积分残差差阻碍定向壁；否则，在任意等级中，扩展范式弧形成相对维度$r(r-1)$的仿射torsor，并且对移位残差切片的特化是多项式的并且按根高度是三角形的。相邻壁表现出由类型 $A$ 根子群关系决定的复合根校正，而双数上的示例检测到幂零饱和缺陷。对于单分支$F$-束，标量分支从残差迹中恢复，并且标量残差产生与零分支$F$-束的对称幺半等价。这种结构产生残余原子、函子乔丹层以及与爆炸和 p 兼容的残余化学式

items.title: The $m=2$ amplituhedron is a positive geometry
items.excerpt: Amplituhedra are semi-algebraic sets of fundamental importance in particle physics. Their discovery initiated the field of Positive Geometry. We settle a central conjecture in this field: we show that the $m=2$ amplituhedron is a positive geometry. Our main new tool is a Hodge-theoretic criterion for being a positive geometry, connecting the work of Brown--Dupont with the original setup of Arkani-Hamed--Bai--Lam.
items.authors: Joris Koefler, Dmitrii Pavlov, Rainer Sinn
items.title_zh: $m=2$ 幅面体是正几何
items.excerpt_zh: 幅面体是粒子物理学中具有根本重要性的半代数集。他们的发现开创了正几何领域。我们解决了该领域的一个中心猜想：我们证明 $m=2$ 振幅面体是正几何。我们主要的新工具是成为正几何的霍奇理论准则，将布朗杜邦的工作与阿卡尼哈米德拜林的原始设置联系起来。

items.title: Rational analytic prismatization
items.excerpt: We develop a general theory of analytic prismatization with $\mathbb{Q}_p$-coefficients in rigid analytic geometry over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. We prove an equivalence of perfect complexes on the perfect analytic prismatization modulo Frobenius with perfect complexes on the relative Fargues--Fontaine curve for any smooth partially proper rigid analytic variety. In particular, we explain how this equivalence conceptualizes the decompletion techniques by passing to locally analytic vectors which appear in (geometric) Sen theory
items.authors: Johannes Ansch\"utz, Arthur-C\'esar Le Bras, Juan Esteban Rodr\'iguez Camargo, Peter Scholze
items.title_zh: 理性分析棱镜化
items.excerpt_zh: 我们利用 $\mathbb{Q}_p$ 上刚性解析几何中的 $\mathbb{Q}_p$ 系数发展了解析棱镜化的一般理论。我们证明了完美解析棱镜化模 Frobenius 上的完美复形与任何光滑部分真刚性解析簇的相对 Fargues-Fontaine 曲线上的完美复形的等价性。特别是，我们解释了这种等价如何通过传递到（几何）Sen 理论中出现的局部解析向量来概念化反完成技术

items.title: Cram\'{e}r-type moderate deviations and precise large deviations for the elephant random walk with random step sizes
items.excerpt: In this paper, we focuses on how the distribution of random step sizes affects Cram\'{e}r-type moderate deviations and precise large deviations for the elephant random walk with random step sizes. First, with sub-exponential moment condition of random step sizes, we establish Cram\'{e}r-type moderate deviation results. Consequently, moderate deviation principles are obtained. Secondly, for random step sizes with sub-exponential tails, we establish a large deviation principle on tail probabilities. Finally, for random step sizes with regularly varying tails, we obtain precise large deviations.
items.authors: Xiequan Fan, Shuyuan Liang, Dongxue Ma
items.title_zh: 具有随机步长的大象随机游走的 Cram\'{e}r 型中等偏差和精确大偏差
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们重点研究随机步长的分布如何影响具有随机步长的大象随机游走的 Cram\'{e}r 型中度偏差和精确大偏差。首先，在随机步长的次指数矩条件下，我们建立了Cram\'{e}r型适度偏差结果。由此，得到了适度偏差原则。其次，对于具有次指数尾部的随机步长，我们建立了尾部概率的大偏差原理。最后，对于具有规则变化尾部的随机步长，我们获得了精确的大偏差。

items.title: Least singular values of Gaussian matrices with deterministic shifts
items.excerpt: Let $A$ be a deterministic real square matrix and $G$ a standard Gaussian matrix. We determine $\E\smin(A+G)$, up to universal constants, in terms of the singular values of $A$. The expectation is comparable to the square root of the smallest zero of the expected characteristic polynomial of $(A+G)^{\top}(A+G)$. This resolves Problem~3 in Tikhomirov's ICM 2022 survey. We also prove that the zeros of the expected characteristic polynomial are majorized by the expected ordered eigenvalues of $(A+G)^{\top}(A+G)$.
items.authors: Xuanang Hu, Zeyan Song, Xinglong Wu
items.title_zh: 具有确定性平移的高斯矩阵的最小奇异值
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $A$ 为确定性实方矩阵，$G$ 为标准高斯矩阵。我们根据 $A$ 的奇异值确定 $\E\smin(A+G)$，直到通用常数。该期望相当于 $(A+G)^{\top}(A+G)$ 期望特征多项式的最小零的平方根。这解决了 Tikhomirov 的 ICM 2022 调查中的问题~3。我们还证明了预期特征多项式的零点主要由 $(A+G)^{\top}(A+G)$ 的预期有序特征值决定。

items.title: Supercritical Branching Random Walks on Nested Lattices
items.excerpt: In classical models of supercritical continuous-time branching random walks (BRWs) on a $d$-dimensional lattice, the dimension $d$ is typically assumed to be fixed. When comparing the exponential growth rate $\lambda_0$ of a particle population in a BRW with a single branching source across lattices of different dimensions, a question arises whether it is possible to construct a family of random walks on $d$-dimensional lattices such that the model for a $(d+1)$-dimensional lattice ``inherits'' the properties of the model for a $d$-dimensional lattice in a meaningful sense. To address this question, the paper introduces the concept of a ``random walk on nested lattices'' and investigates the effect of the dimension $d$ on particle population growth using the ``inheritance'' condition. For an arbitrary symmetric random walk, a limit theorem is proved on the representation of the positive eigenvalue of the evolution operator for the mean particle numbers in terms of the process parameters and the dimension $d$, as the branching source intensity $\beta \to \infty$. The theorem shows that the influence of dimension persists even for very
items.title_zh: 嵌套格子上的超临界分支随机游走
items.excerpt_zh: 在 $d$ 维晶格上的超临界连续时间分支随机游走 (BRW) 的经典模型中，通常假设维度 $d$ 是固定的。当比较 BRW 中粒子群的指数增长率 $\lambda_0$ 与跨不同维度晶格的单个分支源时，出现了一个问题：是否可以在 $d$ 维晶格上构造一系列随机游走，使得 $(d+1)$ 维晶格的模型在有意义的意义上“继承”$d$ 维晶格模型的属性。为了解决这个问题，本文引入了“嵌套格子上的随机游走”的概念，并使用“继承”条件研究了维度 $d$ 对粒子种群增长的影响。对于任意对称随机游走，证明了将平均粒子数的演化算子的​​正特征值表示为过程参数和维度 $d$ 的极限定理，即分支源强度 $\beta \to \infty$。该定理表明，即使对于非常大的情况，尺寸的影响仍然存在。

items.title: Central Limit Theorem for continuous $N$-particle systems in fixed- and high-temperature: single level
items.excerpt: We characterize central limit theorems for polynomial linear statistics of continuous $N$-particle systems on $\mathbb R$, in both the fixed-temperature regime $\theta=\beta/2>0$ and the high-temperature regime $N\theta\to\gamma>0$. In each regime, we give necessary and sufficient conditions in terms of the coefficients of the logarithmic Bessel generating function, together with an explicit combinatorial formula for the limiting covariance. At fixed temperature, this formula recovers the classical second-order free moment--cumulant relation, up to the factor $1/\theta$; at high temperature, it yields new second-order free $\gamma$-cumulants and their covariance relations. The proof combines moment extraction through Dunkl operators with a topological expansion of the logarithmic multivariate Bessel function indexed by ribbon graphs on surfaces. This expansion gives a topological interpretation of the free-cumulants: only genus zero contributes at fixed temperature, whereas arbitrarily high genera contribute at high temperature. As applications, we prove that $\beta$-addition preserves the CLT in both regimes and determine its limitin
items.title_zh: 固定温度和高温下连续 $N$ 粒子系统的中心极限定理：单水平
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在固定温度状态 $\theta=\beta/2>0$ 和高温状态 $N\theta\to\gamma>0$ 上描述了 $\mathbb R$ 上连续 $N$ 粒子系统的多项式线性统计的中心极限定理。在每种情况下，我们根据对数贝塞尔生成函数的系数给出必要和充分的条件，以及限制协方差的显式组合公式。在固定温度下，该公式恢复了经典的二阶自由矩-累积关系，最高可达因子$1/θ$；在高温下，它产生新的二阶自由 $\gamma$-累积量及其协方差关系。该证明将通过 Dunkl 算子进行的矩提取与由曲面上的带状图索引的对数多元贝塞尔函数的拓扑展开相结合。这种展开给出了自由累积量的拓扑解释：只有零属在固定温度下有贡献，而任意高的属在高温下有贡献。作为应用，我们证明 $\beta$ 加法在两种情况下都保留了 CLT，并确定了其限制

items.title: Large Deviations in Stochastic Dynamics: A Hamiltonian Perspective
items.excerpt: These lecture notes present an introduction to large deviations in stochastic dynamical systems, adapted from a lecture series given at the Les Houches school ``Large Deviations: Theory and Applications'' in July 2024. The exposition develops the theory through a unified methodology: WKB analysis of backward Kolmogorov equations, which reveals the Hamiltonian structure underlying all large deviation principles considered here. We treat three asymptotic regimes systematically. First, the small-noise limit for stochastic differential equations and the large-volume limit for Markov jump processes, where the Large Deviation Principle emerges from the Law of Large Numbers through progressively finer characterizations of fluctuations. Second, the long-time limit combined with small noise, yielding the quasipotential formalism for metastability and transition rates in both equilibrium and nonequlibrium systems. Third, the long-time limit at finite noise, connecting to spectral methods via tilted generators and enabling reduction of multiscale systems. We survey computational approaches including minimum action methods, their geometric varian
items.authors: Lorenzo Cirigliano, William D. Pi\~{n}eros, Anna Poggialini, Grant M. Rotskoff, Eric Vanden-Eijnden
items.title_zh: 随机动力学中的大偏差：哈密顿观点
items.excerpt_zh: 这些讲义介绍了随机动力系统中的大偏差，改编自 Les Houches 学校 2024 年 7 月“大偏差：理论与应用”系列讲座。该讲座通过统一的方法发展了该理论：向后 Kolmogorov 方程的 WKB 分析，揭示了此处考虑的所有大偏差原理背后的哈密顿结构。我们系统地处理三种渐近机制。首先，随机微分方程的小噪声极限和马尔可夫跳跃过程的大体积极限，其中大偏差原理通过逐渐精细的波动表征从大数定律中出现。其次，长时间极限与小噪声相结合，产生了平衡和非平衡系统中亚稳态和转变率的准势形式。第三，有限噪声的长期限制，通过倾斜发生器连接到谱方法并能够减少多尺度系统。我们调查计算方法，包括最小动作方法、它们的几何变量

items.title: A functional central limit theorem for the KPZ equation with narrow wedge initial data
items.excerpt: In this article, we consider the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) equation with narrow wedge initial data. We prove a functional central limit theorem for the spatial average of the solution, which solves an open problem from Gu and Pu (2025). Our main tool is Clark-Ocone formula from Malliavin calculus, combined with an in-depth analysis of the increments of the solution. The main step is a moment bound for time increments of the normalized spatial integral. For this, we introduce a new technique, called a ``common-ray'' change of variables. Using the fact that Malliavin derivative of the solution satisfies a Chapman-Kolmogorov relation, we reduce the kernel differences at two times to spatial increments at one common time.
items.authors: Raluca M. Balan, Le Chen, Jinxin Wang
items.title_zh: 窄楔初始数据KPZ方程的函数中心极限定理
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们考虑具有窄楔形初始数据的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) 方程。我们证明了解的空间平均值的功能中心极限定理，它解决了 Gu 和 Pu (2025) 的开放问题。我们的主要工具是来自 Malliavin 微积分的 Clark-Ocone 公式，并结合对解的增量的深入分析。主要步骤是归一化空间积分的时间增量的矩限制。为此，我们引入了一种新技术，称为变量的“共同射线”变化。利用解的 Malliavin 导数满足 Chapman-Kolmogorov 关系这一事实，我们将两次的核差异减少到一次公共时间的空间增量。

items.title: From Hermite Chaos to an Attractive Log-Gas: Explicit High-Rank Limits of Iterated-Logarithm and Tail Constants
items.excerpt: Let $Z$ be a standard Hermite process of order $m\ge2$ and Hurst index $H\in(1/2,1)$. For $d2$, let $Y$ be the variance-normalized version of the weighted integral $\int_0^1 x^{-d}\,\mathrm dZ(x)$. Its right tail satisfies $ \log\Pr\{Y>t\}\sim -\frac12\left(\frac{t}{\Lambda_m}\right)^{2m}, t\to\infty, $ where the positive constant $\Lambda_m$ admits an infinite-dimensional variational representation. The same constant governs the sharp law of the iterated logarithm for weighted sums of nonlinear functions of long-memory Gaussian sequences. A general closed-form evaluation at finite order is not known. As $m\to\infty$ with $H$ and $d$ fixed, the normalized constants $\sqrt{m!}\,\Lambda_m$ decrease to an explicit positive function of $H$ and $d$, with relative error $O(m^{-1})$. This function also gives a lower bound for the normalized constant at every finite order. An exact R\'enyi variational representation at each order yields, in the high-rank limit, the entropy--energy variational problem of an attractive logarithmic gas. items.title_zh: 从埃尔米特混沌到有吸引力的对数气体：迭代对数和尾常数的显式高阶极限
items.excerpt_zh: 令$Z$ 为$m\ge2$ 阶和Hurst 索引$H\in(1/2,1)$ 的标准Hermite 过程。对于 $d2$，令 $Y$ 为加权积分 $\int_0^1 x^{-d}\,\mathrm dZ(x)$ 的方差归一化版本。它的右尾满足 $ \log\Pr\{Y>t\}\sim -\frac12\left(\frac{t}{\Lambda_m}\right)^{2m}, t\to\infty, $ 其中正常数 $\Lambda_m$ 允许无限维变分表示。相同的常数控制着长记忆高斯序列的非线性函数的加权和的迭代对数的锐律。有限阶的一般封闭式评估尚不清楚。当 $m\to\infty$ 固定 $H$ 和 $d$ 时，归一化常数 $\sqrt{m!}\,\Lambda_m$ 减小为 $H$ 和 $d$ 的显式正函数，相对误差为 $O(m^{-1})$。该函数还给出了每个有限阶的归一化常数的下界。在高阶极限下，每个阶的精确 R\'enyi 变分表示都会产生有吸引力的对数气体的熵-能量变分问题。极限自由能通过 Selberg 积分和 Barnes $G$ 函数进行评估。对于$d\le0$，c

items.title: Chaotic CLT using Poisson Fourth Moment Theorem and Graph Theory
items.excerpt: In this article, we consider the parabolic Anderson model and the hyperbolic Anderson model in dimension 1, driven by a time-independent L\'evy noise, which is either white, or colored with integrable coloration kernel $\kappa$. Using a Poisson version of the Fourth Moment Theorem due to D\"obler, Vidotto and Zheng (2018), we prove that the spatial integral of the solution satisfies a central limit theorem. We prove that this result also holds for the hyperbolic Anderson model in dimension $d=2$, if in addition $\kappa$ is bounded. To estimate the fourth cumulant of the projection of the spatial integral on a fixed chaos, we develop a novel technique using graph theory, which allows us to handle some intricate integrals involving the modified contractions.
items.title_zh: 使用泊松四阶矩定理和图论的混沌 CLT
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们考虑 1 维中的抛物线安德森模型和双曲安德森模型，由时间无关的 L\'evy 噪声驱动，该噪声要么是白色，要么是用可积着色内核 $\kappa$ 着色的。使用 D\"obler、Vidotto 和 Cheng (2018) 提出的第四矩定理的泊松版本，我们证明解的空间积分满足中心极限定理。我们证明这个结果也适用于维度 $d=2$ 的双曲安德森模型，如果另外 $\kappa$ 有界。为了估计空间积分在固定混沌上的投影的第四累积量，我们开发了一种使用图论的新技术，这使我们能够处理一些涉及修改收缩的复杂积分。

items.title: Iterated Lavrentiev regularization under random noise: variational source conditions and rates in expectation
items.excerpt: The convergence theory of iterated Lavrentiev regularization for nonlinear monotone ill-posed equations is deterministic: the data error is bounded by a known level that the discrepancy principle uses explicitly. Under Gaussian noise no such bound exists. For a discretized two-dimensional nonlinear inverse source problem for the Poisson equation, we analyse convergence in a finite-energy Gaussian noise model, keeping the linearized and nonlinear cases apart. For the linearized iteration the noisy and noise-free iterates differ by one resolvent applied to the noise; this gives an exact singular-value variance formula, a priori rates in expectation, and the main result: for a family of discretizations whose distance functions are bounded uniformly in the mesh, the rate is governed by that decay, which relaxes the classical range condition. The rate degrades gracefully, down to logarithmic, as the underlying continuum error loses smoothness, and a balancing rule attains it without knowing the smoothness. items.authors: Ankit Singh, Hemant Sharma, Kiran Davuluri
items.title_zh: 随机噪声下的迭代拉夫连季耶夫正则化：变分源条件和期望速率
