items.title: A noise-level-free parameter-choice rule for iterated Lavrentiev regularization of nonlinear potential monotone ill-posed problems
items.excerpt: We consider nonlinear ill-posed operator equations $F(x)=y$ in a Hilbert space, where $F$ is monotone with a Lipschitz continuous Fr\'echet derivative that is self-adjoint near the solution $x^\dg$ (a locally \emph{potential} operator), and only noisy data $y^\delta$ with unknown noise norm $\delta:=\|y-y^\delta\|$ is available. For the nonstationary iterated Lavrentiev regularization \[ x_{k+1}^\delta=x_k^\delta-\bigl(F'(x_k^\delta)+\alpha_kI\bigr)^{-1}\bigl(F(x_k^\delta)-y^\delta+\alpha_k(x_k^\delta-x_0)\bigr), \] all classical stopping rules require $\delta$. We analyze a \emph{noise-level-free} parameter-choice rule of retrospective type, selecting a minimizer $k_*$ of $\theta(k,y^\delta)=\|F(x_k^\delta)-y^\delta\|^2/\alpha_k^2$ over a finite computed window. Under a standard noise condition (necessary in view of the Bakushinskii veto) the rule is well defined and $\alpha_{k_*}^2\ge c\,\delta/\|x_0-x^\dg\|$. If moreover $x_0-x^\dg\in\R(F'(x^\dg))$ and $k_*\ge1$, we prove $\|x_{k_*}^\delta-x^\dg\|=O(\sqrt{\delta_*}+\sqrt{\delta})$ with the computable $\delta_*=\|F(x_{k_*}^\delta)-y^\delta\|$ satisfying $\kappa\delta\le\delta_*\le C
items.title_zh: 非线性势单调病态问题迭代拉夫连季耶夫正则化的无噪声水平参数选择规则
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑希尔伯特空间中的非线性病态算子方程 $F(x)=y$，其中 $F$ 与 Lipschitz 连续 Fr\'echet 导数单调，该导数在解 $x^\dg$ 附近自伴（局部 \emph{潜在} 算子），并且只有具有未知噪声范数 $\delta:=\|y-y^\delta\|$ 的噪声数据 $y^\delta$ 可用。对于非平稳迭代 Lavrentiev 正则化 \[ x_{k+1}^\delta=x_k^\delta-\bigl(F'(x_k^\delta)+\alpha_kI\bigr)^{-1}\bigl(F(x_k^\delta)-y^\delta+\alpha_k(x_k^\delta-x_0)\bigr), \] 所有经典停止规则都需要 $\delta$。我们分析了回顾性类型的\emph{无噪声水平}参数选择规则，在有限的计算窗口上选择$\theta(k,y^\delta)=\|F(x_k^\delta)-y^\delta\|^2/\alpha_k^2$的最小化器$k_*$。在标准噪声条件下（考虑到巴库辛斯基否决权，这是必要的），规则是明确定义的，$\alpha_{k_*}^2\ge c\,\delta/\|x_0-x^\dg\|$。此外，如果 $x_0-x^\dg\in\R(F'(x^\dg))$ 和 $k_*\ge1$，我们用可计算证明 $\|x_{k_*}^\delta-x^\dg\|=O(\sqrt{\delta_*}+\sqrt{\delta})$ $\delta_*=\|F(x_{k_*}^\delta)-y^\delta\|$ 满足 $\kappa\delta\le\delta_*\le C

items.title: Data-driven accelerated multigrid method for Riesz space fractional diffusion equations
items.excerpt: The multigrid method is one of the most efficient iterative methods for solving large structured linear systems, and its efficiency stems from the complementarity between the smoother and the coarse grid correction. In this paper, we consider the block Toeplitz linear system obtained by discretizing time dependent Riesz space fractional diffusion equations, and employ the weighted Jacobi iterative method as a smoother. The weighted Jacobi smoother features a simple structure and low computational cost, yet its smoothing property is highly dependent on the relaxation parameter. We adopt Gaussian process regression to select the relaxation parameter to accelerate the convergence of the multigrid method. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical analysis, which simultaneously verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the data-driven parameter selection strategy.
items.title_zh: Riesz 空间分数扩散方程的数据驱动加速多重网格方法
items.excerpt_zh: 多重网格方法是求解大型结构化线性系统最有效的迭代方法之一，其效率源于平滑网格修正和粗网格修正之间的互补性。在本文中，我们考虑通过离散时间相关的 Riesz 空间分数扩散方程获得的块 Toeplitz 线性系统，并采用加权 Jacobi 迭代方法作为平滑器。加权雅可比平滑器具有结构简单、计算成本低的特点，但其平滑特性高度依赖于松弛参数。我们采用高斯过程回归来选择松弛参数来加速多重网格方法的收敛。数值实验验证了理论分析，同时验证了数据驱动参数选择策略的有效性和优越性。

items.title: Structure-Preserving Numerical Schemes for a Time-Fractional Porous Medium Equation with Nonlocal Pressure
items.excerpt: In this work, we study numerical approximations of the equation \begin{equation} \partial_t^\alpha u-\nabla\cdot\left(u^{m-1}\nabla(-\Delta)^{-\sigma}u\right)=0, \end{equation} where $0<\alpha<1$, $0<\sigma<1$ and $m>1$. The Caputo derivative is discretized by the L1 formula, while the nonlinear nonlocal flux is approximated by a conservative upwind finite-difference scheme. We establish several structural properties of the implicit scheme in arbitrary space dimension, including a discrete maximum principle, non-negativity, mass conservation, $\ell^\infty$ and $\ell^2$ stability, existence of non-negative discrete solutions, and a discrete energy-dissipation estimate. Our assumptions include natural symmetry, a sign condition on the sum of the directional coefficients, and decay on the discrete weights. We also derive a consistency estimate for the complete nonlinear spatial operator. For rigorous convergence analysis, we restrict ourselves to one space dimension and introduce the cumulative variable associated with the density. This transforms the discrete problem into a monotone approximation of an equation involving the fractional
items.title_zh: 具有非局部压力的时间分数式多孔介质方程的保结构数值方案
items.excerpt_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究方程 \begin{equation} \partial_t^\alpha u-\nabla\cdot\left(u^{m-1}\nabla(-\Delta)^{-\sigma}u\right)=0, \end{equation} 的数值近似，其中 $0<\alpha<1$、$0<\sigma<1$ 和 $m>1$。 Caputo 导数由 L1 公式离散化，而非线性非局部通量则由保守的迎风有限差分格式近似。我们在任意空间维度上建立了隐式格式的几个结构性质，包括离散最大原理、非负性、质量守恒、$\ell^\infty$ 和 $\ell^2$ 稳定性、非负离散解的存在性以及离散能量耗散估计。我们的假设包括自然对称性、方向系数之和的符号条件以及离散权重的衰减。我们还推导出完整非线性空间算子的一致性估计。为了进行严格的收敛分析，我们将自己限制在一个空间维度，并引入与密度相关的累积变量。这将离散问题转换为涉及分数的方程的单调近似

items.title: Low Residuals, Wrong Value: Learning the Viscosity Solution of Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs Equations with PINNs
items.excerpt: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and other residual-trained solvers judge a candidate solution by the size of its sampled PDE residual. For first-order Hamilton-Jacobi equations this is not sufficient: the same equation and boundary data admit Lipschitz almost-everywhere solutions that differ from the viscosity solution by $O(1)$ while violating the equation only on sets of measure zero. We study whether residual minimization selects such solutions in a fixed-horizon pursuit-evasion game whose Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs value function is known in closed form on the circle $S^1$ and on the flat tori $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ and $\mathbb{T}^{4}$. We train four neural parameterizations with ten seeds on each geometry, 120 runs in total. A standard network with periodic Fourier features converges to folded almost-everywhere solutions in all 30 runs: small residuals and the expected capture-layer gradient, yet values that are wrong over most of the domain. A network with periodicity imposed through the loss recovers the viscosity solution in one and two dimensions but becomes unreliable in four. Two parameterizations that receive the geodesic
items.authors: Raul Jimenez, Pablo Tejerina-P\'erez, Leonid Sarieddine, Pedro Taranc\'on-\'Alvarez, Marisol Traforetti, Pau Sol\'e-Vilar\'o, Oleksii Ignatenko, Nazar Tkach, Pavlos Protopapas
items.title_zh: 残差低，值错误：使用 PINN 学习 Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs 方程的粘度解
items.excerpt_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 和其他残差训练求解器通过采样的 PDE 残差的大小来判断候选解。对于一阶 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程，这还不够：相同的方程和边界数据几乎处处允许 Lipschitz 解与粘度解相差 $O(1)$，而仅在测度为零的集合上违反方程。我们研究残差最小化是否在固定范围的追击逃避游戏中选择这样的解决方案，该游戏的 Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs 值函数在圆 $S^1$ 和平坦环面 $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ 和 $\mathbb{T}^{4}$ 上以封闭形式已知。我们训练四个神经参数化，每个几何体上有 10 个种子，总共 120 次运行。具有周期性傅里叶特征的标准网络在所有 30 次运行中收敛到几乎所有地方的折叠解决方案：小的残差和预期的捕获层梯度，但在大多数域上的值都是错误的。通过损失施加周期性的网络可以在一维和二维中恢复粘度解，但在四维中变得不可靠。接收测地线的两个参数化

items.title: Convolution Quadrature with Adaptive History Compression for Variable-Order Fractional Reaction--Diffusion Equations
items.excerpt: We develop a fully implicit fast method for semilinear variable-order fractional reaction--diffusion equations with periodic fractional diffusion and exponential-transition Scarpi memory. A Volterra-resolvent analysis establishes local well-posedness and temporal regularity estimates that describe the weak initial singularity. Backward Euler convolution quadrature combined with Fourier pseudospectral discretization achieves mesh-uniform stability and positive-time first-order convergence. To accelerate the scheme, we utilize Cauchy--FFT weight recovery and adaptive blockwise sum-of-exponentials compression, which significantly reduces the cost of history evaluation under local error control. A logarithmic perturbation bound quantifies the effects of weight recovery, history compression, and inexact nonlinear solves, giving tolerance conditions that preserve the convergence order. Numerical experiments confirm the first-order accuracy and demonstrate that the accelerated method efficiently resolves long-time spatial patterns at a substantially reduced computational cost.
items.title_zh: 变阶分数反应的自适应历史压缩的卷积求积--扩散方程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种半线性变阶分数反应的完全隐式快速方法——具有周期性分数扩散和指数跃迁 Scarpi 记忆的扩散方程。 Volterra 解析分析建立了描述弱初始奇点的局部适定性和时间规律性估计。后向欧拉卷积求积与傅里叶伪谱离散化相结合，实现了网格均匀稳定性和正时间一阶收敛。为了加速该方案，我们利用 Cauchy-FFT 权重恢复和自适应分块指数和压缩，这显着降低了局部误差控制下的历史评估成本。对数扰动界限量化了权重恢复、历史压缩和不精确非线性求解的影响，给出了保留收敛阶的容差条件。数值实验证实了一阶精度，并证明加速方法能够以显着降低的计算成本有效地解析长时间空间模式。

items.title: Soliton Profiles in 1D: Enhanced Neural-Network Solvers and Constrained Deep Ritz Methods
items.excerpt: We develop and compare enhanced neural-network solvers for one-dimensional ground-state profiles, which are solutions of $$ Q^{\prime\prime}=bQ-\gamma Q^{p},\quad Q>0,\quad p>1, \quad b, \gamma >0, $$ the stationary profile equation for the nonlinear Schr\"odinger, generalized Korteweg-de Vries, and nonlinear Klein-Gordon equations. Its explicit sech-type solutions serve as exact reference for error computation and benchmark hyperparameter selection. We improve on the standard Adam-trained physics-informed neural network (PINN) baseline by introducing higher-order optimization via Gauss-Newton/Levenberg-Marquardt and L-BFGS refinements, as well as Fourier-feature PINNs, and constrained Deep Ritz (DR) formulations. In DR approaches we introduce two new neural-network formulations, which implement two classical variational characterizations: a Nehari-constrained Deep Ritz method, in which the height is learned by projecting onto the Nehari/Pokhozhaev manifold, and a Weinstein Deep Ritz method, in which a normalized profile minimizes the Weinstein quotient. The Deep Ritz formulations perform best overall, in particular, the Weinstein var
items.authors: Chandler Haight, Alex D Rodriguez, Svetlana Roudenko
items.title_zh: 一维孤子分布：增强型神经网络求解器和约束 Deep Ritz 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发并比较了一维基态轮廓的增强型神经网络求解器，这些求解器是 $$ Q^{\prime\prime}=bQ-\gamma Q^{p},\quad Q>0,\quad p>1, \quad b, \gamma >0, $$ 非线性 Schr\"odinger、广义 Korteweg-de Vries 和非线性 Klein-Gordon 方程的稳态轮廓方程的解。其显式sech 型解决方案作为误差计算和基准超参数选择的精确参考，通过 Gauss-Newton/Levenberg-Marquardt 和 L-BFGS 改进引入高阶优化，以及傅立叶特征 PINN 和约束 Deep Ritz (DR) 公式，我们改进了标准 Adam 训练的物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 基线。在 DR 方法中，我们引入了两种新的神经网络公式，它们实现了两种经典变分。表征：Nehari 约束的 Deep Ritz 方法，其中通过投影到 Nehari/Pokhozhaev 流形上来学习高度；以及 Weinstein Deep Ritz 方法，其中归一化轮廓最小化 Weinstein 商 Deep Ritz 公式总体表现最佳，特别是 Weinstein var。

items.title: Trace Inverse Estimates and Kernel-based Nitsche Galerkin Methods for Elliptic Interface Problems
items.excerpt: We establish trace inverse estimates for products of independently generated Sobolev-kernel trial spaces on Lipschitz subdomains and use them to analyze symmetric Nitsche Galerkin methods for elliptic interface problems. The estimates control one-sided gradient traces by subdomain gradients, the interface jump, and an exterior boundary trace. Their conormal form provides the flux control required by the Nitsche formulation without imposing value constraints on the trial spaces, including configurations with an interior inclusion. For quasi-uniform center families with comparable fill distances and a fixed kernel scale, we obtain coercivity and well-posedness for sufficiently large penalty parameters independent of refinement. We prove energy and $L^2$ error bounds of orders $h^{s-1}$ and $h^s$ for piecewise $H^s$ solutions, $2\le s\le m$, where $h$ is the maximum fill distance and $m$ is the kernel Sobolev order. The $L^2$ bound additionally requires piecewise $H^2$ regularity of the homogeneous adjoint interface problem. For scaled kernels $\Phi_{m,\varepsilon}$ with $0<\varepsilon\le1$, we also derive a scale-explicit condition-numb
items.authors: Leevan Ling, Shu Ma, Weifeng Qiu, Yizhong Sun
items.title_zh: 椭圆界面问题的迹逆估计和基于核的 Nitsche Galerkin 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们对 Lipschitz 子域上独立生成的 Sobolev 核试验空间的乘积建立了迹逆估计，并使用它们来分析椭圆界面问题的对称 Nitsche Galerkin 方法。该估计通过子域梯度、界面跳跃和外部边界轨迹来控制单侧梯度轨迹。它们的共正规形式提供了尼采公式所需的通量控制，而不对试验空间施加值限制，包括具有内部夹杂物的配置。对于具有可比填充距离和固定核尺度的准均匀中心族，我们获得了足够大的罚参数的矫顽力和适定性，而与细化无关。我们证明了分段 $H^s$ 解 $2\le s\le m$ 阶数 $h^{s-1}$ 和 $h^s$ 的能量和 $L^2$ 误差界限，其中 $h$ 是最大填充距离，$m$ 是内核 Sobolev 阶数。 $L^2$ 界限还需要齐次伴随界面问题的分段 $H^2$ 正则性。对于缩放内核 $\Phi_{m,\varepsilon}$ 且 $0<\varepsilon\le1$，我们还导出了一个缩放显式条件numb

items.title: Hyperwellfoundedness and Eventual Domination
items.excerpt: We prove that a Borel strict partial order is an increasing union of wellfounded Borel partial orders if and only if it admits an (injective) Borel homomorphism to the eventual domination order.
items.title_zh: 超级有根据和最终的统治
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，Borel 严格偏序是有充分根据的 Borel 偏序的递增并集，当且仅当它承认最终支配序的（内射）Borel 同态。

items.title: The first-order part of the Ordered Variable Word theorem
items.excerpt: An ordered $\omega$-variable sequence over a finite alphabet~$A$ is an infinite sequence over the extended alphabet $A \sqcup \{ x_0, x_1, \dots \}$, where each variable kind appears at least once, and the last occurrence of $x_i$ appears before the first occurrence of $x_{i+1}$. The Ordered Variable Word theorem states that for every finite coloring of the words over a finite alphabet~$A$, there is an ordered $\omega$-variable sequence~$W$ over~$A$ such that every word induced by substituting variables with letters, and cutting before the first undefined variable, has the same color. In this article, we prove that the Ordered Variable Word theorem is $\Pi^1_1$-conservative over $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}\Sigma^0_2$. It follows that the tree theorem for singletons by Chubb, Hirst, and McNicholl is $\Pi^1_1$-conservative over $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}\Sigma^0_2$, answering a long-standing open question. Lemma 3.13 was found by Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic).
items.title_zh: 有序变量字定理的一阶部分
items.excerpt_zh: 有限字母表~$A$上的有序$\omega$变量序列是扩展字母表$A \sqcup \{ x_0, x_1, \dots \}$上的无限序列，其中每个变量种类至少出现一次，并且$x_i$的最后一次出现在$x_{i+1}$第一次出现之前。有序变量词定理指出，对于有限字母表 ~$A$ 上单词的每个有限颜色，在 ~$A$ 上存在一个有序 $\omega$ 变量序列 ~$W$，这样通过用字母替换变量并在第一个未定义变量之前切割而导出的每个单词都具有相同的颜色。在本文中，我们证明有序变量字定理相对于 $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}\Sigma^0_2$ 是 $\Pi^1_1$ 保守的。由此可见，Chubb、Hirst 和 McNicholl 提出的单例树定理相对于 $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}\Sigma^0_2$ 是 $\Pi^1_1$ 保守的，回答了一个长期悬而未决的问题。引理 3.13 由 Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) 发现。

items.title: There can be equitable social welfare orders but no fair voting system
items.excerpt: In the context of intergenerational equity it is natural to ask that social welfare orders have th properties of finite anonymity and strong Pareto efficiency. Such social welfare orders can be constructed from nonprincipal ultrafilters over the set of natural numbers, and the existence of ultrafilters of this kind is known to be equivalent to the existence of a fair voting system for a countably infinite population in the sense of Arrow's theorem. Unfortunately, the existence of this variety of social welfare order, which we call anonymous Pareto, implies the existence of nonmeasurable sets of real numbers. For some, such as Litak, this entails that such social welfare orders are inadmissible for use in theoretical economics because they are non-constructive in nature. The authors seek to give nuance to this view, proving that anonymous Pareto and other social welfare orders can exist in the absence of nonprincipal ultrafilters over the set of natural numbers.
items.title_zh: 可以有公平的社会福利秩序，但没有公平的投票制度
items.excerpt_zh: 在代际公平的背景下，很自然地要求社会福利秩序具有有限匿名性和强帕累托效率的属性。这种社会福利秩序可以通过自然数集上的非主超过滤器来构建，并且已知这种超过滤器的存在等同于阿罗定理意义上的可数无限人口的公平投票系统的存在。不幸的是，这种社会福利秩序的多样性（我们称之为匿名帕累托）的存在意味着不可测量的实数集的存在。对于利塔克等人来说，这意味着此类社会福利秩序不允许在理论经济学中使用，因为它们本质上是非建设性的。作者试图对这一观点进行细微的阐述，证明匿名帕累托和其他社会福利秩序可以在自然数集上没有非主超过滤器的情况下存在。

items.title: Closed maximal eventually different families for $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ and weakly Farah ideals
items.excerpt: Motivated by the existence of closed maximal $\mathcal{I}$-eventually different ($\mathcal{I}$-MED) families, we study uniform combinatorial properties of ideals. For a fixed ideal, a property is uniform if its witnesses can be chosen by a single Borel map. We prove that every $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ ideal is uniformly weakly $P^+$. We also prove that the classes of Farah and weakly Farah ideals coincide, answering a question of Hru\v{s}\'ak and Meza-Alc\'antara. We then show that every weakly Farah ideal is uniformly weakly Ramsey. As an application, we obtain closed $\mathcal{I}$-MED families for $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ ideals and weakly Farah ideals.
items.authors: Jialiang He, Jiaheng Zhuang, Yi Zhou
items.title_zh: $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$ 和弱法拉理想的封闭最大最终不同族
items.excerpt_zh: 受封闭最大 $\mathcal{I}$-最终不同 ($\mathcal{I}$-MED) 族存在的启发，我们研究理想的统一组合属性。对于固定理想，如果可以通过单个 Borel 地图选择见证人，则属性是统一的。我们证明每个$\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$理想都是一致弱$P^+$。我们还证明了 Farah 和弱 Farah 理想的类别是一致的，回答了 Hru\v{s}\'ak 和 Meza-Alc\'antara 的问题。然后我们证明每个弱法拉理想都是弱拉姆齐。作为一个应用，我们获得了$\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^0_3$理想和弱法拉理想的封闭$\mathcal{I}$-MED族。

items.title: Counterexamples to the Monotone Completeness Conjecture
items.excerpt: Combining a modification of the recent counterexample to the quasitrace conjecture with model-theoretic reductions due to the first author, we exhibit a counterexample to the monotone completeness conjecture. We fully reproduce the disproof of the quasitrace conjecture by a modified construction and arguments.
items.title_zh: 单调完备性猜想的反例
items.excerpt_zh: 将最近对准迹猜想的反例的修改与第一作者的模型理论还原相结合，我们展示了单调完备性猜想的反例。我们通过修改的构造和论证完全重现了对准迹猜想的反驳。

items.title: SEAC from EAC modulo Schanuel: reduction to algebraic exponentials
items.excerpt: We consider the problem of reducing Zilber's pseudo-exponentiation conjecture to mere exponential-algebraic closedness, assuming Schanuel's conjecture but not Zilber-Pink. Generalising work of Mantova, we show that it would suffice to show that perfectly rotund varieties have non-dense intersection with finitely generated subgroups of the graph of exponentiation in which the exponentials live in a number field.
items.title_zh: 来自 EAC 模 Schanuel 的 SEAC：简化为代数指数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑将 Zilber 伪幂猜想简化为指数代数封闭性的问题，假设是 Schanuel 猜想而不是 Zilber-Pink。概括曼托瓦的工作，我们证明，只要证明完美圆形簇与指数图的有限生成子群具有非稠密交集，其中指数存在于数域中。

items.title: Linear Axiomatization of Linear Differential Equations
items.excerpt: This article presents an axiomatization of linear differential equations that is complete for topologically open properties with compact initial conditions and time horizons by proving them deductively via a sound reduction to formulas of linear real arithmetic. Indeed, linearity is preserved: linear differential invariants are complete for open properties of linear differential equations and reduce with a linear number of Lie derivatives (per atom) to linear real arithmetic. In particular, this article shows that the linear fragment of differential dynamic logic (dL), a modal extension of standard first-order logic over the reals satisfies these completeness properties. By establishing completeness within decidable linear real arithmetic, the need for proving sophisticated nonlinear formulas of real arithmetic is circumvented. Furthermore, this article establishes generalizations to the nonlinear fragment of dL that enable the practical certification of reachability computations, validating the output of external computations in dL with machine-checkable proofs.
items.title_zh: 线性微分方程的线性公理化
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提出了线性微分方程的公理化，该公理化对于具有紧凑初始条件和时间范围的拓扑开放性质是完整的，通过对线性实数算术公式的合理简化进行演绎证明。事实上，线性度得到了保留：线性微分不变量对于线性微分方程的开放性质来说是完整的，并且通过线性数量的李导数（每个原子）简化为线性实数算术。特别是，本文表明，微分动态逻辑 (dL) 的线性片段（标准一阶逻辑在实数上的模态扩展）满足这些完整性属性。通过在可判定的线性实数算术中建立完整性，避免了证明实数算术的复杂非线性公式的需要。此外，本文还对 dL 的非线性片段进行了推广，以实现可达性计算的实际认证，并通过机器可检查的证明来验证 dL 中外部计算的输出。

items.title: Counting Bessel zeros and applications
items.excerpt: We establish o-minimal definability results and develop point-counting machinery applicable to the zeros of a Bessel function of fixed non-negative real parameter. We also give an Ax-Schanuel theorem for Bessel functions of fixed (complex) parameters and exponential functions. We combine these to prove a sparsity result (weak Manin-Mumford) for points on an algebraic variety whose coordinates are zeros of a Bessel function of fixed (non-negative real) parameter. We apply this result to improve density results on spectral sets for the unit ball motivated by Fuglede's conjecture.
items.authors: Gal Binyamini, Avner Kiro, Gady Kozma, Jonathan Pila
items.title_zh: 计算贝塞尔零点及其应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们建立了 o 最小可定义性结果，并开发了适用于固定非负实参数的贝塞尔函数的零点的点计数机制。我们还给出了固定（复数）参数和指数函数的贝塞尔函数的 Ax-Schanuel 定理。我们将这些结合起来，证明代数簇上的点的稀疏性结果（弱 Manin-Mumford），这些点的坐标是固定（非负实数）参数的贝塞尔函数的零点。我们应用这个结果来改进由富格莱德猜想激发的单位球的谱集的密度结果。

items.title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
items.excerpt: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatche
items.authors: Haotian Deng, Chris Farber, Sonal Narasimha, Samskrithi Sivakumar, Yexiang Xue
items.title_zh: 修复，而不仅仅是重新采样：Lean 4 中的有界编译器引导修复
items.excerpt_zh: 自动定理证明器通常依赖于采样语言模型，但像 Lean 这样的证明助手会用精确的错误消息拒绝每个失败的步骤——纯采样会丢弃的信息。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了有界的在线步骤级修复模块。我们的搜索在每一步对 $K$ 候选策略进行采样，并最多修复 $R$ 次失败的策略。我们没有放弃失败的策略，而是将编译器的错误消息提供给预训练的修复模型，以修复单个被拒绝的步骤。这种方法提高了所有测试候选预算（$K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$）中仅采样基线的解决率，实现了高达 $32\%$ 的相对增益，并在 LeanDojo 基准的 $1{,}990$ 定理子集上解决了 $82$ 的额外定理。修复不是免费的：它用额外的运行时间来换取可到达的证明。但这种交易是可以预见的：当抽样受到限制时，维修费用最高；它的回报是预先加载的，第一次修复尝试捕获了总收益的 $84\text{--}96\%$ ；而且收益几乎完全来自浅层策略执行失败，而不是类型不匹配等结构性错误

items.title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
items.excerpt: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning
items.authors: Xinping Wang, Jie Ma, Rui Xing, Wensong Guo, Xiayi Zhang, Jianhao Deng, Zihao Zhou, Boqian Yang, Feijuan He
items.title_zh: MAMath-Bench：多模态多智能体数学推理的过程感知和鲁棒评估
items.excerpt_zh: 数学推理是大型语言模型 (LLM) 教育应用的一项基本能力，其中可靠的问题解决不仅需要正确的答案，还需要连贯且可验证的推理过程。通过利用多个 LLM 代理之间的协作和验证，多代理系统 (MAS) 在该领域显示出越来越大的潜力。然而，现有的评估主要关注纯文本环境中最终答案的正确性，对多模态推理能力、中间推理步骤的可靠性以及针对推理错误的鲁棒性的了解有限。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 MAMath-Bench，这是一种流程感知基准，旨在评估 MAS 的多模态数学推理能力。 MAMath-Bench 包含 1,003 个问题，涵盖 11 个数学类别、多个难度级别和多种模式，包括文本、图像和音频。它具有细粒度的里程碑注释，可以从三个维度评估系统：问题解决的正确性、推理过程的可靠性以及对抗性推理的稳健性

items.title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
items.excerpt: As AI systems begin to resolve open research problems, reliable verification becomes increasingly important. Formal mathematics provides a trusted framework for mathematical reasoning, enabling agents to produce machine-checkable proofs while conducting mathematical exploration. Existing formal mathematics benchmarks often focus on known results or a small set of prominent open problems, which can become difficult to evaluate reliably once solutions are discovered and widely disseminated. Existing evaluation protocols are also not always aligned with how modern coding agents operate. We therefore introduce ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), spanning entry-level open research problems across a broad range of mathematical subfields. We expect these less prominent open problems, which tend to attract less attention and may remain unsolved for longer, to be better suited for held-out evaluation of end-to-end open problem resolution in Lean. We adopt a standard coding-agent evaluation setting, placing each problem and its logical negation into a Lean project
items.authors: Zeyu Zheng, Yiyang Liu, Yuyang Zhao, Congmin Zheng, Jiachen Zhu, Jianian Chen, Kangning Zhang, Kayue Daniel Wong, Lingyu Yang, Rong Shan, Shihao Chen, Thomas Zhu, Wentao Zhang, Xiaopeng Li, Yan Hu, Yongxi Lin, Yuxiang Chen, Zhuoying Ou, Jianghao Lin, Jeremy Avigad, Prasad Tetali, Jingbang Chen, Sean Welleck
items.title_zh: ReuF2F：针对形式化本科研究问题对编码代理进行基准测试
items.excerpt_zh: 随着人工智能系统开始解决开放研究问题，可靠的验证变得越来越重要。形式数学为数学推理提供了一个值得信赖的框架，使代理能够在进行数学探索的同时产生机器可检查的证明。现有的正式数学基准通常侧重于已知结果或一小部分突出的开放问题，一旦发现并广泛传播解决方案，这些问题就很难可靠地评估。现有的评估协议也不总是与现代编码代理的操作方式保持一致。因此，我们引入了 ReuF2F，这是一个精益 4 基准，包含 244 个形式化的开放问题，这些问题取自本科生研究经验 (REU)，涵盖了广泛的数学子领域的入门级开放研究问题。我们预计这些不太突出的开放问题往往不会引起太多关注，并且可能在较长时间内未得到解决，因此更适合对精益中的端到端开放问题解决方案进行持续评估。我们采用标准的编码代理评估设置，将每个问题及其逻辑否定放入精益项目中

items.title: PORA: Learning When More Reasoning Pays Off for LLM Agents
items.excerpt: LLM agents perform tasks over multiple steps and revise their actions based on feedback. As the total reasoning budget is often limited and must support future steps, the agent must choose between short and long reasoning before each action. Longer reasoning may improve the final task outcome by preventing later errors, but it also uses budget capacity that may be needed for future decisions. This creates two challenges: estimating the downstream value of long reasoning and deciding when that value is worth using the remaining budget. We propose Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation (PORA), which learns this decision by comparing short and long reasoning from the same interaction state. During training, \method{} completes the task twice from each selected state, once with a short reasoning allowance and once with a long allowance, and compares their final quality and total processing to estimate when longer reasoning is valuable. During inference, a controller weighs this estimate against learned prices on remaining-budget pressure and chooses either short or long reasoning without running both alternatives. We evaluate PORA acr
items.authors: Bo Yan, Qi Zhang, Zhen Tan, Tianlong Chen, Song Wang
items.title_zh: PORA：当更多推理为 LLM 代理带来回报时学习
items.excerpt_zh: LLM 代理通过多个步骤执行任务，并根据反馈修改其操作。由于总推理预算通常是有限的并且必须支持未来的步骤，因此智能体必须在每次行动之前在短推理和长推理之间进行选择。较长的推理可以通过防止以后的错误来改善最终的任务结果，但它也会使用未来决策可能需要的预算能力。这带来了两个挑战：估计长推理的下游价值，并决定何时该价值值得使用剩余预算。我们提出了配对结果引导推理分配（PORA），它通过比较相同交互状态的短推理和长推理来学习这个决策。在训练期间，\method{} 从每个选定的状态完成任务两次，一次使用短推理余量，一次使用长余量，并比较它们的最终质量和总处理量，以估计较长推理何时有价值。在推理过程中，控制器会根据剩余预算压力将此估计与已知价格进行权衡，并选择短期或长期推理，而不运行两种选择。我们评估 PORA acr

items.title: EDMA: Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering
items.excerpt: Multimodal question answering (MMQA) is based on integrating heterogeneous data sources, selectively leveraging relevant modalities, and ignoring distractors. Existing approaches based on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) improve performance by splitting the task into intermediate steps, but do not quantify how each modality contributes to reaching the final answer. We argue that quantifying the effect that each modality has on the answering process improves process traceability and final performance. Thus, we propose Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering (EDMA), which uses logical entropy to formalise multimodal QA as an iterative process of entropy reduction and to quantify the contribution of each modality in distinguishing correct from incorrect candidate answers. This enables the construction of quantifiable answering trajectories, where each step is associated with a measurable entropy reduction. EDMA introduces (i) modality-conditioned partitioning to estimate unimodal entropy reduction, (ii) entropy-driven multimodal fusion to capture complementary information across modalities, and (iii) entropy-based selection of the an
items.authors: Emanuele Mezzi, Gertjan Burghouts, Fabio Massacci, Mengyuan Zhang
items.title_zh: EDMA：熵驱动的多模态应答
items.excerpt_zh: 多模态问答 (MMQA) 基于集成异构数据源、选择性地利用相关模态并忽略干扰因素。基于多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 的现有方法通过将任务拆分为中间步骤来提高性能，但没有量化每种模态如何有助于达到最终答案。我们认为，量化每种模式对回答过程的影响可以提高过程的可追溯性和最终性能。因此，我们提出了熵驱动多模态应答（EDMA），它使用逻辑熵将多模态 QA 形式化为熵减少的迭代过程，并量化每种模态在区分正确与错误候选答案方面的贡献。这使得能够构建可量化的回答轨迹，其中每个步骤都与可测量的熵减少相关联。 EDMA 引入了 (i) 模态条件划分来估计单模态熵减少，(ii) 熵驱动的多模态融合来捕获跨模态的互补信息，以及 (iii) 基于熵的选择

items.title: LSA-PAST: Layer-Specific Adaptation and Prototype Transport for Compositional Incremental Learning
items.excerpt: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to recognize new classes over time while retaining prior knowledge, but many real-world problems are compositional, where visual concepts arise from combinations of primitives such as states (i.e., red, shiny) and objects (i.e., shoe, car). Standard CIL methods treat each composition as an independent class, ignoring shared primitives and providing no mechanism to stabilize their representations as new compositions arrive. This causes parameter updates to entangle primitives and induce drift that degrades performance on earlier compositions. Compositional Incremental Learning (composition-IL) formalizes this setting by introducing new state-object compositions across tasks. In this paper, we propose Layer-Specific Adaptation with Prototype-Anchored Adapter-Space Transport (LSA-PAST), a parameter-efficient method tailored to composition-IL. LSA integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into a frozen ViT with depth-specialized adapters for states, objects, and compositions. PAST then maps past, anchored prototypes into the current adapter space through a rehearsal-free affine transform fit on
items.authors: Kyle Stein, Andrew Arash Mahyari, Guillermo Francia III, Eman El-Sheikh, Jiangpeng He
items.title_zh: LSA-PAST：组合增量学习的特定层适应和原型传输
items.excerpt_zh: 类增量学习 (CIL) 使模型能够随着时间的推移识别新的类，同时保留先验知识，但许多现实世界的问题是组合性的，其中视觉概念源自状态（即红色、闪亮）和对象（即鞋子、汽车）等基元的组合。标准 CIL 方法将每个组合视为一个独立的类，忽略共享基元，并且不提供在新组合到达时稳定其表示的机制。这会导致参数更新纠缠基元并引起漂移，从而降低早期合成的性能。组合式增量学习（composition-IL）通过跨任务引入新的状态-对象组合来形式化这种设置。在本文中，我们提出了带有原型锚定适配器空间传输的层特定自适应（LSA-PAST），这是一种针对组合 IL 定制的参数高效方法。 LSA 将低阶适应 (LoRA) 集成到冻结的 ViT 中，并具有针对状态、对象和组合的深度专用适配器。然后，PAST 通过无需排练的仿射变换拟合，将过去的锚定原型映射到当前的适配器空间中

items.title: Unified Sharp Bounds on Probabilities of Causation
items.excerpt: Probabilities of causation (PoCs) have developed steadily, from the binary measures first introduced by Pearl to the non-binary setting recently studied by Shu et al. As the theory has matured, PoCs have found applications in a growing range of areas, including personalized medicine, marketing and legal attribution. Shu et al. proposed closed-form bounds for multi-valued treatments and outcomes and proved them valid, but left their sharpness in high dimensions open. We close this gap with a mathematical proof. We further show that $\PNS$, $\PSub$, $\PRep$ and $\PN$ are all special cases of a single, more general formula. Combined with their equivalence classes, this settles the question of sharp bounds for discrete PoCs from experimental and observational data: in every dimension, they are given in closed form by a single theorem.
items.title_zh: 因果关系概率的统一锐界
items.excerpt_zh: 因果关系概率（PoC）一直在稳步发展，从 Pearl 首次引入的二元测量到 Shu 等人最近研究的非二元设置。随着理论的成熟，PoC 已在越来越多的领域得到应用，包括个性化医疗、营销和法律归因。舒等人。提出了多值处理和结果的封闭式边界，并证明了它们的有效性，但保留了它们在高维度上的锐度。我们通过数学证明来缩小这一差距。我们进一步证明 $\PNS$、$\PSub$、$\PRep$ 和 $\PN$ 都是单个更通用公式的特殊情况。结合它们的等价类，这解决了来自实验和观察数据的离散 PoC 的锐界问题：在每个维度上，它们都由一个定理以封闭形式给出。

items.title: Ask to Distill: Learning to Synthesize Data for On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) can succeed with surprisingly few training questions, motivating a view of questions as carriers of distributional knowledge transfer. How can we assess whether a newly generated question is valuable for distillation, and learn to generate better questions---without access to its correct answer? We introduce Ask-to-Distill (\method), a framework that treats synthetic questions as distribution elicitors and optimizes the teacher supervision they expose along student-generated trajectories. A student-initialized synthesizer is optimized using a distributional surrogate for question value, computed from a frozen student--teacher pair without reference answers, correctness rewards, or per-candidate student updates. The reward combines teacher--student disagreement with teacher probability mass on the student's candidate support, together with length and diversity controls. The generated questions are filtered and deduplicated into a prompt-only bank for standard OPD. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks, our method improves average performance and teacher-gap recovery over unoptimi
items.authors: Jiashuo Sun, Hao Zhang, Xueqiang Xu, Heng Wang, Yixuan Xie, Pengcheng Jiang, Zhenrui Yue, Jiajun Fan, Peiran Li, Ge Liu, Shaowen Wang, Jiawei Han
items.title_zh: 要求蒸馏：学习合成数据以进行合规蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）只需很少的训练问题就可以取得成功，从而激发了将问题视为分布式知识转移载体的观点。我们如何评估新生成的问题对于蒸馏是否有价值，并学会生成更好的问题——而无需获得其正确答案？我们引入了 Ask-to-Distill（\method），这是一个将综合问题视为分布诱导子的框架，并优化了它们沿着学生生成的轨迹暴露的教师监督。学生初始化的合成器使用问题值的分布代理进行优化，该问题值是根据冻结的学生-教师对计算出来的，没有参考答案、正确性奖励或每个候选学生的更新。奖励结合了教师与学生对学生候选人支持率的分歧以及教师概率质量，以及长度和多样性控制。生成的问题经过过滤和重复数据删除后，放入标准 OPD 的仅提示库中。在数学推理、代码生成和代理任务方面，我们的方法比非优化方法提高了平均性能和教师差距恢复

items.title: Beyond Policy Discrepancy: Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance remains provided by the teachers. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and instruction following, CA-MOPD achieves an average score of 32.22, outperforming naive MOPD, Open-MOPD,
items.authors: Xuanfeng Yang, Le Gai, Jiaming Wang, Xuan Zhang
items.excerpt_zh: 多教师政策蒸馏（MOPD）将领域专家整合到共享学生中，但确定每位教师应监督的力度仍然具有挑战性。即使学生已经匹配或超过教师的任务表现，现有的基于差异的分配也可以分配强有力的监督，因为行为不匹配并不一定意味着剩余的能力缺陷。我们提出能力感知多教师按策略蒸馏（CA-MOPD），它将专家合并与能力引导分配相结合，以考虑学生已经学到的知识。 CA-MOPD 首先将强化学习专家合并到强大的学生初始化中，然后使用验证者估计的师生能力差距来调整领域级蒸馏强度。当能力差距缩小时，监督就会减少；而当估计的学生能力下降时，监督就会增加，而教师仍然提供密集的象征性指导。在涵盖数学、代码生成和指令遵循的六个基准测试中，CA-MOPD 的平均得分为 32.22，优于 naive MOPD、Open-MOPD、
items.title_zh: 超越政策差异：能力意识多教师的政策蒸馏

items.title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.
items.authors: Yunan Zeng, Jinhao Jing, Xi Cheng, Yuwang Wang
items.title_zh: 通过激活空间引导进行探索，以实现具有可验证奖励的强化学习
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 通过对响应进行采样、使用自动验证器对其进行评分并根据所得奖励更新策略来训练语言模型。因此，该政策仅从其推出时出现的轨迹接收直接学习信号。然而，对同一政策的重复抽样可能会集中在类似的推理路径上，从而在固定的推出预算下留下未探索的有用替代方案。我们引入激活空间探索（ASE），这是一种用于多样化培训推出的在线方法。通过对同一问题的正确和错误响应之间的激活差异进行聚类，ASE 构建了潜在探索向量的结构化库。然后将不同的向量应用于后续的推出，以探索替代的推理路径。在 DAPO-Math-17k 上训练的 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，在相同的部署预算下，ASE 在六个数学推理基准上的平均 Mean@8 比 GRPO 分别提高了 4.87 和 1.87 个百分点。

items.title: Reconstruction-Optimized Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
items.excerpt: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse expert activation, but deployment still requires storing a large number of expert parameters. We study post-training expert pruning using task-domain calibration data as a subset-selection problem: given a pretrained MoE layer, select a fixed number of experts that best reconstruct its original output. Exact subset search is combinatorial and becomes intractable for modern MoE models with many experts per layer. We develop OptEP, a scalable continuous relaxation that directly optimizes differentiable expert-selection variables, followed by a lightweight reconstruction-based update of the retained expert weights. Across multiple MoE architectures and tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approach improves over the strongest existing expert-pruning baselines, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 15.05% on Qwen3-30B-A3B, 14.55% on Qwen3-235B-A22B, 11.06% on GLM-4.5-Air, and 16.20% on Mixtral-8x7B. items.authors: Jelena Markovic-Voronov, Petros Prastakos, Kayhan Behdin, Jincheng Cao, Zhipeng Wang, Shayan Mohajer Hamidi, Yuanda Xu, Zhengze Zhou, Wenhui Zhu, Rahul Mazumder
items.title_zh: 混合专家语言模型的重构优化专家剪枝
items.excerpt_zh: 专家混合（MoE）模型通过稀疏专家激活减少计算量，但部署仍然需要存储大量专家参数。我们使用任务域校准数据作为子集选择问题来研究训练后专家剪枝：给定预训练的 MoE 层，选择固定数量的专家来最好地重建其原始输出。精确子集搜索是组合性的，对于每层有许多专家的现代 MoE 模型来说变得很棘手。我们开发了 OptEP，这是一种可扩展的连续松弛，可以直接优化可微分的专家选择变量，然后对保留的专家权重进行基于轻量级重建的更新。在涵盖数学推理和代码生成的多个 MoE 架构和任务中，我们的方法改进了现有最强的专家剪枝基线，Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的绝对准确度增益高达 15.05%，Qwen3-235B-A22B 上的绝对精度增益为 14.55%，GLM-4.5-Air 上的绝对精度增益为 11.06%，Mixtral-8x7B 上的绝对精度增益为 16.20%。这些改进在积极修剪下尤其明显，这表明重建驱动的专家选择和权重适应可以提高

items.title: Understanding the Benefits of Scaffolds through Computational Separations
items.excerpt: Inference-time harnesses, i.e., external procedures that call a model many times and keep state across calls, can substantially improve model capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the benefits of using such harnesses and the extent to which these benefits can be internalized through training. More precisely, we conceptualize a harness $\mathcal{A}$ as an arbitrary wrapper around a base model $M$ and attempt to distill a student model from the harness's traces. Empirically we find that, even with simple scaffolds and small models, the inference-time harness significantly outperforms a distilled student. We then prove that such a gap is due to a fundamental representational limitation: inference-time harnesses can compute a closure of their per-call primitive that is $\NL$-complete even when the primitive is a trivial $\AC^0$ lookup, and that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under the widely believed conjecture that $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$. items.excerpt_zh: 推理时间利用，即多次调用模型并在调用之间保持状态的外部过程，可以显着提高模型功能。在本文中，我们研究了使用此类安全带的好处以及这些好处可以通过培训内在化的程度。更准确地说，我们将线束 $\mathcal{A}$ 概念化为基本模型 $M$ 的任意包装器，并尝试从线束的痕迹中提取学生模型。根据经验，我们发现，即使使用简单的支架和小型模型，推理时间工具的表现也明显优于经过精炼的学生。然后，我们证明这样的差距是由于基本的表示限制造成的：即使原语是一个微不足道的 $\AC^0$ 查找，推理时间工具也可以计算其每次调用原语的闭包，该闭包是 $\NL$ 完整的，并且在广泛相信的猜想 $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$ 下，没有固定深度的前向传递可以表示。我们的理论表明，扩大学生相对于手头任务的表征能力，例如，通过扩大模型、使任务更容易或延长其时间

items.title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
items.excerpt: On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. The method uses contrastive updates to favor corrections over failed attempts and refreshes these corrections as the student evolves, enabling near-on-policy learning even when all student attempts fail. items.excerpt_zh: 在策略学习是后训练的核心：对模型自己的代进行训练可以限制分布转移并有助于保留现有功能。然而，在难题上，当所有尝试都失败时，策略强化学习不会提供基于奖励的学习信号。策略蒸馏提供了来自老师的下一个令牌监督，但在困难问题上，如果部署过早出错，后续监督将以已经包含错误的前缀为条件。正确的行为可以来自黄金或教师解决方案，但这种偏离策略的目标可能与模型的世代有很大不同，并且正如我们所展示的，可能会侵蚀现有的能力。因此，我们将在政策性视为一个连续体，并提出计划蒸馏，将学生的失败尝试最小化为正确的目标。该方法使用对比更新来支持针对失败尝试的更正，并随着学生的发展刷新这些更正，即使所有学生尝试都失败，也能实现近策略学习。从理论上讲，我们证明学生的学习后悔随着编辑大小的增加而增加：它与地平线成线性比例并且

items.title: When Parameter Gradient Flows Close in Representation Space
items.excerpt: The represented gradient flow of a parameterized model depends on a mobility that can retain hidden parameter information. We study when one entire represented mobility map works for every autonomous loss from one fixed initialization. For two-factor matrix representations wider than both output dimensions, with individually full-row-rank factors, we classify all admissible joint ranks: closure occurs precisely at effective scalar-balanced minimal joint rank or a two-value signed spectral family at full joint rank. All intermediate ranks are excluded; positive represented flows belong to known square-root families. For general representations with constant ambient representation and gradient-Lie ranks, ordinary closure is equivalent to a local invariant-level metric in the analytic case and specified smooth regimes. An endpoint section forces the initially unrestricted mobility map to admit a locally smooth representative on the represented image. items.title: SliMOO: Interpretable Multi-Objective Evolutionary Search for LLM Depth Pruning
items.excerpt: As large language models (LLMs) grow more powerful, their scale makes them costly to serve. Depth pruning offers a practical route to efficiency by directly reducing memory and latency without hardware-specific support. However, we observe that transformer layers exhibit markedly different task-dependent layer contributions, whereas existing depth-pruning methods ignore this heterogeneity and thus tend to optimize for a narrow domain or benchmark rather than preserve broad capability. This suggests that LLM depth pruning should be formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem rather than a single-score ranking problem. We propose SliMOO, an interpretable multi-objective evolutionary search framework for LLM depth pruning. SliMOO first uses single-layer removal probing to construct a task-layer importance map, which provides an interpretable view of task-shared and task-specific layers and serves as a search prior. items.title_zh: SliMOO：LLM深度修剪的可解释多目标进化搜索
items.excerpt_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 变得越来越强大，其规模使得其服务成本高昂。深度修剪通过直接减少内存和延迟而无需特定于硬件的支持，提供了一种提高效率的实用途径。然而，我们观察到变压器层表现出明显不同的任务相关层贡献，而现有的深度修剪方法忽略了这种异质性，因此倾向于针对狭窄的域或基准进行优化，而不是保留广泛的功能。这表明LLM深度剪枝应该被表述为多目标优化问题而不是单分排名问题。我们提出了 SliMOO，一种用于 LLM 深度修剪的可解释的多目标进化搜索框架。 SliMOO 首先使用单层移除探测来构建任务层重要性图，该图提供了任务共享层和任务特定层的可解释视图，并用作搜索先验。然后，它对修剪掩模执行帕累托感知进化搜索，其中候选者在任务层先验的指导下生成，根据每个任务与密集模型的偏差进行评分，并保留

items.title: Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. items.authors: Guangyu Liu, Siyuan Gan, Shilong Zhou, Linjian Meng, Boyan Wang, Jing Huo
items.excerpt_zh: 在策略蒸馏 (OPD) 使用采样令牌学生-教师对数比来监督学生生成的响应。正对数比会惩罚学生比老师分配更高概率的标记，但其当前值无法区分持续的高惩罚和响应中的突然增加。我们通过比较同一响应中的连续令牌块来检查这些局部变化。我们的诊断发现了惩罚跳跃，平均惩罚的突然增加持续存在于持有的代币上。在这些跳跃过程中，处罚会增加，而教师的信心会下降。我们将这种模式称为惩罚-信心紧张。高惩罚块的边界没有表现出可比较的置信度变化，这表明局部变化提供了超出当前惩罚值的信息。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了自适应回拉 OPD (AP-OPD)。在每次检测到的跳跃时，AP-OPD 使用前一个块作为局部参考，并统一缩放后一个块中的所有监督系数，使其加权平均惩罚与前一个块的原始平均值相匹配。这个参考值决定了t
items.title_zh: 自适应回调：在政策蒸馏中重新调整惩罚跳跃的监管权重

items.title: WaveCommitments: Private and Verifiable Speech-Agent Marketplaces
items.excerpt: Modern speech systems are evolving into ecosystems of autonomous speech agents that interact, negotiate, and trade assets such as embeddings, spectrograms, or raw data. In such markets, sellers cannot reveal assets for evaluation due to privacy constraints, and buyers cannot price what they cannot test. Thus, we introduce WaveCommitments, an end-to-end design that couples multivariate polynomial commitments with confidential asset valuation via Data Shapley inside a trusted execution environment. It enables selective openings and tamper-evident provenance to prove that a delivered asset matches the valuation while hiding everything else. Our extensive experiments across three standard datasets and various tasks with state-of-the-art encoders, including Whisper, reveal that we speed up the strongest baselines by up to 18.1x while reducing their proof sizes by up to 43.2x. We also analyze how a speaker's value shifts across tasks and encoders, revealing agent-level market prices.
items.authors: Oguzhan Baser, Kaan Kale, Sriram Vishwanath, Sandeep Chinchali
items.title_zh: WaveCommitments：私有且可验证的语音代理市场
items.excerpt_zh: 现代语音系统正在演变成自主语音代理的生态系统，这些代理可以交互、协商和交易嵌入、频谱图或原始数据等资产。在这样的市场中，由于隐私限制，卖家无法透露资产进行评估，买家也无法对他们无法测试的东西进行定价。因此，我们引入了 WaveCommitments，这是一种端到端设计，通过可信执行环境中的 Data Shapley 将多元多项式承诺与机密资产评估结合起来。它可以实现选择性开放和防篡改出处，以证明交付的资产与估值相符，同时隐藏其他所有内容。我们使用最先进的编码器（包括 Whisper）对三个标准数据集和各种任务进行了广泛的实验，结果表明我们将最强的基线速度提高了 18.1 倍，同时将其证明大小减少了 43.2 倍。我们还分析了说话者的价值如何在任务和编码器之间变化，揭示代理级别的市场价格。

items.title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
items.excerpt: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably in isolation. This degradation cannot be fully explained by the accumulation of independent errors. Across both open-weight models and the frontier model Claude Opus 5, our findings instead point to an implicit thinking budget underlying this effect. In particular, under composition, models use substantially fewer tokens per task than in isolation, even when the full sequence remains well within the context window. Tasks that require longer solution traces in isolation are consequently more $\textit{fragile}$ under composition, i.e., models make more errors on prompts containing these tasks. items.authors: Chenpan Li, Thies Brockmoeller, Stefanie Jegelka, Sharut Gupta, Nikolaos Karalias
items.excerpt_zh: 现代语言模型越来越多地被要求在单个提示中处理多个任务。这样做需要正确解决每项任务，同时将所得答案整合为连贯的响应。在本文中，我们确定了这个过程中的一个基本限制，即模型在组合任务时会犯更多错误，即使它们可以独立可靠地解决每个组成任务。这种退化不能完全用独立误差的积累来解释。在开放权重模型和前沿模型 Claude Opus 5 中，我们的研究结果指出了这种效应背后的隐性思维预算。特别是，在组合下，模型在每个任务中使用的标记比单独使用的标记要少得多，即使完整序列保持在上下文窗口内也是如此。因此，需要更长的孤立解决方案跟踪的任务在组合下会更加$\textit{fragile}$，即，模型在包含这些任务的提示上犯更多错误。孤立地看，非脆弱任务会接受超出其需要的推理，从而浪费计算资源。然而，通过根据任务的脆弱性对其进行分组，我
items.title_zh: 关于组合任务的脆弱性：语言模型中的隐式预算

items.title: On the LLM Verification for Argument Graph Generation
items.excerpt: Multi-agent LLM systems can formalize natural-language argumentation end-to-end, turning plain text into structured graphs by classifying components, connecting them with relations, and enriching the resulting graphs into formal models. Quality assurance for those graphs is almost always another LLMs: a reviewer, judge, or critic agent. On the other side, in adjacent neuro-symbolic fields, such generated output is often verified symbolically by external checks and solvers. In this work, we argue that in argument graph verification, the allocation should be similar, and based on what each instrument can guarantee. We propose layered verification: starting from deterministic checks, moving to solver-based and LLM reviews, and utilizing debate only under uncertainty, leaving human judgment for what no other instrument can decide. We ground our principle with a study on human-annotated graphs with injected structural defects. items.title_zh: 关于论证图生成的LLM验证
items.excerpt_zh: 多智能体法学硕士系统可以端到端地形式化自然语言论证，通过对组件进行分类，将它们与关系连接起来，并将生成的图丰富为正式模型，从而将纯文本转换为结构化图。这些图表的质量保证几乎总是由另一个法学硕士负责：审稿人、法官或批评代理人。另一方面，在相邻的神经符号场中，此类生成的输出通常由外部检查和求解器进行符号验证。在这项工作中，我们认为在参数图验证中，分配应该是相似的，并且基于每个工具可以保证的内容。我们提出分层验证：从确定性检查开始，转向基于求解器和法学硕士审查，并仅在不确定性下利用辩论，将人类的判断留给其他工具无法决定的事情。我们通过对带有注入结构缺陷的人工注释图的研究来奠定我们的原则。法学硕士审稿人以接近上限的召回率检测到它们，包括支持关系中的循环，但它反对几乎十分之一的正确图表，即使它不应该，碰巧在结论上不一致

items.title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
items.excerpt: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. items.authors: Shreyas Kulkarni, Uttam Gurram, Madhav Kanda, Krishna Teja Chitty Venkata, Shichu Chen, Kartik Balasubramaniam, Supriyo Chakraborty, Sambit Sahu
items.title_zh: DStill：用于块扩散推测解码中加速一步起草的轨迹一致性蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 块扩散推测解码通过并行起草多个标记来加速大型语言模型推理。然而，离散扩散中的一步起草受到令牌分解误差的限制：每个令牌都是从同一屏蔽块预测的，而不以该步骤中其他位置选择的令牌为条件。这可能会产生不一致的草稿并缩短验收时间。迭代细化通过对先前提交的令牌进行后续预测来缓解这一限制，尽管额外的传递会增加起草成本。为了解决草稿保真度和推理延迟之间的这种权衡，我们引入了 DStill，这是一种两阶段框架，可将目标条件起草者自己的多步骤细化提炼为一步起草。我们首先训练绘图员完成部分显示的块，然后使用其细化轨迹来训练学生一次性预测最终完成情况。通过使用从部分输入逐渐过渡到完全屏蔽输入的课程，我们成功地将多步细化能力转化为一步。跨推理、数学、代码基准测试

items.title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
items.excerpt: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.
items.authors: Jui-Chien Tsou, Hsuan-Chi Liu, Wei-Chin Wang, Yu-Syuan Xu, Chun-Yi Lee
items.title_zh: TeCoP：通过暂定上下文流水线加速扩散大型语言模型解码
items.excerpt_zh: 扩散大型语言模型 (dLLM) 在每次前向传递中预测多个标记位置，而块式解码器则序列化生成并重复重新计算稳定的预测。我们将这种低效率归因于将预测对不可逆转承诺的准备与其作为上下文的效用结合起来。我们引入了暂定上下文流水线（TeCoP），这是一种无需训练的解码器，它通过交错的块并行流水线以及草稿和验证来解耦这些角色。 TeCoP 重用稳定但未提交的预测作为临时跨块上下文，并由置信度和稳定性检查控制承诺。在 GSM8K、Minerva MATH 和 MBPP 上的四个 LLaDA 和 Dream dLLM 中，TeCoP 将前向评估数量减少了高达 87%，并且在没有 KV 缓存的情况下实现了高达 7.50 倍的吞吐量，在使用缓存的情况下实现了 11.77 倍的吞吐量。无论是否有缓存，它在所有 12 个模型基准设置中的吞吐量均优于 Fast-dLLM 和 DSB，同时将平均缓存精度保持在原始解码器的 1 个百分点以内。

items.title: Are Linguistic and Arithmetic Circuits Dissociated in LLMs?
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit both knowledge of language, rendered by, for example, grammatical judgment ability, and abilities to perform tasks through language, such as math-word problem solving. Motivated by neurolinguistic studies of their neural dissociation in human brains, in this study, we investigate the overlap of their circuits in large language models (LLMs). Specifically, we examine the overlap and causal effects between the circuits extracted for linguistic and arithmetic tasks, using controlled materials and circuit discovery methods from the mechanistic interpretability field. Our experiments with five LLMs show that circuit similarity is mostly explained by task domains (linguistic vs. arithmetic), rather than by their input and output vocabularies or by the syntactic similarities between natural-language sentences and arithmetic expressions. This finding suggests that LLMs may process linguistic and arithmetic information using largely separate neural circuits, highlighting an ability-based modular organization of circuits within these models.
items.authors: Riku Kisako, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Ryohei Sasano
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）既展示了语言知识（例如语法判断能力），也展示了通过语言执行任务（例如解决数学单词问题）的能力。受人类大脑中神经解离的神经语言学研究的启发，在这项研究中，我们研究了它们在大语言模型（LLM）中的回路重叠。具体来说，我们使用机械可解释性领域的受控材料和电路发现方法，检查为语言和算术任务提取的电路之间的重叠和因果效应。我们对五个法学硕士的实验表明，电路相似性主要是通过任务领域（语言与算术）来解释的，而不是通过它们的输入和输出词汇或自然语言句子和算术表达式之间的句法相似性来解释的。这一发现表明法学硕士可以使用很大程度上独立的神经回路来处理语言和算术信息，突出了这些模型中基于能力的回路模块化组织。
items.title_zh: 法学硕士的语言和算术回路是否分离？

items.title: On-Policy Transition Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates expert capabilities into a single student by matching teacher and student final-layer distributions on student-generated rollouts. We investigate whether depthwise prediction transitions, the changes in predictions between layers, can provide additional task-relevant supervision. Our diagnostic study finds that stronger teacher--student agreement in intermediate transitions is associated with higher answer correctness within questions, with correct responses exhibiting lower mean transition KL across all measured intermediate layer pairs. These observations motivate On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning teacher and student layer-to-layer log-probability increments on student-generated rollouts. Evaluations across three backbones and eight benchmarks spanning mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that OPTD achieves the best or tied-best overall performance in both dual- and three-domain distillation. In the three-domain setting, OPTD recovers $\approx 90\%$ of the overall teacher--student capability gap, compared wit
items.authors: Runyang You, Yongqi Li, Tiezheng Yu, Wenjie Li
items.title_zh: 按政策过渡蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 在策略蒸馏 (OPD) 通过在学生生成的部署上匹配教师和学生的最终层分布，将专家能力整合到单个学生中。我们研究深度预测转换（层之间预测的变化）是否可以提供额外的与任务相关的监督。我们的诊断研究发现，中间转换中更强的师生一致性与问题中更高的答案正确性相关，正确的答案在所有测量的中间层对中表现出较低的平均转换 KL。这些观察结果激发了策略转移蒸馏（OPTD），它通过在学生生成的推出上调整教师和学生的层间对数概率增量来增强最终层的分布匹配。对三个主干和八个基准（涵盖数学、编码和指令跟踪）的评估表明，OPTD 在双域和三域蒸馏中实现了最佳或并列最佳的整体性能。在三域设置中，与 OPTD 相比，OPTD 恢复了教师与学生整体能力差距的 $\approx 90\%$

items.title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused ST
items.title_zh: Africa-Papers：非洲基金会语言模型的 100 亿代币多领域学术语料库
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 从根本上取决于其预训练语料库的多样性、深度和事实严谨性。然而，当代基础预训练数据集（例如 The Pile、S2ORC 和 Dolma）表现出严重的结构性遗漏：非洲科学、医学、法律和农业奖学金仅占全球预训练代币的不到 0.5%。因此，在推理热带流行病学、局部小农农业生态、区域经济治理和本土语言结构时，最先进的模型会遭遇系统性失败模式。为了解决这种代表性不足并推进非洲在人工智能方面的知识主权，我们推出了 Africa-Papers，这是迄今为止最大的精心策划的多领域泛非学术预训练语料库。 Africa-Papers 包含超过 844,807 篇全文论文，涵盖 879 个 Parquet 分片中的 101.5 亿个代币，统一了四个主要科学流：(1) 31 个非洲国家的 DOAJ 索引的大陆同行评审期刊，(2) CGIAR CGSpace 农业知识库，(3) 非洲作者和以非洲为重点的 ST

items.excerpt_zh: 本着我最近关于使用人工智能辅助增强人类对数学理解而不是替代数学的新方法的“数学 2.0”演讲的精神，我利用这篇文章提出了一项实验挑战，其灵感来自于最近围绕排除朗道-西格尔零点的活动，如上一篇文章中所讨论的。有 […]

items.title: Who will become the new mathematicians of Math 2.0?
items.excerpt: “I am mathematics PhD student. Up until recently, I fully intended to pursue a career in academic research. I deeply love mathematics, and I entered graduate school because of this. However I have made the decision to leave academia once I finish my doctorate and I am heartbroken; I would like to explain why. […]”
items.title_zh: 谁将成为数学2.0的新数学家？
items.excerpt_zh: “我是数学博士生。直到最近，我一心想从事学术研究。我深深热爱数学，因此我进入了研究生院。然而，我决定在完成博士学位后离开学术界，我很伤心；我想解释一下原因。[...]”

items.title: A critique of the mathematical economy
items.excerpt: We present a theoretical framework to understand mathematics, and the disruptive effect of AI in our field. Treating mathematics as an economy, we borrow ideas from the theory of value to uncover the hidden dynamics of prestige, attribution, and the job market.
items.title_zh: 对数学经济学的批判
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个理论框架来理解数学以及人工智能在我们领域的颠覆性影响。将数学视为一种经济，我们借用价值论的思想来揭示声望、归因和就业市场的隐藏动态。

items.title: Letter to a worried student
items.excerpt: I don't know how it will all turn out, so I certainly can't promise you anything. But I do know that “understanding” is a human activity — something computers cannot do for us (even if they solve problems better than we do, it serves no purpose unless there are humans who actually understand).
items.title_zh: 写给忧心忡忡的学生的一封信
items.excerpt_zh: 我不知道结果会怎样，所以我当然不能向你保证任何事情。但我确实知道“理解”是一种人类活动——计算机无法为我们做这些事情（即使它们比我们更好地解决问题，但除非有人真正理解，否则它没有任何意义）。

items.title: Ramanujan Conjecture and Riemann Hypothesis for the unitary groups over function fields
items.excerpt: We establish generic local and global Langlands functoriality, namely stable base change, for the unitary groups in characteristic $p$. Main applications are the Ramanujan Conjecture and the Riemann Hypothesis for extended Langlands-Shahidi $L$-functions of the unitary groups over function fields.
items.title_zh: 函数域上酉群的拉马努金猜想和黎曼猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为特征 $p$ 的酉群建立通用的局部和全局 Langlands 函子性，即稳定的基数变化。主要应用是拉马努金猜想和黎曼假设，用于函数域上酉群的扩展 Langlands-Shahidi $L$ 函数。

items.title: Gaps for PLRS with zero coefficients
items.excerpt: Zeckendorf proved that every positive integer has a unique decomposition as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Among its extensions, we focus on Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS): fixed depth recurrences with non-negative integral coefficients whose first and last terms are positive: $G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$ with $c_i$ non-negative integers and $c_1 c_L \ge 1$. We again find every integer can be written uniquely as an appropriate sum of terms of the sequence, and we can study the distribution of gaps between summands in decompositions. Bower et al. (2015) proved that if each $c_i \ge 1$ then the distribution of gaps in the generalized Zeckendorf decompositions of integers in $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ converges to a geometric decay for gaps at least two. What if some of the $c_i$'s are allowed to be zero? To date only the Kangaroo case, where there is a fixed $g$ such that $c_i = 1$ if $i \equiv 1 \bmod g$ and 0 otherwise, has been done and again geometric behavior emerges. Ben-Ari and Miller (2016) developed a probabilistic framework that also produce similar results, but their approach requires more advanced
items.authors: Yinxi Chen, Zongyun Chen, Brian Hii, Steven J. Miller
items.title_zh: 零系数 PLRS 的间隙
items.excerpt_zh: 泽肯多夫证明，每个正整数都有一个唯一的分解，即非相邻斐波那契数之和。在其扩展中，我们关注正线性递归序列（PLRS）：具有非负积分系数的固定深度递归，其第一项和最后一项均为正：$G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$，其中$c_i$非负整数和$c_1 c_L \ge 1$。我们再次发现每个整数都可以唯一地写为序列项的适当和，并且我们可以研究分解中被加数之间的间隙分布。鲍尔等人。 (2015) 证明，如果每个 $c_i \ge 1$ 则 $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ 中整数的广义 Zeckendorf 分解中的间隙分布收敛到间隙至少为 2 的几何衰减。如果允许某些 $c_i$ 为零怎么办？迄今为止，只有袋鼠情况，其中存在固定的 $g$，如果 $i \equiv 1 \bmod g$ 则 $c_i = 1$，否则为 0，已经完成并再次出现几何行为。 Ben-Ari 和 Miller (2016) 开发了一个概率框架，也能产生类似的结果，但他们的方法需要更先进的方法

items.title: Dihedral fields with Bloch lattice index five and quadratic subfield Q(i)
items.excerpt: We construct infinitely many Galois extensions $M/\mathbb{Q}$ with dihedral group of order ten, quadratic subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and Bloch lattice index $Q_2(M)=5$. More precisely, we specify a Chebotarev set of rational primes of density $1/50$. For every prime $\ell$ in this set, at least two of four mixed cyclic quintic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of conductor $(25\ell)$ have this index and satisfy $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$. A two-dimensional cup-product pencil selects the extensions. Generalized Bockstein maps, integral co-descent, and a motivic genus formula then determine the tame kernel and the subfield Bloch-lattice index. The result is unconditional.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们用十阶二面群、二次子域 $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ 和布洛赫晶格索引 $Q_2(M)=5$ 构造无限多个伽罗瓦扩展 $M/\mathbb{Q}$。更准确地说，我们指定密度为 $1/50$ 的切波塔列夫有理素数集。对于该集合中的每个素数 $\ell$，导体 $(25\ell)$ 的 $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ 的四个混合循环五次扩展中的至少两个具有该索引并满足 $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$。二维杯产品铅笔选择延伸部分。然后，广义 Bockstein 映射、积分共同下降和动机属公式确定驯服核和子域布洛赫格指数。结果是无条件的。
items.title_zh: 布洛赫晶格指数为 5 的二面体场和二次子场 Q(i)

items.title: Recovering Dirichlet coefficients from even samples
items.excerpt: In this work, we determine the exact case error for recovering a Dirichlet coefficient from finitely many positive even samples with bounded additive errors. For sequences with a bounded tail and an unrestricted initial block, a polynomial estimator is minimax among all recovery maps. Its tail and noise constants admit explicit product formulas. We prove a sharp tail asymptotic on the index scale K^(3/2) and give a terminating procedure for selecting the sample count from a computable error bound.
items.title_zh: 从偶数样本中恢复狄利克雷系数
items.excerpt_zh: 在这项工作中，我们确定了从有限多个具有有限加性误差的正偶数样本中恢复狄利克雷系数的确切情况误差。对于具有有界尾部和不受限制的初始块的序列，多项式估计器在所有恢复图中是极小极大。它的尾部常数和噪声常数允许明确的乘积公​​式。我们证明了指数尺度 K^(3/2) 上的尖尾渐近，并给出了从可计算误差范围中选择样本计数的终止过程。

items.title: Diamond Maximal Operators: Classification, Moduli, and Oscillation Envelopes
items.excerpt: We study maximal averages generated by bounded cancellative kernels taking values in finite-dimensional real normed spaces, on Euclidean balls and on balls in a non-Archimedean local field with a fixed uniformizer. For angular kernels, pointwise domination of the full maximal operators is equivalent to factorization of their angular averaging maps, with the same optimal constant. Nonzero scalar angular comparison classes are therefore projective kernel classes. For angular kernels constant on a fixed finite measurable partition of the direction space, symmetric convex bodies classify exact norm measurements, Grassmannians parametrize nonzero classes under mutual domination, and positive semidefinite Gram matrices classify Hilbert-valued measurements. For general kernels, the closed convex hull of the averaging densities obtained from all scales and the dual unit ball is a complete invariant of the full maximal operator. A dilation example exhibits identifications of residue kernels beyond scaling and unit-coordinate changes. For nonzero radial residue kernels on bounded inputs, mutual domination is classified by the unit-circle zeros
items.title_zh: 钻石极大算子：分类、模数和振荡包络线
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由有界抵消核生成的最大平均值，该核在有限维实范范空间、欧几里得球和具有固定均匀器的非阿基米德局部场中的球上取值。对于角度核，完整极大算子的逐点支配相当于对其角度平均图进行因式分解，具有相同的最佳常数。因此，非零标量角度比较类是投影核类。对于方向空间的固定有限可测量分区上的角核常数，对称凸体对精确范数测量进行分类，格拉斯曼主义者对相互支配下的非零类进行参数化，正半定格拉姆矩阵对希尔伯特值测量进行分类。对于一般核，从所有尺度和双单位球获得的平均密度的闭合凸包是完全极大算子的完全不变量。膨胀示例展示了除缩放和单位坐标变化之外的残差内核的识别。对于有界输入上的非零径向剩余核，相互支配由单位圆零点分类

items.title: On the Ramanujan-Ligozat modular unit
items.excerpt: Let $\chi$ be the quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $N$ associated with a given real quadratic field $k$ and let $X_\chi(N)$ be the double covering of $X_0(N)$ associated with $\chi$. In this note, we study a modular unit $f$ on the curve $X_\chi(N)$. We prove that the transform of $f$ by the Fricke involution $\mathscr{w}_N$ is the level $N$ analogue of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction introduced by Lee and Park. Furthermore, if $N$ is a positive prime discriminant, then $f$ is Ligozat's modular unit, which is known from Mazur's work on the Eisenstein ideal. We extend Ligozat's construction to any positive fundamental discriminant $N$.
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\chi$ 为与给定实二次场 $k$ 关联的导体 $N$ 的二次狄利克雷特征，并令 $X_\chi(N)$ 为与 $\chi$ 关联的 $X_0(N)$ 的双重覆盖。在本文中，我们研究曲线 $X_\chi(N)$ 上的模块化单元 $f$。我们证明$f$通过Fricke对合$\mathscr{w}_N$的变换是Lee和Park引入的Rogers-Ramanujan连续分数的$N$级类似物。此外，如果 $N$ 是正素判别式，那么 $f$ 就是 Ligozat 的模单元，这是从 Mazur 关于爱森斯坦理想的工作中得知的。我们将 Ligozat 的构造扩展到任何正的基本判别式 $N$。
items.title_zh: 关于 Ramanujan-Ligozat 模块化单元

items.title: The exact Euclidean window of $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$
items.excerpt: Let $R = \mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$, let $\pi = 4 + \sqrt{14}$, and let $\mathfrak{p} = (2,\sqrt{14}) = \pi R$ be the prime ideal above $2$. Cavallar and Lemmermeyer studied the multiplicative weighted norms $\phi_{t}(x) = |N(x)|(t/2)^{v_{\pi}(x)}$ and asked for which weights $t$ they are Euclidean functions on $R$. We show that the set of these weights, the Euclidean window of $\mathfrak{p}$, is $(\sqrt{5},T]$, where $T$ is the algebraic number \[ T = \sqrt{\frac{8}{104051\sqrt{2} - 55617\sqrt{7}}} = 2.2468286690\ldots = \sqrt{5} + 0.0107606915\ldots. \] Thus the window is nonempty but not open. We also obtain the integer-valued completely multiplicative Euclidean function $2^{v_{\pi}(x)}|N(x)|^{6}$ on $R$.
items.title_zh: $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$ 的精确欧几里得窗口
items.excerpt_zh: 令$R = \mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$，令$\pi = 4 + \sqrt{14}$，令$\mathfrak{p} = (2,\sqrt{14}) = \pi R$ 为$2$ 以上的素理想。 Cavallar 和 Lemmermeyer 研究了乘法加权范数 $\phi_{t}(x) = |N(x)|(t/2)^{v_{\pi}(x)}$ 并询问它们是 $R$ 上的欧几里得函数的权重 $t$。我们证明这些权重的集合，即 $\mathfrak{p}$ 的欧几里德窗口，为 $(\sqrt{5},T]$，其中 $T$ 是代数数 \[ T = \sqrt{\frac{8}{104051\sqrt{2} - 55617\sqrt{7}}} = 2.2468286690\ldots = \sqrt{5} + 0.0107606915\ldots。因此，窗口非空但未打开。我们还获得了 $R$ 上的整数值完全乘法欧几里得函数 $2^{v_{\pi}(x)}|N(x)|^{6}$。

items.title: Markoff spectra of Hecke groups
items.excerpt: We study the initial discrete parts of the Markoff spectra of Hecke groups of index $q\ge 5$. Using a digit expansion associated with geodesics and a Perron-type formula, we classify all bi-infinite digit sequences whose Markoff values lie at or below the first accumulation point. We obtain explicit formulas for the discrete spectral values and identify the sequences realizing them, including those attaining the first accumulation point. We also prove that the infinite family of discrete values increases strictly to this point. Our results recover Vulakh's description of the initial discrete spectra through an explicit symbolic approach.
items.title_zh: Hecke 群的马尔可夫谱
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究索引 $q\ge 5$ 的赫克群马尔可夫谱的初始离散部分。使用与测地线相关的数字扩展和 Perron 型公式，我们对马尔科夫值位于或低于第一个累积点的所有双无限数字序列进行分类。我们获得了离散谱值的显式公式，并识别了实现它们的序列，包括那些达到第一个累积点的序列。我们还证明了离散值的无限族严格增加到这一点。我们的结果通过明确的符号方法恢复了 Vulakh 对初始离散光谱的描述。

items.title: Almost Empty Monochromatic Polygons in Planar Point Sets
items.excerpt: For integers $r \ge 3$, $c \ge 2$, and $s \ge 0$, let $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ denote the smallest integer such that any set of at least $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ points in the plane in general position (no three on a line), colored with $c$ colors, contains a monochromatic $r$-gon (not necessarily convex) with at most $s$ interior points. Define $\lambda_r^{\star}(c)$ to be the smallest integer such that $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,\lambda_r^{\star}(c)) < \infty$. The case of triangles, that is, $r=3$, has been studied in recent years. In this paper, we establish bounds on $\lambda_r^{\star}(c)$, for $r \ge 4$. Specifically, in the bichromatic case, we prove that $\lambda_r^{\star}(2)\leq \lfloor\frac{r-2}{2}\rfloor$, for every $r\geq3$. For hexagons, we sharpen this bound to $\lambda_6^{\star}(2)\leq1$, that is, every sufficiently large bichromatic planar point set in general position contains a monochromatic hexagon with at most one interior point. items.title_zh: 平面点集中几乎空的单色多边形

items.title: Unranking $S$-avoiding permutations with two forbidden offsets
items.excerpt: Given a finite family of combinatorial objects with a total order, ranking asks for the position of a given object, and unranking asks for the object occupying a given position. Both provide algorithmic access to families too large to enumerate. Kagey gave a polynomial-time algorithm for several position-restricted families and left open the case of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations. We show that when $|S| = 2$, the graph of forbidden squares is $2$-regular, a disjoint union of cycles, and that fixing a prefix leaves only paths and untouched cycles. This yields polynomial-time prefix counting, ranking and unranking for every two-element set of offsets, covering $\{-1,1\}$. The same structure gives a short proof that the number of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations equals the $n$-th m\'enage number for odd $n$ and exceeds it by $2$ for even $n$, proving a conjecture recorded in the OEIS entry A354152.
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个具有总顺序的有限组合对象族，排序要求给定对象的位置，而取消排序则要求占据给定位置的对象。两者都提供了对太大而无法枚举的族的算法访问。 Kagey 给出了几个位置受限族的多项式时间算法，并保留了 $\{-1,1\}$ 避免排列的情况。我们证明当 $|S| = 2$，禁止方块的图是$2$-正则，循环的不相交并集，固定前缀只留下路径和未触及的循环。这会为每个偏移量的二元素集生成多项式时间前缀计数、排序和取消排序，覆盖 $\{-1,1\}$。相同的结构给出了一个简短的证明，即对于奇数 $n$，$\{-1,1\}$ 避免排列的数量等于第 $n$-th m\'enage 数，对于偶数 $n$ 则超过 $2$，从而证明了 OEIS 条目 A354152 中记录的猜想。
items.title_zh: 取消 $S$ 的排名 - 避免具有两个禁止偏移的排列

items.title: Planar Disk Filters and Real Chromatic Roots at Beraha Numbers
items.excerpt: We construct simple plane triangulations whose chromatic polynomials have real roots accumulating at every noninteger Beraha number $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$; the integer values $0,1,2,3$ are roots of $K_4$. The construction rests on the observation that a triangulated disk with four boundary vertices acts, inside a larger triangulation, as a transfer operator lying in a commutative three-parameter algebra. Rotating such disks by a quarter turn and composing them in series moves their eigenvalue triples around this algebra in a controllable way, and for every fixed $q\in(B_{10},4)$ one can manufacture a finite disk whose two competing local eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the third -- a physical filter. Closing a grid of such disks between two poles produces a sphere triangulation, and a fused Temperley-Lieb trace identity accounts for its chromatic polynomial completely, sector by sector, with no appeal to semisimplicity at the root of unity itself -- generic semisimplicity enters only through polynomial identities continued from $\delta>2$ -- and no singular higher Jones-Wenzl projectors. items.excerpt_zh: 我们构造简单的平面三角剖分，其色多项式的实根在每个非整数 Beraha 数 $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$ 处累加；整数值 $0,1,2,3$ 是 $K_4$ 的根。该构造基于以下观察：具有四个边界顶点的三角圆盘在较大的三角剖分内充当可交换三参数代数中的传递算子。将这些圆盘旋转四分之一圈并将它们串联起来，以可控的方式围绕该代数移动它们的特征值三元组，并且对于每个固定的 $q\in(B_{10},4)$ ，我们可以制造一个有限圆盘，其两个相互竞争的局部特征值严格受第三个（物理滤波器）支配。关闭两个极点之间的此类圆盘网格会产生球体三角剖分，并且融合的 Temperley-Lieb 迹恒等式完全逐个扇区地解释其色多项式，而无需在单位本身的根上诉诸半简单性 - 通用半简单性仅通过从 $\delta>2$ 继续的多项式恒等式进入 - 并且没有奇异的更高 Jones-Wenzl 投影仪。在单一上限领域，克赖因型 ar

items.title: New lower bounds for binary constant-weight codes from prescribed-automorphism search, and two quantum codes meeting their upper bounds
items.excerpt: We give explicit binary constant-weight codes that raise the lower bounds on $A(n,6,w)$ in eight cells of Brouwer's table, all now listed there. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: $A(27,6,11)\ge 19305$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24453$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 18642$ and $A(28,6,9)\ge 11154$, together with an explicit $A(24,6,12)$ code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: $A(29,6,10)\ge 27183$, $A(29,6,11)\ge 42042$, $A(29,6,9)\ge 14781$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 19110$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24804$, $A(28,6,9)\ge 11388$ and $A(27,6,13)\ge 27783$, three of which replace first-round values. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group $\mathrm{A\Gamma L}(1,27)$, its index-2 subgroup, or $\mathrm{AGL}(1,23)$, acting on all but at most two coordinates. The orbits were chosen by maximum-weight independent set search on the orbit conflict graph: branch and bound in the first round, iterated local search in the second.
